programme.title: White Oluja / Bela oluja
programme.desc: The rebellious teenager even decides to join the crew of the Albatros sailboat. The employee on board is a strict Captain Sheldon, and besides him, other people of different fate will be found on board. The adventure of life will suddenly turn into a fight for survival. / Buntovni tinejdžer Čak odlučuje da se priključi posadi jedrenjaka Albatros. Zapovednik na brodu je strogi kapetan Šeldon, a osim njega na brodu će se naći i drugi ljudi različitih sudbina. Avantura života nenadano će se pretvoriti u borbu za preživljavanje.

programme.title: Aight of 2 / Matorani 2
programme.desc: Another comedy that continues to show the life of five old friends and their families. Leni returns to her hometown together with his family. In this continuation, the MATORANI will need to learn which lesson from your children ... / Još jedna komedija koja nastavlja da prikazuje život pet starih prijatelja i njihovih porodica. Leni se vraća u rodni grad zajedno sa svojom porodicom. U ovome nastavku matorani će morati da nauče koju lekciju od svoje dece...

programme.title: Rubin red / Rubin crvena
programme.desc: Gwen is a teenager who grew up in the shadow of his cousin Charlotte, for which everyone believes inherited by a gene passed on to the female line in the family and giving her the opportunity to travel through time. At the celebration of the Charlotte Sixteenth Birthday, Gwen happen to strange things and she starts traveling at times. He soon reveals that she was actually long-awaited last person who will have this privilege. / Gven je tinejdžerka koja je odrastala u senci svoje rođake Šarlot, za koju svi veruju da je nasledila gen koji se prenosi ženskom linijom u porodici i koji joj daje mogućnost da putuje kroz vreme. Na proslavi Šarlotinog šesnaestog rođendana, Gven se dešavaju čudne stvari i ona na momente počne da putuje kroz vreme. Ubrzo otkriva da je ona zapravo dugoočekivana poslednja osoba koja će imati ovu privilegiju.

programme.title: She is male / Ona je muško
programme.desc: Violin Brother Sebastian traveled to London. Dressed into him, Viola goes to his elite school, and falls in love with his teammate of Djuk, but he thinks she is a man. Shortly, it realizes that it is only a part of a very complicated love puzzle in which the Djukova girl Olivia, as well as Sebastian's girlfriend Monik. It turns out that the role she took over is more difficult than he imagined, and that he would not be easy to find a way out of the maze in which he got involved. / Violin brat Sebastijan je otputovao u London. Prerušena u njega, Viola odlazi u njegovu elitnu školu, i zaljubljuje se u njegovog saigrača Djuka, ali on misli da je ona muškarac. Ubrzo, shvata da je to samo deo veoma komplikovane ljubavne slagalice u koju su uklučeni i Djukova devojka Olivija, kao i Sebastijanova devojka Monik. Ispostavlja se da je uloga koju je preuzela teža nego što je on zamišljala, te da neće biti baš lako pronaći izlaz iz lavirinta u koji se upetljala.

programme.title: Today 13, tomorrow 30 / Danas 13, sutra 30
programme.desc: Girl for his thirteenth birthday, after a party that becomes a real disaster, he has only one wish: to be adult. Her wish is magically realized overnight. Jenna Rink is now a beautiful thirty year old who has the perfect job and a dream home. But in her seemingly perfect life is missing her ex best friend Met ... / Devojčica za svoj trinaesti rođendan, posle zabave koja postane prava katastrofa, ima samo jednu želju: da bude punoletna. Njena želja se magično ostvaruje preko noći. Džena Rink je sada prelepa tridesetogodišnjakinja koja ima savršen posao i dom iz snova. Ali u njenom naizgled savršenom životu nedostaje njen bivši najbolji prijatelj Met...

programme.title: Pentecost executives 2 / Isterivači duhova 2
programme.desc: Due to the new danger of a supernatural disaster that threatens New York, ghost-outers are again on a serious task. / Usled nove opasnosti od natprirodne katastrofe koja preti Njujorku, isterivači duhova su ponovo na ozbiljnom zadatku.

programme.title: Elektra / Elektra
programme.desc: After the traumatic experience of a close encounter with death, the warrior of the Elektra experiences a side transformation - becomes a paid killer. However, he is still persecuted by childhood memories. When he recognizes the widow from the neighborhood and his daughter in his metals, she decides to protect them from the team of wicked mercenaries. / Nakon traumatičnog iskustva bliskog susreta sa smrću, ratnica Elektra doživljava naobičnu transformaciju - postaje plaćeni ubica. Međutim, i dalje je progone sećanja na detinjstvo. Kada u svojim metama prepozna udovca iz komšiluka i njegovu ćerku, ona odlučuje da ih zaštiti od ekipe opakih plaćenika.

programme.title: Goust Radder / Goust Rajder
programme.desc: On aim long time, Johnny sold the soul to the devil. While During day, he works as a well-known cascader, he finds evil souls on earth at night. When he meets a girl again that he once loved, he realized that the only love can bring him back on the right path and help him return his soul. / Još davno, Džoni je prodao dušu đavolu. Dok danju radi kao poznati kaskader, noću pronalazi zle duše na zemlji. Kada ponovo sretne devojku koju je nekad voleo, on uviđa da jedino ljubav može da ga vrati na pravi put i pomogne mu da vrati svoju dušu.

programme.title: Fierce girls / Žestoke devojke
programme.desc: Sara Eshburn is a special FBI agent, it is strict and responsible, and he receives a grumpy Boston Police for the partner, Šennon Mulins. The two of them have the task of working together on the case of the arrest of the dangerous head of the Narco Mafia. Their relationship is extremely interesting, considering that none of them had a previous partner, especially not a partner who could become a true friend. / Sara Ešburn je specijalni FBI agent, stroga je i odgovorna, a za partnerku dobija mrzovoljnu bostonsku policajku, Šenon Mulins. Njih dve imaju zadatak da zajedno rade na slučaju hapšenja opasnog šefa narko mafije. Njihov odnos je izuzetno zanimljiv, s obzirom na to da nijedna od njih nije imala ranije partnera, pogotovo ne partnera koji bi mogao da postane i pravi prijatelj.

programme.title: The search / Potraga
programme.desc: The directorial debut Jean-Claude outside the lady, who plays and a major role in this film full of action. The year is 1925. and a competition in martial arts are held. Young New Yorkin Chris will get the opportunity to correct the mistakes from the past and win the prestigious title of the winner of this tournament, which brings him a valuable statue made of gold. / Rediteljski debi Žan-Klod Van Dama, koji igra i glavnu ulogu u ovom filmu prepunom akcije. Godina je 1925. i održava se takmičenje u borilačkim veštinama. Mladi Njujorčanin Kris dobiće priliku da ispravi greške iz prošlosti i osvoji prestižnu titulu pobednika ovog turnira, koja mu donosi i vrednu statuu napravljenu od zlata.

programme.title: Eighth passenger 2 / Osmi putnik 2
programme.desc: The Oscarovac James Cameron is taking the rudder while the safe Viver returns to this dark universe. programme.title: American Football: NFL - The Best of / Američki fudbal: NFL - The best of
programme.desc: The largest and most popular NFL football league was founded in 1920. years, but by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, the present version of the competition was created. The league performs 32 teams divided into two conferences. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The top six teams conferencing enters the playoff to the Great Final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podeljene u dve konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plejof do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Spartak - Crvena Zvezda / Košarka - ABA liga: Spartak - Crvena Zvezda
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. programme.title: Football - Croatian League: Osijek - Dinamo / Fudbal - Hrvatska liga: Osijek - Dinamo
programme.desc: The Croatian football league was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Cibona - Future / Košarka - ABA liga: Cibona - Budućnost
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football - Montenegrin League: Lake - Future / Fudbal - Crnogorska liga: Jezero - Budućnost
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Fudbal - Carabao Cup: Tottenham - Manchester United / Fudbal - Carabao Cup: Tottenham - Manchester United
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike its popular FA Cup brother, starts its history in the 1960s and 20th centuries using the possibility of playing under the spotlight in the evening hours it was not possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg brata FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Osasuna - Villarreal / Fudbal - Španska liga: Osasuna - Villarreal
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path set after the hand of Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team of Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Fudbal - Švedska Liga: Hacken - Elfsborg / Fudbal - Švedska liga: Hacken - Elfsborg
programme.desc: Swedish football league or Allsvenskan is the highest rank of club football in Sweden. League was founded in 1924. under the interference of the Swedish Football Association and in today's format are competing 16 teams on the system of a two-circular competition with domestic and visiting meetings. After 30 played circuits, the champion is a team that gathered the largest number of points. League is played from the end of March or early April to the beginning of November. The team with the most conquered titles of Sweden is Malmo with 23 conquered titles. / Švedska fudbalska liga ili Allsvenskan je najviši rang klupskog fudbala u Švedskoj. Liga je osnovana 1924. godine pod ingerencijom Švedskog fudbalskog saveza te se u današnjem formatu takmiče 16 ekipa po sistemu dvokružnog takmičenja sa domaćim i gostujućim susretima. Nakon 30 odigranih kola prvak je ekipa koja je skupila najveći broj bodova. Liga se igra od kraja marta ili početka aprila do početka novembra. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula Švedske je Malme sa 23 osvojene titule.

programme.title: Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos, G4 / Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos, G4
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. programme.title: Basketball - Germany League: Heidelberg - Bayern, G2 / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Heidelberg - Bayern, G2
programme.desc: The history of the German club basketball dates back to 1939. years, but the German basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964. while only the competition sets two years later. The last two of the regular part of the regular part drop out in the lower rank, while the Plejofor gets the Best of Five format where the teams must receive minimum 3 matches from 5 to eject the rivals. programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.title: I want to tell you / Želim da ti kažem
programme.desc: The show I want to tell you is a collective program that is broadcast live from the Devetdvojka study, and which Water Teodora Todorović and Marina Kotevski. The emission has a main topic that the leaders are processing with the help of guests in a study from a slightly different angle, but also cover all the corners and their guests comment on each other. Whether it is about current topics, symbolism, social phenomena to talk about, Theodor and Marina are there that for viewers to the topic of the presentation in the best way. / Emisija Želim da ti kažem je kolažni program koji se uživo emituje iz studija devesetdvojke, a koju vode Teodora Todorović i Marina Kotevski. Emisija svakog dana ima glavnu temu koju voditeljke obrađuju uz pomoć gostiju u studiju iz nešto drugačijeg ugla, ali i na određenu temu pokrivaju sve uglove i sa svojim gostima svaki od njih komentarišu. Bilo da su u pitanju aktuelne teme, simbolika, društveni fenomeni o kojima treba pričati, Teodora i Marina su tu da za gledaoce temu predstave na najbolji način.

programme.title: Fertile and gender / Plodno i rodno
programme.desc: Agriculture changes quickly, like never before. The branch of the economy that once enjoyed the status of static, experienced the explosion of biotechnological innovations, major steps in genetics, large market changes and earthquakes. In the crowd of information, new laws, regulations, credit lines, growing ways, new races - the prostrate program and gender will help you follow the development and you adapt to new tendencies. / Poljoprivreda se poslednjih godina menja brzo, kao nikad do sada. Grana ekonomije koja je nekada uživala status statične, doživela je eksploziju biotehnoloških inovacija, krupne korake u genetici, velike tržišne promene i potrese. U gomili informacija, o novim zakonima, uredbama, kreditnim linijama, novim tehnološkim rešenjima, načinima gajenja, novim rasama - program Plodno i rodno pomoćiće vam da se snađete, pratite razvoj i na vreme se prilagodite novim tendencijama.

programme.title: China - a holy taste / Kina - Svet Ukusa
programme.desc: China - The world of Drustaja Chinese documentary on food that was produced by the Tencent, Doclabs Beijing and the Chinese International Television Corporation. This documentary series after the series of bite of China, another work of Chen Xiaoqing, which provides wider insight and a higher view of the world of food. The biggest advantage of this DuCument series is his world character, that the uniqueness of Chinese food is evoking from the global perspective, so that the Chinese culinary culture in the international framework once again receives the interpretation and promotion. / Kina - Svet Ukusaje kineski dokumentarac o hrani koji je nastao u produkciji Tencent-a, Doclabs Beijing i Kineske međunarodne televizijske korporacije. Ovaj dokumentarni serijal je nakon serijala Zalogaj Kine još jedno delo reditelja Chen Xiaoqing-a, koje pruža širi uvid i viši pogled na svet hrane. programme.title: Serbia works, Serbia is being built / Srbija radi, Srbija se gradi
programme.desc: Dragana Mandic moves on an exciting journey to meet with people who deal with interesting jobs. Remember the old crafts and get to know people who deal with traditional and somewhat forgotten jobs. / Dragana Mandić kreće na uzbudljivo putovanje na kome će se sresti sa ljudima koji se bave zanimljivim poslovima. programme.title: Bodybuilder / Kulturista
programme.desc: The series of culturist emissions is engaged in the research of cultural heritage (customs) and locations in the Balkans witnessing ancient times. The cultural and tourist offer of the Balkans is rich in incredible and few-known places, which keep renovation of the picturesque past, people and events that have lived in this area by printing them almost a fairytale history that is the cultural foundation of our people today. Through the series, we will discover an unconventional type of ethno-tourism, relying on the far well-known Serbian hospitality, giving an incentive and idea to see the viewers and those of our space travel and research. / Serijal emisija Kulturista se bavi istraživanjem kulturnog nasleđa (običaja) i lokacija na Balkanu koje su svedoci davnih vremena. Kulturna i turistička ponuda Balkana je bogata neverovatnim i malo poznatim mestima, koja čuvaju sećanje na živopisnu prošlost, ljude i događaje koji su živeli na ovim prostorima ispisujući im gotovo bajkovitu istoriju koja je kulturološki temelj našeg naroda danas. programme.title: Life is to go / Život sa Koradžijom
programme.desc: The Founder's family is the founder of Koragija, known for its excellent pitas and busters. With this craft, they deal with over half a century when Grandma Mitar began a step-down tradition. Through the story, the youngest member of the family, Andrej. He decided that the old brand to be a new guard, to resist his times and retained his place among the most delicious old crafts. At the same time, he gives motivation to young people to start their business, keep tradition and come true in what they love. / Porodica Antanasijević osnivač je brenda Koradžija, poznatog po izvrsnim pitama i burecima. Ovim zanatom se bave preko pola veka kada je baka Mitra započela koradžijsku tradiciju. Kroz priču nas vodi najmlađi član porodice, Andreja. On je rešio da starom brendu da novo ruho, kako bi odoleo vremenu i zadržao svoje mesto među najukusnijim starim zanatima. Ujedno, on daje motivaciju mladim ljudima da započnu svoj biznis, čuvaju tradiciju i ostvare se u onome što vole.

programme.title: Water paths / Vodene Staze
programme.desc: In the continuation of the water trail series, we will feel the wild and tame of the Green River, Vrbas, which flows through the largest city of Republika Srpska. We will drop with its most beautiful parts, stop in the best places and meet a spa port from another angle. You will find out what is the difference between Base and Kajmak, how to go down the rapids in the boat, we will visit the monastery near the river Vrbas, drive a boat dajak which is part of the interesting tourist offer Banja Luka, see how kraft beer is cooked. / U nastavku serijala Vodene staze osetićemo divlju i pitomu stranu zelene reke, Vrbas, koja protiče kroz najveći grad Republike Srpske. Spustićemo se njenim najlepšim delovima, zaustaviti na najboljim mestima i upoznati Banja Luku iz drugog ugla. Saznaćete koja je razlika između base i kajmaka, kako je spuštati se brzacima Vrbasa u čamcu, šta se jede posle rafatinga… Obići ćemo manastir u mestu Krupa, trapistički samostan u blizini reke Vrbas, voziti se čamcem dajak koji je deo zanimljive turističke ponude Banja Luke, videti kako se kuva kraft pivo.

programme.title: Right in target / Pravo u metu
programme.desc: The right in target is a series where you experienced hunters lead you through famous Serbian hunting grounds showing the importance of hunting for ecology and maintaining balance in nature as well as the potential of the hunting Turmeric of our country. Serbia is rich in numerous hunting grounds in which there are many noble species of wild animals that hunters take care of, breaking the prejudice that they are just those who liquidate them. Get ready to hear the call of nature that will open your lavish door by getting to know you with all the mysteries of the fauna that lives in it. Our hunters will also introduce you to security measures to be taken when you enter the world of wild animals, as well as how to not experience you as intruders. Find out if all hunting stories are true, get ready to adrenaline and arm yourself for adventure. / Pravo u metu je serijal u kome vas iskusni lovci vode kroz čuvena srpska lovišta prikazujući značaj lova za ekologiju i održavanje balansa u prirodi kao i potencijal lovnog turzima naše zemlje. Srbija je bogata brojnim lovištima u kojima postoji mnogo plemenitih vrsta divljih životinja o kojima lovci brinu, razbijajući predrasudu da su oni samo oni koji ih likvidiraju. Spremite se da čujete zov prirode koja će vam otvoriti svoja raskošna vrata upoznajući vas sa svim misterijama faune koja u njoj živi. Naši lovci će vas upoznati i sa merama bezbednosti koje treba preduzeti kada ulazite u svet divljih životinja, kao i kako da vas one ne dožive kao uljeze. Saznajte da li su sve lovačke priče istinite, spremite se na adrenalin I naoružajte se za avanturu.

programme.title: Golden hands / Zlatne ruke
programme.desc: Go with us on a journey through time. The golden-hand emission reveals you the oldest Balkan crafts. Forgotten skills occupying a special place in the cultural heritage of the people of these areas. Kazandžijska craft, Kosovo embroidery, naive painting of Slovaks, are just some of the crafts to introduce you in this series. / Pođite sa nama na putovanje kroz vreme. Emisija Zlatne ruke vam otkriva najstarije zanate Balkana. Zaboravljene veštine koje zauzimaju posebno mesto u kulturnom nasleđu naroda ovih prostora. Kazandžijski zanat, kosovski vez, naivno slikarstvo Slovaka, samo su neki od zanata koje ćemo vam predstaviti u ovom serijalu.

programme.title: The song of my city / Pesma Moga Grada
programme.desc: One of the most beautiful features of Serbia is certainly music. Each end of the country has specific melodies and ways of performing them. The series of the song of my city through music depicts various Serb cities, through several categories - love, sad, cheerful, city and traditional song. Indulge in this music journey from Sevdah to Meraka on the most beautiful destinations of Serbia!. / Jedno od najlepših obeležja Srbije svakako je muzika. Svaki kraj zemlje ima specifične melodije i načine izvođenja istih. Serijal Pesma moga grada kroz muziku oslikava različite srpske gradove, i to kroz nekoliko kategorija – ljubavnu, tužnu, veselu, gradsku i tradicionalnu pesmu. programme.title: The alphabet of our lives / Azbuka našeg života
programme.desc: In the center of the intriguing, entertainment, but on moments and heavy and tragicomic stories is an urban Belgrade family and a married couple Popović. Behind Vesna and Uroš is twenty-five years of living together, in which, from the juvenile rapture and passion, they entered with student love, eager for a better tomorrow and success in a trivial society in which it is all permitted to reach status, career and money. Nevertheless, a quarter of a century later, after acquired all material goods, while their children are studying abroad, this seemingly ideal family, begins to break up. Vesna and Uroš then realize that they are in the fight for material - lost itself. Such, defeated and embarrassed, running away from reality, wander through love adventures, scams, lies, solitude, biting conscience and the crisis of their own identities. The story follows the parallel female and male side. Through a dynamic action, frequent Fleshbekov, which evoke us otherwise, the past dimension of their priority that enriches the drama of the world's sincerity - about the crisis of the family and interpersonal relationships, the crisis of our society, identity crisis. Excised through the fate of a married couple, this is actually a story about all of us, about modern families, about the divorce epidemic, about the loneliness of the modern man. The alphabet of our lives is a story about love, about missed lives, about disappointment, ostentation and repentance, about trying to catch at least a fraction of the Procedure of happiness. / U središtu intrigantne, zabavne, ali na momente i teške i tragikomične priče je urbana beogradska porodica i bračni par Popović. Iza Vesne i Uroša je dvadeset i pet godina zajedničkog života, u koji su, iz mladalačke zanesenosti i strasti, ušli nošeni studentskom ljubavlju, željni boljeg sutra i uspeha u trivijalnom društvu u kojem je sve dozvoljeno da bi se došlo do statusa, karijere i novca. Ipak, četvrt veka kasnije, nakon što su stekli sva materijalna dobra, dok im se deca školuju u inostranstvu, ova naizgled idealna porodica, počinje da se raspada. Vesna i Uroš tada shvataju da su u borbi za materijalno – izgubili sebe. Takvi, poraženi i posramljeni, bežeći od realnosti, tumaraju kroz ljubavne avanture, prevare, laži, samoću, grižu savesti i krizu sopstvenih identiteta. Priča prati paralelno žensku i mušku stranu. Kroz dinamičnu radnju, česte flešbekove, koji nam dočaravaju drugačiju, onu prošlu dimenziju njihove životne priče, zatim kroz voice-over naraciju koja obogaćuje dramu ličnim doživljajima glavnih likova, serija nam donosi iskrenu priču o veoma aktuelnim društvenim pojavama – o krizi porodice i međuljudskih odnosa, krizi srednjih godina, krizi našeg društva, krizi identiteta. Ispričano kroz sudbinu jednog bračnog para, ovo je zapravo priča o svima nama, o modernim porodicama, o epidemiji razvoda, o usamljenosti savremenog čoveka. Azbuka našeg života je priča o ljubavi, o promašenim životima, o razočaranju, o otrežnjenju i pokajanju, o pokušaju da se uhvati makar delić proćerdane sreće.

programme.title: Storm / Oluja
programme.desc: The shop is located in the period - a few days before the Operation Storm until the end of the operation, with an epilog, which is briefly displayed and the refugee life of our heroes and their navigation outside Krajina. The action occurs through two dominant lines. One follows the life of Ilija, deer and their son Petra. Ilija is a diversal that a storm is followed while on the front and Ilija from the War Hell is cramping tricked to return to the family. Ilija does not know that his wife and son is in the column, nor does he assume where and how their persecution will end. In search of them, Ilija loses his friends from the company and barely saves his own life. The second line follows the life of the former legionary of honor - Danet, the perfect soldier and the killer, who returns to the gender village after he learned that Ustashas killed his brother of the twin somewhere in Croatia. Dane Mother gives the promise to bring the body of his brother and will be buried in a family tomb. While Serbian troops are drawn up as the storm destroyed Krajina through persecution, in contrast, it is deeply pierceed towards the interior of Croatia, cleaning every enemy on the road, would not come to his brother's body and returned him home. The family represents the nucleus of these stories and through their suffering, escape, sacrifice and struggle, the whole context and horror through which the inhabitants of the Serbian Krajina are through. This story also abounds in episodes and images that are leaning into true stories, destinies and confessions of Krajina refugees. The vision from which the story is observed comes from the twelve-year-old Petra, / Radnja je smeštena u period - nekoliko dana pre operacije Oluja sve do završetka operacije, s epilogom koji se ukratko prikazuje i izbegličku život naših junaka i njihovo snalaženje izvan Krajine. Radnja se događa kroz dve dominante narativne linije. Jedna prati život Ilije, Jelene i njihovog sina Petra. Ilija je diverzant kojeg Oluja zadesi dok je na frontu i Ilija iz ratnog pakla grčevito pokušava da se vrati porodici. Ilija ne zna da su mu supruga i sin u koloni, niti pretpostavlja gde i kako će se završiti njihov progon. U potrazi za njima, Ilija gubi svoje prijatelje iz čete i jedva spašava sopstveni život. Druga linija prati život bivšeg legionara časti – Daneta, savršenog vojnika i ubicu, koji se vraća u rodno selo nakon što je saznao da su ustaše ubili njegovog brata blizanca negde na teritoriji Hrvatske. Dane majci daje obećanje da će doneti telo svog brata i da će biti sahranjen u porodičnoj grobnici. Dok se srpske trupe povlače i dok Oluja razara Krajinu kroz progon, Dane se, nasuprot tome, duboko probija prema unutrašnjosti Hrvatske, čisti svakog neprijatlja koji mu se nađe na putu, ne bi li došao do bratovog tela i vratio ga kući. Porodica predstavlja nukleus ove priče i kroz njihovo stradanje, bežanje, žrtvovanje i borbu prikazuje se ceo kontekst i užas kroz koji su prošli stanovnici Srpske Krajine. Ova priča obiluje i epizodama i slikama koje se naslanjaju i na istinite priče, sudbine i ispovesti krajinskih izbeglica. Vizura iz koje se priča posmatra dolazi od dvanaestogodišnjaka Petra,

programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: These are family members Savković. Mother Grozda, proud owner of the florists. The younger son of Ljubisa, mathematics teacher. programme.title: Team drim / Drim tim
programme.desc: Workers and certain wrinkles of cadastre arrive at the field - representative of the investor Marli Konstrakšn, who has permission to raise a new residential complex at the place where they will destroy the Ikin of the cafe and the stadium. In an attempt to save the terrain from the announced construction and the movement family, Ilija resorts to all legal and illegal methods: decides to join the Political Parties, and in those in the opposition, as well as, in case of crime. But the sons and their wives will not even hear that, except to devote to crime, which seems to them much fairer and cost-effective activity from politics. That is why Ilija is emergency that their decision, after the strict selection between sons, impose force. / Na teren stižu radnici i izvesni Bora Katastar - predstavnik investitora Marli konstrakšn, koji ima dozvolu da podigne novi stambeni kompleks na mestu gde će da poruši Ikinu kafanu i stadion. U pokušaju da spase teren od najavljene gradnje a porodicu od selidbe, Ilija poseže za svim legalnim i nelegalnim metodama: odlučuje da sinove preko veze učlani u političke stranke, i u one na vlasti i na one u opoziciji, kao i, za svaki slučaj - u svet kriminala. Ali sinovi i njihove žene za to neće ni da čuju, izuzev da se posvete kriminalu, što im izgleda kao mnogo poštenija i isplativija delatnost od politike. Zato je Ilija u nuždi da im svoju odluku, posle strogog odabira između sinova, nametne silom.

programme.title: Frimont / Frimont
programme.desc: Lower works in a Chinese cookie factory with San Francisco messages. The former interpreter for the American army in Afghanistan, she struggles to return his life to the track. At the moment of sudden revelation, he decides to send a special message in a cookie. / Donja radi u fabrici kineskih kolačića s porukama u San Francisku. Nekad prevodilac za američku vojsku u Avganistanu, ona se bori da vrati svoj život u kolosek. U trenutku iznenadnog otkrovenja, odlučuje da pošalje posebnu poruku u kolačiću.

programme.title: A letter of a pig / Pismo svinje
programme.desc: The traumatic memory of the Holocaust survivor is running a young student on the inner journey, looking at his own road while deleting the border between animal and human nature. / Traumatično sećanje osobe koja je preživela holokaust vodi mladu učenicu na unutrašnje putovanje, u potrazi za sopstvenim putem dok se briše granica između životinjske i ljudske prirode.

programme.title: Marinet / Marinet
programme.desc: Marinet Picon is one of the world's largest football stars and has been holding a record in the number of goals and matches for the French team (men / women together), before became the first French player with career to the United States. The film is following the fight of the pioneer of French women's football for the rights of women in sports. The path full of traps, from childhood that destroyed the violent father alcoholic, to the heavy burden of the era in which there are no LGBTQ + rights. Its success in sports will encourage her desire to contribute to the recognition of French women's football, homosexuality and equal possibilities. / Marinet Pićon jedna je od najvećih svetskih fudbalskih zvezda i skoro dve decenije držala je rekord po broju golova i utakmica za francuski tim (muškarci/žene zajedno), pre nego što je postala legenda FIFA tako što je postala prva francuska igračica s karijerom u SAD. Film prati borbu pionirke francuskog ženskog fudbala za prava žena u sportu. Put pun zamki, od detinjstva koje je razorio nasilni otac alkoholičar, do teškog bremena izlaska u eri u kojima ne postoje LGBTQ+ prava. Njen uspeh u sportu podstaći će njenu želju da doprinese priznavanju francuskog ženskog fudbala, homoseksualnosti i jednakih mogućnosti.

programme.title: Land of women / Zemlja žena
programme.desc: This is a historic drama inspired by the traditional Sardinian figure of Koge, a village witch. Fear and superstitions dominate the life of a girl who is seventh in the family with six girls. In the rural Sardinia at the end of the Second World War, Fidel is a village witch: Lei Zle makes up to everyone, but his none, because it is good that no man touches. And when Bastijan, the extramarital seventh daughter, entrusts Fidel, not only reveals the power of maternity, but begins to review all imposed beliefs and traditions. / Ovo je istorijska drama inspirisana tradicionalnom sardinijskom figurom Koge, seoske veštice. Strah i sujeverje dominiraju životom devojčice koja je sedma u porodici sa šest devojčica. U ruralnoj Sardiniji krajem Drugog svetskog rata, Fidela je seoska veštica: leči zle čini i svima porađa decu, ali svoju nema, jer je dobro da je nijedan čovek ne dodirne. A kad Bastijanu, vanbračnu sedmu ćerku, povere Fideli, ona ne samo da otkrije moć majčinstva, već počinje da preispituje sva nametnuta verovanja i tradicije.

programme.title: Wound of hesitation / Rana oklevanja
programme.desc: Criminal lawyer Canan shares his time between the morning in court and evening with his mother's hospital bed. On the date of the verdict for the murder suspected, Kanan defend, she faces a moral choice that will influence the lives of her mother, judge and accused. / Krivični advokat Kanan deli svoje vreme između jutarnjih sati na sudu i večeri uz bolnički krevet svoje majke. Na dan izricanja presude osumnjičenom za ubistvo kojeg Kanan brani, ona se suočava s moralnim izborom koji će uticati na živote njene majke, sudije i optuženog.

programme.title: Until love disassembles us / Dok nas ljubav ne rastavi
programme.desc: The thirty-year-old Shao should marry his long-term guy, a successful banker and fiancé hua, while he has a stable job in college. Nevertheless, during the visit of the school program of Europe, the cheers of the theater director Fan in Prague, in which he hopelessly falls in love. The fan, who has been living in Europe for many years, dedicated himself to the theater. Sha Hi See the other side of the world through his art. Fan is sensual, warm and full of creativity. This brief experience in Europe awakens the echo long longing. She returns to China and marry, the wheels of life turn on. He refrains from craving a fan, but her hopes was broken by brutal reality. Morny, discouraged and depressed, it brings the ultimate decision and moves to a revolutionary road ... / Tridesetogodišnja Šu Ćao treba da se uda za svog dugogodišnjeg momka, uspešnog bankara i verenika Hua, dok ima stabilan posao na koledžu. Ipak, tokom posete školskog programa Evropi, Šu sreće pozorišnig reditelja Fana u Pragu, u koga se beznadežno zaljubljuje. Fan, koji živi u Evropi već više godina, posvetio je sebe pozorištu. Šu Ćao vidi drugu stranu sveta preko njegove umetnosti. Fan je senzualan, topao i pun kreativnosti. Ovo kratko iskustvo u Evropi budi Šuinu dugogodišnju čežnju. Ona se vraća u Kinu i udaje se, točkovi života se okreću dalje. Uzdržava se da žudi za Fanom, ali njene nade je skršila brutalna realnost. Izmučena, obeshrabrena i depresivna, ona donosi krajnju odluku i kreće na revolucionarni put...

programme.title: Grandma Gloria / Baka Glorija
programme.desc: The six-year-old Kleo loves his nanny Gloria more than anything. When Gloria is suddenly forced to return to the green-tier islands to take care of his children, Kleo is made to promise to see each other soon. Gloria calls Kleo on his island and two of them have to better use their last summer. / Šestogodišnja Kleo voli svoju dadilju Gloriju više od svega. Kad je Glorija iznenada prinuđena da se vrati na Zelenortska ostrva da brine o svojoj deci, Kleo je natera da obeća da će se uskoro videti. Glorija poziva Kleo na svoje ostrvo i njih dve moraju što bolje da iskoriste svoje poslednje zajedničko leto.

programme.title: SNEG I Medved / Sneg i medved

programme.title: Lusia's story / Lusijina priča
programme.desc: During one night in 1989. in the middle of the Civil War in Salvador, six Jesuit priests were killed at the University of UC. The news has an immediate international echo as their contribution was key in the future peace agreement after the whole decade of the bloody war. Who killed them? The government immediately blamed Gerilce, but one eyewitness denied the official version. It's called Lussia and works as a cleaner in the UC. She saw who were real killers - the army. The United States will have to elect between testimony for the truth and protection of their families. / Tokom jedne noći 1989. godine, usred građanskog rata u Salvadoru, šest jezuitskih sveštenika ubijeno je na Univerzitetu UCA. Vest ima neposredan međunarodni odjek pošto je njihov doprinos bio ključan u budućem mirovnom sporazumu posle cele decenije krvavog rata. Ko ih je ubio? Vlada je odmah okrivila gerilce, ali jedan očevidac demantovao je zvaničnu verziju. Zove se Lusija i radi kao čistačica u UCA. Videla je ko su bile prave ubice ― vojska. Sad će morati da bira između svedočenja za istinu i zaštite svoje porodice.

programme.title: Power / Moć
programme.desc: The boy was accidentally killed in the informal hunt somewhere on the border of the two European countries. One of the interrogated Minister Berger, a candidate for the influential position of the High Commissioner for Water Management, who will have the task of finding a solution for the growing water shortage across Europe. The government hires a secret Stanner Agent to cover the scandal. The more exploring the case, increasingly involved in the dilemmas on power and its execution. / Dečak je slučajno ubijen u neformalnom lovu negde na granici dve evropske zemlje. Jedan od umešanih je ministar Berger, kandidat za uticajan položaj Visokog komesara za vodoprivredu, koji će imati zadatak da pronađe rešenje za sve veću nestašicu vode širom Evrope. Vlada angažuje tajnog agenta Stajnera da zataška skandal. Što više istražuje slučaj, sve se više upliće u dileme o moći i njenom izvršenju.

programme.title: Family business / Porodični posao
programme.desc: Three big stars are associated in this clear view of theft. Sean Koneri is a nice cheater whose son is (Dasta Hoffman) all his life on the right side of the law. But when the grandson of Metja Broderik leaves M.I.T. And asking the Conveyor's help in a perfect adventure, what can Hoffman be agreed? It is a robbery full of fun that proves that the family who robs together stays together - even if their time goes into a quarrel than in breaking! Directed by the Sidney Lamet (night in Manhattan). / Tri velike zvezde udružuju se u ovom vedrom pogledu na krađu. Šon Koneri je simpatični prevarant čiji je sin (Dastin Hofman) celog života na pravoj strani zakona. Ali kad unuk Metju Broderik napusti M.I.T. i zatraži Konerijevu pomoć u savršenoj avanturi, šta Hofman može sem da se složi? To je pljačka puna zabave koja dokazuje da porodica koja pljačka zajedno ostaje zajedno ― čak i ako im više vremena prođe u svađi nego u provaljivanju! U režiji Sidni Lameta (Noć na Menhetnu).

programme.title: Samaritan / Samarićanin
programme.desc: With Silvester Stalone in the main role, Samaritan is following a young boy (Javon wants Volton) while he reveals whether he is a mythic hero (Stallone) who kept his neighborhood - and who disappeared 20 years after one tragic event - still alive. Based on the graphic novel Bragija F. Shuta, directed by Julius Avery, This sharp thriller is imaginative new view of the genre of the action hero. / Sa Silvesterom Staloneom u glavnoj ulozi, Samarićanin prati mladog dečaka (Džavon Želi Volton) dok otkriva da li je mitski heroj (Stalone) koji je čuvao svoj komšiluk - i koji je nestao 20 godina pre toga nakon jednog tragičnog događaja - još uvek živ. Zasnovan na grafičkom romanu Bragija F. Šuta, u režiji Džulijusa Ejverija, ovaj oštri triler je maštoviti novi pogled na žanr akcionog heroja.

programme.title: Arms / Roki
programme.desc: A somewhat tiffy amateur boxer from the harsh suburbs of Philadelphia gets an unexpected opportunity to fight for the world boxing champion in a difficult category, at the same time finding love in the arms of shy and lonely girls. / Pomalo pritupi amaterski bokser iz surovog predgrađa Filadelfije dobija neočekivanu priliku da se bori za svetskog bokserskog prvaka u teškoj kategoriji, u isto vreme pronalazeći ljubav u naručju stidljive i usamljene devojkе.

programme.title: Return shot / Uzvratni udarac
programme.desc: To perform weapon delivery in war Devaria Darfur, Džanjavid Terrorists are kidnapped by Kler Somersby, a doctor with a clinic for refugees, whose father is the main weapon supplier, British Merge Weapons Gerald Kroford. / Da bi izveli isporuku oružja u ratom razoren Darfur, Džandžavid teroristi otimaju Kler Somersbi, doktorku s klinike za izbeglice, čiji je otac glavni Latifov snabdevač oružjem, britanski trgovac oružjem Džerald Kroford.

programme.title: Return shot / Uzvratni udarac
programme.desc: Without scott, which is expelled from the game and is located in the Sudan hospital, Stounbridge along with Kroford and Jakub is looking for Claire, which Tahir took to the Camp Džanjavid. The three are performing an incredibly release of Claire and nid. / Bez Skota, koji je izbačen iz igre i nalazi se u sudanskoj bolnici, Stounbridž zajedno s Krofordom i Jakubom polazi u potragu za Kler, koju je Tahir odveo u kamp Džandžavida. Njih trojica izvode neverovatno oslobađanje Kler i Nidžama.

programme.title: Poltergajst: home spirit / Poltergajst: Kućni duh
programme.desc: Legendary director SEM DRIME (SPIDERMEN, Dead, curse) and director Gil Kenan (Monster House) recorded this classic story about the family whose home in the suburbs obsessing evil force. When scary ghosts strengthen the attacks and captures the youngest daughter, the family must associate in order to save her before it disappears forever. / Legendarni reditelj Sem Rajmi (Spajdermen, Zli mrtvi, Kletva) i reditelj Gil Kenan (Čudovišna kuća) snimili su ovu klasičnu priču o porodici čiji dom u predgrađu opsedaju zle sile. Kad zastrašujuće utvare pojačaju napade i zarobe najmlađu ćerku, porodica mora da se udruži kako bi je spasla pre nego što nestane zauvek.

programme.title: Night peace / Noćni mir
programme.desc: A well-situated middle-aged man at the airport is a witness of a small incident between the unknown young man, perhaps Arabic origin, and members of security. When young men directly face the toilet at the airport, the man begins to feel an indefinite, but an increasing sense of danger. Fear of evil that ever since it surrounds gradually becomes an obsession, an emergency desire to see that evil, and finally, catch him in part and destroy it. / Dobro situiran sredovečan muškarac na aerodromu biva svedok sitnog incidenta između nepoznatog mladića, možda arapskog porekla, i pripadnika obezbeđenja. Kad se s mladićem direktno suoče u toaletu na aerodromu, muškarac počinje da oseća neodređen, ali sve veći osećaj opasnosti. Strah od zla koje ga od tada okružuje postepeno postaje opsesija, hitna želja da vidi to zlo, i najzad, da ga uhvati na delu i uništi.

programme.title: Champions / Šampioni
programme.desc: Marko is auxiliary coach in the first Basketball League of Spain. One day, after getting drunk, his frustration and the way of nature lead to a traffic accident that ends in court. He loses his job and girlfriend, and convicted him in the worst sentence for his ego: to train a group of people with special needs, who never took the ball into their hands. Through their innocence, tenderness and much good humor, they will learn the brand what is important in life. They are the real champions of life. / Marko je pomoćni trener u prvoj košarkaškoj ligi Španije. Jednog dana, nakon što se napije, njegova frustracija i preka narav dovedu do saobraćajne nesreće zbog koje završi na sudu. On gubi posao i devojku, a osude ga na najgoru moguću kaznu za njegov ego: da trenira grupu osoba sa posebnim potrebama, koje nikada nisu uzele loptu u ruke. Kroz njihovu nevinost, nežnost i mnogo dobrog humora, oni će naučiti Marka šta je u životu važno. Oni su pravi šampioni života.

programme.title: Mali Berlin / Mali Berlin
programme.desc: When the iron curtain divides his little German village in half, Taurus Peter is separated from his 36 cows. The film is based on a true story, and the narrator is Kristof Walc. / Kad Gvozdena zavesa podeli njegovo malo nemačko selo na pola, bik Peter odvojen je od svojih 36 krava. Film je zasnovan na istinitoj priči, a narator je Kristof Valc.

programme.title: Dinner / Večera
programme.desc: Since she had to face the deadly cancer of his mother, the Iciator became aware that she was in 1977. Eta stole and killed grandfather. Thanks to the senior efforts to lighten the family memory, she and her father will be together again and find a common language and a new look at the past to face the future and continue to live. / Pošto je morala da se suoči sa smrtonosnim rakom svoje majke, Icijar postaje svesna da joj je 1977. godine ETA otela i ubila dedu. Zahvaljujući Icijarinim naporima da rasvetli porodično sećanje, ona i njen otac ponovo će biti zajedno i pronaći zajednički jezik i novi pogled na prošlost kako bi se suočili s budućnošću i nastavili da žive.

programme.title: Talks of women / Razgovori žena
programme.desc: Shaken due to several accusations of sexual abuse, newly discovered in their isolated menonite religious colony, a group of women gather in Senik to discuss how to react. While men are absent, women narrow their options on three: not to take anything, to stay and fight or go. Some are afraid that every act of defiance will endanger their entry into paradise, while others believe they cannot survive without husbands and sons. Some are ready to take all measures to avoid the horror of their family lives and insist that the truth is stronger than the rules. / Potresene zbog nekoliko tačaka optužnice za seksualno zlostavljanje, novootkriveno u njihovoj izolovanoj menonitskoj verskoj koloniji, grupa žena se okuplja u seniku da razgovaraju o tome kako da reaguju. Dok su muškarci odsutni, žene sužavaju svoje mogućnosti na tri: da ne preduzmu ništa, da ostanu i bore se ili da odu. Neke se plaše da će svaki čin prkosa ugroziti njihov ulazak u raj, dok druge veruju da ne mogu da prežive bez muževa i sinova. Neke su spremne da preduzmu sve mere da izbegnu užas svojih porodičnih života i insistiraju da je istina jača od pravila.

programme.title: Seven continent / Sedmi kontinent
programme.desc: The film monitors three members of the family that belongs to the middle layer, while their lives slowly disintegrate. Nothing is spectacular not happening: it is only endless and boring life and aimless existence. The final scene of the film reminds of fazbinder, while this troque is forgiven from all in the grotesque way. It does not need to stand out in particular that this film is not for everyone's taste. / Film prati tri člana porodice koja pripada srednjem sloju, dok se njihovi životi polako dezintegrišu. Ništa spektakularno se ne dešava: u pitanju je samo beskrajno i dosadno životarenje i besciljna egzistencija. Finalna scena filma podseća na Fazbindera, dok se ova trojka oprašta od svih na groteskan način. Ne treba posebno isticati da ovaj film nije za svačiji ukus.

programme.title: A man who knew too little / Čovek koji je znao premalo
programme.desc: While he thinks he participates in the play of the street theater, the American worker from the video club replacement for the international spy and he breaks through the grid of spygies, while international conspiracy takes place. / Dok misli da učestvuje u predstavi uličnog pozorišta, američkog radnika iz video-kluba zamene za međunarodnog špijuna i on se probija kroz mrežu špijunaže, dok se oko njega odvija međunarodna zavera.

programme.title: Total recall / Totalni opoziv
programme.desc: The total recall is an action thriller on reality and memories, re-inspired by the famous short story we can remember for you wholesale, Filip K. Dika. Welcome to Rikol, a company that can turn your dreams into real memories. For the worker in the factory, Kolin Farrel), although he has a beautiful wife (Kate Bekinsale) that he loves, the hallucination sounds like a perfect vacation of tense life - the actual memories of superpower may be what really needs. But when the procedure goes wrong, the quad becomes a hostel. Running the police controlled by Koharn Kohagen, the leader of the free world, the Kvejd associations with the rebel (Jessica Bill) to find the leader of the underground resistance movement (Bill of Naji) and stopped Kohagen. The line between imagination and reality is vague and the fate of the world is uncertain as the Kvejd reveals its true identity, its true love and destiny. / Totalni opoziv je akcioni triler o stvarnosti i uspomenama, ponovo inspirisan čuvenom kratkom pričom Mi se možemo setiti za tebe na veliko, Filipa K. Dika. Dobro došli u Rikol, kompaniju koja može pretvoriti vaše snove u stvarne uspomene. Za radnika u fabrici, Daglasa Kvejda (Kolin Farel), iako ima prelepu ženu (Kejt Bekinsejl) koju voli, halucinacija zvuči kao savršen odmor od napetog života - stvarne uspomene superšpijuna možda su ono što mu zaista treba. Ali kad procedura krene po zlu, Kvejd postaje lovina. Bežeći od policije koju kontroliše kancelar Kohagen (Brajan Kranston), vođa slobodnog sveta, Kvejd se udružuje s pobunjenicom (Džesika Bil) kako bi pronašao vođu podzemnog pokreta otpora (Bil Naji) i zaustavio Kohagena. Linija između mašte i stvarnosti je nejasna i sudbina sveta je neizvesna dok Kvejd otkriva svoj pravi identitet, svoju pravu ljubav i sudbinu.

programme.title: Senki Society / Društvo senki
programme.desc: There is not many room for humanity and compassion in the Zein Dystopian world. It is managed by a shadow organization known as section. Since he knows about himself, Zea is on the run. Her enemy is well known. But he soon reveals that the section does not always remain in the shadows. The truth will soon wake the monster in it and compel that the war goes out into the light of day. Watch yourself, Zea don't cry ... Zea shoots. And shoots to kill. / U Zeinom distopijskom svetu nema mnogo mesta za humanost i saosećanje. Njime upravlja organizacija iz senke poznata kao Sekcija. Otkako zna za sebe, Zea je u bekstvu. Neprijatelj joj je dobro poznat. Ali ubrzo otkriva da Sekcija ne ostaje uvek u senci. Istina će uskoro probuditi čudovište u njoj i primorati da rat izađe na svetlost dana. Pazite se, Zea ne plače... Zea puca. I puca da ubije.

programme.title: Turn me on / Uključi me
programme.desc: In the world in which the unpleasant human emotions are eradicated using government daily vitamins, one young couple jumps on their dose and reveals love, joy, sex and everything comes with it. / U svetu u kojem su neprijatne ljudske emocije iskorenjene pomoću vladinih dnevnih vitamina, jedan mladi par preskače svoju dozu i otkriva ljubav, radost, seks i sve ono što dolazi s tim.

programme.title: Cup of coffee and new shoes / Šoljica kafe i nove cipele
programme.desc: Agim and Gezim, identical twins in their thirties, feel strong brother's love. They are deaf, but that doesn't mind in everyday life in urban tyrants. One day they get the news that changes everything: they have a row of genetic disease and will lose sight. Together, and with the support of the Gezim Girls of Ana, they face a change of his relationship to the world. With a cup of coffee, two brothers must re-determine their relationship while trying to adapt to new life. / Agim i Gezim, identični blizanci u svojim tridesetim, osećaju snažnu bratsku ljubav. Oni su gluvi, ali to im ne smeta u svakodnevnom životu u urbanoj Tirani. Jednog dana dobijaju vest koja menja sve: imaju retku genetsku bolest i izgubiće i vid. Zajedno, i uz podršku Gezimove devojke Ane, suočavaju se s promenom svog odnosa prema svetu. Uz šolju kafe, dva brata moraju ponovo da odrede svoju vezu dok pokušavaju da se prilagode novom životu.

programme.title: Dangerous neighborhood / Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Augsburg is a city in southern Germany, in Bavaria, with a population of about three hundred thousand people. The hometown of the poet and playwright Bertold Brecht. How did it happen that in this relatively small German city, which is eighty kilometers from Munich, so many migrants from the countries of the former Soviet Union? And what influence do they have on the political and social structure of Augsburg? / Аугсбург — город на юге Германии, в Баварии, с населением около трёхсот тысяч человек. Родной город поэта и драматурга Бертольда Брехта. Здесь, в Аугсбурге, по разным оценкам от 10 до 25 процентов населения говорят на русском и украинском языках. Их действительно можно услышать в городе буквально на каждом шагу. Как же так случилось, что в этом, сравнительно небольшом немецком городе, что находится в восьмидесяти километрах от Мюнхена, столько мигрантов из стран бывшего Советского Союза? Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Signs of life / Признаки жизни
programme.desc: But they belong not only to the older generation, proud of the longevity of their cars. Young people also buy old VAZ cars: this is an opportunity to get their own car cheaply when, at 18, they surrendered to the rights, or lovingly rebuild the old car from exclusive factory spare parts, which is already half a century, or strengthen and strengthen it and participate in amateur races, drift. / Но принадлежат они не только старшему поколению, гордящемуся долгожительством своих машин. Старые ВАЗовские машины покупает и молодежь: это возможность дешево получить свою собственную машину, когда в 18 лет сдал на права, или любовно пересобрать из эксклюзивных заводских запчастей старый автомобиль, которому уже под полвека, или укрепить и усилить его и участвовать в любительских гонках, дрифтовать.

programme.title: European values / Европейские ценности
programme.desc: Italy confidently becomes the country of long -livers and a pan -European example of an old age. Umbria, the central region. Pensioners ride on retro cars, dance at parties, drink coffee in the morning in a cafe, enter universities of the third age to obtain a new education and increase their involvement in society. In small high -mountain Borgo, fundamentally new projects of silver villages develop: fast medical logistics, additional financing, general activity. Almost every town has centennial people. The national system of the life of the Italian society has long been comprehensively rebuilt into the concept of a silver economy: the restructuring of social spheres, taking into account the new life expectancy of people. Here we want to find out and show how the country can take care of older people, how it is possible to give people a long happy life even without ultra -high pensions. We will see how they live and what the long -livers of Italy are doing - from the capital to a deep province. / Италия уверенно становится страной долгожителей и общеевропейским примером отношения к старости. Умбрия, центральный регион. Пенсионеры катаются на ретроавтомобилях, танцуют на вечеринках, пьют кофе по утрам в кафе, поступают в университеты третьего возраста для получения нового образования и повышения своей вовлеченности в жизнь общества. В маленьких высокогорных Борго развиваются принципиально новые проекты серебряных деревень: быстрая медицинская логистика, дополнительное финансирование, общие активности. Почти в каждом городке есть столетние люди. Национальная система жизни общества Италии давно уже комплексно перестраивается в концепцию серебряной экономики: перестройка социальных сфер с учетом новой продолжительности жизни людей. Здесь мы хотим узнать и показать, как страна может заботиться о пожилых людях, как возможно дать людям долгую счастливую жизнь даже без сверхвысоких пенсий. Мы увидим, как живут и что делают долгожители Италии — от столицы до глубокой провинции.

programme.title: Amur Golgotha / Амурская Голгофа
programme.desc: Taxi player Viktor Toroptsev from an endangered city in the Far East decides that a critical moment has come in his life. He starts the YouTube channel Vitek Live to become the main people's journalist in the region and rally surrounding fellow countrymen. Victor is sure that it is he who should turn his city and all of Russia into paradise on earth. To do this, he goes on the most important journey of his life, not yet imagining what chain of events he launched. Amur Golgotha. / Таксист Виктор Торопцев из вымирающего города на Дальнем Востоке решает, что в его жизни наступил критический момент. Он заводит ютуб-канал Витек Live, чтобы стать главным народным журналистом в регионе и сплотить вокруг себя земляков. Виктор уверен, что именно он должен превратить свой город и всю Россию в рай на земле. Для этого он отправляется в важнейшее путешествие своей жизни, еще не представляя, какую цепь событий запустил. Амурская Голгофа.

programme.title: Crossroads / Перекресток
programme.desc: In September 2024, the Russian military struck a guided bomb at the nursing home in Sumy. The bomb hit the top floor, where older people and disabled people rested in their rooms, destroyed the nursing home and fell behind it, exploding. A 78-year-old woman died, and 12 people were injured in her head, faces and hands. 222 inhabitants of the nursing home, most of which are more than eighty years old, were resettled in five similar institutions in Ukraine. / В сентябре 2024 года российские военные нанесли удар управляемой бомбой по дому престарелых в Сумах. Бомба попала в верхний этаж, где в своих комнатах отдыхали пожилые люди и инвалиды, разрушила дом престарелых и упала за ним, взорвавшись. programme.title: Art in detail / Искусство в деталях
programme.desc: The transmission of art in detail deeply explores an international creative scene, revealing new ideas and explaining the cultural phenomena that form our history, present and future. Who are contemporary artists? What works have become their business card? What influence do they have on society? And where can you get acquainted with their bright projects? / Передача Искусство в деталях глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Amur Golgotha / Амурская Голгофа
programme.desc: Taxi player Viktor Toroptsev from an endangered city in the Far East decides that a critical moment has come in his life. He starts the YouTube channel Vitek Live to become the main people's journalist in the region and rally surrounding fellow countrymen. Victor is sure that it is he who should turn his city and all of Russia into paradise on earth. To do this, he goes on the most important journey of his life, not yet imagining what chain of events he launched. Amur Golgotha. / Таксист Виктор Торопцев из вымирающего города на Дальнем Востоке решает, что в его жизни наступил критический момент. Он заводит ютуб-канал Витек Live, чтобы стать главным народным журналистом в регионе и сплотить вокруг себя земляков. Виктор уверен, что именно он должен превратить свой город и всю Россию в рай на земле. Для этого он отправляется в важнейшее путешествие своей жизни, еще не представляя, какую цепь событий запустил. Амурская Голгофа.

programme.title: Winning chaos / Побеждая хаос
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, chaos came in Europe. As a result of the bombing of Germany and the countries of the anti -Hitler coalition, millions of civilians died. Many large cities lay in ruins, and hundreds of thousands of people who lost the roof above their heads needed new housing. Gavr, London, Berlin and Warsaw were among the most injured. Documentary series The winning chaos talks about how these European cities were reborn after the war / После окончания Второй мировой войны в Европе наступил хаос. В результате бомбардировок Германии и стран антигитлеровской коалиции погибли миллионы мирных жителей. Многие крупные города лежали в руинах, и сотни тысяч людей, потерявших крышу над головой, нуждались в новом жилье. Гавр, Лондон, Берлин и Варшава были в числе наиболее пострадавших. Документальный сериал Побеждая хаос рассказывает о том, как эти европейские города возрождались после войны

programme.title: Crossroads / Перекресток
programme.desc: In September 2024, the Russian military struck a guided bomb at the nursing home in Sumy. The bomb hit the top floor, where older people and disabled people rested in their rooms, destroyed the nursing home and fell behind it, exploding. A 78-year-old woman died, and 12 people were injured in her head, faces and hands. 222 inhabitants of the nursing home, most of which are more than eighty years old, were resettled in five similar institutions in Ukraine. / В сентябре 2024 года российские военные нанесли удар управляемой бомбой по дому престарелых в Сумах. Бомба попала в верхний этаж, где в своих комнатах отдыхали пожилые люди и инвалиды, разрушила дом престарелых и упала за ним, взорвавшись. Погибла 78-летняя женщина, а 12 человек получили ранения головы, лица и рук. 222 обитателя дома престарелых, большинству из которых больше восьмидесяти лет, были переселены в пять аналогичных заведений в Украине.

programme.title: A person has the right / Человек имеет право
programme.desc: In the program of Maryany Torocheshnikova, human rights activists, civil activists and ordinary citizens summarize the main results of the week. / В программе Марьяны Торочешниковой юристы, правозащитники, гражданские активисты и обычные граждане подводят главные итоги недели.

programme.title: Asia 360 / Азия 360
programme.desc: Ulken appeared on the map of Kazakhstan in the early 80s. The village was built for power plants for power plants - they planned to build a the largest thermal power station in the south of Kazakhstan in two five -year planes. But the Soviet Union fell apart, and the boiler houses did not appear here. Only houses managed to build, in which the builders themselves settled. Therefore, it would be more correct to call Ulken a town not of power engineers, but builders. However, many residents are still hoping here that one day there will still be some station: whether it is thermal, whether it be atomic. / Улькен появился на карте Казахстана в начале 80-х. Поселок ударными темпами строили для энергетиков - планировали в две пятилетки возвести здесь крупнейшую на юге Казахстана тепловую электростанцию. Но Советский Союз развалился, и котельные здесь так и не появились. Успели возвести лишь дома, в которых и заселились сами строители. Поэтому, правильнее было бы называть Улькен городком не энергетиков, а строителей. Впрочем, многие жители здесь до сих пор надеятся, что однажды тут все-таки появится какая-нибудь станция: будь то тепловая, будь то атомная.

programme.title: European values / Европейские ценности
programme.desc: Italy confidently becomes the country of long -livers and a pan -European example of an old age. Umbria, the central region. Pensioners ride on retro cars, dance at parties, drink coffee in the morning in a cafe, enter universities of the third age to obtain a new education and increase their involvement in society. In small high -mountain Borgo, fundamentally new projects of silver villages develop: fast medical logistics, additional financing, general activity. Almost every town has centennial people. The national system of the life of the Italian society has long been comprehensively rebuilt into the concept of a silver economy: the restructuring of social spheres, taking into account the new life expectancy of people. Here we want to find out and show how the country can take care of older people, how it is possible to give people a long happy life even without ultra -high pensions. We will see how they live and what the long -livers of Italy are doing - from the capital to a deep province. / Италия уверенно становится страной долгожителей и общеевропейским примером отношения к старости. Умбрия, центральный регион. Пенсионеры катаются на ретроавтомобилях, танцуют на вечеринках, пьют кофе по утрам в кафе, поступают в университеты третьего возраста для получения нового образования и повышения своей вовлеченности в жизнь общества. В маленьких высокогорных Борго развиваются принципиально новые проекты серебряных деревень: быстрая медицинская логистика, дополнительное финансирование, общие активности. Почти в каждом городке есть столетние люди. Национальная система жизни общества Италии давно уже комплексно перестраивается в концепцию серебряной экономики: перестройка социальных сфер с учетом новой продолжительности жизни людей. Здесь мы хотим узнать и показать, как страна может заботиться о пожилых людях, как возможно дать людям долгую счастливую жизнь даже без сверхвысоких пенсий. Мы увидим, как живут и что делают долгожители Италии — от столицы до глубокой провинции.

programme.title: Special project / Спецпроект.док
programme.desc: The cycle of documentary programs of the TV channel is present. / Цикл документальных программ телеканала Настоящее Время.

programme.title: Dangerous neighborhood / Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Dangerous neighborhood is a documentary cycle about how residents of independent states adjacent to the Russian Federation live and feel themselves in connection with Russia's aggression in relation to Ukraine. Do they fear the invasions or hybrid violations of the sovereignty of their country on the part of Russia? Or, perhaps, consider themselves part of the Russian world? What problems do they face in connection with the influence of their country in Russia? Do they like such a neighborhood and do they consider it dangerous? / Опасное соседство - документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью русского мира? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: In the evening / Вечер
programme.desc: The evening program is about the most interesting and important events that the team of our journalists is following. Exclusive interviews, unexpected guests, the widest look at topical topics - every evening on the air from Monday to Friday. We do not run after the news, but find them for you. We show all points of view and talk about everything that happened at the end of the day. / Программа Вечер — о самых интересных и важных событиях, за которыми следит команда наших журналистов. Эксклюзивные интервью, неожиданные гости, самый широкий взгляд на злободневные темы - каждый вечер в прямом эфире с понедельника по пятницу. Мы не бежим за новостями, а находим их для вас. Мы показываем все точки зрения и рассказываем обо всем, что случилось, в конце дня.

programme.title: #the Vukraine / #вУкраине
programme.desc: Ukrainian farmers continue to work, despite the full -scale invasion of Russia. In Sumy, only 20 kilometers from the border with the aggressor state, they collected wheat, soy, sunflowers and other crops. In the agricultural sector of Vladislav Pelevin, all the granaries and almost all the equipment were destroyed with a missile blow, but it is already preparing for sowing. In addition, Pelevin, who had been engaged in pig farming for 30 years, killed about 1000 tribal heads. Does the state help farmers? Will they be able to continue work while being so close to Russia? / Украинские фермеры продолжают работать, несмотря на полномасштабное вторжение России. На Сумщине, всего в 20 километрах от границы с государством-агрессором, собрали пшеницу, сою, подсолнухи и другие культуры. В агрохозяйстве Владислава Пелевина ракетным ударом были уничтожены все зернохранилища и почти вся техника, но он уже готовится к посевной. Кроме того, у Пелевина, который 30 лет занимался свиноводством, убили около 1000 племенных голов. Помогает ли фермерам государство? Смогут ли они продолжать работу, находясь так близко к России?

programme.title: Asia 360 / Азия 360
programme.desc: Ulken appeared on the map of Kazakhstan in the early 80s. The village was built for power plants for power plants - they planned to build a the largest thermal power station in the south of Kazakhstan in two five -year planes. But the Soviet Union fell apart, and the boiler houses did not appear here. Only houses managed to build, in which the builders themselves settled. Therefore, it would be more correct to call Ulken a town not of power engineers, but builders. However, many residents are still hoping here that one day there will still be some station: whether it is thermal, whether it be atomic. / Улькен появился на карте Казахстана в начале 80-х. Поселок ударными темпами строили для энергетиков - планировали в две пятилетки возвести здесь крупнейшую на юге Казахстана тепловую электростанцию. Но Советский Союз развалился, и котельные здесь так и не появились. Успели возвести лишь дома, в которых и заселились сами строители. Поэтому, правильнее было бы называть Улькен городком не энергетиков, а строителей. Впрочем, многие жители здесь до сих пор надеятся, что однажды тут все-таки появится какая-нибудь станция: будь то тепловая, будь то атомная.

programme.title: Special project / Спецпроект.док
programme.desc: The cycle of documentary programs of the TV channel is present. / Цикл документальных программ телеканала Настоящее Время.

programme.title: Details / Детали
programme.desc: Details - a weekly television project of the Russian Voice Service of America, in which the host Andrei Derkach talks about scientific discoveries and high -tech developments in areas such as medicine, space, information technology. The program correspondents on themselves experience new Hi-Tech markets, communicate with the creators of everything that makes our life more interesting, safer and more convenient. / Детали - еженедельный телевизионный проект Русской службы Голоса Америки, в котором ведущий Андрей Деркач рассказывает о научных открытиях и высокотехнологичных разработках в таких сферах, как медицина, космос, информационные технологии. Корреспонденты программы на себе испытывают новинки рынка hi-tech, общаются с создателями всего того, что делает нашу жизнь интереснее, безопаснее и удобнее.

programme.title: Quiet terror. Chronicles of hell / Тихий террор. Хроники ада
programme.desc: Quiet terror. The chronicles of hell are a film about life in the occupation. The fact that silence is sometimes, worse than explosions. Russian propaganda is doing everything to create a picture of peaceful life in the city, but in fact he abducts and tortures people, leaves the Kherson in information isolation, and does not allow to leave the occupied region. In hostages, the Russian military had several hundred thousand people. However, Kherson resists. Quiet terror. Chronicles of hell. / Тихий террор. Хроники ада - это фильм о жизни в оккупации. О том, что тишина иногда, страшнее взрывов. Российская пропаганда делает все, чтобы создать картинку мирной жизни в городе, а в действительности похищает и пытает людей, оставляет херсонцев в информационной изоляции, не позволяет покидать оккупированный регион. В заложниках у российских военных оказались несколько сот тысяч человек. Однако Херсон сопротивляется. Тихий террор. Хроники ада.

programme.title: Facing the event / Лицом к событию
programme.desc: The acute political talk show live on the main theme of the day. In the Radio Studio Liberty - politicians, experts, journalists. / Острополитическое ток-шоу в прямом эфире на главную тему дня. В студии Радио Свобода - политики, эксперты, журналисты.

programme.title: In the evening / Вечер
programme.desc: The evening program is about the most interesting and important events that the team of our journalists is following. Exclusive interviews, unexpected guests, the widest look at topical topics - every evening on the air from Monday to Friday. We do not run after the news, but find them for you. We show all points of view and talk about everything that happened at the end of the day. / Программа Вечер — о самых интересных и важных событиях, за которыми следит команда наших журналистов. Эксклюзивные интервью, неожиданные гости, самый широкий взгляд на злободневные темы - каждый вечер в прямом эфире с понедельника по пятницу. Мы не бежим за новостями, а находим их для вас. Мы показываем все точки зрения и рассказываем обо всем, что случилось, в конце дня.

programme.title: Phili fantasy / Fili Fantazija
programme.desc: Fili Fantasy is a new series of adventures Rouzi, a unicorn foal who attends the Royal Academy of Magic in the Kingdom of Fantasy. Her best friends - Bela, Lin, Vil and Sedrik attend together with Rouza school and learn how to improve their magic skills, whether it is a mixing of magical potions or throws. In the basement of the Academy lives Renglum, evil magic wood creature that is captured inside a dark mirror like a crystal prison. Njeni najbolji prijatelji – Bela, Lin, Vil i Sedrik pohadjaju zajedno sa Rouzi školu I uče kako da poboljšaju svoje magijske veštine, bilo da se radi o mešanju čarobnih napitaka ili bacanja čini. Rouzi takođe mora da se nosi sa svakodnevnim školskim životom tinejdžera dok uči o magičnom svetu oko sebe. U podrumu akademije živi Renglum, zlo čarobnjacko drvoliko stvorenje koje je zarobljeno unutar tamnog ogledala nalik kristalnom zatvoru. Betivigs, slepi miš koji je Vilov i Sedrikov kućni ljubimac u studentskom domu, tajno radi za Rengluma kao njegov nespretni sluga.
