programme.title: Dinoster / Dinoster
programme.desc: Dinoster's shop is located in the universe where the asteroid missed the country, and dinosaurs have never been extinct. Using high-tech suits and transforming vehicles, Lucio and members investigate unknown landscapes, they save dinosaurs in trouble, and fighting mysterious beks hunter, a villain from their reality, which is resolved to win this multiverse. / Radnja Dinostera smeštena je u univerzum gde je asteroid promašio Zemlju, i dinosaurusi nikada nisu izumrli. programme.title: Vegesauri / Vegesauri
programme.desc: Meet Ginger, brave tricertopsica that looks like a carrot! She lives in the colorful and cheerful valley of Vegesaura, along with three playful babies of Graškoreks. Every day brings a new adventure - whether chasing through the jungle, they find new friends or thinking how to solve a problem, the fun never stops! If you like dinosaurs, fruits, vegetables and many laughs, go to adventure with jinger and her little friends and discover the magical world of Vegesaura Valley! / Upoznaj Džindžer, hrabru Triceratopsicu koja izgleda kao šargarepa! Ona živi u šarenoj I veseloj Dolini Vegesaura, zajedno sa tri razigrane bebe Graškoreksa. programme.title: Masha and Medved / Maša i medved
programme.desc: Our main heroine is a girl of a wave whose best friend is awkward and a big bear she keeps, teaching and playing with her. Zajedno prolaze kroz mnoge komične avanture u koje Maša upada zbog svoje znatiželje i razigranosti. Na kraju se uvek sve dobro reši zahvaljujuci smirenosti i snalažljivosti medveda. Pored njih srećemo i ostale stanovnike šume: zeca, ježa, vukove, vevericu i medvedicu.

programme.title: BLUU / Blui
programme.desc: Blui is a six-year-old puppy of the Australian Govedar, a shepherd dog, who is characterized by an abundance of energy, imagination and curiosity towards the world. Young Blui lives with his father Bendit, Mother of Chili and younger sister Bingo, who joins her in every adventure and endless fantasizing through the game. This world-famous series abounds in a variety of characters, representatives of different dog races, and the stories that are talked will recognize themselves because they talk about the family and growing up. / Blui je šestogodišnje štene rase Australijskog govedara, pastirskog psa, koga karakteriše obilje energije, mašte i radoznalosti prema svetu. Mlada Blui živi sa svojim ocem Benditom, majkom Čili i mlađom sestrom Bingo, koja joj se pridružuje u svakoj avanturi i beskrajnom maštanju kroz igru. programme.title: Super wings / Super Krila
programme.desc: The action of the Super Wings series revolves around the cutest jet plane named Jet traveling along the world by delivering the packages to children. Jet and Super wings have a unique ability to transform from the plane to the heroes who can run, they climb, dig even dive deep into the sea. / Radnja serije Super Krila vrti se oko simpatičnog mlaznog aviona po imenu Džet koji putuje svetom isporučujući pakete deci. Džet i Super Krila imaju jedinstvenu sposobnost da se iz aviona transformišu u junake koji mogu trče, penju se, kopaju pa čak i zarone duboko u more.

programme.title: Bejblejd Quad Strajk / Bejblejd Kvad Strajk
programme.desc: The volt school adores Beillidd and hang out with the Šuenai, which is successful in the game and entered the finals of the State Beillid Tournament. programme.desc: Beyblade X is the first season of the new series, interesting in that combining exciting blader struggles with a deeper story that attracts and something older audiences. programme.title: Anatane / Anatane
programme.desc: Paris, 2213. Anatan, 15-year-old boy knows that, like Father, he will soon be taken to Okura to transform him into binia, robotic will be destined to work for Dictator Klanka. The fate of Anatan and his team from the end, will change the day he discovered to have an incredible power of invisibility. Then he starts the way towards an eye, the place where all Klank's evil originates from. In a world full of hidden hazards, young Anatan, with its sister Arian and Nikit's best friends, moves in an epic adventure to preserve his country from constant threat. Guided by ancient prophecy, reveal a powerful relationship between nature and their own destiny, and their courage and friendship become the key to survival. Anan, more than ever, wants to discover the truth about his origin and unlock the power that can change the fate of humanity. In the distant future, the adventure begins, and freedom is the only goal! / Pariz, 2213. Anatan, 15-godišnji dečak zna da će, poput oca, uskoro biti odveden u Okuru kako bi ga transformisali u Bizija, robotizovano biće predodređeno da radi za diktatora Klanka. Sudbina Anatana i njegove ekipe iz kraja, promeniće se onog dana kada otkrije da ima neverovatnu moć nevidljivosti. Tada započinje put ka Okuri, mestu odakle potiče sve Klankovo zlo. U svetu prepunom skrivenih opasnosti, mladi Anatan, sa svojom sestrom Arijanom i najboljim prijateljima Nevenom i Nikitom, kreće u epsku avanturu kako bi sačuvao svoju zemlju od stalne pretnje. Vođeni drevnim proročanstvom, otkrivaju moćnu vezu između prirode i sopstvene sudbine, a njihova hrabrost i prijateljstvo postaju ključ opstanka. programme.title: Spin fighters / Spin borci
programme.desc: Soni, Johnny and Rocks entered a hundred twenty-six players who qualified for Spinfajteri Tournament after the basic test. The Spinfactor Association Getting the Competition to each of them spinner and the gun set so that they can achieve top results. Roki got his personal spinner Sonik Matrix and the Black Dragon gun but he wants to use the one who gave him Dad - Flejm Fajtera. After the first fight in which Johnny convincingly wins him he begins to doubt his choice. However, a doctor of Vird jumped in his help and gives him a spinner of the Flame Storm. Will our young and inexperienced deadline succeed from overriding Johnny? Can he win the tournament in honor of his father? He is waiting for him a lot more challenges. / Soni, Džoni i Roki su nakon osnovnog testa ušli u sto dvadeset šest igrača koji su se kvalifikovali za turnir Spinfajtersa. Roki je dobio svog ličnog spinera Sonik Matriksa i pištolj Blek Dragon ali on želi da koristi onaj koji mu je tata poklonio - Flejm Fajtera. Posle prve borbe u kojoj ga Džoni ubedljivo pobeđuje on počinje da sumnja u svoj izbor. Međutim u pomoć mu priskače Doktor Vird i poklanja mu spiner Flejm Storm. Da li će naš mladi i neiskusni Roki uz pomoć novog partnera uspeti da nadjača Džonija? Može li da osvoji turnir u čast svog oca? Čeka ga još mnogo izazova.

Tobots are no longer needed to save the matter, and slowly become an ordinary urban legend. Once many of their friends went to different cities, Riley, Kora and Dylan are now fifth grade students. Franklin and Limo together peacefully run a mechanic shop, but decide that Tobots needed once again to stop new evil robots that appeared in the city of Daedo. Enjoy a new, witty story with a thobot x, y and z and their pilots - Riley, Root and Dylan! Watch our friends, new Tobots, cooperate to protect the city of Daedo from new villains! / Naši voljeni prijatelji, Toboti su se vratili! Zle robotske sile su nestale iz grada Daedo. Toboti više nisu potrebni da bi spasili stvar, i polako postaju obična urbana legenda. Nakon što su mnogi njihovi prijatelji otišli u različite gradove, Rajli, Kori i Dilan su sada učenici petog razreda. Frenklin i Limo zajedno mirno vode mehaničarsku radnju, ali odlučuju da su Toboti još jednom potrebni da zaustave nove zle robote koji su se pojavili u gradu Daedo. Uživajte u novoj, duhovitoj priči sa Tobotom X, Y i Z i njihovim pilotima - Rajlijem, Korijem i Dilanom! Gledajte kako naši prijatelji, Novi Toboti, sarađuju kako bi zaštitili grad Daedo od novih zlikovaca!

programme.title: Pepa praase / Pepa prase
programme.desc: The cartoon series, based on the adventures of Pepe and its brother George, her family and friends. Pepa loves to play but also to jump around muddy baricas. Each of their adventure ends with loud laughter ... / Crtana serija, zasnovana na avanturama Pepe i njenog brata Džordža, njene porodice i prijatelja. Pepa obožava da se igra ali i da skakuće po blatnjavim baricama. Svaka njihova avantura se završava uz glasan smeh...

programme.title: Dinoster / Dinoster
programme.desc: Dinoster's shop is located in the universe where the asteroid missed the country, and dinosaurs have never been extinct. Using high-tech suits and transforming vehicles, Lucio and members investigate unknown landscapes, they save dinosaurs in trouble, and fighting mysterious beks hunter, a villain from their reality, which is resolved to win this multiverse. / Radnja Dinostera smeštena je u univerzum gde je asteroid promašio Zemlju, i dinosaurusi nikada nisu izumrli. Koristeći visokotehnološka odela i transformišuća vozila, Lucio i članovi njegovog tima istražuju nepoznate predele, spasavaju dinosauruse u nevolji, i bore se protiv misterioznog Beksa Hantera, zlikovca iz njihove stvarnosti, koji je rešen da osvoji ovaj multiverzum.

programme.title: Be Svet / Bibin svet
programme.desc: The main heroine, Bibi, is a cheerful and wise girl, always ready to help others in trouble. On the way to which he is experiencing a variety of experiences, she is never alone since her company is making her best friend Bobby. Unlike the main heroine, Bobi is naughty and stubborn and often intrudes into trouble. In his joint adventures, Bibi and Bobby meet with diverse creatures - giant, dragons, they also encountered Santa, and neither the wicked witch failed to bypass. These encounters were beneficial, and will also mean the audience to keep the hygiene of the house in which we live, why it is important to take care of the body, how and why it is important to be modest and grateful, and how to help friend in trouble. With their faithful viewers, Bibi and Bobby will also show what is most valuable in friendship, why it is important to keep the environment and not pollute our surroundings, and many topics will be opened by great songs, which in addition to affecting lyrics, exude and extremely likable melodies. Welcome you all came to Bibin world! / Glavna junakinja, Bibi, vesela je i mudra devojčica, uvek spremna da pomogne drugima u nevolji. Na putu na kojem proživljava najrazličitija iskustva, ona nikada nije sama budući da joj društvo pravi najbolji prijatelj Bobi. Za razliku od glavne junakinje, Bobi je nestašan i tvrdoglav i često upada u nevolje. U svojim zajedničkim avanturama, Bibi i Bobi susreću se sa raznolikim stvorenjima – džinovima, zmajevima, naišli su čak i na Deda Mraza, a ni zlu vešticu nisu uspeli da zaobiðu. Ti susreti svima su bili od koristi, a značiće i publici da na zanimljivim primerima nauči kako treba održavati higijenu kuće u kojoj živimo, zašto je važno voditi računa o telu i zdravlju, o pravilnoj ishrani, kako i zašto je važno biti skroman i zahvalan, te kako pomoći prijatelju u nevolji. Svojim vernim gledaocima, Bibi i Bobi će pokazati i šta je najvrednije u prijateljstvu, zašto je bitno da čuvamo životnu sredinu i da ne zagađujemo svoje okruženje, a mnoge teme biće opevane sjajnim pesmicama koje pored poučnih stihova, odišu i izuzetno dopadljivim melodijama. Dobro došli ste svi, u Bibin svet!

programme.title: LOL / LOL
programme.desc: Join Royal, Lady Divi, Neon and everything while gathering again in a new adventure that will never forget. Royal would buy a restaurant and a house where she and her three best friends spent the most beautiful days. But it becomes a house of surprise because it needs serious renovation and our heroins do not know what all awaits them. / Pridružite se Rojal Bi, Lejdi Divi, Neon i Sveg dok se ponovo okupljaju u novoj avanturi koju nikada neće zaboraviti. Rojal Bi kupuje restoran i kuću u kojoj su ona i njene tri najbolje prijateljice provele najlepše dane. Ali to postaje kuća iznenadjenja jer joj je potrebno ozbiljno renoviranje a naše junakinje ne znaju sta ih sve čeka.

programme.title: Pinokio / Pinokio
programme.desc: Pinocchio dreams of becoming a real boy and engages in different adventures! Together with faithful friends, he is always ready to explore the world that surrounds him, and the highest store of his father Đepet. / Pinokio sanja da postane pravi dečak i upušta se u različite avanture! Zajedno sa vernim prijateljima, on je uvek spreman da istražuje svet koji ga okružuje, a najviše prodavnicu svog oca Đepeta.

programme.title: Pirata I Kapetano / Pirata i Kapetano
programme.desc: While pirate for his ship's rudder, pink skull, travels the big sea, her faithful crew monitor her in numerous adventures. Pirating Best Friend, Captain, manages the red seawashion and joins nautical research. Sail with our heroes in an exciting treasure search, full adventures and fun, you will learn a lot about the values of teamwork and real friendship. / Dok Pirata za kormilom svog broda, Ružičaste lobanje, putuje Velikim morem, njena verna posada prati je u brojnim avanturama. Piratin najbolji prijatelj, Kapetano, upravlja crvenim hidroavionom i pridružuje se nautičkim istraživanjima. Zaplovite sa našim junacima u uzbudljivu potragu za blagom, punu avanture i zabave, naučićete mnogo o vrednostima timskog rada i pravog prijateljstva.

programme.title: Gaba's house doll / Gabina kuća lutkica
programme.desc: Gabi is a girl who will love to share their joy of fantasizing and playing with you. You will find out very quickly that it worshes everything that has to do with cats is because they are the most popular toys of Pandisha, Majaufina who always prepares a tasteful surprise, maacarene that is at the same time, crazy and always clear DJ Macan, charming Vragolana Macova and many others! Play, interaction, good verses, music and splendor ideas for always new and exciting adventures, all this is waiting for you in Gaba's house doll! / Gabi je devojčica koja će voleti da podeli svoju radost maštanja i igranja sa vama. Saznaćete vrlo brzo da ona obožava sve što ima veze sa mačkama jer su joj najomiljenije igračke upravo one mačkastične, poput nerazdvojnog prijatelja Pandiše, sićušne Magi Mace iz Mijaukovite bašte vila, Mijaufina koji u svojoj kuhinji uvek spremi neko ukusno iznenađenje, Macarene koja je u isto vreme i mačka i sirena i naučnica, raspevanog i uvek vedrog DJ Macana, šarmantnog vragolana Macova i mnogih drugih! Igra, interakcija, dobri stihovi, muzika i raskoš ideja za uvek nove i uzbudljive avanture, sve to vas čeka u Gabinoj Kući lutkica!

programme.title: Kokmelon / Kokomelon
programme.desc: Learn letters, numbers, animal sounds and more in this music series that brings fun for the whole family with children's songs! Pevajte zajedno sa nama dok učite i zabavljate se!

programme.title: Vegesauri / Vegesauri
programme.desc: Meet Ginger, brave tricertopsica that looks like a carrot! She lives in the colorful and cheerful valley of Vegesaura, along with three playful babies of Graškoreks. Every day brings a new adventure - whether chasing through the jungle, they find new friends or thinking how to solve a problem, the fun never stops! If you like dinosaurs, fruits, vegetables and many laughs, go to adventure with jinger and her little friends and discover the magical world of Vegesaura Valley! / Upoznaj Džindžer, hrabru Triceratopsicu koja izgleda kao šargarepa! Ona živi u šarenoj I veseloj Dolini Vegesaura, zajedno sa tri razigrane bebe Graškoreksa. Svaki dan donosi novu pustolovinu – bilo da jure kroz džunglu, pronalaze nove prijatelje ili smišljaju kako da reše neki problem, zabava nikad ne prestaje! Ako voliš dinosauruse, voće, povrće I mnogo smeha, kreni u avanturu sa Džindžer I njenim malim drugarima I otkrij čarobni svet Doline Vegesaura!

programme.title: Masha and Medved / Maša i medved
programme.desc: Our main heroine is a girl of a wave whose best friend is awkward and a big bear she keeps, teaching and playing with her. Together they pass through many comic adventures in which the wax breaks due to its curiosity and playfulness. In the end, everything always solves all well thanks to the calm and resourcefulness of the bear. In addition to them, we also meet other residents forest: Rabbit, Hedgehog, Vukov, Vevers and Medvedica. / Naša glavna junakinja je devojčica Maša čiji je najbolji drug nezgrapan i veliki medved koji je čuva, podučava i igra se sa njom. Zajedno prolaze kroz mnoge komične avanture u koje Maša upada zbog svoje znatiželje i razigranosti. Na kraju se uvek sve dobro reši zahvaljujuci smirenosti i snalažljivosti medveda. Pored njih srećemo i ostale stanovnike šume: zeca, ježa, vukove, vevericu i medvedicu.

programme.title: Blui / Blui
programme.desc: Blui is a six-year-old puppy of the Australian Govedar, a shepherd dog, who is characterized by an abundance of energy, imagination and curiosity towards the world. Young Blui lives with his father Bendit, Mother of Chili and younger sister Bingo, who joins her in every adventure and endless fantasizing through the game. This world-famous series abounds in a variety of characters, representatives of different dog races, and the stories that are talked will recognize themselves because they talk about the family and growing up. / Blui je šestogodišnje štene rase Australijskog govedara, pastirskog psa, koga karakteriše obilje energije, mašte i radoznalosti prema svetu. Mlada Blui živi sa svojim ocem Benditom, majkom Čili i mlađom sestrom Bingo, koja joj se pridružuje u svakoj avanturi i beskrajnom maštanju kroz igru. Ovaj svetski poznat serijal obiluje raznovrsnim likovima, predstavnicima različitih rasa pasa, a priče koje se pričaju prepoznaćete i sami jer govore o porodici i o odrastanju.

programme.title: Super wings / Super Krila
programme.desc: The action of the Super Wings series revolves around the cutest jet plane named Jet traveling along the world by delivering the packages to children. Each delivery jet meets the new problem he and his friends must solve together. Jet and Super wings have a unique ability to transform from the plane to the heroes who can run, they climb, dig even dive deep into the sea. / Radnja serije Super Krila vrti se oko simpatičnog mlaznog aviona po imenu Džet koji putuje svetom isporučujući pakete deci. Svakom isporukom Džet se susreće sa novim problemom koji on i njegovi prijatelji moraju zajedno da reše. Džet i Super Krila imaju jedinstvenu sposobnost da se iz aviona transformišu u junake koji mogu trče, penju se, kopaju pa čak i zarone duboko u more.

programme.title: Bejblejd Quad Strajk / Bejblejd Kvad Strajk
programme.desc: The volt school adores Beillidd and hang out with the Šuenai, which is successful in the game and entered the finals of the State Beillid Tournament. Inspired by the success of his friend, Volt decides to be a choice for participation in the tournament. Through a struggle with heavy opponents, Volt acquires new friends and dreams of becoming the best blader. / Školarac Volt obožava Bejblejd i druži se sa Šu Kurenaiom koji je uspešan u igri i ušao je u finale državnog Bejblejd turnira. Inspirisan uspehom svog drugara, Volt odlučuje da se i sam izbori za učestvovanje na turniru. Kroz borbu sa teškim protivnicima Volt stiče i nove prijatelje i sanja da postane najbolji Blejder.

programme.title: Bejblejd X / Bejblejd X
programme.desc: Beyblade X is the first season of the new series, interesting in that combining exciting blader struggles with a deeper story that attracts and something older audiences. The action follows Robin Kazamia, a young blider, who, after leaving teammates, teams up forces with mysterious Blader X to form a team of Person. Together with Multi Nanairo, internet sensation, striving to target the top x tower, the site where the most powerful bladers gather. The road is long, but Robin Kazami and his team know that he strives for the right goal is most important. / Beyblade X je prva sezona novog serijala, zanimljiva po tome što kombinuje uzbudljive blejderske borbe sa dubljom pričom koja privlači i nešto stariju publiku. Radnja prati Robina Kazamija, mladog blejdera koji, nakon što ga napuste saigrači, udružuje snage sa misterioznim Blejderom X kako bi formirali tim Persona. Zajedno sa Multi Nanairo, internet senzacijom, streme ka cilju da se popnu na vrh X Tornja, mestu na kojem se okupljaju najmoćniji blejderi. Put je dugačak, ali Robin Kazami i njegova ekipa znaju da je stremiti ka pravom cilju najvažnije.

programme.title: Anatane / Anatane
programme.desc: Paris, 2213. Anatan, 15-year-old boy knows that, like Father, he will soon be taken to Okura to transform him into binia, robotic will be destined to work for Dictator Klanka. The fate of Anatan and his team from the end, will change the day he discovered to have an incredible power of invisibility. Then he starts the way towards an eye, the place where all Klank's evil originates from. In a world full of hidden hazards, young Anatan, with its sister Arian and Nikit's best friends, moves in an epic adventure to preserve his country from constant threat. Guided by ancient prophecy, reveal a powerful relationship between nature and their own destiny, and their courage and friendship become the key to survival. Anan, more than ever, wants to discover the truth about his origin and unlock the power that can change the fate of humanity. In the distant future, the adventure begins, and freedom is the only goal! / Pariz, 2213. Anatan, 15-godišnji dečak zna da će, poput oca, uskoro biti odveden u Okuru kako bi ga transformisali u Bizija, robotizovano biće predodređeno da radi za diktatora Klanka. Sudbina Anatana i njegove ekipe iz kraja, promeniće se onog dana kada otkrije da ima neverovatnu moć nevidljivosti. Tada započinje put ka Okuri, mestu odakle potiče sve Klankovo zlo. U svetu prepunom skrivenih opasnosti, mladi Anatan, sa svojom sestrom Arijanom i najboljim prijateljima Nevenom i Nikitom, kreće u epsku avanturu kako bi sačuvao svoju zemlju od stalne pretnje. Vođeni drevnim proročanstvom, otkrivaju moćnu vezu između prirode i sopstvene sudbine, a njihova hrabrost i prijateljstvo postaju ključ opstanka. Anatan, više nego ikada, želi da otkrije istinu o svom poreklu i otključa moć koja može da promeni sudbinu čovečanstva. U dalekoj budućnosti, avantura počinje, a sloboda je ponovo jedini zacrtani cilj!

programme.title: Salivenov Prelaz / Salivenov prelaz
programme.desc: When the life of Mugi Saliven went to restless during, she decided to temporarily leave her life and career in Boston, in order to put her in his former Childhood, a picturesque camp in Novi Scotitk, which leads her father with whom he is not in contact, Sali Saliven. Maggi was at home to see the Father from the summer when she turned 15 and since then things between them were tense. Maggie never managed to forgive salt that didn't want to be part of her life after the divorce from her mother. Meggie is again in Saliven's transition trying to reconnect with old friends while trying to move through their complicated present, as well as dealing with their painful past. But the Maggie is not the only one fighting. Her return home has disrupted the status quo leaving the ever happy Sali to deal with memories and feelings that long decided to ignore. When Maggie encounters Kala Jones (Chad Michael Marej), a mysterious stranger who helped her father in the camp store, the two of them were badly slugging. In the end, Cal begins to like Mega, which only further complicates things because she has to choose between life in Boston and life in Saliven's crossing. / Kada je život Megi Saliven krenuo nemirnim tokom, ona odlučuje da privremeno napusti svoj život i karijeru u Bostonu, koji vodi zajedno sa svojim dečkom Endrjuom, kako bi se sklonila u svoj nekadašnji dom iz detinjstva, u Salivenovom prelazu, slikovitom kampu u Novoj Škotskoj koji vodi njen otac sa kojim nije u kontaktu, Sali Saliven. Megi nije bila kod kuće da vidi oca od leta kada je napunila 15 godina i od tada su stvari između njih bile napete. Megi nikada nije uspela da oprosti Saliju što nije hteo da bude deo njenog života nakon razvoda od njene majke. Megi se ponovo nalazi u Salivenovom prelazu pokušavajući da se ponovo poveže sa starim prijateljima dok pokušava da se kreće kroz svoju komplikovanu sadašnjost, kao i da se nosi sa svojom bolnom prošlošću. Na kraju, Kal počinje da se sviđa Megi, što samo dodatno komplikuje stvari jer ona mora da bira između života u Bostonu i života u Salivenovom prelazu.

programme.desc: Leonor transmits Rafael of the sad news. Alehandra tells Rafael to make sure he recover completely. Heems give a confession. / Leonor prenosi Rafaelu tužne vesti. Alehandra kaže Rafaelu da će se pobrinuti da se on potpuno oporavi. Hajme daje priznanje.

programme.title: Until the money disassembles us / Dok nas novac ne rastavi
programme.desc: Gaston is shocked by Hajme's recognition. programme.title: Until the money disassembles us / Dok nas novac ne rastavi
programme.desc: Rafael tells the sellers to resign and ask them to give Bernal a chance. Gaston apologizes Viki forced her to marry her. / Rafael kaže prodavcima da je dao ostavku i traži od njih da Bernalu daju šansu. Gaston se izvinjava Viki što ju je prisilio da se uda.

programme.title: Love in action / Ljubav u akciji
programme.desc: Fitness Specialist Kate gets the task of returning the disobedient film star in the form in time to capture his next action film. / Stručnjak za fitnes Kejt dobija zadatak da vrati neposlušnu filmsku zvezdu Rika u formu na vreme za snimanje njegovog sledećeg akcionog filma.

programme.title: Fate / Sudbina
programme.desc: Defne and Kahraman Jorukhan are rich, but they don't have children. The condemnation of their families makes the define look for an alternative way to give a husband to give his successor. He decides to hire a surrogate mother, who will give birth to a baby instead of her. Her choice falls on Elif, a young woman from Antakia, Kahraman's hometown. / Defne i Kahraman Jorukhan su bogati, ali nemaju dece. Njen odabir pada na Elif, mladu ženu iz Antakije, Kahramanovog rodnog mesta.

programme.title: Friends / Prijatelji
programme.desc: Eren, Sits, Merve and Žunus are four friends who met a year ago in college. At their first year of lectures, the sitting of happiness to his childhood friend Gizem. Sirs and Gizemon connected from the first moment as in the old days. But the balance in the group is soon starting to change. While the sitting, Eren, Merv, Junus and Gazem face ghosts of the past, begin to think that adult life is not such a good thing. Now they realized they were alone in their war with life. / Eren, Seda, Merve i Žunus su četvoro prijatelja koji su se upoznali pre godinu dana na fakultetu. Na njihovoj prvoj godini predavanja, Seda sreće svoju prijateljicu iz detinjstva Gizem. Seda i Gizem su se od prvog trenutka povezale kao u stara vremena. Ali ravnoteža u grupi ubrzo se počne menjati. Dok se Seda, Eren, Merve, Junus i Gizem suočavaju s duhovima prošlosti, počinju misliti da život odraslih i nije tako dobra stvar. Sad su shvatili da su sami u svom ratu sa životom.

programme.title: Infamous prison guards of the Islamic State / Zloglasni zatvorski čuvari Islamske države
programme.desc: The film about the members of the Isis who are known as Bitsls, who were brutal prison guards for many west hits, including the American war reporter, James Foil. After the brutal direct transfer of the Chams Foil, Sean James, a war journalist and a close friend of James Foil, he managed to find two members of the Beatli group when they were in the Kurds's prisonment. Langan recorded one-hour meetings with Aleksanda Kotej and El Shafi, extremely harsh and emotional confrontation, which serves as the basis of understanding the nature of what a man from the west and the leading figure of Isis. Aleksanda Kotej and El Shafi Elšeik were subsequently declared guilty before the Court in Washington in April 2022. and will serve lifelong slabs for their actions. This film deals with the topic of the detention period in Syria since 2013. and 2014 until 2022. The film shows a brutal case, apologized by eyewitnesses. It is built through carefully guided interviews, archival shots, personal recordings and dramatization. The witness stories are shocking in their brutal honesty. / Film o članovima Isisa koji su poznati kao Bitlsi, koji su bili brutalni zatvorski čuvari za mnoge zapadne taoce, uključujući američkog ratnog reportera, Džejmsa Folija. Nakon brutalnog direktnog prenosa odsecanja glave Džejmsa Folija, Šon Langan, ratni novinar i blizak prijatelj Džejmsa Folija, uspeo je da nađe dva člana grupe Bitlsi kada su bili u zatvoreništvu Kurda nakon što je Isis napustio Raku. Langan je snimio jednočasovne sastanke s Aleksandom Kotej i El Šafijem Elšeikom u krajnje surovoj i emotivnoj konfrontaciji, koja služi kao osnova razumevanja prirode toga šta znači biti čovek sa Zapada i vodeća figura Isisa. Aleksanda Kotej i El Šafi Elšeik su naknadno proglašeni krivima pred sudom u Vašingtonu u aprilu 2022. i služiće doživotne robije zbog svojih postupaka. Ovaj film se bavi temom perioda zatočenosti u Siriji od 2013. i 2014. pa sve do 2022. Film prikazuje brutalan slučaj, ispričan od strane očevidaca. Gradi se kroz pažljivo vođene intervjue, arhivske snimke, lične snimke i dramatizaciju. Priče svedoka su šokantne u svojoj brutalnoj iskrenosti.

programme.title: Stig Lašon: a man who was playing with fire / Stig Lašon: Čovek koji se igrao vatrom
programme.desc: Stig Lashon: The man who played with fire brings details about the felling and the life of the famous writer of the Stiga Lashon. The creator and writer of the popular Millennium series, which was also processed in several successful films, was a dedicated journalist and a writer whose fascinating and dramatic life was generally unknown to this day. He devoted his time to fight right-wing extremism in the world and spread the message that democracy is the right to fight. This film also brings interviews with people who were close lasses, as well as unique material from private archives, dramatization and so far unprecedented archive shots. / Stig Lašon: Čovek koji se igrao vatrom donosi detalje o zaveštanju i životnom delu slavnog pisca Stiga Lašona. Tvorac i pisac popularnog serijala Milenijum, koji je prerađen i u nekoliko uspešnih filmova, Lašon je bio posvećeni novinar i pisac čiji je fascinantni i dramatični život uglavnom bio nepoznat do danas. Posvetio je svoje vreme borbi protiv desničarskog ekstremizma u svetu i širio poruku da je demokratija pravo za koje se treba boriti. Ovaj film donosi i intervjue s ljudima koji su bili bliski Lašonu, kao i jedinstven materijal iz privatne arhive, dramatizacije i do sada neviđene arhivske snimke.

programme.title: Viking: Pad Narcotics / Viking: Pad narkobosa
programme.desc: Viking: The fall of the narcobos is a partial biographical film, a partially true criminal story. A true story about a man who spent 16 years in prison, of which two in one of the worst prisons in Brazil, where prisoners are happy if they manage to preserve their head. Desperately wishing not to hurt his son, the Malmkquist pretends to be a prison guard for 12 years, never revealing the reality of his life as a prisoner. But it is not behind bars, what burdens the Calaise Malmkvist - but the people he injured. Malmkvist's greatest regret is his attitude towards his son: the relationship completely built on lies. / Viking: Pad narkobosa je delimično biografski film, delimično istinita kriminalistička priča. Istinita priča o čoveku koji je proveo 16 godina u zatvoru, od čega dve u jednom od najgorih zatvora u Brazilu, gde su zatvorenici srećni ako uspeju da sačuvaju svoju glavu. Očajnički želeći da ne povredi svog sina, Malmkvist se pretvara da je zatvorski čuvar 12 godina, nikad ne otkrivajući stvarnost svog života kao zatvorenika. Ali nije život iza rešetaka ono što opterećuje Klauza Malmkvista - nego ljudi koje je povredio. Malmkvistovo najveće žaljenje je njegov odnos prema vlastitom sinu: odnos u potpunosti izgrađen na lažima.

programme.title: Titan collision / Sudar titana
programme.desc: Relations of China and the United States are currently the worst in modern history. How is historical forces of pride and shame sign that conflict? Understand Chinese life of humiliation and find out that poverty in America spreads anti-Chinese attitudes in public. As it worsens, we discover communities in confusion, companies on the edge of the abyss and the states that walk around the rope. / Odnosi Kine i SAD-a su trenutno najgori u savremenoj istoriji. Kako istorijske sile ponosa i sramote potpiruju taj sukob? Shvatite kineski vek poniženja i saznajte kako siromaštvo u Americi širi anti-kineske stavove u javnosti. Kako se to pogoršava, otkrivamo zajednice u zbrci, kompanije na ivici ponora i države koje hodaju po užetu.

programme.title: Nazi treasure hunt / Lov na nacističko blago
programme.desc: This series processes the largest robbery in history, and one of the biggest hunts on the treasure in the world today. Between 1933. and 1945. The Nazis stolen on millions of cultural artifacts and hundreds of tons of gold. They stole rings and gold fillings, untreated diamonds and crown jewels; The museums, libraries, churches, synagogues, shops, factories and family homes were covered. Some of the stolen things have not been found today, including approximately 100,000 artistic works of artists such as Degaa, Van Goga and Rafael, as well as gold stocks, diamonds, jewelery and other cultural values worth tens, if not hundreds of millions. Trying to get all right back in the last days of World War II, and lasts today. Hunting on the Nazi slight emphasis on modern research, detective work and authentic quest. Each episode follows the investigator team on the trail of missing plen. / Ovaj serijal obrađuje najveću pljačku u istoriji, i jedan od najvećih lovova na blago na svetu danas. Između 1933. i 1945. nacisti su pokrali na milione kulturnih artefakata i stotine tona zlata. Krali su burme i zlatne plombe, neobrađene dijamante i krunske dragulje; pročešljali su muzeje, biblioteke, crkve, sinagoge, radnje, fabrike i porodične domove. Neke od ukradenih stvari ni danas nisu nađene, uključujući i otprilike 100.000 umetničkih dela umetnika poput Degaa, Van Goga i Rafaela, kao i zalihe zlata, dijamanata, nakita i drugih kulturnih vrednosti vrednih više desetina, ako ne i stotina miliona. Pokušaj da se sve to povrati započeo je u poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, a traje i danas. Lov na nacističko blago stavlja naglasak na savremeno istraživanje, detektivski rad i autentičnu potragu. Svaka epizoda prati tim istražitelja na tragu nestalom plenu.

programme.title: Impossible repairs / Nemoguće popravke
programme.desc: Impossible repairs is an exciting documentary series that leads viewers behind the scenes of the largest and most complex machines in the world, in order to investigate dirty jobs and the most amazing missions of many heroes around the world. Huge machines and complex operations are in the focus of each episode, and Majk Davidson works together with teams responsible for working with daily hazards lurking behind the corner on the railroads, in the air and in the pučina. Small complications can become big problems for the blink of an eye, so the pilots, drivers, engineers and mechanics that Mike accompanies under constant pressure. Mother's instincts and knowledge in these areas are unprecedented, and he is always on the caution while the teams are dripping these beasts of these beasts, in order to keep them on the road, and eventually completed the mission. / Nemoguće popravke je uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija koja vodi gledaoce iza kulisa najvećih i najsloženijih mašina na svetu, kako bi istražio prljave poslove i najneverovatnije misije prekaljenih junaka širom sveta. Ogromne mašine i složene operacije su u fokusu svake epizode, a voditelj Majk Dejvidson radi zajedno sa ekipama koje su odgovorne za rad sa svakodnevnim opasnostima koje vrebaju iza ćoška na prugama, u vazduhu i na pučini. Male komplikacije mogu da postanu veliki problemi za tren oka, pa su neverovatni piloti, vozači, inženjeri i mehaničari koje Majk prati pod stalnim pritiskom. Majkovi instinkti i znanja u ovim oblastima su bez presedana, a on je uvek na oprezu dok ekipe prekopavaju utrobe ovih zverskih mašina, kako bi ih držali na putu, obavili posao, i na kraju, dovršili misiju.

programme.title: How did they build it? / Kako su to izgradili?
programme.desc: Incredible secrets behind the most impressive buildings of the world. From a luxurious subway in China, a riding to the top of the world, over the curved skeleton covered in a 15-meter in Singapore, this exciting agriculture that the world has ever seen - how did they build it? Traveling across the planet in search of answers, we meet people who designed and build these buildings, and reveal exceptional secrets of modern engineering that made these modern miracles possible. Beautiful, brave and surprisingly, this is an engineering of the scale and complexity as soon as they have not been seen. These engineering ventures will be guaranteed to take away your breath. / Neverovatne tajne iza najimpresivnijih građevina sveta. Od luksuznog podzemnog hotela u Kini, do vožnje liftom do vrha sveta, preko zakrivljenog nebodera na Menhetnu prekrivenog bakrom, do krovne bašte na visini od 500 metara u Singapuru, ovaj uzbudljivi serijal slavi neke od najvećih inženjerskih postignuća koje je svet ikada video - od kojih svako navodi na pitanje - kako su to izgradili? Putujući širom planete u potrazi za odgovorima, upoznajemo ljude koji su projektovali i izgradili ove građevine, i otkrivamo izuzetne tajne savremenog inženjerstva koje su učinile ova savremena čuda mogućim. Prelepe, hrabre i iznenađujuće, ovo je inženjerstvo razmera i složenosti kakve pre nisu viđene. Ovi inženjerski poduhvati će vam garantovano oduzeti dah.

programme.title: Meeting with death / Sastanak sa smrću
programme.desc: The death meeting will explore the turbulent era of the 1970s and reveal how the rule of terror of Gornia Alkale crossed the road from Los Angeles to New York. As a student of art, the Alkala grinded its photographic skills at UCLA universities and NYU. Thanks to the photographic craft, the Alkala received the opportunity to spoil girls and children throughout the free and focused decade. His collection of over 1,000 photos serves as the main resource for the Alkala to connect to other potential victims, but due to the explicit nature of these photos, only a small number of them are released to determine the identities and locations of his entities. This series returns us through time, until his first known crime in Los Angeles in 1968. year, when he kidnapped, raped and almost killed an eight-year-old girl. After her family did not allow her to testify, Alkalu waited only shorter custody. After premature release in 1974. Alkala has been returning back to prison for years for different offenses. In the end, the Federal Investigation revealed a number of victims into four federal states, between 1968. and 1979, which led to his arrest. Chasing women and children, Alkala managed to deceive and capture innocent target, pretending to be a successful photographer. With the coefficient of intelligence over 160, he was used by cunning to connect with the victims he later used for his sadist games. / Sastanak sa smrću će istražiti turbulentnu eru 1970-tih i otkriti kako je vladavina terora Rodnija Alkale prešla put od Los Anđelesa do Njujorka. Kao student umetnosti, Alkala je brusio svoje fotografske veštine na univerzitetima UCLA i NYU. Zahvaljujući fotografskom zanatu, Alkala je dobio mogućnost da uhodi devojke i decu tokom čitave slobodnjačke i pomodarske decenije. Njegova zbirka od preko 1.000 fotografija služi kao glavni resurs za policiju kako bi se Alkala povezao sa drugim potencijalnim žrtvama, ali zbog eksplicitne prirode tih fotografija, samo mali broj njih je pušten u javnost u nadi da će se utvrditi identiteti i lokacije njegovih subjekata. Ovaj serijal nas vraća kroz vreme, do njegovog prvog poznatog zločina u Los Anđelesu 1968. godine, kada je kidnapovao, silovao i skoro ubio osmogodišnju devojčicu. Nakon što joj porodica nije dozvolila da svedoči, Alkalu je sačekao samo kraći pritvor. Nakon preranog otpusta 1974. Alkala je godinama vraćan nazad u zatvor zbog različitih prestupa. Na kraju je federalna istraga otkrila čitav niz žrtava u četiri savezne države, između 1968. i 1979, što je dovelo do njegovog hapšenja. Progoneći žene i decu, Alkala je uspeo da obmane i zarobi nevine mete, pretvarajući se da je uspešan fotograf. Sa koeficijentom inteligencije preko 160, koristio se lukavstvom kako bi se povezao sa žrtvama koje je kasnije koristio za svoje sadističke igre.

programme.title: Murders by the sea / Ubistva pored mora
programme.desc: It may be up to the sea air or too much sun, but despite the joy we associate with sandy castles and ice cream, the asset riding, many British coastal cities have a suspicious reputation as cities in which the murder rate is extremely high. Some of the oddest and most terrible murders in the criminal history of Britain have taken place in their famous resorts: some of the most comfortable murders took place in these large hotels, and the seabed has become hunting tle for the most dangerous serial killers in history. / Možda je do morskog vazduha ili previše sunca, ali uprkos veselju koje povezujemo sa peščanim zamkovima i sladoledom, laganim šetnjama po promenadi i jahanjem magaraca, mnogi britanski primorski gradovi imaju sumnjivu reputaciju kao gradovi u kojima je stopa ubistava izuzetno visoka. Neka od najčudnijih i najstrašnijih ubistava u kriminalnoj istoriji Britanije odvila su se u njihovim poznatim primorskim odmaralištima: u tim velikim hotelima desila su se neka od najužasnijih ubistava, a morska riva postala je lovačko tle za najopakije serijske ubice u istoriji.

programme.title: DNA evidence / DNK dokazi
programme.desc: With the revolution in forensics, obsolete cases around the world are finally resolved, and DNA evidence emissions investigates and transmits stories of the most amazing cases that have been resolved so far. With the testimony of witnesses, new conversations, archival recordings and dramatic reconstructions, DNA evidence brings an exciting television program that will reveal new and dynamic forms of combating crime. / Pomoću revolucije u forenzici, zastareli slučajevi širom sveta se napokon rešavaju, a emisija DNK dokazi istražuje i prenosi priče najneverovatnijih slučajeva koji su do sada rešeni. Pomoću iskaza svedoka, novih razgovora, arhivskih snimaka i dramatičnih rekonstrukcija, DNK dokazi donosi uzbudljiv televizijski program koji će nam otkriti nove i dinamične oblike borbe protiv kriminala.

programme.title: Nurses who kill / Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju
programme.desc: They are angels patrol hospital corridors. People we entrust our lives. But some are not there to heal, but to kill. Why do they do that? In this document criminal series, superior medical, police and psychological experts will analyze the motives of these medical technicians who kill, the way they are extracted, and how difficult they are to prove their guilt. We will revive cases with the help of actors who will show real technicians in personal testimonies. In addition to the unprecedented evidence, the emissions of the nurses that kill reveals shocking cynicism and brutality behind the care of the care of those who tuck you into bed at night. / Oni su anđeli koji patroliraju bolničkim hodnicima. Ljudi kojima poveravamo svoje živote. Ali neki nisu tamo da bi lečili, već da bi ubijali. Zašto to rade? U ovoj dokudramskoj kriminalističkoj seriji, vrhunski medicinski, policijski i psihološki stručnjaci će analizirati motive ovih medicinskih tehničara koji ubijaju, načine na koji se izvlače, i koliko je nekada teško dokazati njihovu krivicu. Slučajeve ćemo oživeti uz pomoć glumaca koji će prikazati stvarne tehničare u ličnim svedočenjima. Uz do sada neobjavljene dokaze, emisija Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju otkriva šokantan cinizam i brutalnost iza brižnih ličnosti onih koji vas noću ušuškavaju u krevet.

In this document criminal series, superior medical, police and psychological experts will analyze the motives of these medical technicians who kill, the way they are extracted, and how difficult they are to prove their guilt. We will revive cases with the help of actors who will show real technicians in personal testimonies. In addition to the unprecedented evidence, the emissions of the nurses that kill reveals shocking cynicism and brutality behind the care of the care of those who tuck you into bed at night. / Oni su anđeli koji patroliraju bolničkim hodnicima. Ljudi kojima poveravamo svoje živote. Ali neki nisu tamo da bi lečili, već da bi ubijali. Zašto to rade? U ovoj dokudramskoj kriminalističkoj seriji, vrhunski medicinski, policijski i psihološki stručnjaci će analizirati motive ovih medicinskih tehničara koji ubijaju, načine na koji se izvlače, i koliko je nekada teško dokazati njihovu krivicu. Slučajeve ćemo oživeti uz pomoć glumaca koji će prikazati stvarne tehničare u ličnim svedočenjima. Uz do sada neobjavljene dokaze, emisija Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju otkriva šokantan cinizam i brutalnost iza brižnih ličnosti onih koji vas noću ušuškavaju u krevet.

programme.title: How did they build it? / Kako su to izgradili?
programme.desc: Incredible secrets behind the most impressive buildings of the world. From a luxurious subway in China, a riding to the top of the world, over the curved skeleton covered in a 15-meter in Singapore, this exciting agriculture that the world has ever seen - how did they build it? Traveling across the planet in search of answers, we meet people who designed and build these buildings, and reveal exceptional secrets of modern engineering that made these modern miracles possible. Beautiful, brave and surprisingly, this is an engineering of the scale and complexity as soon as they have not been seen. These engineering ventures will be guaranteed to take away your breath. / Neverovatne tajne iza najimpresivnijih građevina sveta. Od luksuznog podzemnog hotela u Kini, do vožnje liftom do vrha sveta, preko zakrivljenog nebodera na Menhetnu prekrivenog bakrom, do krovne bašte na visini od 500 metara u Singapuru, ovaj uzbudljivi serijal slavi neke od najvećih inženjerskih postignuća koje je svet ikada video - od kojih svako navodi na pitanje - kako su to izgradili? Putujući širom planete u potrazi za odgovorima, upoznajemo ljude koji su projektovali i izgradili ove građevine, i otkrivamo izuzetne tajne savremenog inženjerstva koje su učinile ova savremena čuda mogućim. Prelepe, hrabre i iznenađujuće, ovo je inženjerstvo razmera i složenosti kakve pre nisu viđene. Ovi inženjerski poduhvati će vam garantovano oduzeti dah.

programme.title: Impossible repairs / Nemoguće popravke
programme.desc: Impossible repairs is an exciting documentary series that leads viewers behind the scenes of the largest and most complex machines in the world, in order to investigate dirty jobs and the most amazing missions of many heroes around the world. Huge machines and complex operations are in the focus of each episode, and Majk Davidson works together with teams responsible for working with daily hazards lurking behind the corner on the railroads, in the air and in the pučina. Small complications can become big problems for the blink of an eye, so the pilots, drivers, engineers and mechanics that Mike accompanies under constant pressure. Mother's instincts and knowledge in these areas are unprecedented, and he is always on the caution while the teams are dripping these beasts of these beasts, in order to keep them on the road, and eventually completed the mission. / Nemoguće popravke je uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija koja vodi gledaoce iza kulisa najvećih i najsloženijih mašina na svetu, kako bi istražio prljave poslove i najneverovatnije misije prekaljenih junaka širom sveta. Ogromne mašine i složene operacije su u fokusu svake epizode, a voditelj Majk Dejvidson radi zajedno sa ekipama koje su odgovorne za rad sa svakodnevnim opasnostima koje vrebaju iza ćoška na prugama, u vazduhu i na pučini. Male komplikacije mogu da postanu veliki problemi za tren oka, pa su neverovatni piloti, vozači, inženjeri i mehaničari koje Majk prati pod stalnim pritiskom. Majkovi instinkti i znanja u ovim oblastima su bez presedana, a on je uvek na oprezu dok ekipe prekopavaju utrobe ovih zverskih mašina, kako bi ih držali na putu, obavili posao, i na kraju, dovršili misiju.

programme.title: Nazi treasure hunt / Lov na nacističko blago
programme.desc: This series processes the largest robbery in history, and one of the biggest hunts on the treasure in the world today. Between 1933. and 1945. The Nazis stolen on millions of cultural artifacts and hundreds of tons of gold. They stole rings and gold fillings, untreated diamonds and crown jewels; The museums, libraries, churches, synagogues, shops, factories and family homes were covered. Some of the stolen things have not been found today, including approximately 100,000 artistic works of artists such as Degaa, Van Goga and Rafael, as well as gold stocks, diamonds, jewelery and other cultural values worth tens, if not hundreds of millions. Trying to get all right back in the last days of World War II, and lasts today. Hunting on the Nazi slight emphasis on modern research, detective work and authentic quest. Each episode follows the investigator team on the trail of missing plen. / Ovaj serijal obrađuje najveću pljačku u istoriji, i jedan od najvećih lovova na blago na svetu danas. Između 1933. i 1945. nacisti su pokrali na milione kulturnih artefakata i stotine tona zlata. Krali su burme i zlatne plombe, neobrađene dijamante i krunske dragulje; pročešljali su muzeje, biblioteke, crkve, sinagoge, radnje, fabrike i porodične domove. Neke od ukradenih stvari ni danas nisu nađene, uključujući i otprilike 100.000 umetničkih dela umetnika poput Degaa, Van Goga i Rafaela, kao i zalihe zlata, dijamanata, nakita i drugih kulturnih vrednosti vrednih više desetina, ako ne i stotina miliona. Pokušaj da se sve to povrati započeo je u poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, a traje i danas. Lov na nacističko blago stavlja naglasak na savremeno istraživanje, detektivski rad i autentičnu potragu. Svaka epizoda prati tim istražitelja na tragu nestalom plenu.

programme.title: Storm is getting ready / Sprema se oluja
programme.desc: Long-term Tramp's advisor tries to manipulate the Danish director of Christopher Guldbrandsen in this shocking portrait of a puppet collected in his own strings. This film is recorded a combination of toxicity, hypocrisy and audacity which makes Roger Ston as an influential and dangerous American political landscape figure. It is an unusual, sometimes scary film. It is even more significant because the potential new tramps of the Presidential campaign for 2024 is taken place. Year. The film reveals that Stone sets figures and manages the Presidents as if it is his private game. And that is not a 3D chess, as you might think first, but somewhat strategically much less sophisticated - more like a children's monopoly party, in which the Roger Stone always has the first move and a ticket to exit prison. / Dugogodišnji Trampov savetnik pokušava da izmanipuliše danskog reditelja Kristofera Guldbrandsena u ovom šokantnom portretu lutkara koji se zapleo u sopstvene konce. Ovaj film beleži kombinaciju toksičnosti, licemerja i drskosti koja Rodžera Stona čini tako uticajnom i opasnom figurom američkog političkog pejzaža. To je nesvakidašnji, ponekad zastrašujući film. Još je značajniji jer se odvija uoči potencijalne nove Trampove predsedničke kampanje za 2024. godinu. Film otkriva kako Stone postavlja figure i upravlja predsednicima kao da je to njegova privatna igra. I to nije 3D šah, kako biste možda prvo pomislili, već nešto strateški mnogo manje sofisticirano — više nalik dečjoj partiji Monopola, u kojoj je jedina sigurnost to da Roger Stone uvek ima prvi potez i kartu za izlazak iz zatvora.

programme.title: Detained orka - Kit killer whale / Zatočeni orka - kit ubica
programme.desc: The Orka-detained Kit killer brings a story about the fight of the trapped orc for survival and freedom. After a decade of unsuccessful attempts to return home, an unexpected partnership between indigenous Matriarch, billionaire of the Orca and the new Aquarium owner, was captured 53 years ago while the cub was closed in the smallest pool for orcs in North America. When Lolita gets sick under worrying circumstances, her advocates face a painful question: Is it too late to save her? / Orka-zatočeni kit ubica donosi priču o borbi zarobljene orke za preživljavanje i slobodu. Nakon decenija neuspešnih pokušaja da je vrate kući, neočekivano partnerstvo između autohtonih matrijarha, milijardera filantropa, stručnjaka za orke i novog vlasnika akvarijuma odlučuje da preuzme gotovo nemoguć zadatak oslobađanja Lolite, zarobljene pre 53 godine dok je bila mladunče, a zatim zatvorene u najmanjem bazenu za orke u Severnoj Americi. Kada Lolita oboli pod zabrinjavajućim okolnostima, njeni zagovornici suočavaju se s bolnim pitanjem: da li je prekasno da je spase?

programme.title: Hunting for the king of pirate / Lov na kralja pirata
programme.desc: In 2009, the Indian Ocean became the stage of waves of boldness. Somali pirates, floating in ordinary boats, attacked dozens of ships and took crews as hostages in exchange for large sums of money. It is the fate of the Belgian ship Pompei. In Brussels, a special team was determined, which gathers to do everything that can free from ten crew members. In the meantime, the Belgian police identify the culprits and moves in the pursuit of them. The team focuses on the leader of the largest pirated cartel, and the police designs a risky secret surgery. In the inventive plot of the story within the story, they manage to get it out of the hiding place - right at the Belgian courtroom. In this documentary series in three parts, key actors - ship crew members, the Belgian bodies of the Order and the Sama Purates themselves - these exceptional stories are recapped. / Godine 2009. Indijski okean postaje pozornica talasa smelih otmica. Somalski pirati, ploveći u običnim čamcima, napadali su desetine brodova i uzimali posade kao taoce u zamenu za velike sume novca. To je sudbina belgijskog broda Pompei. U Briselu, određen je poseban tim, koji se okuplja kako bi učinio sve što može da oslobodi deset članova posade. U međuvremenu, belgijska policija identifikuje krivce i kreće u poteru za njima. Tim se fokusira na vođu najvećeg piratskog kartela, a policija osmišljava rizičnu tajnu operaciju. U inventivnom zapletu priče unutar priče, uspevaju da ga izvuku iz skrovišta — pravo u belgijsku sudnicu. U ovoj dokumentarnoj seriji u tri dela, ključni akteri — članovi posade broda, belgijski organi reda i sami somalski pirati — prisećaju se ove izuzetne priče.

programme.desc: We survived the attack of the serial killer of zaris deep into personal stories of people who survived the direct meeting with the killer and lived enough to tell their story. From Ronde Steyspi, he attacked one of the most relaxed U.S. History, Ted Bandi, whose husband, whose husband was beaten, as well as the student's attack on Peter Synca, and all the way to Tonni Antoneci, who was an appraiser Local builder John Vejnu geisius, to almost avoid the creepy fate of the remaining 33 gejsi sacrifices - all these people, and others, talk about their terrible experiences. Through a number of detailed conversations, this unusual crime series focuses not only on criminals, but also on the lives of survivors of victims, which give personal descriptions of their hellish adversity and influence that left to their later lives. / Preživeli smo napad serijskog ubice zaranja duboko u lične priče ljudi koji su preživeli direktan susret sa ubicom i poživeli dovoljno da ispričaju svoju priču. Od Ronde Stejpli, koju je napao jedan od najzloglasnijih ubica u istoriji SAD, Ted Bandi, ili Sindi Braun, čiji muž, Bobi Džo Long, ju je prebijao i ubio 10 žena u Floridi, pa do studentkinje Mo Lee, koja je uspela da umakne napadu Pitera Satklifa odnosno Jorkširskog koljača, i sve do Tonija Antonučija, koji je bio šegrt lokalnom graditelju Džonu Vejnu Gejsiju, da bi zamalo izbegao jezivu sudbinu preostale 33 Gejsijeve žrtve - sve ove osobe, i druge, govore o svojim strašnim iskustvima. Kroz niz detaljnih razgovora, ovaj nesvakidašnji kriminalistički serijal fokusira se ne samo na zločinca, već i na živote preživelih žrtava, koje daju lične opise svojih paklenih nedaća i uticaja koji je to ostavilo na njihove kasnije živote.

programme.title: Titanic: in the heart of the wreckage / Titanik: U srce olupine
programme.desc: During the previous 35 years, research is performed by the most wonderful wreck in the world, but now, 108 years after the sinking, the Titanic is compromised. Laying at a depth of more than 3,800 meters below the surface of the sea and 380 nautical miles from the coast of Newfoundland, in a pitch dark, the most famous wreck in the world is eating colonies of food bacteria. This slow and inevitable decay will, considered many concerned experts, within a few decades to destroy all traces of the secret legendary passenger ship. Using a new approach, this documentary connects the underwater exception of the largest research expeditions to the Titanic and the development of the most prominent wreck in the world. From the legendary discovery of the wreck in 1985., after twenty failed attempts, through the research missions of the Cameron, which was in the ship's robots, all the way to the treasure of which over 5,000 buildings, will be able to experience the excitement of these first dives to which there is no warrant. For the first time ever, the five heroes of Titanic research will call us to relive their fantastic adventures and missions whose last remnants), Lori Johnston (biopher who studies the bacterial attack on the Titanic), Anatoly Sagalevich, Poljer Ani Naržole (researcher who led seven Titanic's research mission) / Tokom prethodnih 35 godina vrše se istraživanja najmisterioznije olupine na svetu, ali sada, 108 godina nakon potonuća, Titanik je ugrožen. Ležeći na dubini od više od 3.800 metara ispod površine mora i 380 nautičkih milja od obale Njufaundlenda, u mrklom mraku, najpoznatiju olupinu na svetu izjeda kolonija bakterija koje se hrane gvožđem. Ovo sporo i neminovno propadanje će, smatraju mnogi zabrinuti eksperti, u roku od nekoliko decenija uništiti sve tragove tajni legendarnog putničkog broda. Koristeći se novim pristupom, ovaj dokumentarac povezuje podvodnu odiseju najvećih istraživačkih ekspedicija do Titanika i razvoj najproučavanije olupine na svetu. Od legendarnog otkrića olupine od strane francusko-američkog tima 1985. godine, nakon dvadeset neuspelih pokušaja, preko istraživačkih misija kojima je predvodio Džejms Kameron, koji je uspeo da osvetli olupinu poput holivudskog filmskog seta i uđe unutar broda zahvaljujući robotima na daljinsko upravljanje, sve do potraga za blagom kojima je izvučeno preko 5.000 objekata - moći ćemo da iskusimo uzbuđenje ovih prvih zaranjanja kojima nema premca. Po prvi put ikada, pet heroja istraživanja Titanika pozvaće nas da ponovo proživimo njihove fantastične avanture i misije čiji je cilj očuvanje poslednjih ostataka Titanika: Džejms Kameron (filmski reditelj i istraživač), Lori Džonston (biološkinja koja proučava bakterijski napad na Titanik), Anatolij Sagalevič (inženjer podmornica), Pol Anri Naržole (istraživač koji je predvodio sedam istraživačkih misija Titanika)

programme.desc: Smoking is completely prohibited in public areas and in most restaurants, at least in the western world. Šarolike marketinške kampanje prodaju iluziju novog pušenja: ono je kul, ne smrdi i ne razboljeva vas. Ali da li su ova obećanja industrija istinita? Ili se dešava isto što i oduvek: prodavanje magle potrošačima? Nikako ne možemo da tvrdimo da su novi elektronski proizvodi zdraviji: baš kao i duvanske cigarete, one sadrže nervni otrov nikotin - i on vas čini zavisnicima, a iznad svega i bolesnima, kako to navodno tvrdi nova studija. Proizvodi se razvijaju, ali strategije ostaju iste; kako ova industrija nastavlja da zarađuje bez ikakvog razmišljanja o zdravlju?

programme.desc: If 20. The century really started on the night 12. April 1912. He may have ended in the night on the night 26. April 1986. As the largest industrial accident changed the course of history, stirred global geopolitics and, directly or indirectly, redeployed the balance and power relations in the 20th century? The world will never be the same again. Following the trail of the amazing battle that the Soviet Union led against radiation, this film wants to trace and lighten one amazing story, exploring short-term and long-term historical roles. / Ako je 20. vek zaista počeo u noći 12. aprila 1912. potonućem Titanika, možda se završio prerano u noći 26. aprila 1986. eksplozijom reaktora 4 nuklearne elektrane Lenjin, poznate i kao Černobilj. 35. godišnjica katastrofe.Tri decenije nakon nuklearne eksplozije, skoro sve je već rečeno o ovoj ekološkoj i sanitarnoj katastrofi koja je upisala ime Pripjata u istoriju. Kako je najveća industrijska nesreća promenila tok istorije, uzburkala globalnu geopolitiku i, direktno ili indirektno, prerasporedila balans i odnose moći u 20. veku? Svet više nikad neće biti isti. Prateći trag neverovatne bitke koju je Sovjetski Savez vodio protiv radijacije, ovaj film želi da uđe u trag i rasvetli jednu neverovatnu priču, istražujući kratkoročne i dugoročne istorijske uloge.

Njen fiktivni ekvivalent u filmu tumači Barbara Sukova, a zbivanja se prikazuju iz perspektive njene sestre koju u filmu tumači Juta Lampe i koja pokušava pomiriti svoje sestrinske osećaje sa odbijanjem da se poput nje radikalizuje.

programme.title: Zapadni Front 1918 / Zapadni front 1918
programme.desc: German black and white war film taken in 1930. directed by George Wilhelm Pabst, to whom it was the first audible accident in his career. The shop is based on the novel Vier Von der Infanterie Ernsta Johanssen, and was housed in the last year of the First World War on the western front. Protogonists are four German soldiers who face scarcity, hunger and horrors of the Royalty War I, but also by cognition of growing futility and meaningless fight. Pubst showed a great skill with this film with new sound technology, especially in driving scenes above the trenches to get the war more effectively. Due to the content, but also the pacifist messages was often compared to the American classic film in the West Nothing new; For the same reasons, they attacked the Nazis due to promoting the defeatism, so after their arrival on the government was banned in Germany. / Njemački crno-beli ratni film snimljen 1930. u režiji Džordž Vilhelm Pabst, kome je to bilo prvo zvučno ostvarenje u karijeri. Radnja se temelji na romanu Vier von der Infanterie Ernsta Johanssena, i smeštena je u poslednju godinu Prvog svetskog rata na Zapadnom frontu. Protagonisti su četvorica nemačkih vojnika koji se suočavaju sa oskudicom, glađu i užasima rovovskog ratovanja, ali i spoznajom o sve većoj uzaludnosti i besmislenosti borbe. Pabst je ovim filmom pokazao veliku veštinu sa novom zvučnom tehnologijom, pogotovo u scenama vožnje iznad rovova kako bi što efektnije dočarao rat. Zbog sadržaja, ali i pacifističke poruke je često bio upoređivan sa američkim klasičnim filmom Na zapadu ništa novo; iz istih razloga su ga zbog promovisanja defetizma napadali nacisti, pa je nakon njihovog dolaska na vlast zabranjen u Nemačkoj.

programme.title: rum / Romul

Matjeu and Ana count down the remaining battery life that sustain the work of Sarina Chamber. Gradske spasilačke ekipe ne znaju što činiti i svima je jasno da niko nema stvari pod kontrolom. Sve nade da će se magla razići blede i uskoro nestaju. Matjeu i Ana odbrojavaju preostalo vreme veka baterija koje održavaju rad Sarine komore. Kako ih mogu zameniti za nove pre nego što se ove istroše i izlože Sara pretećoj opasnosti? Znajući da mogu računati jedino na same sebe, pod pritiskom vremena, moraće potražiti svoju sreću u magli...

programme.title: Bitter / Gorko
programme.desc: The film shows ana's life through the three key sensual moments of her life. The first is the death of her grandfather, when she was still a girl. Grandma performs bizarre rituals, which should facilitate the passage to another world. During that time, Ana realizes that her parents lead love somewhere in the house. The second moment in which he faces his own sexuality as a teenager, and realizes that he can influence men using his charm. In the third part, she is an adult woman, who returns to the child from their childhoods, which is neglected. He discovers that he is not alone. / Film prikazuje Anin život kroz tri ključna senzualna trenutka njenog života. Prvi je smrt njenog deda, kada je još bila devojčica. Baka izvodi bizarne rituale, koji bi trebalo da mu olakšaju prolaz na drugi svet. Za to vreme, Ana shvata da njeni roditelji vode ljubav negde u kući. Drugi je trenutak u kome se kao tinejdžerka suočava sa sopstvenom seksualnošću, i shvata da pomoću svog šarma može da utiče na muškarce. U trećem delu ona je odrasla žena, koja se vraća u kuću iz detinjstava, koja je zapuštena. Otkriva da nije sama.

programme.title: Biro / Biro
programme.desc: Within the Foreign Security Director, the department is known as legends. It is their duty to follow your agents in secret missions where information collects. Each agent gets a false identity. The main character recently returned from Damascus in which he was six years on the mission. But contrary to the protocol, he did not resolve his false identity upon arrival and thus jeopardized the entire system. / Unutar direktorata za spoljnu bezbednost nalazi se odeljenje poznato kao Legende. Njihova dužnost je da prate svoje agente na tajnim misijama na kojima sakupljaju informacije. Svaki agent dobija lažni identitet. Glavni lik nedavno se vratio iz Damaska u kojem je bio šest godina na misiji. Ali suprotno protokolu, on se nije rešio svog lažnog identiteta po dolasku i time je ugrozio čitav sistem.

programme.title: A small tenant / Mali stanar
programme.desc: Nicole is a woman in his fifties. He lives a completely normal, peaceful family life. But then the boom follows - the test is positive! Symptoms that are not menopause, but pregnancy. Are these good news or not? The whole family is twisted upside down. / Nikol je žena u pedesetim godinama. Živi sasvim normalnim, mirnim porodičnim životom. Ali onda sledi bum - test je pozitivan! Simptomi koje ima nisu menopauza, već trudnoća. Da li su to dobre vesti ili ne? Cela porodica izvrnuta je naglavačke.

programme.title: Lola Montes / Lola Montes
programme.desc: The biographical drama about the life of the great adventurer Lola Montes (M. Carol), a dancer and actress, who lived in the 19th century. After she was a mistress to many important men of her time, such as composer Franz Liszt and Ludvig I. Bavarski, she eventually became a circus attraction. / Biografska drama o životu velike pustolovke Lole Montes (M. Carol), plesačice i glumice, koja je živela u 19. veku. Nakon što je bila ljubavnica mnogim važnim muškarcima svojeg doba, kao što su kompozitor Franz Liszt i Ludvig I. Bavarski, na kraju je postala cirkuska atrakcija.

programme.title: The art of a crime / Umetnost zločina
programme.desc: Released due to disobedience, Antoan Verlai, a good police officer in the team, is tied to OCBC (Central Fighting Department of Cultural Dobri) thanks to the intervention of the Commander of the Pardo, his friend who becomes, therefore his new superiors. Smart as an investigator, but a stranger in all that is related to culture, Antoan will cooperate with Florence Arts, who lives and breathes in the middle of daydream, to see and talk to large artists who disappeared as if they were acquaintances. Random partners represent a great tandem and solve crimes associated with artwork. Despite numerous disagreements that this unusual couple has, much indicates that this partnership may grow into something more ... / Otpušten zbog neposlušnosti, Antoan Verlai, dobar policajac koji teško funkcioniše u timu, vezan je za OCBC (Centralno odeljenje za borbu protiv trgovine kulturnim dobrima) zahvaljujući intervenciji komandanta Pardoa, njegovog prijatelja koji postaje, dakle i njegov novi pretpostavljeni. Pametan kao istražitelj, ali stranac u svemu što je vezano za kulturu, Antoan će morati da sarađuje sa Florens Šasanj, poznatom istoričarkom umetnosti, koja živi, govori i diše kulturu, do te mere da joj se dogodi u usred sanjarenja, da kao plod njene mašte vidi i razgovara sa velikim umetnicima koji su nestali kao da su joj poznanici. Slučajni partneri predstavljaju sjajan tandem i rešavaju zločine koji su povezani sa umetničkim delima. Uprkos brojnim nesuglasicama koje ovaj neobični par ima, mnogo toga ukazuje da će ovo partnerstvo možda prerasti u nešto više...

programme.title: Great risk / Veliki rizik
programme.desc: French criminal Abel Davos (L. Ventura) wicked by Italy before the police. He is getting closer to him, so he tries to return to France with his wife and two little children, through Marseille to Paris. It seems that Eric Stark (J-P. Belmondo) is the only one who wants to help him ... / Francuski kriminalac Abel Davos (L. Ventura) beži po Italiji pred policijom. Potera mu je sve bliže, pa se pokušava sa ženom i dvoje male dece vratiti u Francusku, preko Marseillea do Pariza. Čini se da je Eric Stark (J-P. Belmondo) jedini koji mu pri tome želi pomoći...

programme.title: Poor people / Jadnici
programme.desc: The story takes place in France, at the beginning of the nineteenth century. Jean Waldan, a ship's worker, ended in prison due to theft of food, after 19 years he was released. Initially, he only encounters distractions and closed doors; Only Bishop Benvu is kind to him and gives him a refuge. Bishop's Christian compassion and humanity not only to reap the faith return in goodness, but slowly return it to normal life. In addition to the fake identity as Mr. Madelein, Valzan soon becomes a rich, respected citizen and mayor of the small provincial city. Happiness is leaving him again when he meets Fantina, a worker in his factory and the mother of the extramarital child, who die of hunger. The well-meaning Valzan releases the Fantina's out-of-court daughter, Kozette, from the claw of the foster family and cares about her as if her father. Valzan reveals his true identity, to save the innocent man who the police suspect and threatens him by Lifetal Robia, because he reminds himself to his character, and re-convicted of Robi. Valzan successfully flies from prison again and again under false identity continues to live a few years in Paris. Kozette, now an adult girl, will love the young lawyer Marius Pontmers, but Valzan does not allow that love because he loves her himself. Marius will find out about Valzan's criminal past and feelings heels towards Kozet and decide in order to be best to keep him as far away from her. Valzan, in the manner of his last benefactor Bishop Benv, makes the inevitable sacrifice and makes a decision to live further without Cozet. After a short time валжан / Priča se odvija u Francuskoj, na početku devetnaestog veka. Žan Valžan, brodski radnik, koji je zbog krađe hrane završio u zatvoru, posle 19 godina je pušten na slobodu. U početku, nailazi samo na nepoverenje i zatvorena vrata; jedino biskup Benvju je ljubazan prema njemu i pruža mu utočište. Biskupovo hrišćansko saosećanje i humanost ne samo da Žanu vraćaju veru u dobrotu, već ga polako vraćaju i u normalan život. Uz lažni identitet kao g.Madelein, Valžan uskoro postaje bogat, poštovan građanin i gradonačelnik malog provincijskog grada. Sreća ga ponovo napušta kad upoznaje Fantinu, radnicu u njegovoj fabrici i majka vanbračnog deteta, koja umire od gladi. Dobronamerni Valžan oslobađa Fantininu vanbračnu kćerku, Kozet, iz kandži hraniteljske porodice i brine o njoj kao da je njen otac. Valžan otkriva svoj pravi identitet, da bi spasio nevinog čoveka kog policija sumnjiči i preti mu doživotnom robijom, jer likom podseća na njega, i ponovo biva osuđen na robiju. Valžan ponovo uspešno beži iz zatvora i opet pod lažnim identitetom nastavlja živeti nekoliko godina u Parizu. Kozet, sad već odrasla devojka, zavoleće mladog pravnika Mariusa Pontmersi, ali Valžan ne dozvoljava tu ljubav zato što je i sam voli. Marius će saznati za Valžanovu kriminalnu proslost i osećaje koje gaji prema Kozet i pri tome odlučiti da bi bilo najbolje da ga drži što dalje od nje. Valžan, u maniru njegovog prošlog dobročinioca biskupa Benvju, čini neizbežno žrtvovanje i donosi odluku živeti dalje bez Kozet. Posle kratkog vremena Valžan

programme.title: A delicatessic action / Delikatesna radnja

programme.title: Black river / Crna reka
programme.desc: Dani, a teenager from the Arno family, disappeared. The case was added to the Fransoi Vikonti, a tired and disappointed detective, whom the woman had just left. Pametan kao istražitelj, ali stranac u svemu što je vezano za kulturu, Antoan će morati da sarađuje sa Florens Šasanj, poznatom istoričarkom umetnosti, koja živi, govori i diše kulturu, do te mere da joj se dogodi u usred sanjarenja, da kao plod njene mašte vidi i razgovara sa velikim umetnicima koji su nestali kao da su joj poznanici. Slučajni partneri predstavljaju sjajan tandem i rešavaju zločine koji su povezani sa umetničkim delima. Uprkos brojnim nesuglasicama koje ovaj neobični par ima, mnogo toga ukazuje da će ovo partnerstvo možda prerasti u nešto više...

programme.title: Great risk / Veliki rizik
programme.desc: French criminal Abel Davos (L. Ventura) wicked by Italy before the police. He is getting closer to him, so he tries to return to France with his wife and two little children, through Marseille to Paris. It seems that Eric Stark (J-P. Belmondo) is the only one who wants to help him ... / Francuski kriminalac Abel Davos (L. Ventura) beži po Italiji pred policijom. Potera mu je sve bliže, pa se pokušava sa ženom i dvoje male dece vratiti u Francusku, preko Marseillea do Pariza. Čini se da je Eric Stark (J-P. Belmondo) jedini koji mu pri tome želi pomoći...

programme.title: Poor people / Jadnici
programme.desc: The story takes place in France, at the beginning of the nineteenth century. Jean Waldan, a ship's worker, ended in prison due to theft of food, after 19 years he was released. Initially, he only encounters distractions and closed doors; Only Bishop Benvu is kind to him and gives him a refuge. Bishop's Christian compassion and humanity not only to reap the faith return in goodness, but slowly return it to normal life. In addition to the fake identity as Mr. Madelein, Valzan soon becomes a rich, respected citizen and mayor of the small provincial city. Happiness is leaving him again when he meets Fantina, a worker in his factory and the mother of the extramarital child, who die of hunger. The well-meaning Valzan releases the Fantina's out-of-court daughter, Kozette, from the claw of the foster family and cares about her as if her father. Valzan reveals his true identity, to save the innocent man who the police suspect and threatens him by Lifetal Robia, because he reminds himself to his character, and re-convicted of Robi. Valzan successfully flies from prison again and again under false identity continues to live a few years in Paris. Kozette, now an adult girl, will love the young lawyer Marius Pontmers, but Valzan does not allow that love because he loves her himself. Marius will find out about Valzan's criminal past and feelings heels towards Kozet and decide in order to be best to keep him as far away from her. Valzan, in the manner of his last benefactor Bishop Benv, makes the inevitable sacrifice and makes a decision to live further without Cozet. After a short time валжан / Priča se odvija u Francuskoj, na početku devetnaestog veka. Žan Valžan, brodski radnik, koji je zbog krađe hrane završio u zatvoru, posle 19 godina je pušten na slobodu. U početku, nailazi samo na nepoverenje i zatvorena vrata; jedino biskup Benvju je ljubazan prema njemu i pruža mu utočište. Biskupovo hrišćansko saosećanje i humanost ne samo da Žanu vraćaju veru u dobrotu, već ga polako vraćaju i u normalan život. Uz lažni identitet kao g.Madelein, Valžan uskoro postaje bogat, poštovan građanin i gradonačelnik malog provincijskog grada. Sreća ga ponovo napušta kad upoznaje Fantinu, radnicu u njegovoj fabrici i majka vanbračnog deteta, koja umire od gladi. Dobronamerni Valžan oslobađa Fantininu vanbračnu kćerku, Kozet, iz kandži hraniteljske porodice i brine o njoj kao da je njen otac. Valžan otkriva svoj pravi identitet, da bi spasio nevinog čoveka kog policija sumnjiči i preti mu doživotnom robijom, jer likom podseća na njega, i ponovo biva osuđen na robiju. Valžan ponovo uspešno beži iz zatvora i opet pod lažnim identitetom nastavlja živeti nekoliko godina u Parizu. Kozet, sad već odrasla devojka, zavoleće mladog pravnika Mariusa Pontmersi, ali Valžan ne dozvoljava tu ljubav zato što je i sam voli. Marius će saznati za Valžanovu kriminalnu proslost i osećaje koje gaji prema Kozet i pri tome odlučiti da bi bilo najbolje da ga drži što dalje od nje. Valžan, u maniru njegovog prošlog dobročinioca biskupa Benvju, čini neizbežno žrtvovanje i donosi odluku živeti dalje bez Kozet. Posle kratkog vremena Valžan

programme.title: To the last breath / Do poslednjeg daha
programme.desc: The first breath is the first feature film Jean-Luc Godard and one of the originators of the French New Wave. It is a love story between Michel Poiccard (Jean-Paul Belmondo), a small criminal that is wanted for the murder of the police officer, and Patricia Franchini (Jean Seberg), American who is selling the Novina's Tribune's novelties in Paris Bulevari. / Do poslednjeg daha je prvi dugometražni film Jean-Luca Godarda i jedan od začetnika Francuskog novog talasa. U pitanju je ljubavna priča između Michela Poiccarda (Jean-Paul Belmondo), sitnog kriminalca koji je tražen zbog ubistva policajca, i Patricie Franchini (Jean Seberg), Amerikanke koja na pariskim bulevarima prodaje novine International Herald Tribune.
