programme.title: Intruder / Nametljivac
programme.desc: People's Louis Trebor (M. Suborge) The 68-year-old, a self-tone and a heart patient who lives in the woods near the French-Switzerland border with two dogs. He has two sons, and one of them is the young Sidney (Mr. Colin), married to the Antoinette Customs Officer (F. Loiret-Caille). Sidney and Antoinette have two children, but they are all very rarely seeing Louis, which the son considers a very difficult and mentally disordered person. The drugs seriously endangered by Louis procures a pharmacist (Bambo), with which he maintains an occasional love connection, while simultaneously trying to get closer to his neighbor, an attractive dog breeder (B. Dalle). After his enigmatic Russian smuggling organizations organizes heart transplantation in the South Korace town of Pusan, Louis from there decide to go to Tahiti, in search of his other son he had never seen. / Osobenjak Louis Trebor (M. Subor) povučeni je 68-godišnjak, samotnjak i srčani bolesnik koji s dva psa haskija živi u šumi nedaleko francusko-švajcarske granice. Ima dvojicu sinova, a jedan od njih je mladi Sidney (G. Colin), oženjen carinskom službenicom Antoinette (F. Loiret-Caille). Sidney i Antoinette imaju dvoje dece, ali svi oni vrlo retko viđaju Louisa kojeg sin smatra vrlo teškom i mentalno poremećenom osobom. Lekove za ozbiljno ugroženo srce Louisu nabavlja apotekarka (Bambou), s kojom on održava povremenu ljubavnu vezu, dok se istovremeno bezuspešno pokušava zbližiti sa svojom komšinicom, privlačnom uzgajivačicom pasa (B. Dalle). Nakon što mu zagonetna ruska švercerka organima (J. Golubeva) organizuje transplantaciju srca u južnokorejskom gradu Pusanu, Louis odande odluči krenuti na Tahiti, u potragu za svojim drugim sinom kojeg nikad nije video.

programme.title: Goodbye up there / Doviđenja tamo gore
programme.desc: November 1919. years, two soldiers who survived the war, devise malversation with veterans monuments. programme.title: Level 23 / Nivo 23
programme.desc: Level 23 is one of the oldest broadcasts that are continuously broadcast on TV Studio B. The show was designed, edited by Velja Pavlović. It is a nocturnal date of relaxed chat with guests who talk about culture in an engaged way, as culture defined Slobodan Jovanović - as a term wider than politics. At the beginning, guests and the author were sitting and talked without any scenography, on the black floor, against the black background. Even when the guests were so respected personnel, such as the academician Vladet Jerotić, or the Drama Writer of Aca Popović, the conversation was conducted from the floor because then the entire program was primarily protest against Slobodan Milosevic's regime. The show never weighed a mass audience or viewing. Without pretensions towards imaginary exclusivity and elitism, the author of time and attention was paid to exceptional, and unknown personalities than the mitle from the beholder. Insisting on the courage and morality of each guest, it was assumed that the guests regularly and the opponents of the regime. The show has repeatedly removed from the program, always when the violent police administration and the editorial office is introduced in the studio. From the Fifth October 2000. Emisee was going color, with renovated, Color Spicom (original was black and white) and a modern scenery. / NIVO 23 je jedna od najstarijih emisija koja se kontinuirano emituje na TV Studio B. Emisiju je osmislio, uređuje i vodi Velja Pavlović. To je noćni kasni termin opuštenog ćaskanja sa gostima koji govore o kulturi na angažovan način, onako kako je kulturu definisao Slobodan Jovanović - kao pojam širi od politike. Na početku, gosti i autor sedeli su i razgovarali bez ikakve scenografije, na crnom podu, nasuprot crnoj pozadini. Čak i kad su gosti bile tako uvažene ličnosti kao što je akademik Vladeta Jerotić, ili dramski pisac Aca Popović, razgovor je vođen sa poda jer je tada čitav program Studija B prvenstveno bio protest protiv režima Slobodana Miloševića. Emisija nikada nije težila masovnoj publici ili gledanosti. Bez pretenzija ka umišljenoj ekskluzivnosti i elitizmu, autor je vreme i pažnju pre poklanjao izuzetnim, a nepoznatim ličnostima nego miljenicima gledalaca. Insistiranje na hrabrosti i moralu svakog gosta, pretpostavljalo je da gosti redovno bivaju i protivnici režima. Emisija je više puta skidana sa programa, uvek kada je u Studiju B uvođena nasilna policijska uprava i uredništvo. Od petog oktobra 2000. godine emisija ide u boji, sa obnovljenom, kolor špicom (originalna je bila crno-bela) i modernom scenografijom.

programme.title: Level 23 / Nivo 23
programme.desc: Level 23 is one of the oldest broadcasts that are continuously broadcast on TV Studio B. The show was designed, edited by Velja Pavlović. It is a nocturnal date of relaxed chat with guests who talk about culture in an engaged way, as culture defined Slobodan Jovanović - as a term wider than politics. At the beginning, guests and the author were sitting and talked without any scenography, on the black floor, against the black background. Even when the guests were so respected personnel, such as the academician Vladet Jerotić, or the Drama Writer of Aca Popović, the conversation was conducted from the floor because then the entire program was primarily protest against Slobodan Milosevic's regime. The show never weighed a mass audience or viewing. Without pretensions towards imaginary exclusivity and elitism, the author of time and attention was paid to exceptional, and unknown personalities than the mitle from the beholder. Insisting on the courage and morality of each guest, it was assumed that the guests regularly and the opponents of the regime. The show has repeatedly removed from the program, always when the violent police administration and the editorial office is introduced in the studio. From the Fifth October 2000. Emisee was going color, with renovated, Color Spicom (original was black and white) and a modern scenery. / NIVO 23 je jedna od najstarijih emisija koja se kontinuirano emituje na TV Studio B. Emisiju je osmislio, uređuje i vodi Velja Pavlović. To je noćni kasni termin opuštenog ćaskanja sa gostima koji govore o kulturi na angažovan način, onako kako je kulturu definisao Slobodan Jovanović - kao pojam širi od politike. Na početku, gosti i autor sedeli su i razgovarali bez ikakve scenografije, na crnom podu, nasuprot crnoj pozadini. Čak i kad su gosti bile tako uvažene ličnosti kao što je akademik Vladeta Jerotić, ili dramski pisac Aca Popović, razgovor je vođen sa poda jer je tada čitav program Studija B prvenstveno bio protest protiv režima Slobodana Miloševića. Emisija nikada nije težila masovnoj publici ili gledanosti. Bez pretenzija ka umišljenoj ekskluzivnosti i elitizmu, autor je vreme i pažnju pre poklanjao izuzetnim, a nepoznatim ličnostima nego miljenicima gledalaca. Insistiranje na hrabrosti i moralu svakog gosta, pretpostavljalo je da gosti redovno bivaju i protivnici režima. Emisija je više puta skidana sa programa, uvek kada je u Studiju B uvođena nasilna policijska uprava i uredništvo. Od petog oktobra 2000. godine emisija ide u boji, sa obnovljenom, kolor špicom (originalna je bila crno-bela) i modernom scenografijom.

programme.title: Arkadne Legende - Cold Heart and Snake / Arkadne Legende - Cold Heart and Snake
programme.desc: Go with us on a trip to the past and remember some legendary arcade games! / Pođite sa nama na putovanje u prošlost i prisetite se nekih legendarnih arkadnih igara!

programme.title: Kidarena - Sarezza Roblox / Kidarena - Sarezza Roblox
programme.desc: The famous author of the game videos, Sara Miljković, in the world of games known as Sarezza, presents us Roblox. / Poznata autorka videozapisa o igrama, Sara Miljković, u svetu igara poznata kao Sarezza, predstavlja nam Roblox.

programme.title: CZV Krunalex EA FC 25 / CZV Krunalex EA FC 25
programme.desc: We present you a game that is intended for all football lovers! Choose team and players and show that you are able to achieve a serious result in great competitions. / Predstavljamo vam igricu koja je namenjena svim ljubiteljima fudbala! Odaberite tim i igrače i pokažite da ste sposobni da na velikim takmičenjima ostvarite ozbiljan rezultat.

programme.title: Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League / Kidarena - Tasteless Rocket League
programme.desc: We take you to the world of hybrid football in which a player is operating a car that strives to control the ball greater than yourself. The goal of the game is, as in football, score. / Vodimo vas u svet hibridnog fudbala u kome igrač upravlja automobilom koji nastoji da kontroliše loptu veću od sebe. Cilj igre je, kao i u fudbalu, postići gol.

programme.title: Migzi od Persia - Prince of Persia The Lost Crown / Migzi Od Persije - Prince Of Persia the Lost Crown
programme.desc: We bring a review of the game that is part of the popular franchise of the Prince of Persia. The main hero is Sargon who has to face a number of challenges while trying to make a mission. / Donosimo recenziju igrice koja je deo popularne franšize Princ od Persije. Glavni junak je Sargon koji mora da se suoči sa brojnim izazovima dok pokušava da izvrši misiju.

programme.title: Legendary tkddspale - Apex Legends / Legendarni Tkdspale - Apex Legends
programme.desc: Tkdspale introduces us to the world of Apex Legends, in which we will find old heroes with new abilities in different domains. / Tkdspale uvodi nas u svet Apex Legends, u kome ćemo pronaći stare heroje sa novim sposobnostima u različitim domenima.

programme.title: Ets2 - West Balkans - Caotutifruti / Ets2 - West Balkans - Caotutifruti
programme.desc: In the Videos Euro Truck Simulator 2 we will try for a truck wheel, visit interesting places across Europe and try to successfully deliver the goods. / U videoigri Euro Truck Simulator 2 ćemo se oprobati za volanom kamiona, posetiti zanimljiva mesta širom Evrope i pokušati uspešno dostaviti robu.

programme.title: Tastless Lol-Uje / Tasteless LoL-uje
programme.desc: Gamer of the Red Star, Igor Radusinovic, will spend you through lol. Learn everything you are interested in about a popular game from our professional. Good fun is certainly guaranteed. / Gejmer Crvene Zvezde, Igor Radusinović, provešće vas kroz LOL. Naučite sve što vas zanima o popularnoj igri od našeg profesionalca. Dobra zabava je svakako zagarantovana.

programme.title: Excitement / Uzbuđenje
programme.desc: The show excitement every day announces in the right way a new day with interesting topics. The show was created as a result of the desires of our viewers and friends. It suits all ages with all the ages, offering a wide range of interesting things and tips. The show aims to promote positive events, fun music and culture. We want a light but well -designed conversation or prepared informative side dish, advice for every day/accent for developing culture and living, information from the world and proven news from BiH, a weather forecast and an event for an event or a place for a good time, we paint a monotonous everyday life. The excitement is a show that allows a good start for a day full of freshness, energy and positive thoughts. / Emisija UzBuđenje svakim danom na pravi način najavljuje novi dan uz interesantne teme. Emisija je nastala kao rezultat želja naših gledatelja i prijatelja. Svojim sadržajima odgovara svim uzrastima, te nudi širok spektar zanimljivosti i savjeta. Emisija ima cilj da promovira pozitivna dešavanja, zabavnu muziku i kulturu. Želja nam je da uz lagani, ali dobro osmišljeni razgovor ili pripremljeni informativni prilog, savjete za svaki dan/akcenat na razvijanje svijesti o kulturi i načinu življenja, informacijama iz svijeta i provjerenim vijestima iz BiH, vremenskom prognozom i najavom događaja ili mjesta za dobar provod obojimo monotonu svakodnevnicu. UzBuđenje je emisija koja omogućava dobar start za dan pun svježine, energije i pozitivnih misli.

programme.title: Bosnian Skills / Bosanski Vjestnik
programme.desc: The Bosnian skill is regulated and presented by Amra Halilović, which introduces novelties in the preparation of current topics in the preparation of current topics and other areas of social importance, confronting, direct issues and interesting observations. What is this type of emission different from others in the pronounced creativity that journalistic team through short contributions, which includes the core of the current themes, presented the public without longer and overcoming information - short, clearly and objectively. / Bosanski vjestnik uređuje i prezentuje Amra Halilović, koja u ovoj sezoni za sve gledaoce uvodi novitete u pripremi aktuelnih tema, odabiru gostiju iz svijeta politike i drugih oblasti od društvenog značaja, suočavanja, direktnih pitanja i zanimljivih zapažanja. Ono u čemu se ova vrsta emisije razlikuje od drugih leži u izraženoj kreativnosti koju novinarski tim kroz kratke priloge, a koji obuhvataju srž aktuelne tematike, prezentuju javnosti bez dužih i preopširnih informacija - kratko, jasno i objektivno.

Within the summer scheme, our viewers have the opportunity to see the most interesting and most dramatic guest appearances from our Face to face, Central Diary with Senad Hadžifejzović, Bosnian skill. Face from the archive brings you an overview of the guest appearances that caused the most attention during this TV season. / Face televizija je godinama postala sinonim za aktuelan i objektivan informativni program. U okviru ljetne sheme, naši gledaoci imaju priliku ponovo pogledati najzanimljivija i najdramatičnija gostovanja iz naših emisija Face to Face, Centralni dnevnik sa Senadom Hadžifejzovićem, Bosanski vjestnik. Face iz arhiva vam donosi pregled gostovanja koja su izazvala najviše pažnje tokom ove TV sezone.

programme.title: Maximus Olympic / Maximus Olympicus
programme.desc: The contribution of Bosnian clubs and athletes in the former Yugoslavia is huge. Just like the brave military leader of Maximus from the Gladiator movie and our Olympians won, winning the Olympic medal, leaving an indelible mark on sports history. Inspired by their power of spirit and body, which brought them to the winning throne, the series is called unusual, but by name that speaks of that power of forty -one athletes - Bosnian and Herzegovina who won 48 Maximus Olympicus medals. Careful analysis is easy to find out that after rare significant results in the 50's and 60s, sports clubs and athletes from Yugoslavia experience the true explosion of success in the 1970s and 1980s. All these results achieved were certainly a remarkable contribution to the Bosnians and Herzegovinians who, at the time, defending the colors of the former common state, won Olympic and other medals in individual and collective sports. Considering the importance of the Olympic Games as the world's largest sports festival, Face as a partner in the implementation proudly joined this project, exclusively focused on Bosnian Olympians who won medals. At the Olympic Games held in the period 1948–1988. 41 athletes from Bosnia and Herzegovina brought a total of 48 medals: 16 gold, 20 silver and 12 bronze. / Doprinos bosanskohercegovačkih klubova i sportista u bivšoj Jugoslaviji je ogroman. Baš poput hrabrog vojskovođe Maximusa iz filma Gladijator i naši olimpijci su pobjeđivali, osvajali olimpijske medalje, ostavivši tako neizbrisiv trag u sportskoj povijesti. Inspirirani njihovom snagom duha i tijela, koja ih je dovela na pobjednički tron, serijal je nazvan neobičnim, ali imenom koji govori upravo o toj snazi četrdeset i jednog sportiste - Bosanca i Hercegovca koji su osvojili 48 medalja Maximus Olympicus. Pažljivom analizom lako se dolazi do spoznaje da nakon rijetkih značajnijih rezultata u 50-tim i 60-tim godinama, sportski klubovi i sportisti iz Jugoslavije doživljavaju pravu eksploziju uspjeha 70-tih i 80-tih godina prošlog stoljeća. Svim tim ostvarenim rezultatima svakako su izniman doprinos dali Bosanci i Hercegovci koji su u to vrijeme, braneći boje bivše zajedničke države, osvajali olimpijska i druga odličja u individualnim i kolektivnim sportovima. Imajući u vidu značaj Olimpijskih igara kao najveće svjetske smotre sporta, FACE se kao partner u realizaciji ponosno uključio u ovaj projekt, isključivo fokusiran na bosanskohercegovačke olimpijce koji su osvojili medalje. Na Olimpijskim igrama održanim u periodu 1948–1988. godine 41 sportista iz Bosne i Hercegovine donijeli su ukupno 48 medalja i to: 16 zlatnih, 20 srebrenih i 12 bronzanih.

programme.title: Your head / Kafana
programme.desc: The cafe is part of the culture of the Balkan peoples. The place where it all begins, it is created and ends. This is where the first love is created, the unhappy end. The only place where it is celebrated, grieves, tells and silent. This is where politics, states, make political decisions, disappear differences. Everyone knows everything about everything. The topics of sports, money, love, politics, economics, conspiracy theory, life are exchanged, and they are all professional, and those with a diploma and those without it. The Talk Show of the Caper is a 20 show series, and it involves talking to guests from different social spheres in the atmosphere of a cafe. In the focus, above all, an ordinary man of an interesting life story (writers, poets, lawyers, professors, waiters, utilities, takisists, fizers, sellers, street entertainers, police officers, firefighters, athletes, singers, students, educators). The stage concept of studies, ie the atmosphere of the cafes, creates a relaxed atmosphere, the intimacy between guests and leaders, and even conversations look more natural, deviating from the standard form of Interview. A relaxed atmosphere will also contribute to an indispensable part of every cafe - music. / Kafana je dio kulture balkanskih naroda. Mjesto gdje sve počinje, nastaje i završava. Tu se stvaraju prve ljubavi, nesretne završavaju. Jedino je mjesto na kojem se slavi, tuguje, priča i šuti. Tu se vode politike, nastaju države, donose političke odluke, nestaju razlike. Tu svako sve o svemu zna. Razmjenjuju se teme od sporta, novca, ljubavi, politike, ekonomije, teorija zavjere, života i svi su stručni, i oni sa diplomom i oni bez nje. Talk show Kafana je serijal od 20 emisija, a podrazumijeva razgovor sa gostima iz različitih društvenih sfera u ambijentu kafane. U fokusu je, prije svega, običan čovjek zanimljive životne priče (pisci, pjesnici, advokati, profesori, konobari, komunalci, takisisti, fizeri, prodavači, ulični zabavljači, policajci, vatrogasci, sportisti, pjevači, učenici, vaspitači). Scenski koncept studija, tj. ambijent kafane stvara opuštenu atmosferu, prisnost između gosta i voditelja pa i razgovori izgledaju prirodnije, odstupajući od standardne forme interview-a. Opuštenoj atmosferi će doprinijeti i neizostavni dio svake kafane – muzika.

programme.title: Drunk parents / Pijani roditelji
programme.desc: Meet Frank and Nancy Teagarten: a family that resolutely holds up the higher social classes with their great black range rover and a deliciously decorated Tudor style house. They nervously take their daughter to the first day of college and as parents cannot be more proud. But shortly afterwards, they visit them from the debt, after which they barely put an end to the end, and it seems that their wealth is less guaranteed than we thought! Combining to the daughter to enable college, they take a backyard sale paired from a drunken evening after which they regret some of their decisions in the morning. They are trying to hide their missing capital from friends and families through complex neighborhood programs that are just moreover. / Upoznajte Franka i Nancy Teagarten: obitelj koja se odlučno drži viših društvenih slojeva sa svojim sjajnim crnim Range Roverom i ukusno uređenom kućom u tudorskom stilu. Nervozno odvezu kćer na prvi dan koledža i kao roditelji ne mogu biti ponosniji. No ubrzo zatim ih posjeti utjerivač dugova nakon čega jedva krpaju kraj s krajem te se čini da je njihovo bogatstvo manje zajamčeno nego što smo mislili! Obvezavši se da kćeri omoguće fakultet, oni održe dvorišnu prodaju uparenu s večeri pijančenja nakon koje ujutro požale neke svoje odluke. Pokušavaju skriti svoj nestali kapital od prijatelja i obitelji preko složenih kvartovskih programa kojima se samo još više srozavaju.

programme.title: On the devil's way / Na đavoljem putu
programme.desc: The director and screenwriter is Jason Cabell - a former member of the special units (Navy Seal). The scenario was written on the basis of his personal experience from Colombia when he collaborated with a narcotics suppression (DEA). The action of the film follows the path of drugs from Mexico, over the US to Canada. The Executive Director of the International Conglomerate sends its two best man to investigate the disappearance of several cocaine consignments and find the culprits in the drug smuggling chain. / Reditelj i scenarista je Jason Cabell - bivši pripadnik specijalnih jedinica (Navy SEAL). Scenario je napisan na osnovu njegovog ličnog iskustva iz Kolumbije kada je sarađivao sa Odredom za suzbijanje narkotika (DEA). Radnja filma prati put droge od Meksika, preko SAD do Kanade. Izvršni direktor međunarodnog konglomerata šalje svoja dva najbolja čovjeka da istraže nestanak nekoliko pošiljaka kokaina i nađu krivca u lancu krijumčarenja droge.

U fokusu je, prije svega, običan čovjek zanimljive životne priče (pisci, pjesnici, advokati, profesori, konobari, komunalci, takisisti, fizeri, prodavači, ulični zabavljači, policajci, vatrogasci, sportisti, pjevači, učenici, vaspitači). Scenski koncept studija, tj. ambijent kafane stvara opuštenu atmosferu, prisnost između gosta i voditelja pa i razgovori izgledaju prirodnije, odstupajući od standardne forme interview-a. Opuštenoj atmosferi će doprinijeti i neizostavni dio svake kafane – muzika.

programme.desc: In the back of the twentieth century, Bosnia and Herzegovinjoja was then under the occupation of the Austro-Hungarian monarchy, the awakening of national consciousness begins, in all its nations. programme.title: Bosnia / Bosna
programme.desc: 5.Aprila 1979. in the French city of Grenoblo before 12,000 BOSNA fans, Bosnia won the Italian Champion Emerson with the result 96:93. It was, at the time, the greatest success of Bosnian, but also Yugoslav club basketball. This was the first title of the club European champion in the then state and popular Sarajevo students became synonymous with successful BiH. This is the story of the sports phenomenon of one social and political context. What was the ambience, what were political and social circumstances, who were the key individuals who stood behind this success? The composition of the championship generation: Delibašić, Varajić, Vučević, Benacek, Đogić, BOSIUSIC, IZIĆ, Radovanović, Hadžić, Pešić, Krvavac ... The coach of this brilliant generation was Bogdan Tanjević. Author: Arijana Saračević Helać / 5.aprila 1979. u francuskom gradu Grenoblu pred 12 hiljada navijača KK Bosna je u finalu pobijedila italijanskog šampiona Emersona s rezultatom 96:93. Bio je to, u to vrijeme, najveći uspjeh bosanskohercegovačke, ali i jugoslavenske klupske košarke. Ovo je bila prva titula klupskog evropskog šampiona u tadašnjoj državi i popularni sarajevski studenti postali su sinonim uspješne BiH. Ovo je priča o sportskom fenomenu jednog društvenog i političkog konteksta. Šta je bio ambijent, kakve su bile političke i društvene okolnosti, ko su bili ključni pojedinci koji su stajali iza ovakvog uspjeha? Sastav šampionske generacije: Delibašić, Varajić, Vučević, Benaček, Đogić, Bosiočić, Izić, Radovanović, Hadžić, Pešić, Krvavac... Trener ove brilijantne generacije bio je Bogdan Tanjević. Autorica: Arijana Saračević Helać

Although the autopsy was delayed until the arrival of the American doctor, Murdoch and Ogden manage to determine that Dewitt was shot in the camp in Alberta; His body is gypsized and transported by train and then placed in a dispatch dinosaur to look like he was killed in Toronto. programme.title: Marketing / Marketing
programme.desc: Take a break a few minutes with our marketing block! Learn news about various products, services or some completely new ideas through our marketing program. / Predahnite nekoliko minuta uz naš marketing blok! Saznajte novosti o raznim proizvodima, uslugama ili nekim sasvim novim idejama putem našeg marketing programa.

programme.title: People and events / Ljudi i događaji
programme.desc: This show has an informative-educational character, and the goal of her to remind us through time which people and events marked a certain date. / Ova emisija ima informativno-edukativni karakter, a cilj joj da nas putujući kroz vreme podseti koji su ljudi i događaji obeležili određeni datum.

programme.title: Horoscope / Horoskop
programme.desc: Find out what the stars predict for us for the next period, what to expect when it comes to love, work and health. Follow what stars warn your zodiac sign, adopt a useful advice or just just have fun. / Saznajte šta nam zvezde predviđaju za naredni period, šta da očekujemo kada su u pitanju ljubav, posao i zdravlje. Pratite na šta zvezde upozoravaju Vaš horoskopski znak, usvojite koristan savet ili se prosto samo zabavite.

programme.title: Travel with us / Putujte sa nama
programme.desc: Go with us at a variety of places in the world! We take a picture to the most beautiful landscapes and the most interesting cities on the planet. Let's meet the customs, culture, architecture and other sights of many destinations. / Pođite sa nama na najrazličitija mesta na svetu! Slikom vas vodimo u najlepše predele i u najzanimljivije gradove na planeti. Upoznajmo zajedno običaje, kulturu, arhitekturu i druge znamenitosti mnogih destinacija.

programme.title: A cottage in the flower / Kućica u cveću
programme.desc: Learn in this show how to worry about your flowers. All about the conditions that are best for a particular species, about the prevention of various diseases, preparations, cultivation and nurturing your green pets. / U ovoj emisiji saznajte na koji način da brinete o svom cveću. Sve o uslovima koji su najbolji za određenu vrstu, o prevenciji različitih bolesti, preparatima, gajenju i negovanju vaših zelenih ljubimaca.

programme.title: Vojvodina events / Vojvođanska događanja
programme.desc: In this broadcasting issue, you can find out all the latest information and news from the entire Vojvodina. All news that could be interested in Vojvodina, in one place. / U ovoj emisiji informativnog karaktera možete saznati sve najnovije informacije i aktuelnosti iz čitave Vojvodine. Sve vesti koje bi mogle zanimati Vojvođane, na jednom mestu.

programme.title: Without a prescription / Bez recepta
programme.desc: Emission without a prescription is dedicated to health and healthy lifestyle. We host experts who will share with us tips for improving health and strengthening immunity. / Emisija Bez recepta posvećena je zdravlju i zdravom načinu života. Ugošćujemo stručnjake koji će sa nama podeliti savete za poboljšanje zdravlja i jačanje imuniteta.

programme.title: We cook for you / Kuvamo za Vas
programme.desc: In addition to culinary demonstrations, we will meet with customs and the kitchen of your homeland. / Osim kulinarskih demonstracija, upoznaćemo se i sa običajima i kuhinjom svoje domovine.

programme.title: Some important things / Neke važne stvari
programme.desc: Information magazine on events that marked the past days. / Informativni magazin o događajima koji su obeležili protekle dane.

programme.title: Strong woman a strong village / Jaka žena jako selo
programme.desc: The aim of this project is to improve the position of women in rural areas, which are not only creative and innovative, but also ready to put their energy and knowledge in the function of own entrepreneurship and economic empowerment. / Cilj ovog projekta je poboljšanje položaja žena u seoskim sredinama, koje su ne samo kreativne i inovativne, već i spremne da svoju energiju i znanje stave u funkciju sopstvenog preduzetništva i ekonomskog osnaživanja.

programme.title: Home travelogues / Domaći putopisi
programme.desc: The travel show takes you to tour various destinations and reveals a tourist treasure that is worth visiting. / Putopisna emisija vas vodi u obilazak različitih destinacija i otkriva turistička blaga koja vredi posetiti.

programme.title: Ecovojvodina / Ekovojvodina
programme.desc: Current ecological topics from the territory of the whole of Vojvodina. Look at which we can do this all ways to contribute to the preservation of the environment and the development of environmental awareness. / Aktuelne ekološke teme sa teritorije cele Vojvodine. Pogledajte na koje to sve načine možemo da doprinesemo očuvanju životne sredine i razvoju ekološke svesti.

programme.title: Balkanorama / Balkanorama
programme.desc: The aim of this show is to remind you of all those well-known places that are a paradise for the soul and body, where in accordance with nature, you can find peace. In addition, we discover some lesser known places, which left no less breathless. / Cilj ove emisije je da vas podseti na sva ona dobro poznata mesta koja su raj za dušu i telo, gde u skladu sa prirodom, možete pronaći mir. Sem toga, otkrivamo vam neka manje poznata mesta, koja ništa manje ne ostavljaju bez daha.

programme.title: We cook for you / Kuvamo za Vas
programme.desc: In addition to culinary demonstrations, we will meet with customs and the kitchen of your homeland. / Osim kulinarskih demonstracija, upoznaćemo se i sa običajima i kuhinjom svoje domovine.

programme.title: Some important things / Neke važne stvari

programme.title: Strong woman a strong village / Jaka žena jako selo
programme.desc: The aim of this project is to improve the position of women in rural areas, which are not only creative and innovative, but also ready to put their energy and knowledge in the function of own entrepreneurship and economic empowerment. / Cilj ovog projekta je poboljšanje položaja žena u seoskim sredinama, koje su ne samo kreativne i inovativne, već i spremne da svoju energiju i znanje stave u funkciju sopstvenog preduzetništva i ekonomskog osnaživanja.

programme.title: Home travelogues / Domaći putopisi
programme.desc: The travel show takes you to tour various destinations and reveals a tourist treasure that is worth visiting. / Putopisna emisija vas vodi u obilazak različitih destinacija i otkriva turistička blaga koja vredi posetiti.

programme.title: Ecovojvodina / Ekovojvodina
programme.desc: Current ecological topics from the territory of the whole of Vojvodina. programme.title: Balkanorama / Balkanorama

Mucke / Mućke
programme.desc: A very successful British comedy about two brothers, a part and a gorgeous treater. They deal with street selling things procured in a suspicious way. programme.title: B.B. show / B.B. show
programme.desc: BB Show is the most sub-rural Humorist TV series in the former Yugoslavia. It was designed as a queue sketch vice, a row of witty musical spots. He also launched numerous characters and characters who have laughed children and adults. 7000 jokes were recorded, without political and sex connotations. / BB Show je najdugotrajnija humoristička tv serija na prostorima bivše Jugoslavije. Koncipirana je kao red skeč viceva, red duhovitih muzičkih spotova. Lansirala je i mnogobrojne likove i karaktere koji su zasmejavali decu i odrasle godinama. Snimljeno je 7000 viceva, bez političkih i seksualnih konotacija.

programme.title: Face, before / Alo, alo
programme.desc: Rene Arto (Gorden Kay) is the owner of the cafe in the occupied French town of Navular at the time of the Second World War. It is between two fire: seemingly cooperates with the Nazis and in fact it is actually helped by the movement of resistance. German colonel) is in good relations with Rene but uses coffee to hide the stolen image, which plans to sell after the war. Unfortunately Hitler also wants a picture and sent by Gestapovaca Oto Flica (Richard Gibson) to find it. And on the other hand, the resistance movement, which led by Michelle (Kirsten Kuk) near Renea hides British aircraft. In the middle of all these confusion, Rene Mora and hides the affair with the waitresses from his wife Edit (Carmen Silver). / Rene Artoa (Gorden Kej) je vlasnik kafea u okupiranom francuskom gradiću Nuvionu u vreme Drugog svetskog rata. On se nalazi između dve vatre: naizgled sarađuje sa nacistima a u stvari potajno pomaže Pokretu otpora.Nemački pukovnik Von Strom (Ričard Marner) je u dobrim odnosima sa Reneom ali koristi kafe da sakrije ukradenu sliku, koju planira da proda posle rata. Nažalost Hitler takođe želi sliku i poslao je gestapovca Oto Flika (Ričard Gibson) da je pronađe. A sa druge strane Pokret otpora, koji predvodi Mišel (Kirsten Kuk) kod Renea krije britanske vazduhoplovce. U sred sve te zbrke Rene mora i da skriva afere sa konobaricama od svoje žene Edit (Karmen Silvera).

programme.desc: Rene Arto (Gorden Kay) is the owner of the cafe in the occupied French town of Navular at the time of the Second World War. German colonel) is in good relations with Rene but uses coffee to hide the stolen image, which plans to sell after the war. And on the other hand, the resistance movement, which led by Michelle (Kirsten Kuk) near Renea hides British aircraft. In the middle of all these confusion, Rene Mora and hides the affair with the waitresses from his wife Edit (Carmen Silver). / Rene Artoa (Gorden Kej) je vlasnik kafea u okupiranom francuskom gradiću Nuvionu u vreme Drugog svetskog rata. On se nalazi između dve vatre: naizgled sarađuje sa nacistima a u stvari potajno pomaže Pokretu otpora.Nemački pukovnik Von Strom (Ričard Marner) je u dobrim odnosima sa Reneom ali koristi kafe da sakrije ukradenu sliku, koju planira da proda posle rata. programme.title: B.B. show / B.B. show
programme.desc: BB Show is the most sub-rural Humorist TV series in the former Yugoslavia. It was designed as a queue sketch vice, a row of witty musical spots. He also launched numerous characters and characters who have laughed children and adults. 7000 jokes were recorded, without political and sex connotations. / BB Show je najdugotrajnija humoristička tv serija na prostorima bivše Jugoslavije. Koncipirana je kao red skeč viceva, red duhovitih muzičkih spotova. Lansirala je i mnogobrojne likove i karaktere koji su zasmejavali decu i odrasle godinama. Snimljeno je 7000 viceva, bez političkih i seksualnih konotacija.

programme.title: Face, before / Alo, alo
programme.desc: Rene Arto (Gorden Kay) is the owner of the cafe in the occupied French town of Navular at the time of the Second World War. It is between two fire: seemingly cooperates with the Nazis and in fact it is actually helped by the movement of resistance. German colonel) is in good relations with Rene but uses coffee to hide the stolen image, which plans to sell after the war. Unfortunately Hitler also wants a picture and sent by Gestapovaca Oto Flica (Richard Gibson) to find it. And on the other hand, the resistance movement, which led by Michelle (Kirsten Kuk) near Renea hides British aircraft. In the middle of all these confusion, Rene Mora and hides the affair with the waitresses from his wife Edit (Carmen Silver). / Rene Artoa (Gorden Kej) je vlasnik kafea u okupiranom francuskom gradiću Nuvionu u vreme Drugog svetskog rata. On se nalazi između dve vatre: naizgled sarađuje sa nacistima a u stvari potajno pomaže Pokretu otpora.Nemački pukovnik Von Strom (Ričard Marner) je u dobrim odnosima sa Reneom ali koristi kafe da sakrije ukradenu sliku, koju planira da proda posle rata. Nažalost Hitler takođe želi sliku i poslao je gestapovca Oto Flika (Ričard Gibson) da je pronađe. A sa druge strane Pokret otpora, koji predvodi Mišel (Kirsten Kuk) kod Renea krije britanske vazduhoplovce. U sred sve te zbrke Rene mora i da skriva afere sa konobaricama od svoje žene Edit (Karmen Silvera).

programme.title: Comedy with your feet 3 in 1 / Komedija s nogu 3 u 1
programme.desc: Stand-up comedians from the former Yugoslavia gather in the emission comedy with legs 3 in 1. Each episode contains the exhibition of three comedians from three different countries, which is why the emissions of the Named 3 in 1. / Stand-up komičari sa prostora bivše Jugoslavije okupljaju se u emisiji Komedija sa nogama 3 u 1. Svaka epizoda sadrži postavu od tri komičara iz tri različite zemlje, zbog čega je i sama emisija nazvana 3 u 1.

programme.title: Novice / Novajlije
programme.desc: New Fun - The Humorist Program of Novi is a project on which the Production Happy TV has long and carefully worked, with the desire to enemy hot summer days and to process the competition team as from fairy. In the newcomers, 17 young and valuable participants will be presented for the dream reward ... although many of their fantastic award see in banknotes, a team that bidges in the newcomers fight for dreams! What adorns competitors in newcomers is definitely youth, wit and ambitiousness that has in excess. Everyone has a clear goal in front of them and confidently rushes to fulfilling each task. They will face new tasks, challenges and with countless ways to prevent obstacles on the road to the stars every week. Through interesting tasks, they will employ their creativity, dexterity, persuasiveness, but also vispreciation, and courage to choose from shortcuts and petty cheats or honest and complete endeavors to work from dreams. Newcomers are not a classic competition, through this format, we are fighting our favorites, to fight bravely to achieve public and most intimate dreams, but also attend to conflicts, rivals and tests for tolerance, patience and readiness to teamwork. Who will go out of the reality show as a friend, and who will be ready for gossip and ignorance? / Novi zabavno - humoristički program Novajlije je projekat na kome je produkcija Happy TV dugo i brižno radila, sa željom da gleadocima ulepša vrele letnje dane i da na najbolji mogući način obraduje takmičarsku ekipu nagradom kao iz bajke! U Novajlijama će se predstaviti 17 mladih i vrednih učesnika koji će se takmičiti za nagradu iz snova...Iako mnogi svoju fantastičnu nagradu vide u novčanicama, ekipa koja se nadmeće u Novajlijama bori se za POSAO iz snova! Ono što krasi takmičare u Novajlijama jeste svakako mladost, pamet i ambicioznost koje ima na pretek. Svako ima jasan cilj pred sobom i samouvereno hrli ka ispunjenju svakog zadatka. Oni će se svake nedelje suočavati sa novim zadacima, izazovima i sa bezbroj načina na koje mogu da prenebregnu prepreke na putu ka zvezdama. Kroz zanimljive zadatke, oni će svakodnevno upošljavati svoju kreativnost, spretnost, ubedljivost, ali i visprenost i smelost kojom će se opredeliti za prečice i sitne varke ili poštene i kompletne poduhvate kojima će doći do posla iz snova. Novajlije nisu klasičan konkurs, kroz ovaj format bodrimo svoje favorite, pratimo kako se hrabro bore za ostvarenje javnih i najintimnijih snova, ali i prisustvujemo sukobima, rivalstvima i smicalicama koje predstavljaju svojevrstan podvig i test na toleranciju, strpljenje i spremnost na timski rad. Ko će iz reality show-a izaći kao prijatelj, a ko će biti spreman na ogovaranja i ignorisanja?

programme.title: Matchmaker / Provodadžija
programme.desc: Everyone is a well-known story of our old ones that it used to be unimaginable that two young people be introduced without the help of intermediaries, in the people known as the conductor. The lonely guys cheese in Serbia will find the soul mate, and protects the family, with great success helps the emission of conductors. In the role of real events that include girls and guys are charming headers that, using their methods, games and tests, help guys to get to know the girls better and thus make the right, life choice. The show abounds in laughter and good mood, and what is most important, helping young people realize their wishes and direct them towards the desired goal, and that is successful love. / Svima je već dobro poznata priča naših starih da je nekada bilo nezamisljivo da se dvoje mladih upozna bez pomoći posrednika, u narodu poznatijeg kao provodadžije. Usamljeni momci sirom Srbije u želji da pronađu srodnu dušu, i zasnuju porodicu, sa velikim uspehom pomaže emisija Provodadžija. U ulozi pravih provodadžija koje spadaju devojke i momke nalaze se šarmantne voditeljke koje, koristeći svoje metode, igrice i testove, pomažu momcima da što bolje upoznaju devojke i tako naprave onaj pravi, životni izbor. Emisija obiluje smehom i dobrim raspoloženjem, a ono što je najbitnije, pomaže mladim ljudima da ostvare svoje želje i usmere ih ka željenom cilju, a to je uspešna ljubav.

programme.title: Summer kitchen / Ljetna kuhinja
programme.desc: The life of a BiH man from a person's perspective. The one who creates, lives and survives. The one who fights for a better tomorrow, relying only on himself, his country and hands. And despite everything, he remains smiling, ready to host, welcome and serve his soul just like the most delicious bite. In search of valuable BiH people, we travel to Bosnia and Herzegovina, we live the life of a BiH man, dignified and humble. With all the adversity, obstacles and the weight of reality, hard and hard work ... Man is smiling! / Život bh. čovjeka iz perspektive čovjeka. Onog koji stvara, živi i preživljava. Onog koji se bori za bolje sutra, oslanjajući se samo na sebe, svoju zemlju i ruke. I uprkos svemu, ostaje nasmijan, spreman da ugosti, dočeka i servira dušu baš kao najukusniji zalogaj. U potrazi za vrijednim bh. ljudima, putujemo Bosnom i Hercegovinom, živimo život bh. čovjeka, dostojanstven i ponizan. Uz sve nedaće, prepreke i težinu stvarnosti, težak i naporan rad... čovjek je nasmijan!

programme.title: Anatomy of life / Anatomija života
programme.desc: The new show in the Hayat TV program is anatomy of life. The aim of this show is to offer viewers in coaching staff with professional staff, pharmacies and professors to answer many health questions. programme.desc: The show fulfills my desire, which makes family happy, children, old and young programs are for all generations. Opening the paths of happiness, personal pleasure because we have done someone happy at least for a moment, is a feeling that cannot be changed to any other. The realization that we were all together part of the change, opened one new window into the untouchable absolute freedom, and the ways we make others are innumerable, unlimited and strongly soothing. A socially responsible person who leads socially responsible business and makes life more comfortable people around him is certainly a quality product of the community that surrounds him. Being always on the side of that hand that needs us is the simplicity of life we all strive for, and it is this perfect simplicity of man to end up to infinity, and further. Having a chance to be on the way of good, and the possibility of promoting yourself through the immeasurable moments of the joy of a life is the privilege of those who will always see in everything, and in the end only to feel success and satisfaction, both business and personally. / Emisija Ispuni mi želju, koja usrećuje porodice, djecu, stare i mlade program je za sve generacije. Spoznaja da smo svi zajedno bili dio promjene, otvorili jedan novi prozor u nedodirljivo je apsolutna sloboda, a načini na koji usrećujemo druge su bezbrojni, neograničeni i snažno u konačnici umirujući. Društveno odgovorna osoba, koja predvodi društveno odgovorno poslovanje i čini život ugodnijim ljudima oko sebe sigurno je kvalitetan proizvod zajednice koja ga okružuje. Biti uvijek na strani one ruke koja nas treba je jednostavnost života kojoj svi težimo, a upravo ta savršena jednostavnost čovjeka ispunjava do beskraja, i još dalje. Imati priliku biti na putu dobra, i mogućnosti da se promovirate kroz nemjerljive trenutke radosti jednog života privilegija je onih koji će uvijek i u svemu vidjeti, a na kraju i osjetiti samo uspjeh i zadovoljstvo, kako poslovno tako i lično.

programme.title: In someone else's courtyard with osmani jich / U tuđoj avliji s Osmanom Džihom
programme.desc: The show in Tudjoj Avlija was launched before the aim of pointing out to her viewers to one simple fact: BiH gives birth to successful people we successfully drive away from the country to be successful in foreign countries, to pay taxes and contributions to employ Germans, Austrians, Swiss ... After we successfully expelled them from the country and after they became successful in the foreign country, allows you to invest money in their homeland. Why did our country become an obstacle, not a solution to its citizens? Why doesn't our country want to return and successful? Why are there no institutions in BiH that will bring together our successful entrepreneurs and experts in the diaspora and offer them to be a service to start the same jobs and employ our people? Why is there no institution in BiH that will bring together our successful entrepreneurs and experts in the diaspora and offer them to be a service to start jobs here and to employ our people ?? Because realistically, there is a danger of being left without a diaspora. This show is a kind of appeal to the authorities in BiH to answer the questions asked. / Emisija U tuđoj avliji je pokrenuta prije s ciljem da bi se njenim gledaocima ukazalo na jednu prostu činjenicu: BiH rađa uspješne ljude koje mi uspješno otjeramo iz države da budu uspješni u stranim zemljama, da tamo plaćaju poreze i doprinose, da tamo zapošljavaju Nijemce, Austrijance, Švicarce... Nakon što smo ih uspješno protjerali iz zemlje i nakon što su postali uspješni u tuđim zemljama, BiH uspješno ne dozvoljava da ulože novac u svojoj domovini. Zašto je naša zemlja postala prepreka, a ne rješenje svojim građanima? Zašto naša zemlja ne želi da se sposobni i uspješni vrate? Zašto u BiH ne postoje institucije koje će okupiti naše uspješne poduzetnike i stručnjaje iz dijaspore i ponude im da budu servis da isti pokrenu u njoj poslove i zaposle naše ljude? Zašto ne postoji institucija u BiH koja će okupiti naše uspješne poduzetnike i stručnjake u dijaspori i ponuditi im da bude servis da pokrenu poslove ovdje i da zaposle naše ljude?? Jer realno, postoji opasnost da ostanemo i bez dijaspore. Ova emisija svojevrstan je apel vlastima u BiH da odgovore na postavljena pitanja.

Međutim, to neće biti lako, jer su troje djece u gradu, Arda, Ela i Efe, formirali tim koji zovu Z ekipa i pokušat će da poremete ove planove.

programme.title: True and the kingdom of long / True i Kraljevstvo Duge
programme.desc: True and the Kingdom of Dugerates the Adventures of True, the kind eight -year -old girl and her best friend Cat Bartleby, who live in a capricious and colorful universe. True has the ability to activate the magical powers of the desire of desire to help solve the problem and make the citizens of Dugi Kingdom happy. / True i Kraljevstvo Dugeprati avanture True, ljubazne osmogodišnje djevojčice i njenog najboljeg prijatelja mačka Bartlebyja, koji žive u hirovitom i šarenom svemiru. True ima sposobnost da aktivira magične moći Drveta želja kako bi pomogao u rješavanju problema i usrećio građane Duginog kraljevstva.

programme.title: Do you cook the darkness / Kuhate li mrnjao
programme.desc: Do you cook hate? The story is that the cats of the stripes and alien cats are telling us. Together they prepare simple and healthy meals that children can prepare alone - recipes do not contain cutting, frying, cooking and other potentially dangerous actions where children can be violated. / KUHATE LI MRNJAO? priča je koju nam pričaju mačak Pruga i vanzemaljski mačak Okac. Zajedno pripremaju jednostavne i zdrave obroke koja djeca mogu da pripreme sama - recepti ne sadrže sječenje, prženje, kuhanje i druge potencijalno opasne radnje u kojima djeca mogu da se povrijede.

programme.title: Hayatovci / Hayatovci
programme.desc: This is a show with which they grew up generations of little ones. Hayatovac, Lela, Lilo, but also Lina Raspberry and Dodas lead you to the exciting world of Hayatovac, a lot of knowledge, fun, great guests, in a favorite children's EMIS EVERYONE - Hayatovs! / Ovo je emisija uz koju su odrastale generacije mališana. Hayatovac, Lela, Lilo, ali i Lina Malina i Dodi vode vas u uzbudljivi svijet Hayatovaca, Mnogo spoznaja, zabave, super gostiju, u omiljenoj dječijoj emisji ikada - HAYATOVCI!

programme.title: My pet / Moj ljubimac
programme.desc: My pet is an emission of an educational entertainment character and wants to present pets as equal family members, and educate the owners of the proper posture and care of animals. The interlocutors are veterinarians, gromers, dog trainers, psychologists and other experts related to animals / Moj ljubimac je emisija edukativno zabavnog karaktera i želi predstaviti ljubimce kao ravnopravne članove porodice, te educirati vlasnike o pravilnom držanju i njezi životinja. Sagovornici su veterinari, groomeri, treneri pasa, psiholozi i ostali experti vezani uz životinje

programme.title: Children's hits / Dječiji hitovi
programme.desc: Enjoy music tracks, intended for the youngest viewers, numerous bh. Author. / Uživajte u muzičkim numerama, namjenjenim najmlađim gledateljima, brojnih bh. autora.

programme.title: An ant / Mravko Travko
programme.desc: The story of one of the favorite characters of the toddler in BiH Ant Travka is also translated into a series. After Mravko Travko revived from picture books and sang children's rhymes, he has now decided to entertain children otherwise, but also teach them many useful things. / Priča jednog od omiljenih likova mališana u BiH Mravka Travka pretočena je i u seriju. Nakon što je Mravko Travko oživio iz slikovnica i zapjevao dječije pjesmice, sada je odlučio da djecu zabavi i na drugi način, ali i nauči ih mnogim korisnim stvarima.

programme.title: Children's hits / Dječiji hitovi
programme.desc: Enjoy music tracks, intended for the youngest viewers, numerous bh. Author. / Uživajte u muzičkim numerama, namjenjenim najmlađim gledateljima, brojnih bh. autora.

programme.title: From the team / Z Ekipa
programme.desc: Z city is the only city in the world in which nature and technology are intertwined. The city owes this title with a renewable, secure energy source called the element. Thanks to the element, people live technologically and comfortable life. However, a man named Mr. B, who lives in the high tower on the edge of the city, wants z element. However, this will not be easy, because three children in the city, Arda, Ela and Efa, formed a team called the team and will try to disrupt these plans. / Z City je jedini grad na svijetu u kojem su priroda i tehnologija isprepletene. Grad duguje ovu titulu obnovljivom, sigurnom izvoru energije zvanom Z element. Zahvaljujući Z elementu, ljudi žive tehnološki i udoban život. Međutim, čovjek po imenu gospodin B, koji živi u visokoj kuli na rubu grada, želi Z element. Međutim, to neće biti lako, jer su troje djece u gradu, Arda, Ela i Efe, formirali tim koji zovu Z ekipa i pokušat će da poremete ove planove.

programme.desc: Fernando, a talented cook, comes to Kadakeš during the 70s, where the famous Salvador Dalí was in the international famous Salvador. programme.title: Dog and cat / Pas i mačka
programme.desc: Monika is the owner of the famous influenzerske cats by the name of Diva. Jack is a thief whose last prey, is huge invaluable ruby, accidentally swallowed the Čiči, a dog wanderer. In the unfortunate range of circumstances, Monika and Jack are separated from their pets as they go to an unknown destination ... between Montreal and New York, a crazy ride for both duets that have nothing in common. On the one hand, people who lost their dear animals, and on the other hand, left to defend themselves ... but they don't know that Brant, a police officer who is for his heels, to get to Rubin! / Monika je vlasnica poznate influenserske mačke po imenu Diva. Džek je lopov čiji je poslednji plen, ogromni neprocenjivi rubin, slučajno progutala Čiči, pas lutalica. U nesrećnom spletu okolnosti, Monika i Džek se razdvajaju od svojih ljubimaca dok idu ka nepoznatom odredištu... Između Montreala i Njujorka, počinje luda vožnja za oba dueta koja nemaju ništa zajedničko. S jedne strane ljudi koji su izgubili trag svojih dragih životinja, a s druge strane ljubimci, ostavljeni da se brane sami... Ali ne znaju da će Brant, policajac koji im je za petama, učiniti sve da dođe do rubina!

programme.title: Little / Malci
programme.desc: Ever since we first saw them in the movie Terrible I, we kept wondering where the little ones came from. This movie gives us an answer to that question and brings a story that shows their unpredictable nature and physical appearance and connects them with equally striking human characters. The little ones have actually existed since the beginning of time. They have evolved from one -year -ch yellow organisms in us recognizable beings and have one common goal: to find the most fried Lord who exists and serve him. / Otkako smo ih prvi put videli u filmu Grozan ja, stalno smo se pitali odakle Malci dolaze. Ovaj film nam daje odgovor na to pitanje i donosi priču koja prikazuje njihovu nepredvidivu prirodu i fizički izgled i spaja ih sa podjednako upečatljivim ljudskim likovima. Malci zapravo postoje od početka vremena. Evoluirali su od jednoćelijskih žutih organizama u nama prepoznatljiva bića i imaju jedan zajednički cilj: da pronađu najgroznijeg gospodara koji postoji i da mu služe.

programme.title: MAPE / Van mape
programme.desc: A fearless young thief of Neatana Drejka (Tom Holla) engages the experienced light Viktor Sali Saliven (Mark Volberg) to regain the wealth collected by Ferdinand Magelan and who lost the house of Monkada 500 years ago. What begins as a robbery, for this duo becomes chasing all over the world, a terrifying race to reach the reward before the relentless Santiaga Monkade (Antonio Banderas), who believes that he and his family are legitimental. If Nate and Sali can decipher the traces and resolve one of the oldest world mystery, they will find a slightly worth five billion dollars, and maybe even a long-lost brother ... but only if they can learn to work together. / Neustrašivog mladog lopova Nejtana Drejka (Tom Holand) angažuje iskusni lovac na blago Viktor Sali Saliven (Mark Volberg) da povrati bogatstvo koje je prikupio Ferdinand Magelan i koje je pre 500 godina izgubila kuća Monkada. Ono što počinje kao pljačka, za ovaj dvojac postaje jurnjava po celom svetu, užasavajuća trka da se stigne do nagrade pre nemilosrdnog Santjaga Monkade (Antonio Banderas), koji veruje da su on i njegova porodica zakoniti naslednici. Ako Nejt i Sali mogu da dešifruju tragove i reše jednu od najstarijih svetskih misterija, pronaći će blago vredno pet milijardi dolara, a možda čak i Nejtovog davno izgubljenog brata... ali samo ako mogu da nauče da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Dulitl / Dulitl
programme.desc: Robert Dauni Junior plays the famous doctor and veterinarian who has an unusual ability to talk to animals. In this Victorian version of the classic story, Dulitl lives in a secluded villa, surrounded only by its exotic animals. However, when the young queen Victoria becomes ill, the doctor must leave her home and travel to the mythical island in search of Lek. / Robert Dauni Junior glumi čuvenog doktora i veterinara koji ima neobičnu sposobnost da razgovara sa životinjama. U ovoj viktorijanskoj verziji klasične priče, Dulitl živi u osamljenoj vili, okružen samo svojim egzotičnim životinjama. Međutim, kad mlada kraljica Viktorija oboli, doktor mora da napusti svoj dom i otputuje na mitsko ostrvo u potrazi za lekom.

programme.title: Put do uspeha / Put do uspeha
programme.desc: Sophie is a great student. With the support of mathematics, she leaves the family farm to apply for preparatory lessons for science and tried to the entrance exam for the best graded schools. As he passes through new meetings, challenges, failures and severe competition, Sophie realizes that entering the prestigious engineering school of polytechnics, is not only a matter of competition, but a challenge of climbing on social ladders. / Sofi je sjajan student. Uz podršku profesora matematike, ona napušta porodičnu farmu da bi se prijavila za pripremne časove nauke i oprobala se na prijemnom ispitu za najbolje ocenjene škole. Dok prolazi kroz nove susrete, izazove, neuspehe i žestoku konkurenciju, Sofi shvata da ulazak u prestižnu inženjersku školu Politehnike, nije samo pitanje takmičenja, već izazov uspona na društvenoj lestvici.

programme.title: Arthur King / Artur kralj
programme.desc: During ten days and 700 kilometers, an unbreakable connection is created between the professional adventurous racer of Michael Light, and a dog of a wanderer named Arthur. Based on the true story, the Arthur King Follow the Light, who desperately wants another victory, while convincing the sponsor to support him and the team of Liu, Natali Emanuel and Ali Saliman) for the World Cup in the Dominican Republic. While the team goes to the end boundaries of his durability, Arthur re-determines the true meaning of victory, loyalty and friendship. / Tokom deset dana i 700 kilometara, stvara se neraskidiva veza između profesionalnog avanturističkog trkača Majkla Lajta (Mark Volberg) i psa lutalice po imenu Artur. Zasnovano na istinitoj priči, film Artur Kralj prati Lajta, koji očajnički želi još jednu pobedu, dok ubeđuje sponzora da podrži njega i tim sportista (Simu Liu, Natali Emanuel i Ali Saliman) za Svetsko prvenstvo u avanturističkom trčanju u Dominikanskoj Republici. Dok tim ide do krajnjih granica svoje izdržljivosti, Artur iznova određuje pravo značenje pobede, odanosti i prijateljstva.

programme.title: I remember only happy days / Pamtim samo srećne dane
programme.desc: Sitting in a restaurant that represents a waiting room for the second world, the tired old man watches visitors who represent him and his rental family at the important moments of his life. The moments influenced by him and his family and made a man as he was at the end of his life. / Sedeći u restoranu koji predstavlja čekaonicu za drugi svet, umorni starac posmatra posetioce koji predstavljaju njega i njegovu užu porodicu u važnim trenucima njegovog života. Trenucima koji su uticali na njega i porodicu i od njega stvorili čoveka kakav je bio na kraju svog života.

programme.title: In the glow of the TV screen / U sjaju TV ekrana

Under pale glow of television, the oven's view of reality begins to shoot. / Tinejdžer Oven (Džastis Smit) pokušava da preživi život u predgrađu kad mu drugarica iz razreda (Bridžit Landi-Pejn) pokaže misterioznu kasnonoćnu TV-emisiju — viziju natprirodnog sveta ispod njihovog. Pod bledim sjajem televizije, Ovenov pogled na stvarnost počinje da puca.

programme.title: Life decisions / Životne odluke
programme.desc: The summer is in London. Last day of freedom, Ziba, promising British-Iran teenager, takes his friends on an interesting trip, while secretly struggling with a decision that will change her life. / Leto je u Londonu. Poslednjeg dana slobode, Ziba, perspektivna britansko-iranska tinejdžerka, vodi svoje prijatelje na zanimljivo putovanje, dok se potajno bori sa odlukom koja će joj promeniti život.

programme.title: Attention: spoiler / Pažnja: Spojler
programme.desc: Jim Parsons plays a major role in this touching drama based on Michael Memoars. The film describes how his relationship with a partner Kitao Kauan (Ben Oldridge) deepens when one of them get sick. / Džim Parsons (Štreberi) igra glavnu ulogu u ovoj dirljivoj drami zasnovanoj na memoarima Majkla Ozijela. Film opisuje kako se njegov odnos s partnerom Kitom Kauanom (Ben Oldridž) produbljuje kad se jedan od njih razboli.

programme.title: Grown enough / Dovoljno odrastao
programme.desc: During the summer 1999. year, a seventeen-year-old Serb immigrant Kol was preparing for the Australian Dance Final, when he receives a call from his dance partner Ebony. With the help of her older brother, Adam moves to pick her up, but she stuck in a summer crowd. At that road, Kol and Adam reveal that they have a lot in common and during the next 24 hours between them, an unexpected and intense romance is born. / Tokom leta 1999. godine, sedamnaestogodišnji srpski imigrant Kol se priprema za australijsko plesno finale, kad primi poziv u pomoć od svoje plesne partnerke Eboni. Uz pomoć njenog starijeg brata Adama kreće da je pokupi, ali se zaglave u letnjoj gužvi. Na tom putu Kol i Adam otkrivaju da imaju mnogo toga zajedničkog i tokom naredna 24 sata između njih se rađa neočekivana i intenzivna romansa.

programme.title: All of us foreigners / Svi mi stranci
programme.desc: A shocking story about love, family and ghosts of our past. When Adam connects with a mysterious neighbor, it narrows the things he blocked for a long time. He soon must go back to his childhood home, where his parents, 30 years after his death seems to live. Warning: Some blinking light scenes can bother photo-sensitive viewers. / Potresna priča o ljubavi, porodici i duhovima naše prošlosti. Kad se Adam poveže s misterioznim komšijom, to uskomeša stvari koje je dugo blokirao. Ubrzo mora nazad u svoj dom iz detinjstva, gde izgleda da žive njegovi roditelji, 30 godina nakon svoje smrti. Upozorenje: Neke scene s trepćućim svetlima mogu da smetaju fotoosetljivim gledaocima.

programme.title: All that glamor of henna / Sav taj glamur Kana
programme.desc: All that glamor of the Cannes is a story that requires it to be told. The film enjoys glamor, red carpets, movies, folly, vratolomies, businesses, parties and personalities that are installed in the show-business every year every year in the French Riviera. It offers an exciting adrenal experience of what the festival represented over the years and what could offer in the future. We get the director of the FESTIVA Festival, the regular canning visitors to Tilde Svinton, Sajdo, Mike, Mike, Sean Baker, Ken Louč, and Vim Venders, and the team that includes producers, journalists, photographers, Director, program editors of the festival, fashion designers, organizers of the hotel and hotel managers. / Sav taj glamur Kana priča je koja zahteva da bude ispričana. Film uživa u glamuru, crvenim tepisima, filmovima, ludostima, vratolomijama, poslovima, zabavama i ličnostima koje se svake godine dve nedelje na francuskoj rivijeri ugrađuju u šou-biznis. Nudi uzbudljivo adrenalinsko iskustvo onoga što je festival predstavljao tokom godina i šta bi mogao da ponudi u budućnosti. Dobijamo uvid direktora festivala Tieri Fremoa, redovnih kanskih posetilaca Tilde Svinton, Žilijet Binoš i Lea Sejdu, filmskih stvaralaca kao što su Oliver Stoun, Lin Remzi, Majk Li, Kventin Tarantino, Šon Bejker, Ken Louč i Vim Venders, i ekipe koja uključuje producente, novinare, fotografe, direktore, programske urednike festivala, modne dizajnere, organizatore žurki i menadžere hotela.

programme.title: Spajdermen: Return home / Spajdermen: Povratak kući
programme.desc: Excited for experience with revenge, Piter returns home, where he lives with his aunt Mej, under the watchful eye of a new mentor, Toni Stark, and tries to return to everyday routine. But a new villain appears ... / Uzbuđen zbog iskustva sa Osvetnicima, Piter se vraća kući, gde živi s tetkom Mej, pod budnim okom novog mentora, Tonija Starka, i pokušava da se vrati svakodnevnoj rutini. Ali pojavljuje se novi zlikovac...

programme.title: Kung-Fu Panda: The Secret of Fierce Five / Kung-fu panda: Tajna žestoke petorke

Maybe that Lunga won, but our Dragon's warrior must face the Šifu's greatest challenge with the help of a snake, a tiger, monkey, crane and bogoms. The secrets of fierce five people are finally exasperated because we discover that it takes much more than fast feet and swivels to become a Kung Fu. / Pažnja! Poov najveći izazov dosad. Tajne Žestoke petorke su konačno raskrinkane jer otkrivamo da je potrebno mnogo više od brzih stopala i okretnih ruku da biste postali majstor kung fua.

programme.title: Hollywood on shooting / Holivud na snimanju
programme.desc: The latest cinema premiere, the largest film stars, insight into what awaits us. Every week the latest news from a large screen. Sve to i mnogo više u Filmovima i zvezdama.

programme.title: Adventures Tintin: The secret of a unicorn / Avanture Tintina: Tajna jednoroga
programme.desc: In an attempt to discover the secret of a sunken ship that may be hiding a huge treasure - but the ancient curse - Tintin and his faithful dog snow moving on a journey around the world charged with action and adventures. / U pokušaju da otkriju tajnu potonulog broda koji možda krije ogromno blago - ali i drevno prokletstvo - Tintin i njegov verni pas Sneško kreću na putovanje oko celog sveta nabijeno akcijom i avanturama.

programme.title: My ingenious friend / Moja genijalna prijateljica
programme.desc: Elena's marriage is in crisis. PieTRO alienated and treated as a maid. programme.title: Transformers: Wake up of the beast / Transformersi: Buđenje zveri
programme.desc: Returning to the action and spectacle he won the viewers around the world 14 years ago with original transformers, Transformers: Waking the beasts increases the maximums, strangers and terrorcons in the current battle between Autobota and the desepticon. / Vrativši se akciji i spektaklu koji je osvojio gledaoce širom sveta pre 14 godina sa originalnim Transformersima, Transformersi: Buđenje zveri uvešće Maksimale, Predakone i Terorkone u trenutnu bitku na zemlji između Autobota i Deseptikona.

programme.title: Venom / Venom
programme.desc: The EDI Brok (Tom Hardi) planner to return to work after the scandal, but accidentally becomes hosted by an alien symbiot who gives it violent alteres, vein, and amazing superpower. / Istraživački novinar Edi Brok (Tom Hardi) planira da se vrati na posao nakon skandala, ali slučajno postane domaćin vanzemaljskog simbiota koji mu daje nasilan alter-ego, Venom, i neverovatne supermoći.

programme.title: Venom 2 / Venom 2
programme.desc: Edi Brok is still struggling to coexist with alien vein that changes the shape. When and the disturbed serial killer KLETUS Kasadi becomes hosted with an alien symbiote, Brok and Venoma team up in an attempt to stop him. / Edi Brok se još bori da koegzistira s vanzemaljskim Venomom koji menja oblik. Kad i poremećeni serijski ubica Kletus Kasadi postane domaćin vanzemaljskom simbiotu, Brok i Venom se udružuju u pokušaju da ga zaustave.​

programme.title: Hell Streets 10 / Paklene ulice 10
programme.desc: In the tenth part of the Saga Pakleni street, the home of Toreto and his family are on the target of the deadest opponent with which they have ever faced. When the powerful Dante Reyes (Jason Momo) comes out of the shadows of the past to revenge the father, he makes chaos unprecedented, and his only goal is to destroy Toreta and his family. Using their pilot skills on cars, motorcycles, planes - and even submarines - home and its allies will make everything, it will even defy the laws of physics, to protect their loved ones. / U desetom delu sage Paklene ulice, Dom Toreto i njegova porodica nalaze se na meti najsmrtonosnijeg protivnika s kojim su se ikad suočili. Kad moćni Dante Rejes (Džejson Momoa) izađe iz senki prošlosti da bi osvetio oca, on pravi haos bez presedana, a jedini cilj mu je da uništi Toreta i njegovu porodicu. Koristeći svoje pilotske veštine na automobilima, motociklima, avionima - pa čak i podmornicama - Dom i njegovi saveznici učiniće sve, čak će prkositi zakonima fizike, da zaštite svoje najmilije.

programme.desc: Aquamamen reveals the story of the creation of human and Atlantiund hybrids, Artura Karija, and his life of the throne of the Underwater Kingdom of Atlantis, he must prevent the war between the world of the ocean and the Holy Mainland. / Akvamen razotkriva priču o nastanku hibrida čoveka i Atlantiđana, Artura Karija, i njegovom životnom pohodu - kao naslednik prestola podvodnog kraljevstva Atlantide, on mora da spreči rat između sveta okeana i sveta kopna.

programme.title: Despite everything / Uprkos svemu
programme.desc: One man spends days in the hospital without too much worries. He is hospitalized, protected from all, no obligations and problems. This routine flows smoothly - until the new patient arrives at the department. / Jedan muškarac provodi dane u bolnici, bez previše briga. Hospitalizovan je, zaštićen od svega, nema obaveza i problema. Ta rutina teče glatko - sve dok na odeljenje ne stigne novi pacijent.

programme.title: Zakuvalo se / Zakuvalo se
programme.desc: Jane Peterson, marketing director in a large city, remains without work and without a boyfriend. She is enough for her, he swears that he would leave the city forever. Before it succeeds, he encounters a handsome and charming barist in the local cafe. While he reveals the city with him, he feels like something is getting ready! / Džejn Piterson, direktorka marketinga u velikom gradu, u istom danu ostaje bez posla i bez dečka. Dosta joj je, zaklinje se da će zauvek napustiti grad. Pre nego što to uspe, nailazi na zgodnog i šarmantnog baristu u lokalnom kafiću. Dok s njim ponovo otkriva grad, oseća kao da se nešto sprema!

programme.title: Love therapist / Ljubavni terapeut
programme.desc: In this sophisticated romantic comedy, Aleks Hitches is legendary and in their choice anonymous, New York love therapist, which helped non-counted men to find the women of their dreams. While he trains Alberta (Kevin James), shy accountant, the glamorous star of Alegra Kol (Supermodel Amber Valletta), Hitch finds himself flat in beautiful and smart Sari Melas (Eva Mendez), a trailer journalist who accompanies every alegrine step. Hitch, a career bachelor, suddenly realizes that he is madly in love with Sarah, a journalist whose biggest reporting could be an exactions of the most famous love therapist with Manhattan. / U ovoj sofisticiranoj romantičnoj komediji, Aleks Hič Hičens (Vil Smit) je legendarni i po svom izboru anonimni, njujorški ljubavni terapeut koji je za honorar pomogao nebrojenim muškarcima da pronađu žene svojih snova. Dok obučava Alberta (Kevin Džejms), stidljivog računovođu, zatreskanog u glamuroznu zvezdu Alegru Kol (supermodel Amber Valeta), Hič konačno nalazi sebi ravnu u prelepoj i pametnoj Sari Melas (Eva Mendez), novinarki trač-rubrike koja prati svaki Alegrin korak. Hič, neženja od karijere, odjednom shvata da je ludo zaljubljen u Saru, novinarku čija bi najveća reportaža mogla da bude raskrinkavanje najčuvenijeg ljubavnog terapeuta sa Menhetna.

programme.title: Revenge from the bench: Satirition / Osveta s klupe: Satiranje
programme.desc: Ben Makgrate (Chris Klein) had potential in a high-league of professional baseball, but all his hopes were destroyed. Although bad luck, Ben got another momentum like a new lawyer for the firm and partners. His unusual head Mel (John Lovic) persuade him to lead their eclectic softball-team full of inconsistent players and bad moves. Will they succeed together to get over and go to victory? / Ben Makgrat (Kris Klajn) imao je potencijal u visokoj ligi profesionalnog bejzbola, ali su sve njegove nade uništene. Iako loše sreće, Ben dobija još jedan zamah kao novi advokat za firmu Šmud i partneri. Njegov neobični šef Mel (Džon Lovic) ubedi ga da vodi njihov eklektični softbol-tim pun neskladnih igrača i loših poteza. Da li će zajedno uspeti da se saberu i krenu u pobede?

programme.title: Gudic / Gudrič
programme.desc: When his wife goes to rehab, Endi Gudrič himself takes care of her little kid. / Kad mu žena ode na rehabilitaciju, Endi Gudrič sam brine o svojoj maloj deci.

programme.title: Sinners / Grešnici
programme.desc: From the screenwriter and director Rajan Kugler, with Majklov B. Jordan in the main role, a new vision of fear is coming. Twin brothers (Jordan), trying to leave a problematic life, return home, but reveal that even greater evil are waiting for them there. / Od scenariste i režisera Rajana Kuglera, s Majklom B. Džordanom u glavnoj ulozi, stiže nova vizija straha. Braća blizanci (Džordan), pokušavajući da ostave problematičan život za sobom, vraćaju se kući, ali otkrivaju da ih tamo čeka još veće zlo.

programme.title: Sunbathing / Soltbern
programme.desc: The award-winning director Emerald Fenel brings us a wicked story about privileges and wishes. In an attempt to find its place on Oxford, Oliver Kegan (Bari Kegan) intrusions in the world of charming Aristocrats, which invites him to Saltbern, his eccentric family property, during the summer that will never be forgotten. / Nagrađivana režiserka Emerald Fenel donosi nam opaku priču o privilegijama i željama. U pokušaju da nađe svoje mesto na Oksfordu, Oliver Kvik (Bari Kegan) upada u svet šarmantnog aristokrate Feliksa Katona (Džejkob Elordi), koji ga poziva na Saltbern, njegovo ekscentrično porodično imanje, tokom leta koje nikad neće biti zaboravljeno.

programme.title: Tar / Tar
programme.desc: Todd Field Director and writes a scenario for a drama in which he plays Kate Blanche as a cult Lidija Tar, one of the world's largest conductors and the first woman at the guidelines of the Great German Orchestra. The film explores topics such as the nature of the power and culture of non-posting in modern society while we follow the life of conductors during the week that preceded the long-awaited execution of Malerova Pete Symphony. / Tod Fild režira i piše scenario za dramu u kojoj glumi Kejt Blanšet kao kultna Lidija Tar, jedna od najvećih svetskih dirigentkinja i prva žena na mestu upravnika velikog nemačkog orkestra. Film istražuje teme poput prirode moći i kulture nipodaštavanja u modernom društvu dok pratimo život dirigentkinje tokom nedelja koje su prethodile dugo očekivanom izvođenju Malerove Pete simfonije.

programme.title: Gilded Age / Pozlaćeno doba
programme.desc: In the middle of the release of the lascivious book, Ms. Astor talks to Bert about the future of his bales in Newport. Upon his return from Arizona, Lari divides the promising discovery with George, to receive a worrying news in return. Meanwhile, Mrs. Kirkland gets worrying information about Pegi, and Russell's household reveals the source of recent missing leaks. / Usred objavljivanja lascivne knjige, gospođa Astor razgovara s Bertom o budućnosti svog bala u Njuportu. Po povratku iz Arizone, Lari deli obećavajuće otkriće sa Džordžom, da bi zauzvrat dobio zabrinjavajuće vesti. U međuvremenu, gospođa Kirkland dobija zabrinjavajuće informacije o Pegi, a domaćinstvo Raselovih otkriva izvor nedavnih curenja u štampu.

programme.title: Yesterday / Juče
programme.desc: From the Oskarovac director Danija Bojla (millionaire) and a famous scenarist Richard Curtis (four weddings and funeral, love actually) arrives Rockenrol-Comedy yesterday, with new versions of legendary bits of Beatland. After a very strange accident, singer and songwriter Jack Malik (Himeš Patel, Istendersi realizes that he is the only person in the world that remembers Beatland. Jack performs their classic songs in the world who forgot and rise to celebrate with the help of his agent, on Saturdays in the evening), but in the end he could lose him again), a woman who loved him all the time. / Od režisera oskarovca Denija Bojla (Milioner sa ulice) i poznatog scenariste Ričarda Kertisa (Četiri venčanja i sahrana, Ljubav zapravo) stiže rokenrol-komedija Juče, s novim verzijama legendarnih hitova Bitlsa. Posle vrlo čudne nesreće, pevač i tekstopisac Džek Malik (Himeš Patel, Istendersi) shvata da je on jedina osoba na svetu koja se seća Bitlsa. Džek izvodi njihove klasične pesme u svetu koji ih je zaboravio i uzdiže do slave uz pomoć svog agenta (Kejt Makinon, Subotom uveče uživo), ali bi na kraju mogao da izgubi Eli (Lili Džejms, Mama Mia! Idemo ponovo), ženu koja ga je sve vreme volela.
