programme.title: Collected works in Jay Fikria / Sabrana dela Ej Džej Fikrija
programme.desc: Life A. J. Fikria is not like the one who expected. His wife died, his bookstore experiences the worst sales until then his precious property, rarely edition of Poov songs, stolen. Over time, he gave up people, and even books in his shop, instead of providing him with consolation, became a reminder of the world that changed too quickly. And then the mysterious package arrives in the bookstore, and his unexpected arrival gives a fabric chance to reverse life and see things from a new perspective. / Život A. J. Fikrija nije poput onoga koji je očekivao. Njegova žena je umrla, njegova knjižara doživljava najgoru prodaju dotad, a sada je njegova dragocena imovina, retko izdanje Poovih pesama, ukradena. Vremenom je odustao od ljudi, a čak su i knjige u njegovoj radnji, umesto da mu pružaju utehu, postale podsećanje na svet koji se prebrzo menja. A onda misteriozni paket stigne u knjižaru, i njegov neočekivani dolazak daje Fikriju šansu da preokrene život i vidi stvari iz nove perspektive.

programme.title: September / Septembar
programme.desc: One September day three characters realize that the life they live is not the way they dreamed of. Happiness is a distant idea, but it is still possible. A story exploring interpersonal relationships, our deepest nature, search for an authentic connection between people. The scenarist moth is Molito, Kroče e delicacija and Il Kampionea, the first work made up of existential melancholy, imported dialogues and great freedom of expression. / Jednog septembarskog dana tri lika shvate da život koji žive nije onakav o kakvom su sanjali. Sreća je daleka ideja, ali je ipak moguća. Priča koja istražuje međuljudske odnose, našu najdublju prirodu, potragu za autentičnijom vezom među ljudima. Od scenariste Molje e Marito, Kroče e Delicija i il Kampionea, prvo delo sačinjeno od egzistencijalne melanholije, uvezanih dijaloga i velike slobode izražavanja.

programme.title: Only when I am laughing / Samo kad se smejem
programme.desc: Tina (28), housewife who raises his daughter (6), lives with Fran (32) in the city on the Adriatic. Marital tensions arise when she expresses the desire to complete the faculty, causing thus traditional gender roles in their seemingly perfect marriage. / Tina (28), domaćica koja odgaja ćerku (6), živi sa Franom (32) u gradu na Jadranu. Bračne napetosti nastaju kad ona izrazi želju da završi fakultet, izazivajući time tradicionalne rodne uloge u njihovom naizgled savršenom braku.

programme.title: Murder in oriented by express / Ubistvo u Orijent ekspresu
programme.desc: After the shocking murder of a rich businessman in the luxurious European train, in the middle of a sharp winter, the Private Detective Hercules Poiro must take advantage of all his skills and reveals who is the killer passenger, before he kills himself. The Kenneth Branch Directed and led by the top acting team, including Johnny Deppa, Michel Fajfer, Penelope Cruise, and Judy Dench, in this composite mystery based on the famous novel Agatha Christ. / Nakon šokantnog ubistva bogatog biznismena u luksuznom evropskom vozu koji se kreće ka zapadu, usred oštre zime, privatni detektiv Herkul Poaro mora da iskoristi sve svoje umeće i otkrije ko je od putnika ubica, pre nego što ponovo ubije. Kenet Brana režira i predvodi vrhunsku glumačku ekipu, uključujući Džonija Depa, Mišel Fajfer, Penelope Kruz i Džudi Denč, u ovoj otmenoj, napetoj i uzbudljivoj misteriji zasnovanoj na čuvenom romanu Agate Kristi.

programme.title: Grand Budapest hotel / Grand Budapest hotel
programme.desc: The Grand Budapest Hotel speaks about the adventures of Gustava H, legendary porters in the famous European hotel between the two wars, and Zerou Mustafi, a carrier that becomes his most faithful friend. The story includes theft and finding an invaluable Renaissance image; ruthless struggle for huge family wealth; Desperate chasing engines, trains, sleds and skis; And the finest love affair - all on the continent that passes through sudden and dramatic changes. / Grand Budapest hotel govori o avanturama Gustava H, legendarnog portira u čuvenom evropskom hotelu između dva rata, i Zerou Mustafi, nosaču kofera koji postaje njegov najverniji prijatelj. Priča uključuje krađu i pronalaženje neprocenjive renesansne slike; nemilosrdnu borbu za ogromno porodično bogatstvo; očajničke jurnjave motorima, vozovima, sankama i skijama; i najfiniju ljubavnu aferu - a sve to na kontinentu koji prolazi kroz iznenadne i dramatične promene.

programme.title: Kong: Island of Skull / Kong: Ostrvo lobanja
programme.desc: The team of scientists, soldiers and adventurers must be deepered in the center of the Unruged Pacific Island - wonderful as dangerous - unconscious to enter the territory of mythological cong. / Tim naučnika, vojnika i avanturista mora da zađe još dublje u središte neucrtanog pacifičkog ostrva - divnog koliko i opasnog - nesvesni da ulaze na teritoriju mitološkog Konga.

programme.title: Minecraft Film / Minecraft Film
programme.desc: The four unadjustees bothered with ordinary problems are drawn through the portal in the supervisor. In order to return home, they will have to overcome this world as they engage in a magical quest. / Četvorica neprilagođenih koji se muče s običnim problemima uvučeni su kroz portal u Nadsvet. Da bi se vratili kući, moraće da savladaju ovaj svet dok se upuštaju u magičnu potragu.

programme.title: As chocolate water / Kao voda za čokoladu
programme.desc: Despite his differences, Tito and Rosaurs experience the experience that connects them. Tito reveals that Pedro leads a double life, while he with disbelief witness the true wonders of love. / I pored svojih razlika, Tita i Rosaura doživljavaju iskustvo koje ih povezuje. Tita otkriva da Pedro vodi dvostruki život, dok je on s nevericom svedok pravog čuda ljubavi.

programme.title: Four banks, but Nevin / Četiri banke, a nevin
programme.desc: Andi Sticer (Steve Karel) is a 40-year-old who scored very little in his life. It has a comfortable job of printing accounts in electronic shops, comfortable apartment, good friends, decent behavior and is proud of the collection of action figurines and comics. There is something that has not yet done - something most of his peers have long done. And that many times. Endijevi's friends believe that their duty is to help him come out of that terrible situation and very hard to lure his friend to lose his virginity. / Endi Sticer (Stiv Karel) je 40-ogodišnjak koji je postigao vrlo malo u svom životu. Ima lagodan posao štampanja računa u elektronskoj radnji, udoban stan, dobre prijatelje, pristojno ponašanje i ponosan je na kolekciju akcionih figurica i stripova. Postoji nešto što još nije obavio - nešto što je većina njegovih vršnjaka odavno uradila. I to mnogo puta. Endijevi prijatelji smatraju da je njihova dužnost da mu pomognu da izađe iz te grozne situacije i veoma se trude da svog prijatelja namame da izgubi nevinost.

programme.title: Dormant dogs / Uspavani psi
programme.desc: In this tense criminal trillary, Rasel Krore acts Frima Frima, a former detective with a disturbed memory, who must explore the case that does not remembers. While one man's life closer to the end, Friman must fit brutal evidence from the murder investigation of the old ten years, and reveals the dark network of hidden secrets and betrayals associated with his past. He only believes his instincts and faces a cold truth - sometimes it is best to touch the dog while sleeping. / U ovom napetom kriminalističkom trileru, Rasel Krou glumi Roja Frimana, bivšeg detektiva s poremećenim sećanjem, koji mora ponovo da istraži slučaj kojeg se ne seća. Dok se životu jednog čoveka bliži kraj, Friman mora da uklopi brutalne dokaze iz istrage ubistva starog deset godina, i otkriva mračnu mrežu skrivenih tajni i izdaja povezanih s njegovom prošlošću. Veruje samo svojim instinktima i suočava se s hladnom istinom - ponekad je najbolje ne dirati psa dok spava.

programme.title: Sisi / Sisi
programme.desc: The Hungarian rebel Ödon Kortek wants to abduct Sisi to achieve his goals against Francis Joseph. In a joint captivity with Count Andrassy Sisi, he finally has to ask how long he will be able to restrain his feelings ... The Empress can now only save the Countess Esterhazy. During this time, Francis Joseph in Posenhofen faces a father -in -law, and with Sisa's sister Nena. Sisi and Andrassy travel together to Vienna to convince Francis Joseph into the need for the existence of the Hungarian parliament. Again in the cold cramming of Hofburg, Sisi tries to break your head. But the special closeness between Sisi and Andrassy Francis Joseph does not remain hidden. He falls into old behavior patterns and not only comes into conflict with his mother, but begins to doubt in Sisa. / Ugarski pobunjenik Ödon Kortek želi oteti Sisi kako bi ostvario svoje ciljeve protiv Franje Josipa. U zajedničkom zatočeništvu s grofom Andrassyjem Sisi se napokon mora upitati koliko će još dugo moći obuzdavati svoje osjećaje... Caricu sad može spasiti još samo grofica Esterhazy. Za to vrijeme Franjo Josip u Possenhofenu suočava se s tastom, a i sa Sisinom sestrom Nene.Sisi i Andrassy putuju zajedno u Beč kako bi uvjerili Franju Josipa u nužnost postojanja ugarskog parlamenta. Ponovno u hladnoj skučenosti Hofburga, Sisi pokušava razbistriti glavu. Ali posebna bliskost između Sisi i Andrassyja Franji Josipu ne ostaje skrivena. On upada u stare obrasce ponašanja i ne samo da dolazi u sukob s majkom, nego počinje sumnjati i u Sisi.

PRENTISS) public relations decided to apply for a stabs competition, and that's where the plot begins because Roger has never tried it in that ... / Roger Willoughby (R. Hudson) vrlo je uspješan prodavač sportske opreme, osobito pribora za pecanje, čak ga drže i velikim sportskim stručnjakom. Stoga je šefica odnosa s javnošću Abigail (P. Prentiss) odlučila prijaviti ga na natjecanje u pecanju, a tu počinje zaplet jer se Roger nikada u životu nije okušao u tome...

programme.title: Bible / Biblija
programme.desc: The essence and meaning of Christianity is a testimony. In the ancient past, the testimony of religious experience was emphasized as a means of evangelization, but also the deepening of his own faith. One of the strongest testimonies of faith comes from the voice that yells in the desert, from the one who said that it would come bigger than him. The testimony in the Bible is spoken by prof. Ph.D. Boris Vulic and Rev. Kresimir Saf, pastor of the parish of the birth of St. John the Baptist Ivankovo. / Bit i smisao kršćanstva je svjedočanstvo. Još u drevnoj prošlosti svjedočenje vjerskoga iskustva isticalo se kao sredstvo evangelizacije, ali i produbljenja vlastite vjere. Jedno od najčvršćih svjedočanstava vjere dolazi od glasa koji viče u pustinji, od onoga koji je govorio da će doći veći od njega. O svjedočenju u Bibliji govore prof. dr. sc. Boris Vulić i vlč. Krešimir Šaf, župnik župe Rođenja sv. Ivana Krstitelja Ivankovo.

programme.title: Misa / Misa
programme.desc: Ogorje, a small town of Dalmatian Zagora, belongs to the municipality of Muć and Split-Dalmatia County. Church, within the Diocese of Sibenik, the Dean of Drniš. Ogorje was the name for the wide area between Gora Mosec (once Petrov Gora) and Svilaja in antiquity. The area belonged to an end called Zmin, in which King Zvonimir donated the right to use grazing to the Split church on April 16, 1078. The first known memorial of Ogorje dates from 1378. On the 18th Sunday of the year Mass in the stone Neo -Romanesque parish church of St. Juraj the martyr will be served by Fr. Damir Ciro Cikar, pastor in Ogorje. / Ogorje, malo mjesto Dalmatinske zagore, pripada općini Muć i Splitsko-dalmatinskoj županiji. Crkveno, u sklopu je Šibenske biskupije, Drniškog dekanata. Ogorje je u starini bio naziv za široko područje između gora Moseća (nekoć Petrova gora) i Svilaje. Područje je pripadalo kraju koji se nazivao Zmina, u kojemu je 16. travnja 1078. kralj Zvonimir darovao splitskoj Crkvi pravo korištenja ispaše. Prvi poznati spomen Ogorja datira iz 1378. Na 18. nedjelju u godini misno slavlje u kamenoj neoromaničkoj župnoj crkvi sv. Jurja mučenika služit će fra Damir Ćiro Čikara, župnik u Ogorju.

Ali, bez obzira na mrvicu tuge i razočaranja onih na čiji se glas nije okrenuo nijedan crveni stolac, mentori su se potrudili da svi natjecatelji nastup u The Voice Kidsu pamte kao lijep i nezaboravan doživljaj. programme.title: Whats up Sjever-Jug / Whats up Sjever-Jug
programme.desc: We learn about the Norwegian mentality from writer Lars Svensen, author of the Book of the Philosophy of Boredom, translated into Croatian. Tillit is an important word for the ethics of Norwegian society, its meaning is known by every Norwegian. We find out what is new to Oslo, which is that the windows of the multi -storey dwellings are drunk. It is new to make buildings, even skyscrapers complete of wood. Finland has a historically unpleasant neighbor with whom they boldly fought, as smaller and weaker even winning, but they always raised friendship monuments with the Russian people. Today, these memories are removed without noise, without an audience. We visited one of the 5500 shelters in Helsinki. The entire Finnish shelter territory is 50,500 for almost 5 million inhabitants. We also visited the homeless shelter, and the protégés were mostly stumbling addicts. / O norveškom mentalitetu doznajemo od pisca Larsa Svendsena, autora knjige Filozofija dosade, prevođenog i na hrvatski jezik. Tillit je važna riječi za etiku norveškog društva, njezino značenje zna svaki Norvežanin. Saznajemo što je novo u Oslu, a to je da se prozori višekatnica peru dronovima. Novo je da se prave zgrade, čak i neboderi kompletno od drveta. Finska ima povijesno neugodnog susjeda s kojim su hrabro ratovali, kao manji i slabiji čak i pobjeđivali, ali uvijek na oprezu dizali su spomenike prijateljstva s ruskim narodom. Danas te uspomene uklanjaju bez buke, bez publike. Posjetili smo jedno od 5500 skloništa u Helsinkiju. Na cijelom teritoriju Finske skloništa je 50.500 za gotovo 5 milijuna stanovnika. Posjetili smo i sklonište za beskućnike, a štićenici su uglavnom posrnuli ovisnici.

programme.title: Duel of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: The Dulum of Dulum series depicts the stories of Croatian farmers and entrepreneurs who, despite the challenges, achieve exceptional results with their innovative and ecologically sustainable approach. Each episode reveals stories about people who change agriculture in Croatia through their passion for their passion, building a better and more sustainable community. Through personal stories, the efforts, perseverance and visions of these farmers are shown, with an emphasis on the importance of family values, community and respect for nature. ------ the episode is accompanied by David Pejic, a young ecological farmer and director of the oldest organic estate in Croatia. Located in Dubrava, Zagreb County, its property is a symbol of sustainable agriculture and produces more than 100 certified organic products. David's passion for ecological agriculture was also recognized at the European level, which brought him the prestigious European Commission Award. Through this episode, viewers will witness the leadership of the property with strict environmental principles, the process of cultivation of over 60 crops types and the production of products such as Tofu and Seitan. This episode provides insight into David's vision of the future of ecological agriculture, which is based on sustainability and preserving the health of people and the environment. / Serija Dulum zemlje prikazuje priče hrvatskih poljoprivrednika i poduzetnika koji, usprkos izazovima, svojim inovativnim i ekološki održivim pristupom ostvaruju iznimne rezultate. Svaka epizoda otkriva priče o ljudima koji kroz svoju strast prema zemlji mijenjaju poljoprivredu u Hrvatskoj, gradeći bolje i održivije zajednice. programme.title: Titan conflict / Sukob titana

Međutim, Cherbourg je bio dobro utvrđen i okružen bunkerima s velikim mornaričkim topovima. Trebalo ih je ušutkati. Američki vojni brod Texas, koji je sudjelovao u kampanji u Sjevernoj Africi i iskrcavanju u Normandiju, priskočit će u pomoć. Taj veteranski bojni brod, porinut 1912., imao je silnu vatrenu moć: 128 topova i četiri torpedne cijevi promjera 533 mm. Počela je krvava borba s jednom od najjačih obalnih bitnica na poluotoku Cotentin. Raspolagala je s četiri topa kalibra 240 mm s dometom od 24 kilometra. Bili su prava noćna mora za savezničku flotu. programme.desc: We are watching a shorter recording of an exceptional event in honor of one of the most famous Croatian singers and composers, Zadranin, Tomislav Ivcic. Njihovo veselo raspoloženje naprasno potone na povratku kući kad detektiv Phil Wilkinson uhiti Sidneya i optuži ga za silovanje. Izvor optužbi je brižni otac Harding Redmond kojeg je užasnuo dnevnik njegove kćeri tinejdžerice Abigail u kojem ona piše o svojoj vezi sa župnikom. Abigail je nestala zajedno s dnevnikom. Nakon ispitivanja viši inspektor Benson pusti Sidneya jer su, dok se ne pronađe Abigail ili konkretan dokaz, Hardingove optužbe samo podaci iz druge ruke. programme.title: Vera / Vera
programme.desc: Joel Kingston is a good and favorite policeman from a distinguished police family. His father is a legendary Phil Kingston, a prominent police sergeant. programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?

programme.title: The world of gardeners / Svijet vrtlara
programme.desc: Monty in Longmeadow begins with seasonal works. Nick Bailey visited the Bodnant garden in northern Wales and found out that the team cope with the consequences of a recent Storm and what the new opportunities for planting are. Frances Tophill meets the couple who just started gardening and on a long, narrow garden plot at his home in Somemerset made a garden that is productive and decorative at the same time. Doctor Amir Khan talks about the health benefits of gardening and staying in the greenery in his garden in Leeds, and in Lincolnshire we will visit a breeder who adores garden templates and is a guardian of the national collection of this favorite plant from Ladanj Gardens. In this episode of the world of gardeners, viewers will show us what they are doing in their gardens. / Monty u Longmeadowu počinje sa sezonskim radovima. Nick Bailey posjetio je vrt Bodnant u Sjevernom Walesu i saznao kako se tim nosi s posljedicama nedavne oluje te koje su nove mogućnosti za sadnju. Frances Tophill upoznaje par koji je tek počeo s vrtlarenjem i na dugačkoj, uskoj vrtnoj parceli u svom domu u Somersetu napravio vrt koji je istodobno produktivan i dekorativan. Liječnik Amir Khan govori o zdravstvenim koristima vrtlarenja i boravka u zelenilu u svom vrtu u Leedsu, a u Lincolnshireu posjetit ćemo uzgajivača koji obožava vrtni sljez i čuvar je nacionalne zbirke ove omiljene biljke iz ladanjskih vrtova. U ovoj epizodi Svijeta vrtlara gledatelji će nam pokazati što rade u svojim vrtovima.

programme.desc: Simon and Nancy would like the team to bring in part of the glamor of Beverly Hills, the city where they lived, in their neglected garden that surrounds the 400 -year -old house. / Simon i Nancy željeli bi da ekipa unese dio glamura Beverly Hillsa, grada u kojem su živjeli, u njihov zapušteni vrt koji okružuje 400 godina staru kuću.

Ever since the last sources have dried up due to an earthquake, water should be taken from the glacier. On the other hand, no area in Switzerland is as rich in water as the Lauterbrunnen valley. / Rijetko koja švicarska regija može se pohvaliti tako raznovrsnom florom i faunom kao regija Jungfrau. S druge strane, nijedno područje u Švicarskoj nije tako bogato vodom kao dolina Lauterbrunnen.

programme.title: Tandem / Tandem
programme.desc: On the day of General Rehearsal at the Montpellier Opera, a dead François Durieux, the first violin of the Philharmonic Orchestra, was found. He was killed by a violin production with a knife. It seems that the lonely and gifted young man was only interested in music and his prestigious Armannel's 18th -century violin violin. His passion was supported by his mother and Pascal, a violin builder and François's mentor. The team first doubts the second violin of the orchestra and the main François competitor. But then they discover that Armananell's violin is a copy. Is the murder associated with a violin or did François get into an impossible situation for love for music? / Na dan generalne probe u Operi Montpelliera pronađen je mrtav François Durieux, prva violina filharmonijskog orkestra. Ubijen je nožem za izradu violina. Čini se da je osamljenog i darovitog mladića zanimala samo glazba i njegova prestižna Armanellova violina iz 18. stoljeća. Njegovu su strast podržavali majka i Pascal, graditelj violina i Françoisov mentor. Ekipa najprije posumnja u drugu violinu orkestra i glavnog Françoisova konkurenta. No onda otkriju da je Armanellova violina kopija. Je li ubojstvo povezano s violinom ili se François zbog ljubavi prema glazbi doveo u nemoguću situaciju?

programme.title: Schindlerova List / Schindlerova lista
programme.desc: Krakow, Poland. Oskar Schindler (L. Neeson) finds the perfect opportunity to gain profits in World War II. It opens the factory of utensils and employs the Jews of Itzhaka Stern (B. Kingsley) as an accountant, but the horrific crimes of compatriots make him change his attitude towards the victims of the war. The converted factory also provides other workers with refuge, but the short -term safety of the factory in early 1941 was interrupted by the ghetto opening. Two years later, the ghetto replaces the cruel reality of the work camp, and Schindler is impossible to position the business with a cruel camp manager, a member of the SS Amon Goth (R. Fiennes) ... / Krakov, Poljska. Oskar Schindler (L. Neeson) pronalazi u Drugom svjetskom ratu savršenu priliku za stjecanje profita. Otvara tvornicu posuđa i zapošljava Židova Itzhaka Sterna (B. Kingsley) kao računovođu, no stravični zločini sunarodnjaka natjeraju ga da promijeni stav prema žrtvama rata. Preobraćeni tvorničar pruža i ostalim radnicima utočište, no kratkotrajnu sigurnost tvornice početkom 1941. prekida otvaranje geta. Dvije godine kasnije geto zamjenjuje okrutna realnost radnog logora, a Schindler dolazi u nemoguć položaj poslovanja s okrutnim upraviteljem logora, pripadnikom SS-a Amonom Gothom (R. Fiennes)...

programme.desc: Little Malabar and Turtle will swim surrounded by fish, and then a large turtle will swim and bring in chaos! programme.desc: The third episode takes us to the Chinese city. Do you wonder what Beijing looks like at 5 am? Do you want to find out something about the imperial palace and the big wall? programme.title: The mouth of the river / Ušća rijeka
programme.desc: The largest, most fertile, longest, with the biggest delta. There is a lot best for Rijeka, which, due to its importance, is treated in two episodes. It is Neretva, and in the first episode we go to its source in eastern Herzegovina. And this is where the green crystal rhapsody of the Neretva begins, which is only a creek that grows from inaccessible sources. There is Neretva and its tributaries of the Pastra River, those noble streams, and those endemic unique ones - hubs. The Neretva has eliminated the path through beautiful canyons, rapids still unrecognized by dams ideal for rafting, and pure water for unique plant and animal worlds. Numerous tributaries make Neretva, such as Trebižat with the most beautiful waterfalls or a lush with a beautiful mouth. We also meet the eel - a symbol of the Neretva, which leads us from Hut's mud to another episode. / Najveća, najplodnija, najduža, s najvećom deltom. Puno je naj za rijeku koja je zbog svoje važnosti obrađena u dvije epizode. To je Neretva, a u prvoj epizodi odlazimo na njezin izvor u istočnoj Hercegovini. A tu počinje prštava zeleno kristalna rapsodija Neretve koja je tek potočić koji raste iz nepristupačnih izvora. Tu je Neretva i njezini pritoci rijeka pastrva, one plemenite potočne, a i one endemske jedinstvene - glavatice. Neretva je tu izdubila sebi put kroz predivne kanjone, brzaci još nepregrađeni branama idealni za rafting, a čista voda za neponovljiv biljni i životinjski svijet. Brojni pritoci snaže Neretvu, kao što je Trebižat s najljepšim slapovima ili Buna s prekrasnim ušćem. Susrećemo i jegulju - simbol Neretve, koja nas iz Hutovog blata vodi u drugu epizodu.

programme.title: Classics to the people / Klasici narodu
programme.desc: From Pera Jonathan Swift comes one of the most popular satirical-fantastic stories about Naval Gulliver and his trips. The story full of uncertainty and interesting descriptions that read in one, up to two breaths. A story that allegorically ridiculed human flaws and social opportunities of England at the end of the 17th century. A story that is read with equal joy by schoolchildren, puberty, adults and pensioners. A story that will only tell you chess players and hemps for you. Let's listen to Gulliver on the island of Lilliput with people only six palaces. / Iz pera Jonathana Swifta dolazi jedna od najpopularnijih satirično-fantastična priča o pomorcu Gulliveru i njegovim putovanjima. Priča puna neizvjesnost i zanimljivih opisa koja se čita u jednom, najviše dva daha. Priča koja alegorički ismijava ljudske mane i društvene prilike Engleske krajem 17. stoljeća. Priča koju s jednakim veseljem čitaju školarci, pubertetlije, odrasli i penzioneri. Priča koju će samo za vas ispričati šahisti i konopaši. Poslušajmo kako se snašao Gulliver na otoku Lilliputu s ljudima visokim svega šest palaca.

programme.title: World Literature Festival / Festival svjetske književnosti
programme.desc: Jean-Baptiste del amo is one of the most important French writers of his generation, born in 1981. programme.title: Drums across the river / Bubnjevi preko rijeke
programme.desc: Crown City in the country Colorado used to be a soft tracer for gold and a very rich town, but now he could become an abandoned place. The only remaining gold is in the hands of the Indians inhabited across the river. Gary Brannon tries to arrange a concession on the mine with a peaceful way, but Frank Walker (L. Bettger) plans to start the war with the Indians to leave his territory. Gary, as well as his father alone, cares to preserve peace ... / Crown City u državi Colorado nekad je bio meka tragača za zlatom i vrlo bogat gradić, no sada bi mogao postati napušteno mjesto. Jedino preostalo zlato je u rukama Indijanaca nastanjenih preko rijeke. Gary Brannon (A. Murphy) pokuša mirnim putem s poglavicom dogovoriti dobivanje koncesije na rudnik, no Frank Walker (L. Bettger) planira započeti rat s Indijancima ne bi li oni napustili svoj teritorij. Garyju je, kao i njegovu ocu Samu, stalo da očuva mir...

programme.title: Island Experience: Mljet 1960 - Today / Iskustvo otoka: Mljet 1960. - danas
programme.desc: This is the story of the nature and society of one of the most famous Croatian islands. Folded almost exclusively of archival recordings, a documentary through the example of a small space and a small group of people who live on perhaps the most important problem of the modern world: how to reconcile economic development with protection and preservation of nature. / Ovo je priča o prirodi i društvu jednog od napoznatijih hrvatskih otoka. Sklopljen gotovo isključivo od arhivskih snimki, dokumentarni film kroz primjer jednog sasvim malog prostora i male skupine ljudi koji na njemu obitavaju ulazi u možda i najvažniji problem suvremenog svijeta: kako pomiriti gospodarski razvoj sa zaštitom i očuvanjem prirode.

programme.title: It's time for jazz / Vrijeme je za jazz
programme.desc: By visiting American jazz music, conductor Michele Weir and pianist and vocalist Dene Derose in the Sfumato cycle in Lauba, HRT Choir and HRT Jazz Orchestra musicians-Mario Bocic on saxophone, Joe Kaplowitz for piano, Sasa Borovec on the counter On drums, they joined the celebration of International Jazz Day. The program called All That Jazz paid tribute to the various historical stylish periods of jazz, showed the splendor of the art of Dene Derose and sent a message of love and strength. / Gostovanjem američkih jazz-glazbenica, dirigentice Michele Weir i pijanistice i vokalistice Dene DeRose u ciklusu Sfumato u Laubi, Zbor HRT-a te glazbenici Jazz orkestra HRT-a - Mario Bočić na saksofonu, Joe Kaplowitz za klavirom, Saša Borovec na kontrabasu i bas-gitari te Janko Novoselić na bubnjevima, pridružili su se slavlju Međunarodnog dana jazza. Program pod nazivom All That Jazz odao je počast različitim povijesnim stilskim razdobljima jazza, pokazao raskoš umijeća Dene DeRose te poslao poruku ljubavi i snage.

programme.title: One work / Jedno djelo
programme.desc: A photo of Mlaka taken by Mirjana Vodopija in a natural setting is a scene that enchants her surrealistic beauty. However, this scene also speaks on the symbolic level: about the light and reflections as a picture of inner cognition, of an open spirit that does not recognize the boundaries and walls, about the healing power of nature ... / Fotografija Mlaka koju je Mirjana Vodopija snimila u prirodnom ambijentu prizor je koji očarava svojom nadrealističkom ljepotom. No, tim prizorom umjetnica progovara i na simboličkoj razini: o svjetlosti i odrazima kao slici unutarnje spoznaje, o otvorenom duhu koji ne priznaje granice i zidove, o iscjeljujućoj moći prirode...

programme.title: Man and Space - Contemporary Croatian Architecture / Čovjek i prostor - suvremena hrvatska arhitektura
programme.desc: Nominations for Bernardo Bernardi Award for Best Internal Formation of the 2018 space. In the seventh episode, we show two interior interventions and one exhibition exhibition. 1918 - The turning point in Croatia was set up in the Croatian History Museum on the occasion of the 100th year of the end of World War I. Considering the extremely extensive and content -rich material prepared and distributed by the Custos team in five thematic units, in the cramped area of the Museum, the authors of the exhibition exhibition introduce the concept of the forgiven archives. Ri-Hub is located in the center of Rijeka on the ground floor of historicist corners and is intended as a space for the work and infocetic agency implemented by the ECK 2020 Rijeka project and represents part of the renovated infrastructure, which is given a public purpose and, after the end of the event, remains in public use. It is designed as an open spatial structure that allows meetings, lectures, panels, public communication, information exchange and developing existing and new forms of sociability. Realized with a minimum budget, he oriented more on the activities that take place in him and the interaction of his users than the formal design understood in a classic sense. Atelier D 02 is the second in a series of flexible exhibition-traffic spaces to present the works of fashion designer Branka Donassy, as well as for occasional exhibitions of other authors. The project is completely transformed by the extent to the minimum means of the exiled abandoned space. What is particularly interesting is / Nominacije za nagradu Bernardo Bernardi za najbolje unutrašnje oblikovanje prostora u 2018. godini. U sedmoj epizodi prikazujemo dvije interijerske intervencije i jedan izložbeni postav. 1918. - prijelomna godina u Hrvatskoj je izložba postavljena u Hrvatskom povijesnom muzeju povodom stote godine završetka Prvog svjetskog rata. S obzirom na izuzetno opsežnu i sadržajno bogatu građu koju je kustoski tim pripremio i rasporedio u pet tematskih cjelina, u skučenom prostoru muzeja autori izložbenog postava uvode koncept oprostorene arhive. RI-HUB je smješten u samom centru Rijeke u prizemlju historicističke uglovnice a zamišljen je kao prostor za rad i infocentar agencije koja provodi projekt Rijeka EPK 2020 te predstavlja dio obnovljene infrastrukture kojoj je dana javna namjena te koja nakon završetka manifestacije ostaje u javnom korištenju. Projektiran je kao otvorena prostorna struktura koja omogućava susrete, predavanja, tribine, komunikaciju s javnošću, razmjenu informacija i razvoj postojećih i novih oblika društvenosti. Ostvaren s minimalnim budžetom, on se više orijentira na aktivnosti koje se u njemu zbivaju i interakciju njegovih korisnika nego na formalno oblikovanje shvaćeno u nekom klasičnom smislu. Atelier D 02 je drugi u nizu fleksibilnih izložbeno-prodajnih prostora za prezentaciju radova modne dizajnerice Branke Donassy, kao i za povremene izložbe drugih autora. Projekt minimalnim sredstvima potpuno preobražava zatečeni zapušteni prostor. Ono što je posebno zanimljivo jest

programme.title: Manon Lescaut - Opera Giacoma Puccinija / Manon Lescaut - Opera Giacoma Puccinija
programme.desc: U Gran Teatre of the Liceu U Barceloni Izvedena Je Opera Manon Lescaut Giacoma Puccinija, in Nastupili on Simfonijski Orkestar I Zbor works Liceu Pod Ravnanjem Emmanuela Villaume. ZBorovođa Je Conxita Garcia. Solists on: Liudmyla Monastyrska (Manon Lescaut), David Bižić (Lescaut), Gregory Kunde (Renato des Grieux), Mikeldi AtxalandaBaso (Edmondo), Marc Pujol, Carol García, Jose Manuel Zapata ITD. / U Gran Teatre del Liceu u Barceloni izvedena je opera Manon Lescaut Giacoma Puccinija, a nastupili su Simfonijski orkestar i Zbor Opere Liceu pod ravnanjem Emmanuela Villaume. Zborovođa je Conxita Garcia. Solisti su: Liudmyla Monastyrska (Manon Lescaut), David Bižić (Lescaut), Gregory Kunde (Renato Des Grieux), Mikeldi Atxalandabaso (Edmondo), Marc Pujol, Carol García, Jose Manuel Zapata itd.

programme.title: Cinehill movie festival - chronic / Cinehill Film Festival - Kronika
programme.desc: The Cinehill Film Festival, and this July 27th to 27th, moved fans of the film to the heart of Gorski Kotar, to the picturesque Fuzine. Under the canopy of Borovo, along the coast of Lake Bajer and Lepenica, viewers enjoyed more than a hundred carefully selected movie titles from Croatia, Europe and the world. Cinehill brought together filmmakers, critics, students and lovers of the seventh art through a rich program, workshops and music evenings this year. / Cinehill Film Festival i ovog srpnja, od 22. do 27., preselio je ljubitelje filma u srce Gorskog kotara, u slikovite Fužine. Pod krošnjama borova, uz obalu jezera Bajer i Lepenica, gledatelji su uživali u više od stotinu pomno odabranih filmskih naslova iz Hrvatske, Europe i svijeta. Cinehill je ove godine okupio filmske stvaratelje, kritičare, studente i zaljubljenike u sedmu umjetnost kroz bogat program, radionice i glazbene večeri.

programme.title: Golden velvet / Zlatni baršun
programme.desc: The shop, located in the UK during the era of glam-rock in the early 1970s, brings a story about the fictitious bisexual pop star Brian Slade, who falsified his own death. / Radnja, smještena u Veliku Britaniju tijekom ere glam-rocka ranih 1970-ih, donosi priču o fiktivnoj biseksualnoj pop-zvijezdi Brianu Sladeu, koji je lažirao vlastitu smrt.

programme.title: Classics to the people / Klasici narodu
programme.desc: From Pera Jonathan Swift comes one of the most popular satirical-fantastic stories about Naval Gulliver and his trips. The story full of uncertainty and interesting descriptions that read in one, up to two breaths. A story that allegorically ridiculed human flaws and social opportunities of England at the end of the 17th century. A story that is read with equal joy by schoolchildren, puberty, adults and pensioners. A story that will only tell you chess players and hemps for you. Let's listen to Gulliver on the island of Lilliput with people only six palaces. / Iz pera Jonathana Swifta dolazi jedna od najpopularnijih satirično-fantastična priča o pomorcu Gulliveru i njegovim putovanjima. Priča puna neizvjesnost i zanimljivih opisa koja se čita u jednom, najviše dva daha. Priča koja alegorički ismijava ljudske mane i društvene prilike Engleske krajem 17. stoljeća. Priča koju s jednakim veseljem čitaju školarci, pubertetlije, odrasli i penzioneri. Priča koju će samo za vas ispričati šahisti i konopaši. Poslušajmo kako se snašao Gulliver na otoku Lilliputu s ljudima visokim svega šest palaca.

programme.title: World Literature Festival / Festival svjetske književnosti
programme.desc: Jean-Baptiste del amo is one of the most important French writers of his generation, born in 1981. He received numerous accolades for his work, including Goncourt's most important literary award. In the Croatian translation, we read his novels, the family Saga Empire and the latest, the son of man, whom he speaks of in the grandstand disclosure. / Jean-Baptiste Del Amo jedan je od najvažnijih francuskih pisaca svoje generacije, rođen je 1981. Za svoj rad dobio je brojna priznanja, između ostalih i najvažniju književnu nagradu Goncourt. U hrvatskom prijevodu čitamo njegove romane, obiteljsku sagu Carstvo životinja i najnoviji, Sin čovječji, o kojima govori na tribini Razotkrivanje.

programme.title: China - Land and People / Kina - zemlja i ljudi
programme.desc: In the latest episode of the cinema series - Earth and people we take you to the plantation of the best green tea in the world, we will see what Tongli looks like, a city on the water, better known as Venice of the East. We will also meet the largest Chinese city of Shanghai and some of his restaurants and a particularly interesting snake restaurant. We will also find out how young people in China have fun ... / U posljednjoj epizodi serije Kina - zemlja i ljudi vodimo vas na plantažu najboljeg zelenog čaja na svijetu, vidjet ćemo kako izgleda Tongli, grad na vodi, poznatiji kao Venecija Istoka. Upoznat ćemo i najveći kineski grad Šangaj i neke njegove restorane te posebno zanimljiv restoran zmija. Doznat ćemo i kako se zabavljaju mladi u Kini...

programme.title: The mouth of the river / Ušća rijeka
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Neretva it becomes a wide, almost plain river, the apparel they brought from the far, deposited here, creating here among the karst hills of muddy and earthen plains. There are also the first traces of powerful cities like Narona in mind. But in addition to archaeological monuments, the underground also preserves numerous sources, caves and other karst phenomena. In one of them we found the only freshwater underground shell in the world. This living fossil endemic is our karst regions. Neretva spreads here to the Great Delta. Today, a large amount of land is abducted by swamp, but the wilderness remained in the box or the small River Norina. And that's where we find the eel. Following her through Metkovic, Opuzena we go to the Neretva mouth. Sweet waters of the Neretva are felt far in the open sea. The sandy inlets brought by the Neretva made this sea shallow and suitable for unusual organisms on the border of salty seawater and sweet river waters. / U drugoj epizodi Neretva postaje široka, gotovo ravničarska rijeka, nanosi koje je donijela iz daleka, taložili su se ovdje stvarajući među kraškim brdima muljevite i zemljane ravnice. Tu su i prvi tragovi moćnih gradova poput Narone u Vidu. No podzemlje osim arheoloških spomenika čuva i brojne izvore, špilje i ostale kraške fenomene. U jednoj od njih smo pronašli jedinog slatkovodnog podzemnog školjkaša na svijetu. Taj živi fosil endem je naših kraških krajeva. Neretva se ovdje širi u veliku deltu. Danas je velika količina zemlje oteta močvari no divljina je ostala u Kutima ili pak maloj rječici Norinu. I tu nalazimo jegulju. Prateći je preko Metkovića, Opuzena odlazimo u Neretvino ušće. Slatke vode Neretve osjećaju se daleko na pučini. Pješčani nanosi koje je Neretva donijela učinila je ovo more plitkim i pogodnima za neobične organizme na granici slane morske i slatke riječne vode.

programme.title: Ceremony / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore together and discover the world around us, learn about ourselves and others. We learn in play, in songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuh every morning, every day from 6.30am to 1pm. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Vrtuljići / Vrtuljići
programme.desc: The Vrtuljići are a family of cute beings like birds living in a red boat, and they came from afar to meet our world. The carousels are curious and cheerful. They like to hide, imitate and discover new things. Wherever you find themselves, whether on their boat or real world, they are looking for adventures through which they learn. This animated series is intended for preschool age, and the cute Vrtuljići, just like the children of that age, learn through the fun the basic terms such as below, up and down, full and empty, etc. As the carousels are often clumsy, in a new world that children know more than them, their attempts and mistakes will make their children and the children. older) and learn something. / Vrtuljići su obitelj simpatičnih bića nalik na ptice, koja žive u crvenom brodiću, a došli su izdaleka kako bi upoznali naš svijet. Vrtuljići su znatiželjni i veseli. Vole se skrivati, oponašati i otkrivati nove stvari. Gdje god se našli, bilo na svom brodiću ili i stvarnom svijetu, u potrazi su za pustolovinama kroz koje uče. Ova animirana serija namijenjena je predškolskom uzrastu, a simpatični Vrtuljići, baš kao i djeca tog uzrasta, kroz zabavu uče osnovne pojmove kao što su ispod i iznad, gore i dolje, pun i prazan i sl. Kako su Vrtuljići često nespretni, u novom svijetu o kojem djeca znaju više od njih, njihovi će pokušaji i pogreške djecu nasmijati, a kroz zabavu će i sama (ili tijekom gledanja serije uz roditelje i starije) ponešto i naučiti.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The Canadian Animated Series for Kids Puppies in patrol was created according to Keith Chapman creation. The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of the Seeker and Savior's dog team called puppies in patrol. The team together goes to the tasks in which they work to protect the coastal community of the Bay of Adventure Bay. / Kanadska animirana serija za djecu Psići u ophodnji je nastala prema kreaciji Keitha Chapmana. Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay.

programme.title: LA i BU / LA i BU
programme.desc: In this episode we adopt the term flight/fly! The main character of today's story is not a little Vila La, but her friend Bubamara Bu, who has not yet learned to fly. Because she is small. Because just like young children learn to walk, so do little ladybugs learn - fly! After a few unsuccessful attempts, she almost gave up, and then Lu came up with a way to encourage her friend ... A little magic, a lot of goodwill and she was ready to flight! / U ovoj epizodi usvajamo pojam LET/letjeti! Glavni lik današnje priče nije mala vila La već njezina prijateljica bubamara Bu koja još nije naučila letjeti. Jer je malena. Jer baš kao što malena djeca uče hodati, tako i malene bubamare uče - letjeti! Nakon nekoliko neuspjelih pokušaja gotovo je odustala, a onda je Lu smislila način kako ohrabriti svoju prijateljicu... Malo čarolije, puno dobre volje i Bu je bila spremna za let!

programme.title: I love animals / Volim životinje
programme.desc: The documentary-animated series meets the youngest with animal species. / Dokumentarno-animirana serija upoznaje najmlađe sa životinjskim vrstama.

programme.title: Pussy and puppy / Maca i Psić
programme.desc: Maca and a puppy found a large mirror and pussy soon reveals that using her reflection can joke with a puppy. Through their pussy adventures and a puppy, they learn that mirrors can be great, various forms and that they reflect objects. In a live research, a small scientist reveals that a mirror can be used to create different images, and in the world of materials a tiny researcher waves from the edge of a hand mirror. / Maca i Psić pronašli su veliko zrcalo i Maca uskoro otkriva da se pomoću svojega odraza može našaliti s Psićem. Kroz svoje pustolovine Maca i Psić doznaju da zrcala mogu biti sjajna, raznih oblika te da odražavaju predmete. U istraživanju uživo mali znanstvenik otkriva kako se zrcalo može koristiti za stvaranje različitih slika, a u svijetu materijala nam sićušni istraživač maše s ruba ručnog zrcala.

programme.title: Pocoyo / Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and tiny mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoya and his friends, and each episode deals with another topic. The cheerful societies explore the world through play and teaches new words and concepts. And by the way she has a good time. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. / Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom.

programme.title: Toddlers / Mališani
programme.desc: In twenty two -minute episodes of the series, you are waiting for unprecedented stories and posts: how to wash your paws to your puppy, how to feed it, how to put the laundry on drying and beat the clips, remove the dishes from the washing machine, prepare the orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden, or to pack yourself for a trip. Spend the morning in the company of a two -year -old! The series prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey

We will also find out how young people in China have fun ... / U posljednjoj epizodi serije Kina - zemlja i ljudi vodimo vas na plantažu najboljeg zelenog čaja na svijetu, vidjet ćemo kako izgleda Tongli, grad na vodi, poznatiji kao Venecija Istoka. Upoznat ćemo i najveći kineski grad Šangaj i neke njegove restorane te posebno zanimljiv restoran zmija. Doznat ćemo i kako se zabavljaju mladi u Kini...

programme.title: The mouth of the river / Ušća rijeka
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Neretva it becomes a wide, almost plain river, the apparel they brought from the far, deposited here, creating here among the karst hills of muddy and earthen plains. There are also the first traces of powerful cities like Narona in mind. But in addition to archaeological monuments, the underground also preserves numerous sources, caves and other karst phenomena. In one of them we found the only freshwater underground shell in the world. This living fossil endemic is our karst regions. Neretva spreads here to the Great Delta. Today, a large amount of land is abducted by swamp, but the wilderness remained in the box or the small River Norina. And that's where we find the eel. Following her through Metkovic, Opuzena we go to the Neretva mouth. Sweet waters of the Neretva are felt far in the open sea. The sandy inlets brought by the Neretva made this sea shallow and suitable for unusual organisms on the border of salty seawater and sweet river waters. / U drugoj epizodi Neretva postaje široka, gotovo ravničarska rijeka, nanosi koje je donijela iz daleka, taložili su se ovdje stvarajući među kraškim brdima muljevite i zemljane ravnice. Tu su i prvi tragovi moćnih gradova poput Narone u Vidu. No podzemlje osim arheoloških spomenika čuva i brojne izvore, špilje i ostale kraške fenomene. U jednoj od njih smo pronašli jedinog slatkovodnog podzemnog školjkaša na svijetu. Taj živi fosil endem je naših kraških krajeva. Neretva se ovdje širi u veliku deltu. Danas je velika količina zemlje oteta močvari no divljina je ostala u Kutima ili pak maloj rječici Norinu. I tu nalazimo jegulju. Prateći je preko Metkovića, Opuzena odlazimo u Neretvino ušće. Slatke vode Neretve osjećaju se daleko na pučini. Pješčani nanosi koje je Neretva donijela učinila je ovo more plitkim i pogodnima za neobične organizme na granici slane morske i slatke riječne vode.

programme.title: Sometimes a good idea / Katkada dobra zamisao
programme.desc: Hank Stamper and his father Henry are the owners of the family factory for cutting and shipping a boulder in Oregon. The city is furious when they continue to work despite the decay of the city and the strike of other woodcuts who order the stampers to stop working. However, Hank drives the family to cut even more wood ... / Hank Stamper i njegov otac Henry vlasnici su obiteljske tvornice za sječu i otpremu balvana u Oregonu. Grad je bijesan kad oni nastavljaju s radom unatoč propadanju grada i štrajku ostalih drvosječa koji naređuju Stamperima da prestanu raditi. Međutim, Hank tjera obitelj da siječe još više drva...

programme.title: Listen to the stone / Slušaj kamen
programme.desc: The documentary was created as part of the International Interrives 6 project, publishing the past, it meets the present. It is a meeting in which Mediterranean countries such as Italy, Algeria, Morocco, Croatia, Egypt, Albania, etc. Listen to the stone of stone and work in stone in Pucisca on the island of Brac, told the life of three protagonists who are each in their own way (education), presented the topic of the legacy. The 13 -minute version of the film was awarded at the Tunisia Festival, and it is interesting that the story of the stone has gone to the world - it will be shown on the public television of all project participants. / Dokumentarni film nastao je u sklopu međunarodnog projekta Interrives 6, izdanja pod nazivom Prošlost susreće sadašnjost. Riječ je o susretu u kojem su se na temu naslijeđa predstavile mediteranske zemlje poput Italije, Alžira, Maroka, Hrvatske, Egipta, Albanije i dr. Hrvatski film Slušaj kamen priča je o tradiciji branja kamena i rada u kamenu u Pučišćima na otoku Braču ispričana kroz život trojice protagonista koji su svaki na svoj način (obrazovanje, obrada, restauracija, trgovina) vezani uz kamen. 13-minutna verzija filma nagrađena je na festivalu u Tunisu, a zanimljivo je i da je priča o kamenu otišla u svijet - prikazat će se na javnim televizijama svih zemalja sudionica projekta.

In the KD V. Lisinski on October 4, 2019, the new Fossili held a anniversary concert of the story of 50 years of new fossils. Sanja, Rabbit and Marinko, the only then left from the legendary line -up that, primarily by Rajko Dujmic and the specialty of the musical expression, marked the Croatian music scene in the past more than 40 years, and with top -notch accompanying musicians, recalled old good musical times. In the crowded Lisinski, they played the biggest hits of the group listened to in the 80s and 90s, but who know and listen to the new generations of the 21st century: from dreaming of me, blue shirts, just let me know, seven long years, tonka, my favorite, do you hear me, I am pleased, Milena, under the month, to good old times. For HTV spectators two hours of musical pleasure of watching and listening to timeless songs and music of all generations for the past 50 years ... / U KD V. Lisinskog 4. listopada 2019. Novi fosili održali su obljetnički koncert Priča o 50 godina Novih fosila. Sanja, Zec i Marinko, jedini tada preostali iz legendarne postave koja je autorskim skladbama prvenstveno Rajka Dujmića i posebnošću glazbenog izričaja obilježila hrvatsku glazbenu scenu u proteklih više od 40 godina, te uz vrhunske prateće glazbenike, podsjetili su na stara dobra glazbena vremena. U prepunom Lisinskom svirali su najveće hitove grupe koju su slušale generacije 80-ih i 90-ih, ali koje znaju i slušaju i nove generacije 21. stoljeća: od Sanjaj me, Plave košulje, Samo mi se javi, Sedam dugih godina, Tonke, Najdraže moje, Čuješ li me je l ti drago, Milene, Ispod mjeseca, pa do Dobrih starih vremena. Za gledatelje HTV-a dva sata glazbenog užitka gledanja i slušanja bezvremenskih pjesama i glazbe svih generacija proteklih 50 godina...

programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: In the last ten years, more and more attention has been attracted to ancient megalithic monuments - stećak tombstones. More and more books are written about them, more and more people think about them or go on their way to the remote mountainous parts in search of some perhaps -chopped necropolis. We also witness a gradual change in viewing the question of their age, which has never been devoid of controversy. Today we will head towards Ploče, where the demolished stećak tombstones are raised on the fuel enthusiasm or looking for and finding those mentioned in historical documents ... / U posljednjih desetak godine sve više pažnje privlače drevni megalitski spomenici - stećci. Sve više knjiga se o njima piše, sve više ljudi o njima razmišlja ili pak i sami krenu na put do udaljenih planinskih dijelova u potragu za nekim možda zaboravljenim nekropolama. Svjedočimo i postupnoj promjeni gledanja na pitanje njihove starosti, koje nikad nije bilo lišeno kontroverzi. Danas ćemo se uputiti prema Pločama, gdje se na gorivu entuzijazma podižu srušeni stećci ili traži i nalazi one spomenute u povijesnim dokumentima...

programme.title: New Egypt between luxury and repression / Novi Egipat između raskoši i represije
programme.desc: Egypt, a country of multi -fat civilization that boasts a rich archeological heritage and an unusual beauty of the Nile River, was once a favorite tourist destination. But behind the view as a postcard hides an unprecedented repression, exposed to its 110 million inhabitants. Hope in change and freedom, born in protests at Tahrir Square in 2011, was quickly suffocated. At the head of the state is Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, a retired military official who has been ruling an egypt steel hand for eight years. He wants to turn Egypt into another Dubai and attract investors and rich tourists with luxury villas, imposing business buildings and huge shopping malls that are coming everywhere. His latest project is the new capital in the middle of the desert, six times larger than Paris, whose construction will cost almost 50 billion euros. But not all benefits from Sisi's vision of modern Egypt. About 30% of the population lives with less than two dollars a day - to survive, some even live in cemeteries like El -Araf in the Cairo capital. In this necropolis, hundreds of thousands of people sleep among the graves of ancestors. It's a real city in the city - there are shops and even school. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi is a terrifying opponent and ignoring the poor. One of the symbols of this oppression is Alaa Abd El-Fattah, the leader of the rebellion in Tahrir Square. The 40 -year -old blogger has spent most of the eight years behind bars. We met with his mother, Lail Soueif, activist for human rights, and his sister Sana, a refugee who lives in London and does everything to turn / Egipat, zemlja višetisućljetne civilizacije koja se diči bogatom arheološkom baštinom i nesvakidašnjom ljepotom rijeke Nil, nekada je bio omiljeno turističko odredište. No iza vizura kao s razglednica krije se neviđena represija kojoj je izloženo njegovih 110 milijuna stanovnika. Nada u promjene i slobodu, rođena u prosvjedima na trgu Tahrir 2011. godine, brzo je ugušena. Na čelu države je Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, umirovljeni vojni dužnosnik koji vlada Egiptom čeličnom rukom već osam godina. On želi Egipat pretvoriti u drugi Dubai te privući investitore i bogate turiste luksuznim vilama, impozantnim poslovnim zgradama i golemim trgovačkim centrima koji niču posvuda. Njegov je najnoviji projekt novi glavni grad usred pustinje, šest puta veći od Pariza, čija će izgradnja stajati gotovo 50 milijardi eura. No nemaju svi koristi od Sisijeve vizije modernog Egipta. Oko 30% stanovništva živi s manje od dva dolara dnevno - da bi preživjeli, neki čak žive na grobljima poput El-Arafa u glavnom gradu Kairu. U ovoj nekropoli stotine tisuća ljudi spava među grobovima predaka. To je pravi grad u gradu - ima trgovine pa čak i školu. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi vlada zastrašujući oponente i ignorirajući siromašne. Jedan od simbola ovog ugnjetavanja je Alaa Abd el-Fattah, vođa pobune na trgu Tahrir. 40 godišnji bloger proteklih je osam godina većinom proveo iza rešetaka. Sastali smo se s njegovom majkom, Lailom Soueif, aktivisticom za ljudska prava te njegovom sestrom Sanaom, izbjeglicom koja živi u Londonu i čini sve da skrene

programme.title: Retrospective Alain Delona: Rocco and his brothers / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Rocco i njegova braća
programme.desc: Drama. Four brothers from Sicily, Simone (R. Salvatore), Rocco (A. Delon), Ciro (M. Cartier) and Luca, come with his mother Rosario (K. Paxinou) in the suburbs of Milan and try to adapt to a new life, in which their oldest brother Vincenzo (S. Focas) has already been successful. Simone becomes a successful boxer and begins a love affair with a prostitute Nadiom (A. Girardot), but due to irresponsibility, he soon begins to waste strength and money and leave him. The younger brother Rocco also shows boxing talent and himself begins a relationship with the Nadiom. Still, because of the sense of responsibility for his brother, he interrupts the relationship. While Rocco triumphs as a boxer, Simone, completely failed, rapes Nadi ... Rocco and his brothers is an impressive Italian social drama that, through the gloomy story of a new life, shows a misery and all the fate of such people in Milan. The film was directed by the famous Italian director Luchino Visconti (Death in Venice, Gepard), who entrusted the main roles with famous actors A. Delon, A. Girardot, C. Cardinale and others. Filmed in the tradition of Italian neorealistic films, with a pronounced emphasis on the social state of the protagonist, a film is a cult accomplishment that still impresses with master directing, great music (Nino Rota) and an excellent script. The exceptionality of the film was immediately recognized: the film won a silver lion at the 1961 Venetian Festival, the FiPrensca award and numerous others. / Drama. Četvorica braće sa Sicilije, Simone (R. Salvatore), Rocco (A. Delon), Ciro (M. Cartier) i Luca, dolaze zajedno s majkom Rosariom (K. Paxinou) u predgrađe Milana te se pokušavaju prilagoditi novom životu, u čemu je njihov najstariji brat Vincenzo (S. Focas) već djelomice uspio. Simone postaje uspješan boksač i započinje ljubavnu vezu s prostitutkom Nadiom (A. Girardot), ali zbog neodgovornosti ubrzo počinje rasipati snagu i novac te ga ona ostavi. Mlađi brat Rocco također pokazuje boksačku nadarenost i sam započinje vezu s Nadiom. Ipak, zbog osjećaja odgovornosti prema bratu, prekida vezu. Dok Rocco trijumfira kao boksač, Simone, potpuno propao, siluje Nadiu... Rocco i njegova braća dojmljiva je talijanska socijalna drama koja kroz tmurnu priču o novom životu osiromašene sicilijanske obitelji pokazuje bijedu i svakakve sudbine takvih ljudi pristiglih u Milano. Film je režirao slavni talijanski redatelj Luchino Visconti (Smrt u Veneciji, Gepard), koji je glavne uloge povjerio slavnim glumcima A. Delonu, A. Girardot, C. Cardinale i ostalima. Snimljen u tradiciji talijanskih neorealističnih filmova, s izrazitim naglaskom na socijalno stanje protagonista, film je kultno ostvarenje koje i danas zadivljuje majstorskom režijom, sjajnom glazbom (Nino Rota) i odličnim scenarijem. Izuzetnost filma bila je odmah prepoznata: film je osvojio Srebrnog lava na venecijanskom festivalu 1961. godine, FIPRESCI nagradu te brojne druge.

programme.desc: Who heard her playing her felt what it meant to love music. In every note, in every tone of Samantha Stell, she pulls out pure love from the flute. Although hundreds of concerts are behind her, pedagogical work at the Pula Music School is leading her through the day. Many new generations of Istrian musicians are fortunate to grow with Samanto. / Tko ju je čuo kako svira, osjetio je što znači voljeti glazbu. Iako su stotine koncerata iza nje, pedagoški rad u pulskoj glazbenoj školi vodi je kroz dan. Mnoge nove generacije istarskih glazbenika imaju tu sreću da su rasli uz Samantu.

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: Where the helmets are not angry, the house is not tight, the old proverb and everyday life of the Dulic family from Vojvodina hamlet Djurdjin not far from Subotica. Behind the clear and Zdenka is 16 years of harmonious marriage, admittedly full of renunciation, because they were to be placed on their feet of their eight children. The modest, hardworking, organized mom and dad Dulici live day by day, but find time for themselves. Darko's Novi Sadjani imagines his hometown as a place where people will bind to identity - equally spatial and emotional. He imagines him as an environment where he cares for the rich legacy of the ancestors harmoniously slammed into modern life -threatening. Darko is an architect and urbanist and knows every corner of the new one now that he prefers to visit. I call the Claudius a Vojvodian celebrity, and when you hear it, you will understand why. Mother of the three teenagers, wife, entrepreneur, graduate pedagogue ... There are a number of interests of this stood of Petrovaradin who proudly emphasize her Croatian roots. Music also came up with childhood Darko number two from our story. Parents thought that she would live from the piano playing, but she won the love of another kind of art. Darko is designing and designing posters, collaborating with theaters in Croatia, and at the Novi Sad Academy of Fine Arts, he teaches some new kids that Pannonian sailor Djordje Balasevic sang about. The editor of the series: Silvija Trnčević / Gdje čeljad nije bijesna, ni kuća nije tijesna, stara je poslovica i svakodnevica obitelji Dulić iz vojvođanskog zaseoka Đurđina nedaleko od Subotice. Iza Jasne i Zdenka 16 je godina skladnoga braka, doduše punog odricanja, jer trebalo je postaviti na noge njihovo osmero djece. Skromni, radišni, organizirani mama i tata Dulići žive dan po dan, ali nalaze vremena samo za sebe. Novosađanin Darko zamišlja svoj rodni grad kao mjesto gdje će se ljudi vezati za identitet - podjednako prostorni i emocionalni. Zamišlja ga kao sredinu gdje se mari za bogatu ostavštinu predaka skladno ušuškanu u moderne životne tekovine. Darko je arhitekt i urbanist i dobro poznaje svaki kutak Novoga Sada koji najradije obilazi biciklom. Klaudiju nazivaju vojvođanskim slavujem, a kada ju čujete, bit će vam jasno zašto. Majka troje tinejdžera, supruga, poduzetnica, diplomirana pedagoginja... poduži je niz interesa ove stasite Petrovaradinke koja ponosno ističe svoje hrvatske korijene. Glazba se provlačila i djetinjstvom Darka broj dva iz naše priče. Mislili su roditelji da će živjeti od sviranja klavira no pobijedila je ljubav prema drugoj vrsti umjetnosti. Darko osmišljava i dizajnira plakate, surađuje s kazalištima u Hrvatskoj, a na novosadskoj Likovnoj akademiji predaje nekim novim klincima o kojima je pjevao panonski mornar Đorđe Balašević. Urednica serije: Silvija Trnčević

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: Where the helmets are not angry, the house is not tight, the old proverb and everyday life of the Dulic family from Vojvodina hamlet Djurdjin not far from Subotica. Behind the clear and Zdenka is 16 years of harmonious marriage, admittedly full of renunciation, because they were to be placed on their feet of their eight children. The modest, hardworking, organized mom and dad Dulici live day by day, but find time for themselves. Darko's Novi Sadjani imagines his hometown as a place where people will bind to identity - equally spatial and emotional. He imagines him as an environment where he cares for the rich legacy of the ancestors harmoniously slammed into modern life -threatening. Darko is an architect and urbanist and knows every corner of the new one now that he prefers to visit. I call the Claudius a Vojvodian celebrity, and when you hear it, you will understand why. Mother of the three teenagers, wife, entrepreneur, graduate pedagogue ... There are a number of interests of this stood of Petrovaradin who proudly emphasize her Croatian roots. Music also came up with childhood Darko number two from our story. Parents thought that she would live from the piano playing, but she won the love of another kind of art. Darko is designing and designing posters, collaborating with theaters in Croatia, and at the Novi Sad Academy of Fine Arts, he teaches some new kids that Pannonian sailor Djordje Balasevic sang about. The editor of the series: Silvija Trnčević / Gdje čeljad nije bijesna, ni kuća nije tijesna, stara je poslovica i svakodnevica obitelji Dulić iz vojvođanskog zaseoka Đurđina nedaleko od Subotice. Iza Jasne i Zdenka 16 je godina skladnoga braka, doduše punog odricanja, jer trebalo je postaviti na noge njihovo osmero djece. Skromni, radišni, organizirani mama i tata Dulići žive dan po dan, ali nalaze vremena samo za sebe. Novosađanin Darko zamišlja svoj rodni grad kao mjesto gdje će se ljudi vezati za identitet - podjednako prostorni i emocionalni. Zamišlja ga kao sredinu gdje se mari za bogatu ostavštinu predaka skladno ušuškanu u moderne životne tekovine. Darko je arhitekt i urbanist i dobro poznaje svaki kutak Novoga Sada koji najradije obilazi biciklom. Klaudiju nazivaju vojvođanskim slavujem, a kada ju čujete, bit će vam jasno zašto. Majka troje tinejdžera, supruga, poduzetnica, diplomirana pedagoginja... poduži je niz interesa ove stasite Petrovaradinke koja ponosno ističe svoje hrvatske korijene. Glazba se provlačila i djetinjstvom Darka broj dva iz naše priče. Mislili su roditelji da će živjeti od sviranja klavira no pobijedila je ljubav prema drugoj vrsti umjetnosti. Darko osmišljava i dizajnira plakate, surađuje s kazalištima u Hrvatskoj, a na novosadskoj Likovnoj akademiji predaje nekim novim klincima o kojima je pjevao panonski mornar Đorđe Balašević. Urednica serije: Silvija Trnčević

programme.title: Nothing Kontra Split - Author's Evening Nenad Vilovic / Ništa kontra Splita - autorska večer Nenada Vilovića
programme.desc: Nothing's counter of Split is the name of the concert evening and one of the most famous compositions of composers, songwriters, arrangements and producer Nenad Vilovic. At the Split Festival, this legend of entertainment music, she first introduced herself 52 years ago, with a song that was different, more modern and noticed. Something new and ahead of time are a recognizable sign and signature of the musical creation of Nenad Vilovic. Tonight's concert will recall his greatest hits, songs by the author's choice that were his favorite to him, and to the audience. We will hear the song with which he first introduced himself to the Split audience in 1971, followed by: 48 Uri when the day, old bells, I peeked, after long miles, you were when there was no contradiction of Split, etc. The compositions are performed: Djordje Peruzovic, Zoran Jelenkovic, Ana Opacak, Darko Domijan, Vladimir Garic Kondza, Luka Nizetic, Partenca Klapa, Dean Dvornik, Kreso Bengalka, Roko Zunic 3p Hop. / Ništa kontra Splita naziv je koncertne večeri i jedne od najpoznatijih skladbi skladatelja, tekstopisaca, aranžera i producenta Nenada Vilovića. Na Splitskom se festivalu, ova legenda zabavne glazbe, prvi put predstavila prije 52 godine, s pjesmom koja je bila drukčija, modernija i primijećena. Nešto novo i ispred vremena prepoznatljiv su znak i potpis glazbenog stvaranja Nenada Vilovića. Večerašnjim koncertom prisjetit ćemo se njegovih najvećih uspješnica, pjesama po autorovu izboru koje su njemu, a i publici, bile najdraže. Čut ćemo pjesmu s kojom se prvi put predstavio splitskoj publici davne 1971. godine, a slijede: 48 uri kad bi traja dan, Stara zvona, Virujem, Nakon dugih milja , Di si bija kad je grmilo, Ništa kontra Splita itd. Skladbe izvode: Đorđi Peruzović, Zoran Jelenković, Ana Opačak, Darko Domijan, Vladimir Garić, Igor Cukrov, Lidija Bačić, Zorica Kondža, Luka Nižetić, klapa Partenca, Dean Dvornik, Krešo Bengalka, Roko Žunić 3P HOP.

programme.title: Jojo and a healthy life / Jojo i zdrav život
programme.desc: In the new season through, 8 episodes, Jojo explores a healthy life, so he learns about the importance of teeth health, healthy nutrition, ordering/maintenance of order, the importance of exercise, dealing with sports, staying in the fresh air and playing (in which there are no screens of any kind! :)) Joji joins some old and new characters in his healthy adventure Švrljo, Maca Maza, donkey Šime, Zečići Uško and Gusko and Kravica Ela ... Of course in the new season, each episode is accompanied by its original song. The series can be monitored in linear broadcast and on soup platforms team: author of the characters, illustration and animation: Bojan Jambrosic author of music and song: Bojan Jambrosic costume designer: Jasna Zvonkovic screenwriter: Ivana Gudelj Director: Ivana Radovcic Editor: Silva Skender / U novoj sezoni kroz, 8 epizoda , Jojo istražuje zdrav život, pa uči o važnosti zdravlja zubiju, zdravoj prehrani, urednosti/održavanju reda, važnosti vježbanja, bavljena sportom, boravka na svježem zraku i igranja (u kojemu nema ekrana bilo koje vrste! : )) Joji se u njegovim zdravim pustolovinama pridružuju neki stari i neki novi likovi, ali stalni suputnici i društvo u igrama su njegove životinje - pas Švrljo, maca Maza, magarac Šime, zečići Uško i Guško i kravica Ela... Naravno i u novoj sezoni, svaka je epizoda praćena i svojom originalnom pjesmicom. programme.title: Menus of lost time / Jelovnici izgubljenog vremena
programme.desc: Today it is impossible to imagine our kitchen without various types of beans, arrived in Europe only in the sixteenth century, after the discovery of America. However, it is little known that on our continent, even parts of the Middle East, a type of fažoli or bean, that little yellowish, Latin faseolus, with bob as the oldest species of the whole family and other legumes, primarily lens, peas and bacon, was well known to the chefs of the time. The menus of lost time are dedicated to these legumes and through a small menu composed of them and ways of preparation in various parts of Croatia and Europe tell their unique story. / Danas je nemoguće zamisliti našu kuhinju bez raznih vrsta graha, pristiglih u Europu tek u XVI. stoljeću, nakon otkrića Amerike. Međutim, malo je poznato da je na našem kontinentu, pa i dijelovima Bliskog istoka vrsta fažola ili graha, onoga maloga žućkastoga, latinski faseolus, uz bob kao najstariju vrstu cijele obitelji te druge mahunarke, ponajprije leću, grašak i slanutak, bio dobro poznat onodobnim kuharima. Jelovnici izgubljenog vremena posvećeni su upravo tim mahunarkama i kroz mali jelovnik sastavljen od njih i načine pripreme u raznim dijelovima Hrvatske i Europe pričaju njihovu jedinstvenu priču.

programme.title: Let's meet Croatia - dive with us / Upoznajmo Hrvatsku - Zaronite s nama

U njegovim procjepima svoj dom našle su i kirnje.

programme.title: Love life of a home defense / Ljubavni život domobrana
programme.desc: Humorable drama. You can be a good writer only if you have quality sex. It is the opinion of the editor's sush, dissatisfied with his last stories that are also an escape from the unsatisfactory job of gastrocritic. The truth is - Sashin intimate life knows better days. But everything changes when he meets ines, masseur and trainer in the fitness center. Saved and practical, it represents the arts the opposite of its character. When, after a common dinner, Sasha finally writes a devastating review for the Skorajevski restaurant, an avalanche of events will began to finally face himself and at least try to protect what he cares about ... / Humorna drama. Možeš biti dobar pisac jedino ako imaš kvalitetan seks. To je mišljenje Sašina urednika, nezadovoljnog njegovim posljednjim pričama koje su ujedno i bijeg od nezadovoljavajućeg posla gastrokritičara. Istina je - Sašin intimni život poznaje i bolje dane. No, sve se mijenja kad upozna Ines, maserku i trenericu u fitness centru. Spretna i praktična, ona predstavlja suštu suprotnost njegovom karakteru. Kad, nakon zajedničke večere, Saša konačno napiše poražavajuću recenziju za skorojevićevski restoran, pokrenut će lavinu događaja koji će ga natjerati da se konačno suoči sa samim sobom i barem pokuša zaštititi ono do čega mu je najviše stalo...

programme.title: All will be well / Sve će biti dobro
programme.desc: After sex, Alexandra is coldly accusing Anton of taking advantage of her. Marko provokes his colleague Government that he fell in love with John. Marko uses the opportunity and lies to dealing with the station, sending the government to John, and spends his time with the waitress Djurdje in his house. Mila tells Zoran that she learned from Kristina that Slaven wanted to meet him. Zoran is afraid of meeting her nephew. Nevenka and makeup go after work for coffee and Nevenka recognizes Sunčača's classmate Dinko, who works as a waiter. Nevenka's departure with makeup for coffee be jealousy in Matko. programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Marko Polo and the traditional Moreška dance made Korcula world famous. Its history can be monitored for 20,000 years, and we have found evidence in the Vela Cave. There are also those large flooded caves that were safely on the dry age. We start to discover the secrets of the Korcula underwater. In the south, from Lumbarda, we are looking for a cantari who spawn on the Cape Razhnić. The town of Korcula is a small island Dubrovnik. Full of history, stone towers, walls, churches and villas. The islets, the most famous of which is Badija with the monastery, but also a quarry with a quarry that was an important place of the island economy, when it was built with stone. The diversity and wealth of submarine habitats and life forms lead us to an unusual dive in which we study the movement of animals. The unexpected movement when shells swim, the fish walk, the octopus crawls to all eight arms. Animals you thought were not moving at all can be surprised to be fast. Expert associates: prof. Ivan Jardas, Ph.D. Leon Grubišić, mr. Petar Kružić and Flora Expert Ph.D. Nenad Jasprica Chief Diver: Drazen Ćurković Divers: Miljenko Marukić, Denis Teković, Mijo Knezović, Ivo Srsen, Pavica Sršen, Zorana Andrić, Vlado Brozović / Marko Polo i tradicionalni ples moreška učinili su Korčulu svjetski poznatom. Njezina povijest može se pratiti već 20.000 godina, a dokaze tomu pronašli smo u Veloj špilji. Ima i onih velikih potopljenih špilja koje su sigurno za ledenog doba bile na suhom. Od njih krećemo u otkrivanje tajni korčulanskog podmorja. Na samom jugu, iz Lumbarde, krećemo u potragu za kantarima koji se mrijeste na rtu Ražnjić. Grad Korčula je mali otočki Dubrovnik. Prepun povijesti, kamenih kula, zidina, crkava i vila. Do njega su otočići, od kojih je najpoznatija Badija sa samostanom, ali i Vrnik s kamenolomom koji je bio važno mjesto otočkog gospodarstva, kad se gradilo kamenom. Raznolikost i bogatstvo podmorskih staništa i životnih oblika vodi nas u neobičan zaron u kojem proučavamo kretanje životinja. Ono neočekivano kretanje kad školjke plivaju, ribe hodaju, hobotnica puže na svih osam krakova. Životinje za koje ste mislili da se uopće ne kreću znaju biti iznenađujeće brze. programme.desc: Kumrovec, the most famous village in the world. programme.title: Forbidden dreams / Zabranjeni Snovi
programme.desc: Nothing costs to dream. But realize dreams, turn them into reality, costs a lot. Two young brothers from Salvador illegally cross the American border dreaming of a better life. As immigrants without documents, they must overcome many obstacles that are on their way. But their roads diverge, one goes to success, second to tragedy. Despite the very strong relationship that connects them, they soon reveal that the promised country does not necessarily want the success of both. / Ništa ne košta sanjati. Ali ostvariti snove, pretvoriti ih u realnost, košta mnogo. Dva mlada brata iz Salvadora ilegalno prelaze američku granicu sanjajući o boljem životu. Kao imigranti bez dokumenata, oni moraju da prevaziđu mnoge prepreke koje su im na putu. Ali njihovi putevi se razilaze, jedan ide k uspehu, drugi ka tragediji. Uprkos veoma čvrstoj vezi koja ih spaja, ubrzo otkrivaju da obećana zemlja ne želi nužno uspeh oboma.

programme.title: Info morning / Info jutro
programme.desc: It was made at the extent of the ordinary, nation man, without exaggerated forms and wrist. The idea is to host, our leading couple, be relaxed and informal in commenting to the most current events. Regardless of the advanced emissory shirt and plan, the morning program adapts to the last news that arrives in the studio and the event that interests the public. The viewer of the Informer's morning program should have a feeling that chatting with the hosts of the show, that they give him answers to the questions that bother him every morning. / Napravljena je po meri običnog, narodskog čoveka, bez preterane forme i upeglanosti. Ideja je da domaćini, naš voditeljski par, bude opušten i neformalan u komentarisanju najaktuelnijih događaja. Bez obzira na unapred osmišljenu košuljicu emisije i plan, jutarnji program se prilagođava poslednjoj vesti koja stigne u studio i događaju koji interesuje javnost. Gledalac Informerovog jutarnjeg programa treba da ima osećaj da ćaska sa domaćinima emisije, da mu oni daju odgovore na pitanja koja ga svakog jutra muče.
