programme.title: Legend of the Guardians / Legenda o čuvarima
programme.desc: The film follows the Sorena, the young owl of the Father's epic stories of Gahula, the mythical group of winged warriors who led a large battle for the salvation of all owls from the evil pure. While Soren dreams of just one day to join his heroes, his older brother, Klad despises it and wants to overcome the role of his father's favorite son from the younger brother. But Kladova jealousy has horrible consequences - ausating fall of both young owls from their home on top of wood right among clean. He is now on Sorena to take out a bold with the help of other brave young owls. Together, they go on the road across the sea and through the fog to find great wood, the home of the legendary guardians of Gahula - Soren's only hope that it will defeat the pure and save the kingdoms of the owl. / Film prati Sorena, mladu sovu opčinjenu očevim epskim pričama o Čuvarima GaHula, mitskom grupom krilatih ratnika koji su vodili veliku bitku za spas svih sova od zlih Čistih. Dok Soren sanja o tome da se jednog dana pridruži svojim herojima, njegov stariji brat, Klad to prezire i želi da preotme ulogu omiljenog sina svoga oca od mlađeg brata. Ali Kladova ljubomora ima užasne posledice -izazivajući pad obe mlade sove sa njihovog doma na vrhu drveta pravo među Čiste. Sada je na Sorenu da izvede smelo bekstvo uz pomoć drugih hrabrih mladih sova. Zajedno, oni kreću na put preko mora i kroz maglu da pronađu Veliko Drvo, dom legendarnih Čuvara GaHula - Sorenovu jedinu nadu da će poraziti Čiste i spasiti kraljevstva sova.

programme.title: The dead do not die / Mrtvi ne umiru
programme.desc: Mirni town Sentervil is fighting with zombie hordes after the dead begin to rise from their graves. The plot arises when the Earth's rotation comes out of its own axis and that is why strange things are going on in nature such as running animals, extending the day and, finally, waking the dead ... / Mirni gradić Sentervil bori se sa zombi hordama nakon što mrtvi počnu da se dižu iz svojih grobova. Zaplet nastaje kada zemljina rotacija izađe iz svoje ose i zbog toga krenu da se dešavaju čudne stvari u prirodi poput bežanja životinja, produžavanja dana i, napokon, buđenja mrtvih…

programme.title: Snezana and hunter / Snežana i lovac
programme.desc: Snezana is a princess and the most beautiful person in the kingdom. After marrying her father, whom he soon kills, evil Queen Raven takes into absolute power over the kingdom and locks our heroine in the tower, is forever distancing it from the world. Ravenna is a witch and must feed the beauties of young girls to stay forever young. Her magical mirror indicates the danger that her young snowman can be and that if she consumes her heart - will remain young forever. Snezana manages to escape from captivity from the young hunter trying to form an army with which he will be able to defeat the evil queen. / Snežana je princeza i najlepša osoba u kraljevstvu. Nakon što se uda za njenog oca, kojeg ubrzo i ubija, zla kraljica Ravena preuzima apsolutnu vlast nad kraljevstvom i zaključava našu junakinju u kulu, zauvek je distancirajući od sveta. Ravena je veštica i mora da se hrani lepotama mladih devojaka kako bi ostala zauvek mlada. Njeno magično ogledalo ukazuje na opasnost koju joj mlada Snežana može biti i da ako konzumira njeno srce - ostaće zauvek mlada. Snežana uspeva da pobegne iz zatočeništva iz uz pomoć mladog lovca pokušava da oformi armiju sa kojom će moći da porazi zlu kraljicu.

programme.title: Everything you want / Sve što poželiš
programme.desc: Nil Clark, teacher, will suddenly discover that he owns magical powers. In fact, one hand movement can make something happen. From that he wiped out the entire disobedient class (and return them and everything who ever died in life) to the conversion of his best other in a man for which women not just sigh, but adore him for the rest of his life. The only problem is to hit the right words and, of course, to know what really wants. Accident accident will finally take him to the final problem from which all men fear and which many have been wrong: whether to choose a girl ... or a dog. / Nil Klark, nastavnik, iznenada će otkriti da poseduje magične moći. Zapravo, jednim pokretom ruke on može da učini da se desi šta god poželi. Od toga da zbriše ceo neposlušni razred (i vrati njih i sve koji su ikad umrli u život) do pretvaranja svog najboljeg druga u muškarca za kojim žene ne samo da uzdišu, već ga obožavaju do kraja života. Jedini problem je da pogodi prave reči i, naravno, da zna šta stvarno želi. Nesreća za nesrećom će ga konačno odvesti do krajnjeg problema od kojeg svi muškarci strahuju i koju su mnogi pogrešno rešili: da li da izabere devojku... ili psa.

programme.title: Bullets resistant / Otporni na metke
programme.desc: Kits and Archi are the best friends and tiny criminals who do in what they do have quite success. Everything will change when they get involved in a large drug smuggling surgery, and it turns out that Kits is actually a policeman. / Kits i Arči su najbolji su prijatelji i sitni kriminalci koji u onome što rade imaju prilično uspeha. Sve će se promeniti kada se budu upleli u veliku operaciju krijumčarenja droge, i ispostavi se da je Kits zapravo policajac.

programme.title: Jumandzi: Welcome to the jungle / Džumandži: Dobro došli u džunglu
programme.desc: Four high school students reveal an old video game that they have never heard before. From that moment, it will be drawn into the fun world of Jungle and become the avatars of your own choice: the Spencer will become a nerd, athletes, the real Einstein will turn into a middle-aged professor, and the fragile marta will become a fearless warrant. However, the party will soon turn into something else, when they find that Jumandians are not played - already survives. To win and return to the real world, they must go to the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discovering what Alan Paris left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or will remain in the game forever. / Četvoro srednjoškolaca otkrivaju staru video igru za koju nikad ranije nisu čuli. Od tog trenutka biće uvučeni u zabavan svet džungle i postati avatari prema sopstvenom izboru: Spenser će tako postati štreberski istraživač, sportista Fridž će postati pravi Ajnštajn, popularna devojka Betani će se pretvoriti u sredovečnog profesora, a krhka Marta postaće neustrašiva ratnica. Međutim, zabava će se uskoro pretvoriti u nešto drugo, kada otkriju da se Džumandži ne igra - već preživljava. Da bi pobedili i vratili se u stvaran svet, moraju da odu u najopasniju avanturu njihovih života, otkriju šta je Alan Pariš ostavio pre 20 godina, i promene način na koji razmišljaju o sebi - ili će zauvek ostati u igrici.

programme.title: Being of blood / Biće krvi
programme.desc: Daniel persistently looking for oil and continues to buy a country in cheap that has such potential. When he gets information about the important site on the possession of the Sandej family, Daniel goes to the registration negotiations. He manages to redeem the Earth, but in turn, he will have to ensure a great donation to a young elije, who wants to become the main preacher of the area. / Danijel uporno traži naftu i nastavlja da jeftino kupuje zemlju koja ima takvog potencijala. Kada dobije informaciju o važnom nalazištu na posedu porodice Sandej, Danijel odlazi na pregovore o otkupu. On uspeva da otkupi zemlju, ali će zauzvrat morati da osigurati veliku donaciju mladom Eliju, koji želi postati glavni propovednik oblasti.

programme.title: Application / Aplikacija
programme.desc: The life of one of the world's most famous hackers is in danger after developing an application that can hack any social networking order and get any information using only the phone number. / Život jednog od najpoznatijih svetskih hakera je u opasnosti nakon što je razvio aplikaciju koja može da hakuje bilo koji nalog na društvenim mrežama i dobije bilo koje informacije koristeći samo broj telefona.

programme.title: Hostel 2 / Hostel 2
programme.desc: In the production of Quentina Tarantina and directed by Elija Rota, Hostel 2 is a shocking and frightening of the underground organization where the rich people pay and kill the innocent victims. Girls accept and come to Slovakia where they are placed in a fatal hostel. It will soon become innocent victims put on auction. / U produkciji Kventina Tarantina i režiji Elija Rota,Hostel 2 je šokantan i zastrašujući nastavak o podzemnoj organizacije gde bogataši plaćaju da bi mučili i ubijali nevine žrtve.Tri mlade Amerikanke koje studiraju u Rimu, bivaju pozvane na egzotičan vikend-odmor sa ciljem uživanja. Devojke prihvataju i dolaze u Slovačku gde se smeštaju u kobni Hostel. Uskoro će postati nevine žrtve stavljene na aukciju.

programme.title: The path to the center of the earth / Put u središte zemlje
programme.desc: During the scientific expedition in Iceland, the scientist and visionary Trevor Anderson, his Bratan Sean and their Guide Hannah, remain trapped in the cave from which the only way out leads even and deeper into the depths of the earth. Traveling throughout unprecedented worlds, they face supernatural and unimaginable creatures - including plants of cannibals, giant flying piran, birds that bright and terrifying dinosaurs from ancient times. Adventurists soon notice that volcanic activity is growing around them and conclude that they have to find the way to the Earth before it becomes too late. / Tokom naučne ekspedicije na Islandu, naučnik i vizionar Trevor Anderson, njegov bratanac Šon i njihov vodič Hana, neočekivano ostaju zarobljeni u pećini iz koje jedini izlaz vodi sve dublje i dublje u dubine Zemlje. Putujući kroz do sada neviđene svetove, oni se suočavaju sa natprirodnim i nezamislivim stvorenjima — uključujući biljke ljudožderke, džinvosku leteću piranu, ptice koje svetle i užasavajuće dinosauruse iz davnih vremena. Avanturisti uskoro primećuju da vulkanska aktivnost raste oko njih i zaključuju da moraju da nađu put do zemljine površine pre nego postane prekasno.

programme.title: Who survives talking / Ko preživi pričaće
programme.desc: The action of this hilarious comedy takes place in 1882. in Arizona, Albert, a farmer without self-confidence, loses his beloved girl withdrawing from the duel. He soon lucky to the enchanting Anna, so he reveals his courage and full potential when Anna's husband, a famous criminal, announce his arrival. / Radnja ove urnebesne komedije odvija se 1882. godine u Arizoni, Albert, farmer bez samopouzdanja, gubi svoju voljenu devojku povlačenjem iz dvoboja. Ubrzo sreće zanosnu Anu, pa otkriva svoju hrabrost i puni potencijal kada Anin muž, poznati kriminalac, najavi svoj dolazak.

programme.title: Pentecost executives / Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: When ghosts start obsessing New York, the four scientists first understand what is happening. To try to stop them, they create special weapons and form a unit that will fight ghosts. / Kada duhovi počnu opsedati Njujork, četiri naučnice prve shvate šta se događa. Kako bi ih pokušale zaustaviti, one kreiraju posebna oružja i oformljuju jedinicu koja će se boriti protiv duhova.

programme.desc: We broadcast a special emission on the courier television by the Storm - a crime without penalties, on the occasion of marking the anniversary of tragic events in Croatia. The Serbian people remembers exiled and killed in a storm, the operation of the Croatian Army and the police during which about 2,000 Serbs were killed or disappeared, and more than 220,000 expelled from Croatia. 30 years ago in just 48 hours, the area of the former Republika Srpska Krajina was ethnically clean. Voditeljka Jelena Pejović i pažljivo birani, kompetentni gosti, komentarisaće ovu temu. Ove godine navršava se tri decenije od tragičnih događaja u Hrvatskoj, kada je stradao srpski narod. Srpski narod seća se prognanih i ubijenih u Oluji, operaciji hrvatske vojske i policije tokom koje je oko 2.000 Srba ubijeno ili nestalo, a više od 220.000 proterano iz Hrvatske. Pre 30 godina za samo 48 sati područje nekadašnje Republike Srpske Krajine bilo je etnički čisto. Porodice žrtava još uvek traže pravdu.

programme.title: Indie Intro / Indie Intro
programme.desc: Beneath the sweet cream of AAA games, giant marketing budgets and titles for which your parents heard, and maybe play them, the right sea of creativity, originality and pure spirit of video. Yes, we're talking about the Indie scene! In the basements of independent developers, furtive offices of talented freesters, hundreds of new games are emerging every day, many of which have unseen solutions and ideas that are so very crazy and completely ingenious. If you are afraid you will get lost in that sea of unknown titles, don't worry, we're here, in our gaming chambers, to serve the best catch. As true filmophiles run away from blockbusters, and music lovers are cloven to the youtube trending, so, real gaming gaming know where the best gaming specialties are. Check them out and report impressions! / Ispod slatkastog krema AAA igara, gigantskih marketinških budžeta i naslova za koje su i tvoji roditelji čuli, a možda ih i zaigrali, skriva se pravo more kreativnosti, originalnosti i čistog duha video-igara. Da, govorimo o indie sceni! U podrumima nezavisnih developera, zagušljivim kancelarijama malenih studija i živahnim timovima talentovanih slobodnih strijelaca, svakog dana nastaju stotine novih igara, od kojih mnoge imaju mind-blowing koncepte, dosad neviđena rješenja i ideje toliko uvrnute da su na granici između jednostavno ludog i potpuno genijalnog. Ako se bojiš da ćeš se izgubiti u tom moru nepoznatih naslova, ne brini, ovdje smo, u svojim gejmerskim odajama, da serviramo najbolji ulov. Kao što istinski filmofili bježe od blockbustera, a ljubitelji muzike se klone YouTube trendinga, tako i pravi gejming sladokusci znaju gdje su najbolji gejming specijaliteti. Čekiraj ih i javi utiske!

programme.desc: On the island of Providence, Black Cancer starts the mission of your life, following 80,000 eggs from their home for walking to the shore. programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: South African Drakensberg is one of the most impressive landscapes on the continent. It is home to sharp climate and environmental changes because physical conditions are also changing for creatures on the mainland and for predators that swirl in the sky above. / Južnoafrički Drakensberg je jedan od najimpresivnijih pejzaža na kontinentu. To je dom oštrih klimatskih i ekoloških promena jer se fizički uslovi menjaju i za stvorenja na kopnu i za grabljivice koji se kovitlaju na nebu iznad.

programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: In North Tanzania, high mountains are accompanied by a dramatic valley. Enriched with ancient volcanoes, its slopes provide a variety of habitats for lushing to life, and a large central part retains water even in the smallest times. / U severnoj Tanzaniji, visoke planine prate dramatičnu dolinu. Obogaćene drevnim vulkanima, njene padine pružaju raznovrsna staništa za bujanje života, a veliki središnji deo zadržava vodu čak i u najsušnija vremena.

programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: Simien National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on Earth. Take a look at life on some of the highest peaks of Africa, in the last stronghold of shaped gelads that dogs grass, elusive Ethiopian wolves and iboro. / Nacionalni park Simien u Etiopiji dom je nekih od najređih stvorenja na zemlji. Bacite pogled na život na nekim od najviših vrhova Afrike, u poslednjem uporištu čupavih gelada koje pasu travu, neuhvatljivih etiopskih vukova i kozoroga.

programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: This is a journey into the thickest and most extreme parts in the farthest ends of South Africa. Let's go to spectacular, but the insidious places where it rain is almost not falling, to find an incredibly resistant creature and learn the secrets of their survival. / Ovo je putovanje u najsušnije i najekstremnije delove u najudaljenijim krajevima južne Afrike. Idemo na spektakularna, ali podmukla mesta gde kiša gotovo da ne pada, da pronađemo neverovatno otporna stvorenja i naučimo tajne njihovog opstanka.

programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: Etoš used to be a great lake that dried up and now it is full of water only during the summer rain. When filled with water, countless birds are collected in the shallow lake to reproduce, primarily flame and dwarf flamingos. / Etoša je nekada bila veliko jezero koje je presušilo i sada se puni vodom samo tokom letnjih kiša. Kada se napuni vodom, bezbroj ptica vodarica se okuplja u plitkom jezeru da radi razmnožavanja, pre svega plamenac i patuljasti flamingosi.

programme.title: Extreme Africa / Ekstremna Afrika
programme.desc: Follow the flow of the river Oranje in South Africa from the source to the place where it pours into the Atlantic Ocean. On the road we encounter a variety of habitats and creatures, from dry countries Rihtersveld to the beauty of Augrabies; This is the story of the Linear Oasis. / Pratite tok reke Oranje u Južnoj Africi od izvora do mesta gde se izliva u Atlantski okean. Na putu nailazimo na raznoliku lepezu staništa i stvorenja, od suvih zemalja Rihtersvelda do lepote Augrabiesa; ovo je priča o Linearnoj oazi.

programme.title: From dawn to dusk / Od svitanja do sumraka
programme.desc: See how the tragedy of one family of the animal is the Holiday dinner while New Zealand and island creatures, including penguins, birds of non-tabby, seals and sharks, fighting and protecting their youth in this marine environment. / Pogledajte kako je tragedija jedne porodice životinja praznična večera za drugu dok se novozelandska i ostrvska stvorenja, uključujući pingvine, ptice neletačice, foke i ajkule, bore da nahrane i zaštite svoje mlade u ovom morskom okruženju.

programme.title: From dawn to dusk / Od svitanja do sumraka
programme.desc: Find out which creatures will survive and whose happiness will run until the mothers of animals and future moms fight hot temperatures, lurking predators, mating season and dry season for which it has been shown to be easy. / Saznajte koja bića će preživeti i čija će sreća ponestati dok se majke životinja i buduće mame bore sa vrućim temperaturama, vrebajućim grabežljivcima, sezonom parenja i sušom na dan za koji se pokazalo da nije lak.

programme.title: From dawn to dusk / Od svitanja do sumraka
programme.desc: Wire a sunny tropical September day with creatures from Polynesia to the Indonesian archipelago. programme.title: From dawn to dusk / Od svitanja do sumraka
programme.desc: Celebrate the first day of spring with Australian creatures looking for a dinner or meeting. programme.title: From dawn to dusk / Od svitanja do sumraka
programme.desc: Get to know unique receipts and reptiles looking for water and avoid predators, from the rinorapih lemurs in the rainforests of the east coast to the tiny brown chameleon, in this country of extreme climatic variations and habitats. / Upoznajte jedinstvene primate i gmizavce koji traže vodu i izbegavaju predatore, od prstenorepih lemura u kišnim šumama istočne obale do sićušnih braon kameleona, u ovoj zemlji ekstremnih klimatskih varijacija i staništa.

programme.title: The streets of the puzzle / Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Strange things happen in London. Only one animal is capable of confronting these enigms bordering with supernatural: hamster detective named Klever. It is endowed with an extraordinary sense of observation and logical conclusion that leave ordinary animals without words. But sometimes things don't go according to plan ... then he can count on his temperamental little brother Bro, who is always ready to take the risk and attack opponents much greater than himself. Will they manage to solve these cases that continue to confuse Scotland Jard? / Čudne stvari se dešavaju u Londonu. Samo jedna životinja je sposobna da se suoči s tim enigmama koje se graniče sa natprirodnim: hrčak detektivka po imenu Klever. Ona je obdarena izvanrednim smislom za posmatranje i logičko zaključivanje koji ostavljaju obične životinje bez reči. Ali ponekad stvari ne idu po planu... Tada može da računa na svog temperamentnog malog brata Broa, koji je uvek spreman da preuzme rizik i napadne protivnike mnogo veće od sebe. Da li će uspeti da reše ove slučajeve koji i dalje zbunjuju Skotland Jard?

programme.title: Chatty cat Tom and friends / Brbljivi Mačak Tom i Prijatelji
programme.desc: There are big changes in the lives of Tom and Angel when they finally decide to be together! But will Romans spoil everything and his friends? Even if that doesn't happen, they seem to be certainly in trouble, because the director decided to have a lot of their startup in his garage ... and now he intended to destroy them! The risk is getting greater, and the action is all tense as Tom goes to town to save their company and keep their friends. / Dolaze velike promene u živote Toma i Anđele kada napokon odluče da budu zajedno! programme.title: Sisters / Sestre
programme.desc: Two sisters. Two explosive personalities. Under one roof. The sister's comedy about the daily life of two sisters, one of which has 7 and the second 13 years. Marin is still a child, while her older sister Vendi enters the teenage years. Both are temperamental, very different personalities and adore! Marin is naive, cute, very hyperactive and very attack. She always thinks crazy ideas to attract their sister's attention, while the Vendi is more difficult to live an adult. This comedy of the character is about the brotherhood / nursing. / Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

Marin is still a child, while her older sister Vendi enters the teenage years. Both are temperamental, very different personalities and adore! Marin is naive, cute, very hyperactive and very attack. She always thinks crazy ideas to attract their sister's attention, while the Vendi is more difficult to live an adult. This comedy of the character is about the brotherhood / nursing. / Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Jeronim Stilton / Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Jaronimo is Mr. Mouse, who, in addition to loving his job and his family, adores collecting old cheese crust from the eighteenth century. He hates traveling because every trip, whether by boat, car or plane, causes nausea ... But, no matter what, the family draws it into the most ardent adventure everywhere in the world. / Džeronimo je gospodin miš koji, pored toga što voli svoj posao i svoju porodicu, obožava da skuplja korice starog sira iz osamnaestog veka. Mrzi da putuje jer mu svako putovanje, bilo brodom, kolima ili avionom, izaziva mučninu... Ali ga, bez obzira na to, porodica uvlači u najneverovatnije pustolovine svuda po svetu.

programme.title: Idefix and non -toxives / Idefiks i Neukrotivi
programme.desc: The year is 52. BC. As we already know, the whole lutetie is under Roman rule ... or not exactly the whole. Given that everyday life is disturbed by the decisions of the new Roman Prefect in the city of Light, the group of disobedicated four-legged gala, led by Garoviks, opposes the winners of Roman dogs whose leader is terrible Gothic Arkebuz. / Godina je 52. pre nove ere. Kao što već znamo, cela Lutecija je pod rimskom vlašću... ili pak ne baš cela. S obzirom na to da je svakodnevni život poremećen odlukama novog rimskog prefekta u Gradu svetlosti, grupa nepokorivih četvoronožnih Gala, koje predvodi Garoviks, suprotstavlja se osvajačima i čoporima rimskih pasa čiji je vođa strašni Gotski Arkebuza.

programme.title: Zoro / Zoro
programme.desc: Our new series represents a teenager Don Dieg, who faces the greatest life challenge fighting for justice against numerous ruthless Tirana! Thus, the most famous masked hero is born. Zoro simply makes fun of their opponents by learning them to the lesson and sign their works by the trademark Z! / Naša nova serija predstavlja tinejdžera Don Dijega, koji se suočava sa najvećim životnim izazovom boreći se za pravdu protiv brojnih bezobzirnih tirana! Tako se rađa najpoznatiji maskirani heroj. Zoro jednostavno ismeva svoje protivnike učeći ih lekciji i potpisuje svoja dela zaštitnim znakom Z!

programme.title: The streets of the puzzle / Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Strange things happen in London. Only one animal is capable of confronting these enigms bordering with supernatural: hamster detective named Klever. It is endowed with an extraordinary sense of observation and logical conclusion that leave ordinary animals without words. But sometimes things don't go according to plan ... then he can count on his temperamental little brother Bro, who is always ready to take the risk and attack opponents much greater than himself. Will they manage to solve these cases that continue to confuse Scotland Jard? / Čudne stvari se dešavaju u Londonu. Samo jedna životinja je sposobna da se suoči s tim enigmama koje se graniče sa natprirodnim: hrčak detektivka po imenu Klever. Ona je obdarena izvanrednim smislom za posmatranje i logičko zaključivanje koji ostavljaju obične životinje bez reči. Ali ponekad stvari ne idu po planu... Tada može da računa na svog temperamentnog malog brata Broa, koji je uvek spreman da preuzme rizik i napadne protivnike mnogo veće od sebe. Da li će uspeti da reše ove slučajeve koji i dalje zbunjuju Skotland Jard?

programme.title: Barba and three musketeers / Barbi i tri musketara
programme.desc: This is a story about Corin. Korinn is a brave girl whose dream is to become a Musketar of the Car's Chamber of France, just as her father: Large Musketar Dartanjan. Although her mother is not sure that this is the right path, it supports the Corinine to go on the trip to Paris and happy only person who could fulfill her dream of becoming a musketar: Mr. Travila. / Ovo je priča o Korin. Korin je hrabra devojka čiji je san da postane musketar carskog doma Francuske, baš kao što je to bio njen otac: veliki musketar DArtanjan. Iako njena majka nije sigurna da je to pravi put, ona podržava Korin da krene na put u Pariz i sretne jedinu osobu koja bi joj mogla ispuniti san da postane musketar: g. Trevila.

programme.title: Barbi: It takes two! / Barbi: Potrebno Je Dvoje!
programme.desc: The series monitors a period of one year in Kom Barbie and Barbie attend the secondary school in New York School, start filming a music demo and accept small business to finance the path to the realization of their dreams. They spend all that time by exploring a big apple and often travel to Malibu visiting family and friends. This series that abounds in the story of friendship, family, passion and perseverance monitors this cult duo that works hard and entertained in search of their dreams. / Serija prati period od godinu dana u kom Barbi i Barbi pohađaju srednju školu scenskih umetnosti u Njujorku, započinju sa snimanjem muzičkog demo snimka i prihvataju sitne poslove kako bi finansirale put ka ostvarenju svojih snova. Sve to vreme one provode tako što istražuju Veliku jabuku i često putuju u Malibu u posetu porodici i prijateljima. Ova serija koja obiluje pričama o prijateljstvu, porodici, strasti i istrajnosti prati ovaj kultni duo koji naporno radi i zabavlja se u potrazi za svojim snovima.

programme.title: Barbi - a touch of magic / Barbi - Dodir Čarolije
programme.desc: Barbie and Barbie finds mysteriously foals on the beach in Malibu and soon realize that a small horse is actually a baby speckle! The common forces try to return a small peggy home, protecting it from Roki, fantastic glyph. programme.title: Pets Klub / Pets klub
programme.desc: Nina was founded by the Pets Club with Oscar, Team and the dog Marlu. This secret club asked himself the task of finding all the lost animals: furry, crumbs, even those who just sniffle and sneak around, and return them to their neouthest young owners. But our four young heroes are methodical in their investigations and together have skills to always find that lost pet. / Nina je osnovala Pets klub sa Oskarom, Timom i psom Marluom. Ovaj tajni klub postavio je sebi zadatak da nađe sve izgubljene životinje: krznene, čupave, čak i one koje samo njuškaju i šunjaju se okolo, i vrati ih njihovim neutešnim mladim vlasnicima. Naši mladi heroji moraju da žongliraju školskim životom, vannastavnim aktivnostima (onim koje roditelji smatraju vrlo zabavnim, poput časova klavira i baleta) i vođenjem istrage Pets kluba. Sigurno shvatate da postati stručnjak za nešto kada imate samo sedam ili osam godina nije najlakša stvar na svetu. Ali naša četiri mlada heroja su metodična u svojim istragama i zajedno imaju veštine da uvek nađu tog izgubljenog ljubimca.

Given that everyday life is disturbed by the decisions of the new Roman Prefect in the city of Light, the group of disobedicated four-legged gala, led by Garoviks, opposes the winners of Roman dogs whose leader is terrible Gothic Arkebuz. / Godina je 52. pre nove ere. programme.title: The streets of the puzzle / Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Strange things happen in London. Only one animal is capable of confronting these enigms bordering with supernatural: hamster detective named Klever. It is endowed with an extraordinary sense of observation and logical conclusion that leave ordinary animals without words. But sometimes things don't go according to plan ... then he can count on his temperamental little brother Bro, who is always ready to take the risk and attack opponents much greater than himself. Will they manage to solve these cases that continue to confuse Scotland Jard? / Čudne stvari se dešavaju u Londonu. Samo jedna životinja je sposobna da se suoči s tim enigmama koje se graniče sa natprirodnim: hrčak detektivka po imenu Klever. Ona je obdarena izvanrednim smislom za posmatranje i logičko zaključivanje koji ostavljaju obične životinje bez reči. Ali ponekad stvari ne idu po planu... Tada može da računa na svog temperamentnog malog brata Broa, koji je uvek spreman da preuzme rizik i napadne protivnike mnogo veće od sebe. Da li će uspeti da reše ove slučajeve koji i dalje zbunjuju Skotland Jard?

programme.title: Chatty cat Tom and friends / Brbljivi Mačak Tom i Prijatelji
programme.desc: There are big changes in the lives of Tom and Angel when they finally decide to be together! But will Romans spoil everything and his friends? Even if that doesn't happen, they seem to be certainly in trouble, because the director decided to have a lot of their startup in his garage ... and now he intended to destroy them! The risk is getting greater, and the action is all tense as Tom goes to town to save their company and keep their friends. / Dolaze velike promene u živote Toma i Anđele kada napokon odluče da budu zajedno! Ali da li će romansa sve pokvariti Tomu i njegovim prijateljima? Čak i ako se to ne desi, oni su izgleda svakako u nevolji, jer je direktor odlučio da mu je dosta njihovog startapa u garaži... I sad se namerio da ih uništi! Rizik postaje sve veći, a akcija sve napetija dok Tom odlazi u grad da spase svoju kompaniju i zadrži svoje prijatelje.

programme.title: Women and magic / Žene i magija
programme.desc: Women and magic emphasizes the power, wisdom and mystery of women who deal with various forms of magic and explores the rich and fascinating past that shaped our modern understandings. Through intriguing stories, historical events and mystical traditions, this show discovery the mysterious world of magic, propagation and spirituality that women skillfully shaped throughout the ages. Each episode will focus on various aspects of magic and women, and the viewers will be enchanted while witnessing incredible women wizard and Šamanka who bravely fought against stereotypes and prejudices to express their skills and wisdom. The show will explore the key moments in the history of magic, such as witches in Europe, mysterious cults in ancient civilizations, and the association of women with nature and universal energy. We will also reveal some lesser known chapters of history, such as the role of women in the spiritual heritage of the people in Asia, Africa and other parts of the world. / Žene i magija naglašava moć, mudrost i tajanstvenost žena koje su se bavile raznim oblicima magije i istražuje bogatu i fascinantnu prošlost koja je oblikovala naša moderna shvatanja. Kroz intrigantne priče, istorijske događaje i mistične tradicije, ova emisija otkriće tajanstveni svijet čarolija, proricanja i duhovnosti koje su žene vješto oblikovale kroz vijekove. Svaka epizoda fokusiraće se na različite aspekte magije i žena u različitim vremenskim razdobljima i kulturama, a gledaoci će biti očarani dok svjedoče o životu nevjerovatnih žena čarobnica, vidovnjakinja, vračeva i šamanki koje su se hrabro borile protiv stereotipa i predrasuda kako bi iskazale svoje vještine i mudrost. Emisija će istražiti ključne trenutke u istoriji magije, poput vremena vještica u Evropi, tajanstvenih kultova u drevnim civilizacijama, i povezanosti žena s prirodom i univerzalnim energijama. Otkrivaćemo i neka manje poznata poglavlja istorije, poput uloge žena u duhovnom naslijeđu naroda u Aziji, Africi i drugim dijelovima svijeta.

programme.title: To small pores / Do sitnih pora
programme.desc: The tiny pores is an educational TV show that provides useful health tips, wellness and everyday life habits. Every week, Dr. Vanja Banićević presents advice on topics concerning physical and mental health. From proper nutrition and physical activities to stress and emotional health management, the show offers concrete, easily applicable information for better quality of life. The tone of the show is friendly, educational and inspiring, and the target audience are women but also everyone who wants to improve their health and good condition. / Do sitnih pora je edukativna TV emisija koja pruža korisne savete o zdravlju, wellnessu i svakodnevnim životnim navikama. Svake nedelje, doktorica Vanja Banićević iznosi savete o temama koje se tiču fizičkog i mentalnog zdravlja. Od pravilne ishrane i fizičkih aktivnosti do upravljanja stresom i emocionalnog zdravlja, emisija nudi konkretne, lako primenljive informacije za bolji kvalitet života. Ton emisije je prijateljski, edukativan i inspirativan, a ciljana publika su žene ali i svi drugi koje žele da unaprede svoje zdravlje i dobro stanje.

programme.title: Women and magic / Žene i magija
programme.desc: Women and magic emphasizes the power, wisdom and mystery of women who deal with various forms of magic and explores the rich and fascinating past that shaped our modern understandings. Through intriguing stories, historical events and mystical traditions, this show discovery the mysterious world of magic, propagation and spirituality that women skillfully shaped throughout the ages. Each episode will focus on various aspects of magic and women, and the viewers will be enchanted while witnessing incredible women wizard and Šamanka who bravely fought against stereotypes and prejudices to express their skills and wisdom. The show will explore the key moments in the history of magic, such as witches in Europe, mysterious cults in ancient civilizations, and the association of women with nature and universal energy. We will also reveal some lesser known chapters of history, such as the role of women in the spiritual heritage of the people in Asia, Africa and other parts of the world. / Žene i magija naglašava moć, mudrost i tajanstvenost žena koje su se bavile raznim oblicima magije i istražuje bogatu i fascinantnu prošlost koja je oblikovala naša moderna shvatanja. Kroz intrigantne priče, istorijske događaje i mistične tradicije, ova emisija otkriće tajanstveni svijet čarolija, proricanja i duhovnosti koje su žene vješto oblikovale kroz vijekove. Svaka epizoda fokusiraće se na različite aspekte magije i žena u različitim vremenskim razdobljima i kulturama, a gledaoci će biti očarani dok svjedoče o životu nevjerovatnih žena čarobnica, vidovnjakinja, vračeva i šamanki koje su se hrabro borile protiv stereotipa i predrasuda kako bi iskazale svoje vještine i mudrost. Emisija će istražiti ključne trenutke u istoriji magije, poput vremena vještica u Evropi, tajanstvenih kultova u drevnim civilizacijama, i povezanosti žena s prirodom i univerzalnim energijama. Otkrivaćemo i neka manje poznata poglavlja istorije, poput uloge žena u duhovnom naslijeđu naroda u Aziji, Africi i drugim dijelovima svijeta.

programme.title: Better country / Bolja zemlja
programme.desc: The better country brings together all farmers from the region, primarily the Balkan countries. A group of modern agriculture, food, rural life and a specific way of life in a village that implies primarily, mind, pride, dignity, because this country must be better. / Bolja zemlja okuplja sve poljoprivrednike iz regiona, pre svega Balkanskih zemalja. Grupa o modernoj poljoprivredi, hrani, seoskom životu i specifičnom načinu života na selu koji podrazumeva pre svega, pamet, ponos, dostojanstvo, jer ova zemlja mora biti bolja.

programme.title: Matchmaker / Provodadžija
programme.desc: Everyone is a well-known story of our old ones that it used to be unimaginable that two young people be introduced without the help of intermediaries, in the people known as the conductor. The lonely guys cheese in Serbia will find the soul mate, and protects the family, with great success helps the emission of conductors. In the role of real events that include girls and guys are charming headers that, using their methods, games and tests, help guys to get to know the girls better and thus make the right, life choice. The show abounds in laughter and good mood, and what is most important, helping young people realize their wishes and direct them towards the desired goal, and that is successful love. / Svima je već dobro poznata priča naših starih da je nekada bilo nezamisljivo da se dvoje mladih upozna bez pomoći posrednika, u narodu poznatijeg kao provodadžije. Usamljeni momci sirom Srbije u želji da pronađu srodnu dušu, i zasnuju porodicu, sa velikim uspehom pomaže emisija Provodadžija. U ulozi pravih provodadžija koje spadaju devojke i momke nalaze se šarmantne voditeljke koje, koristeći svoje metode, igrice i testove, pomažu momcima da što bolje upoznaju devojke i tako naprave onaj pravi, životni izbor. Emisija obiluje smehom i dobrim raspoloženjem, a ono što je najbitnije, pomaže mladim ljudima da ostvare svoje želje i usmere ih ka željenom cilju, a to je uspešna ljubav.

programme.title: Prelo in our Sokak / Prelo u našem sokaku
programme.desc: The show is nurturing the long-term tradition of the Serbian people, aims to preserve the cultural and national values of our people from oblivion. In the show: the presidents of municipalities, representatives of tourist organizations, chefs, craftsmen, affirmed singers, as well as cultural and artistic societies. / Emisija neguje dugovekovnu tradiciju srpskog naroda, ima za cilj da kulturne i nacionalne vrednosti našeg naroda sačuva od zaborava. U emisiji gostuju: predsednici opština, predstavnici turističkih organizacija, kuvari, zanatlije, afirmisani pevači, kao i kulturno-umetnička društva.

programme.title: Hair and water carry / Kose i vodu nose
programme.desc: To put up to the knowledge, which are masculine, and which women's jobs were used - it is used to be used to carry out, and who carries water! But great women appeared! In the emission of hair and water, the main heroins are women who break stereotypes division into male and female jobs, occupations or hobbies. The viewers will be able to see emotional and true stories of ordinary, but also brave, persistent and valuable women from all over Serbia, their approach and attitude towards life. Through this series, the most beautiful stories of ladies will be told in our neighborhood, and we do not see them in the media. From this show, it will change. / Da bi se stavilo do znanja, koji su muški, a koji ženski poslove, korišćena je krilatica - zna se ko kosi, a ko vodu nosi! Ali, pojavile su se i super žene! U emisiji Kose i vodu nose, glavne junakinje su žene koje razbijaju stereotipe podele na muške i ženske poslove, zanimanja ili hobije. Gledaoci će moći da vide emotivne i istinite priče običnih, ali I hrabrih, upornih i vrednih žena iz cele Srbije, njihov pristup i odnos prema životu. Kroz ovaj serijal biće ispričane najlepše priče o damama koje su tu u našem komšiluku, a ne vidjamo ih u medijima. Od ove emisije, to će se promeniti.

programme.title: Easy hunting / Laka lova
programme.desc: In this show, the leader will show us from personal experience as it seems to make money today by performing different jobs. / U ovoj emisiji voditeljka će nam, iz ličnog iskustva prikazati kako to danas izgleda zaraditi novac obavljajući različite poslove.

programme.title: Sabotage / Sabotaža
programme.desc: Finally, live, rivalry of men and women in a television show! And, while one wolf theory that men are more important and more capable, others sharpen the opinion that members of the more beautiful half are more severely, more suitable and always step in front of strong partners! New, incredibly interesting sabotage emissions, in which angel Lakicevic and Marko will come to each other to come to the same task, to many of them will make tears on their eyes. And, not only that, but will regularly monitor the adventures of the specially selected leader. / Konačno, uživo, rivalstvo muškaraca i žena u jednoj televizijskoj emisiji! I, dok jedni vuku teoriju da su muškarci bitniji i sposobniji, drugi oštro brane mišljenje da su pripadnice lepšeg pola spretnije, dosetljivije i uvek korak ispred jačih partnera! Nova, neverovatno zanimljiva emisija Sabotaža, u kojoj će Anđela Lakićević i Marko Dolaš, pokušati jedno drugom da doskoče na istom zadatku, mnogima će naterati suze na oči. programme.title: 100 questions / 100 pitanja
programme.desc: The world TV format in the director of the Head of Ivana Savić. Never vision emissions in this area. Or it is enough to say only - 100 questions. Ivana Savić does not only peep in homes of famous and influential people, who are present every day in our lives, but also in their brilliant and unfiltered thoughts. Fast and apparently ordinary questions, which were recorded in a single movement without shutting down the camera and pre-planned answers, the viewers will definitely see something completely different. Some answers will make you sad, many laugh, and there are those, as inspiration to remind some more beautiful times for us, and and to forget for a moment everything we fight with right now. Apart from the visit of the interlocutor in their homes, the team of emissions 100 questions will host the interlocutors in their unusual study, in which all issues will be circulated. / Svetski TV format u režiji voditeljke Ivane Savić. Nikada viđenjeno emisija na ovim prostorima. Ili je dovoljno reći samo - 100 pitanja. Ivana Savić ne zaviruje samo u domove poznatih i uticajnih ljudi, koji su svakodnevno prisutni u našim životima, već i u njihove brilijantne i nefiltrirane misli. programme.title: Behind the lock / Iza brave
programme.desc: Everything we looked at in the movies, about how individuals pass behind bars, after the series behind the lock, a shave in the water! The cruel confessions, which have so far did not see the light of the day, nor did anyone bay about talking about, we will look at Hepi television. - Those stories, which we will listen to the way in which the prisoners say, as well as describing the event, will launch the avalanche behind the brave. - When they found themselves behind the bars, the prisoners are in a completely parallel world from the one in which they had lived. It is then moving for many real hell, torture, for some education for serious crimes. No matter how hard the guards and administrations try to prevent illicit things, it simply - not possible. This is a show on all events, about which decades were silent. / Sve što smo gledali u filmovima, o tome kako pojedinci prolaze iza rešetaka, posle serijala Iza brave, pašće u vodu! Surove ispovesti, koje do sada nisu ugledale svetlost dana, niti je iko smeo o tome da priča, gledaćemo na Hepi televiziji. - Te priče, koje ćemo slušati i način na koji robijaši izgovaraju, kao i opisivanje događaja, sasvim je sigurno, pokrenuće lavinu novih pitanja - rekli su u timu, koji se bavi pripremom emisije Iza brave.- Onog trenutka, kad se nađu iza rešetaka, zatvorenici se nađu u potpuno paralelnom svetu od onog u kojem su do juče živeli. Tad kreće za mnoge pravi pakao, mučilište, za neke edukacija za teška krivična dela. Ma koliko se trudili stražari i uprava da spreče nedozvoljene stvari, to jednostavno - nije moguće. Ovo je emisija o svim događajima, o kojima se decenijama ćutalo.

programme.title: SP in water sports: swimming: finals, eighth day / SP u vodenim sportovima: Plivanje: finale, osmi dan
programme.desc: FINA or INTERNATIONAL PLIVAČKA ORGANIZENA SIEVE AGREEMENTS Water sports championships, at the same time, the first competition was held in Yugoslavia in Belgrade. The competitions were held in the period from 1978 - 1998. year every four years, while since 2001. they were held every two odd years so that the terms did not match the Olympics. Great interest in this championship arises from a large number of swimming disciplines and competitions that are held. The program is swimming, diving, deep diving, outdoor swimming, synchronized swimming and water polo. / FINA ili Međunarodna plivačka organizacija od 1973. godine organizuje Svjetska prvenstva u vodenim sportovima, ujedno prvo takmičenje se održalo te godine u Jugoslaviji u Beogradu. Takmičenja su se u periodu od 1978 - 1998. godine održavala svake četvrte godine, dok od 2001. godine se održavaju svake dvije neparne godine kako se ne bi termini poklapali sa olimpijskim igrama. Velika zainteresovanost za ovo prvenstvo proizlazi iz velikog broja plivačkih disciplina i takmičenja koje se održavaju. Na programu su plivanje, ronjenje, duboko ronjenje, plivanje na otvorenom, sinhronizovano plivanje i vaterpolo.

programme.desc: Marital pair of artists from Belgrade, decides to move into a small place on the banks of the Danube, looking for peace and art inspiration. However, the entanglements of this comic series are just related to very alive and active everyday life of the two and their new neighbors. / Bračni par umjetnika iz Beograda, odlučuje da se preseli u malo mjesto na obali Dunava, u potrazi za mirom i umjetničkom inspiracijom. Međutim, zapleti ove komične serije upravo su vezani za veoma živu i aktivnu svakodnevnicu njih dvoje i njihovih novih komšija.

programme.title: Football - 1. Cfl: First round: Sutjeska - Sailor / Fudbal - 1. CFL: Prvo kolo: Sutjeska - Mornar
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: The world's largest mysteries / Najveće svjetske misterije
programme.desc: We explore some of the largest historical mystery that hide behind famous people and events from closer and further past. We finally discover all about personalities and developments that are wrapped in a veil secret. / Istražujemo neke od najvećih istorijskih misterija koje se kriju iza poznatih osoba i događaja iz bliže i dalje prošlosti. Konačno otkrivamo sve o ličnostima i dešavanjima koji su obavijeni velom tajne.

programme.title: Nisi together / Nisi sama
programme.desc: The podcast in which we discuss numerous current and important topics. Guests of the podcast will be relevant guests who will talk about the position of women in modern society. / Podkast u kome razgovaramo o brojnim aktuelnim i važnim temama. Gosti podkasta biće relevantni gosti koji će govoriti o položaju žena u modernom društvu.

programme.title: What happens when love is born / Šta se zgodi kad se ljubav rodi
programme.desc: Years are fasting, and in human nature is that a lot is forgotten. So Bob and Mary forgot about their crazy years. It should go through all the peripeties of the first to fall in love. Crazy years catch their beloved child ... and the story is repeated. / Godine brzo prolaze, a u ljudskoj prirodi je da se mnogo toga zaboravi. Tako su Boba i Marija zaboravili kako su izgledale njihove lude godine. Treba ponovo proći kroz sve peripetije prvog zaljubljivanja. Lude godine hvataju njihovo ljubljeno dete... i priča se ponavlja.

programme.title: Honeymoon / Medeni mesec
programme.desc: The shop film takes place in Serbia, Albania, Italy and Hungary. The film follows two young couples who want to leave all their country and look for a better life in Western Europe. When the young Albanian couple then a lot of peripetia arrives in the Italian port of Bar, unpredictable problems arise. Something similar is happening with the Serbian couple when they arrive at the Hungarian border. Although they have nothing to do with the murder of two of the Italian KFOR soldiers in Kosovo, both a few will be stopped at the border and suspected due to certain unfortunate circumstances. This will prevent them from, at least, at least, they realize their dreams, as in the Balkan spaces it often be that young people pay guild for sins of previous generations. / Radnja filma odvija se u Srbiji, Albaniji, Italiji i Mađarskoj. Film prati dva mlada para koji žele da napuste svako svoju zemlju i potraže bolji život u zapadnoj Evropi. Kad mladi albanski par posle mnogo peripetija stigne u italijansku luku Bari, nastaju nepredvidivi problemi. Nešto slično se događa i sa srpskim parom kada stignu na mađarsku granicu. Iako nemaju nikakve veze sa ubistvom dvojice italijanskih vojnika KFOR-a na Kosovu, i jedan i drugi par biće zaustavljeni na granici i osumnjičeni usled izvesnih nesrećnih okolnosti. To će ih sprečiti da, barem trenutno, ostvare svoje snove, kao što na balkanskim prostorima to često biva da mladi plaćaju ceh za grehe prethodnih generacija.

programme.title: Stamp / Žigosana
programme.desc: Slavica moves with a social margin, always on the edge of legal. He tries to change the way of life and survive from what he earns, but that is impossible for her. Without another way to survive, he decides to theft and immediately becomes punished. Slavica tries to weld the trace and takes over the identity of Mary, a successful scientist preparing a doctorate from psychoanalysis. The rights of Mary learns about this replacement and begins to be interested in the slavic way of life. They two replace the identity and reveal the worlds that will definitely change them. / Slavica se kreće društvenom marginom, uvek na ivici legalnog. Pokušava da promeni način života i preživi od onoga što zaradi, ali to je za nju nemogući poduhvat. Nemajući drugi način da opstane odluči se za krađu i odmah biva surovo kažnjena. Slavica pokušava da zavara trag i preuzima identitet Marije, uspešne naučnice koja priprema doktorat iz psihoanalize. Prava Marija saznaje za ovu zamenu i počinje da se interesuje za Slavičin način života. Njih dve zamenjuju identitet i otkrivaju svetove koji će ih definitivno promeniti.

programme.title: Behind the camera / Iza kamere
programme.desc: The young director Tanja gets money to record a debut film. Wishing to make a better film, and in the absence of money, Tanja brings together a film team made up of the biggest stars to complete amateur. The trouble arises in the moment, when Tanja became aware of the facts, that the whole film team is nothing more to a set of eccentric characters, which is instead of engaging in film, all their attention in solving private problems and obsessions, which are in most cases bizarre. Tanja struggles with problems, trying to motivate the team to finally focus on filming, but every attempt is thwarted with a new problem, much more bizarre than the previous ... / Mlada rediteljka Tanja dobija novac za snimanje debitantskog filma. U želji da napravi što bolji film, a u nedostatku novca, Tanja okuplja filmsku ekipu sačinjenu od najvećih zvezda do potpunih amatera. Nevolja nastaje u trenutku, kad je Tanja postala svesna činjenice, da cela filmska ekipa nije ništa više do skup ekscentričnih likova, najrazličitijih karaktera, koji umesto da se bavi filmom, svu svoju pažnju i energiju rasipaju u rešavanju privatnih problema i opsesija, koji su u većini slučajeva bizarni. Tanja se do krajnjih granica bori sa problemima, pokušavajući da motiviše ekipu da se konačno fokusiraju na snimanje filma, ali svaki njen pokušaj biva osujećen novim problemom, mnogo bizarnijim od prethodnog...

programme.title: Sarana Jewelry and a half coat / Sarana bižuterija i po koji kaput
programme.desc: The story follows witty moments about one seemingly completely ordinary funeral. After his mother's death, the sons return to the gender village to prepare a funeral. Upon arrival, they learn that her desire was to bury her with a medallion that has an invaluable value. Being in big debts, they realize that the medallion can solve problems and decide to steal it. However, one starts to retard another in that purpose. / Priča prati duhovite momente oko jedne naizgled sasvim obične sahrane. Nakon majčine smrti, sinovi se vraćaju u rodno selo kako bi pripremili sahranu. Po dolasku saznaju da je njena želja bila da je sahrane sa medaljonom koji ima neprocenjivu vrednost. Budući u velikim dugovima, shvataju da im taj medaljon može rešiti probleme i odlučuju se da ga ukradu. Međutim, jedan počinje da odmaže drugom u toj nameri.

programme.title: Happened to this day / Dogodilo se na današnji dan
programme.desc: Belgrade, in the 1960s ... building with several entrances and a common yard in which young people live, different in their social status and in the way of thinking, but similar views on love, friendship and self-affirmation. These natural impulses are often painted with social events (work shares, the May Day Parade ...). However, their maturities take place in the established rules. Everything happens in the yard of this quite ordinary Belgrade building becomes just a projection of the possible experience of one generation. / Beograd, šezdesetih godina… Zgrada sa nekoliko ulaza i zajedničkim dvorištem u kojoj žive mladi ljudi, različiti po svom socijalnom statusu i po načinu razmišljanja, ali sličnih stavova o ljubavi, prijateljstvu i samopotvrđivanju. Ti njihovi prirodni impulsi često su obojeni društvenim zbivanjima (radne akcije, prvomajska parada...). Međutim, njihova sazrevanja odvijaju se po ustaljenim pravilima. Sve što se događa u dvorištu ove sasvim obične beogradske zgrade postaje samo projekcija mogućeg iskustva jedne generacije.

programme.title: It's that I am / To sam što jesam
programme.desc: Skil and Buddy Brothers, Roma from Serbia, live in Germany, where they have a temporary residence permit and deal with hip hop music. They are strong critics of racism and capitalism. After the third album's announcement, they started touring in Europe, which has an unusual character. / Braća Skil i Badi, Romi iz Srbije, žive u Nemačkoj gde imaju dozvolu za privremeni boravak i bave se hip hop muzikom. Snažni su kritičari rasizma i kapitalizma. Nakon objave trećeg albuma krenuli su na turneju po Evropi koja ima neobičan karakter.

programme.title: Monday / Mali Budo
programme.desc: A small budo is a black ethnic comedy about the Montenegrin teenager who has been sent to Serbia to avoid blood revenge caused by the negligent behavior of his father. He is not aware that more danger is waiting for him. In Belgrade, she will face avengers who chase him, nightlife and enchanting girls. In cities like Belgrade, women and nightlife can be more fatal than bullets. The people of Montenegro is known for the specific mentality and value system, which is very similar to Sicilian, Corsican or Critain. / Mali Budo je crna etnička komedija o crnogorskom tinejdžeru koji je poslat u Srbiju da bi izbegao krvnu osvetu izazvanu nemarnim ponašanjem njegovog oca. Nije svestan da ga tamo čeka još veća opasnost. U Beogradu će se suočiti sa osvetnicima koji ga jure, noćnim životom i zanosnim devojkama. U gradovima poput Beograda, žene i noćni život mogu biti kobniji od metka. Narod Crne Gore je poznat po specifičnom mentalitetu i sistemu vrednosti, koji je veoma sličan sicilijanskom, korzikanskom ili kritskom.

programme.title: Beside me / Pored mene
programme.desc: It is a professor of history in high school, young, full enthusiasm and interested in alternative methods of education. Her struggle comes down to the story of the current, the fight against persons in a function that does not care for what the competent Gymnasium), which he tries to convince something in terms of empathy present at the student, while (not) obtains the expected answer. He later searches for alternative ways to help which she is convinced that they can awaken children (organizing excursions). He lives in marriage with a painter, whose last exhibition caused violent public reactions. The Huligan group sees that exhibition as a cause to attack it. The recording of the kake attacks on the Internet. The next day, Olja reveals that he did it any of her students. It takes their mobile phones, threatening to go to the police, if they do not report the culprits and decides in the affect to lock them into a school building until they do. Wishing to solve the problem together, but also from the impossibility of leaving the school building, students begin to communicate. During one night, about himself and his classmates from class will find out more than all the previous years, and more than they ever expected. That night will change their lives, attitudes and thinking forever. / Olja je profesorka istorije u gimnaziji, mlada, puna entuzijazma i zainteresovana za alternativne metode edukacije. Njena borba se svodi na priču sadašnjice, borba jednog građanina protiv osoba na funkciji koji ne mare za ono čemu su nadležni (direktorka gimnazije Svetlan), koju pokušava ubediti da preuzme nešto po pitanju empatije prisutne kod đaka, dok (ne) dobije očekivani odgovor. Kasnije sama traži alternativne načine pomoći u koje je uverena da mogu probuditi decu (organizovanje ekskurzije). Živi u braku sa slikarem, čija je poslednja izložba izazvala burne reakcije u javnosti. Grupa huligana tu izložbu vidi kao povod da je napadne. Snimak napada kače na internet. Narednog dana Olja otkriva da je to uradio neko od njenih učenika. Oduzima im mobilne telefone, zapreti odlaskom u policiju, ako sami ne prijave krivce i u afektu odlučuje da ih zaključa u školsku zgradu dok to ne urade. U želji da zajedno reše problem, ali i iz nemogućnosti da napuste školsku zgradu učenici počinju da komuniciraju. Tokom jedne noći, o sebi i svojim drugovima iz razreda saznaće više nego svih prethodnih godina, i više nego što su ikad očekivali. Ta noć će zauvek promeniti njihove živote, stavove i razmišljanja.

programme.title: Sheet Ratnik / Šejtanov ratnik
programme.desc: Shejthan warrior is a teenager horror comedy. The film speaks about the group of high school students, who fall into a series of comic and terrible situations. Cane, Tića and Mirko are kids, who are trying to stop the primordial evil. Petar Božović, Bane Vidaković, Svetlana Bojković, Branislav Lečić, Dušan Nikolic, Dusan Janjicijevic, Irfan Mensur, Eva RAS, Eva Ras, Eva Ras. and others. Shejthan's warrior is a director's debut of young Stevan Filipovic. The film is also the first domestic film that seriously uses digital special effects, as well as computer post-production film processing. This combination of enthusiasm and modern technology should, but to entertain the viewers, to show that a modern film expression and modern technique is used in our films, as well as inspire young filmmakers in our country not to oversey the technically demanding. / Šejtanov ratnik je tinejdžerska horor-komedija. Film govori o grupi srednjoškolaca, koji upadaju u niz komičnih i strašnih situacija. Cane, Tića i Mirko su klinci, koji pokušavaju da zaustave iskonsko zlo. Od glumaca starije generacije pojavljuju se Petar Božović, Bane Vidaković, Svetlana Bojković, Marko Nikolić, Branislav Lečić, Dragan Nikolić, Dušan Janjićijević, Irfan Mensur, Eva Ras. i drugi. Šejtanov ratnik je režiserski debi mladog Stevana Filipovića. Film je istovremeno i prvi domaći film koji ozbiljno koristi digitalne specijalne efekte, kao i kompjutersku postprodukcijsku obradu filma. Ovaj spoj entuzijazma i moderne tehnologije trebalo bi, sem da zabavi gledaoce, da pokaže da se i u našim filmovima koristi moderan filmski izraz i savremena tehnika, kao i da inspiriše mlade filmske stvaraoce kod nas da ne prezaju od tehnički zahtevnijeg.

programme.title: When the day dawns / Kad svane dan
programme.desc: The film is the story of the Professor of Music Retirement, Miri Brankov, which under the unusual circumstances reveals its right origin. At the place where he used to be a Nazi camp for Jews in World War II, workers accidentally find a tin box with documents that the Far 1941 was buried by the Isak Weiss camp. The professor finds out that his true parents are Weissovs, who were given to the camp, given him to his friends, family Brankov. There is also an unfinished music score called when Dawn Dan, which has composed Isaak Weiss. Searching for the truth about himself and his origin Professor mouse trace and a little known truth about the Judenlager Semlin camp, one of the most awesome nazi exits in the very heart of today's Belgrade. At the same time, professor obsession is to complete the composition of his father and performed in the place of the former camp ... which at the end, after a number of peripes, and departs / Film je priča o profesoru muzike u penziji, Miši Brankovu, koji pod neobičnim okolnostima otkriva svoje pravo poreklo. Na mestu gde je nekada bio nacistički logor za Jevreje u Drugom svetskom ratu, radnici slučajno pronalaze limenu kutiju sa dokumentima koju je daleke 1941. godine zakopao logoraš Isak Vajs. Profesor saznaje da su njegovi pravi roditelji Vajsovi, koji su ga pre nego što su odvedeni u logor dali na čuvanje prijateljima, porodici Brankov. U kutiji je i nedovršena muzička partitura pod nazivom Kad svane dan, koju je komponovao Isak Vajs. Tragajući za istinom o sebi i svom poreklu profesor Miša traga i za malo poznatom istinom o logoru Judenlager Semlin, jednim od najstrašnijih nacističkih stratišta u samom srcu današnjeg Beograda. Istovremeno profesorova opsesija jeste da dovrši započetu kompoziciju svoga oca i da je izvede na mestu nekadašnjeg logora...što mu na kraju, posle niza peripetija, i polazi za rukom

This specific way of animating, that is, a mockery of the club audience, through an actor, a comedian who improvised on an open scene, its own screenwriting, stage design and visually packaged, gets in the TV format of the stand -up comedy - Stand Up Revolution. / STAND UP REVOLUTION е играна студиска верзија на кабартскиот жанр, многу популарен во светот, стенд ап комедија. Овој специфичен начин на анимирање, односно засмејување на клубската публика, преку еден актер, комичар, кој импровизира на отворена сцена, своја сценаристички, сценографски и визуелно спакувана форма, добива во ТВ форматот на стенд ап комедијата – STAND UP REVOLUTION.

programme.title: Photo back stage / Photo back stage
programme.desc: Photo Back Stage is a project of photo and video sessions in which a variety of events are summarized, for the most part photo sessions. The project presents different shows, models, photo sessions for presentation of products, projects and companies. / PHOTO BACK STAGE е проект на фото и видео сесиии во кој се сублимирани најразлични настани, во најголемиот дел фото сесии. Преку проектот се презентирани различни ревии, модели, фото сесии за презентација на производи, проекти и компании.

programme.title: A sip of deity / Голтка божество
programme.desc: Wine, mystical word, taste, color… the sweetness of the soul… why is the truth in the wine. For many wine truths, facts and wisdoms, in a series titled Sip Deity - Stories of Wine. / Вино, мистичен збор, вкус,боја…Сласт на душата… Зошто во виното е вистината. За многу вински вистини, факти и мудрости, во серијалот насловен ГОЛТКА БОЖЕСТВО – ПРИКАЗНИ ЗА ВИНОТО.

programme.title: They said about the business / Кажаа за бизнисот
programme.desc: The Business Project conveys useful tips, thoughts, attitudes and messages from the world's most famous businessmen, innovators, managers and academic authorities in the field of management and business science. Prepared in the form of sublimated messages, through a good graphic display of what needs to be heard, see and memorize and with the sole purpose of using new experiences of managers and leaders they will apply in the management of companies. / Проектот ЗА БИЗНИСОТпренесува корисни совети, мисли, ставови и пораки од најпознатите светски бизнисмени, иноватори, менаџери и академски авторитети во делот на науката за менаџмент и бизнис. Подготвени во форма на сублимирани пораки, преку добар графички приказ на она што треба да се слушне, види и меморира а со единствена цел да се искористи за осознавање на нови искуства на менаџери и лидери кои ќе ги применат во менаџирањето на компаниите.

programme.title: Say and do ... / Кажи и направи...
programme.desc: An informative show that deals with positive events and figures from our city and the state. Special emphasis is on topics related to the successes of individuals, institutions and companies in areas such as sports, science, business, art, culture. Very often, footage and broadcasts of scientific conferences and events related to education institutions (faculties, universities, primary and secondary schools) are broadcast within this project. The positive approach to the topics being processed and the research and scientific segment is a challenge for our TV to support this type of events. / Информативна емисија која обработува позитивни настани и личности од нашиот град и државата. Посебен акцент е ставен на темите поврзани со успесите на поединци, институции и компании во области како што е спортот, науката, бизнис, уметноста, културата. Многу често во рамките на овој проект се емитуваат снимки и преноси од научни конференции и настани поврзани со институциите од образованието ( факултети, универзитети, основни и средни училишта) . Позитивниот пристап на темите кои се обработуваат и истражувачкиот и научен сегмент е предизвик за НАША ТВ за да ги поддржи овој тип на настани.

programme.title: Three business news / Три бизнис вести
programme.desc: Every day. New 3 minutes of business news. 3 new news for 3 events for 3 companies. Business news is intended to monitor and inform current economic developments in the country and in the world. The main emphasis is on domestic companies, their projects, new jobs, investments, successes and achievements. / Секој ден. Нови 3 минути бизнис вести. 3 нови вести за 3 настани за 3 компании. Бизнис вестите се наменети за следење и информирање на актуелни економските случувања во државата и во светот. Главен акцент е ставен на домашните компании, нивните проекти, нови вработувања, инвестиции, успеси и достигнувања.

programme.title: Heads / Бушави глави
programme.desc: 260 episodes after 25 minutes! 2200 children 130 public figures. And why are we proud of this project? Family show with children and public figures heads is a project in which main actors and protagonists are children (from a large group in kindergarten and first and second grade) with their vision, how things in the world operate, open many discussion topics and do not convey to a world that is reserved for open children. Adults are here just to help that world remain what the children's imagination created. With the shaggy heads, despite their children, they will learn many new things in the field of culture and art, learn how to keep their health by sporting and caring for their diet. / 260 епизоди по 25 минути! 2200 деца 130 јавни личности. И зошто сме горделиви на овој проект? Семејната емисија со деца и јавни личности БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ е проект во која главни актери и протагонисти се децата (од голема група во градинка и од прво и второ одделение) со нивната визија, за тоа како нештата во светот фунционираат, отвораат многу теми за дискусија и не пренесуваат во свет кој е резервиран само за отворените детски умови. Возрасните се тука само да помогнат тој свет да остане онаков каков го создала детската фантазија. Со проектот БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ, покрај тоа што децата ќе се забавуваат, тие ќе научат многу нови нешта од областа на културата и уметноста, ќе научат како да го чуваат своето здравје со тоа што ќе спортуваат и ќе внимаваат на својата исхрана.

programme.title: World traveler / Светски патник
programme.desc: The world traveler series-Culture Trip in the 24th episodes covers 100 destinations from 50 countries around the world with a particular focus on making cultures special. Brazilians' secret to the happiest nation in the world, as the lands, have managed to achieve incredible peace, as the Singaporeans of one of the poorest have become one of the most successful, as the Norwegians are as modest and how the sand Arabs make incredible modern castles. / Серијалот СВЕТСКИ ПАТНИК – CULTURE TRIP во 24-ри епизоди опфаќа 100тина дестинации од 50тина држави од целиот Свет со посебен осврт на тоа што ги прави културите посебни. Тајната на Бразилците за најсреќната нација на Светот, како Полежаните успеале да постигнат неверојатен мир, како Сингапурците од едни од најсиромашните станале едни од најуспешните, како Норвежаните се толку скромни и како Арапите од песок прават неверојатни модерни замоци.

programme.title: Cool TV / Cool TV
programme.desc: Television that follows the urban and alternative scene. Hip-hop, alternative rock, indie rock, metal, punk, hard rock… all this and much more, on Cool TV! programme.title: Culturo / Културо
programme.desc: The Cultural Project is a TV format aimed at approximating all important cultural, artistic and social events, the philosophy of living, open issues, perspectives, directions of reasoning and acting, through several different forms, not only to the expert public, artists and all cultural activists in our country, but also to our country, Macedonia. In this way, it supports the main concept of our TV, to affirm, share, nurture positive events, which represents its cultural, cultural and educational function, as a contribution to the basic principles of our TV for nurturing true and lasting values. / Проектот КУЛТУРО е ТВ формат кој има за цел приближување на сите значајни културни, уметнички и општествени настани, филозофијата на живеење, отворени прашања, перспективи, насоки на расмислување и делување, преку неколку различни форми да ги приближи, не само до стручната јавност, уметниците и сите културни дејци во нашата земја, туку и на љубителите на културата и на општиот ТВ аудиториум, што го прави уникатен во медиумскиот простор во Македонија. На тој начин го поткрепува главниот концепт на НАША ТВ, да афирмира, споделува, негува позитивни настани, со што ја претставува својата културна, културолошка и едукативна функција, како придонес кон основните начела на НАША ТВ за негување вистински и трајни вредности.

programme.title: Orient / Ориент експрес
programme.desc: Zoran Ralev. Leisurely. SHOW. A friendly housewife. Delicious food .. wine tastings. Various specialties. Travel and experiences experiences. Various stories. For scents, for flavors. Doctors. Scientists. Artists. Gourmets. Informal experiences. For peoples and cultures. 101 episode after 30 minutes. How do they pass by minute. From one station to another. The train passes. Како за минута поминуваат. Од една до друга станица. Возот поминува. Ориент Експрес.

programme.title: Heads / Бушави глави
programme.desc: 260 episodes after 25 minutes! 2200 children 130 public figures. And why are we proud of this project? Family show with children and public figures heads is a project in which main actors and protagonists are children (from a large group in kindergarten and first and second grade) with their vision, how things in the world operate, open many discussion topics and do not convey to a world that is reserved for open children. Adults are here just to help that world remain what the children's imagination created. With the shaggy heads, despite their children, they will learn many new things in the field of culture and art, learn how to keep their health by sporting and caring for their diet. / 260 епизоди по 25 минути! 2200 деца 130 јавни личности. И зошто сме горделиви на овој проект? Семејната емисија со деца и јавни личности БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ е проект во која главни актери и протагонисти се децата (од голема група во градинка и од прво и второ одделение) со нивната визија, за тоа како нештата во светот фунционираат, отвораат многу теми за дискусија и не пренесуваат во свет кој е резервиран само за отворените детски умови. Возрасните се тука само да помогнат тој свет да остане онаков каков го создала детската фантазија. Со проектот БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ, покрај тоа што децата ќе се забавуваат, тие ќе научат многу нови нешта од областа на културата и уметноста, ќе научат како да го чуваат своето здравје со тоа што ќе спортуваат и ќе внимаваат на својата исхрана.

programme.title: Children's music festivals / Детски музички фестивали
programme.desc: Music ... talenters ... mousse ... children. What is the educational function of music? Are you happy with your children with beautiful children's songs? Our TV in its concept, vision and mission, as one of the main goals has set the goal of touching the best possible way to the youngest audience - children. To achieve this goal, our TV has regular cooperation with the current and former organizers of all children's music festivals, whose releases of years, but also the latest, regularly broadcast them on its program. Every day on our TV are Golden Nightingale, Potocci, S-Dia, Tra-la, Lions of 55 concerts, we produced 165 shows for 30 minutes. / Музика..таленти..музика..илјадници деца.. Време..љубов..детска страст.. Која е последната детска песничка која ја паметите од вашето детство? Која е образовната функција на музиката? Се радувате ли и Вие со Вашите деца на прекрасните детски песни? НАША ТВ во својот концепт, визија и мисија, како една од главните цели ја има зацртано целта да се допре на најдобар можен начин до најмладата публика – децата. За остварување на оваа цел, НАША ТВ има редовна соработка со сегашините и поранешните организатори на сите детски музички фестивали, чии изданија од години наназад, но и најновите, редовно ги емитува на својата програма. Секој ден на НАША ТВ се присутни Златно славејче, Поточиња, СИ-ДО, Тра-ла-ла, Лавчиња Од 55 концерти, продуциравме 165 емисии во времетраење од 30 минути.

programme.title: For the balance / За балансот
programme.desc: For the balance is a TV essay, which in a clear and subtle way, through general terms, reveals the deep world of philosophical thought. With, seemingly, simple and pydy approach goes into the essence of things and makes serious thinking and essential understanding of the world around us. / ЗА БАЛАНСОТ е ТВ есеј, кој на јасен и суптилен начин, преку општите поими, го открива длабокиот свет на филозофската мисла. Со, навидум, едноставен и питок пристап навлегува во суштината на нештата и тера на сериозно размислување и суштинско разбирање на светот околу нас.

programme.title: Exhibition / Изложби

programme.title: Concerts on classical music / Концерти на класична музика
programme.desc: Classic, artistic, expression of life, beauty, sadness, joy ... From the Renaissance to this day, not succumbing to the tooth of time, put to the test. How long will it survive? That is why the choice in this series, as another confirmation that it persists and overcomes time, becomes timeless and continues to listen. Choosing for every lover of classical music, through a blend of performances, events and works, as it has inspired artists and have been laid through in recent years. / Класична, уметничка, израз на животот, убавината, тагата, радоста… од ренесансата до денес, не потклекнувајќи на забот на времето, ставена на тест. До кога ќе опстои? Затоа и избор во овој серијал, како уште една потврда дека опстојува и го победува времето, станува вонвременска и продолжува да се слуша. Избор за секој љубител на класичната музика, преку спој на изведби, настани и дела, како што ги инспирирале уметниците и се ределе низ изминатите години.

programme.title: Love TV / Love TV
programme.desc: Love consists of three different components: intimacy, dedication and passion. All forms of love are seen as different combinations of these three components. The liking includes only intimacy. The blindness involves only passion. Romantic love includes both intimacy and passion. Friendly love involves intimacy and dedication. The frivolous love involves passion and dedication. Lastly, perfect love includes all three. Architectural miracles are waged for love, novels, verses, songs are written. Agápē, Ljubav, Love, Ljbov, Dashuri, You Yubesk… in all Balkan languages, like love, when she sings for her: Massimo Savic, Zoran Predin, Rita Ora… Look at Love TV! / Љубовта се состои од три различни компоненти: интимност, посветеност и страст. На сите облици на љубов се гледа како на различни комбинации од овие три компоненти. Допаѓањето вклучува само интимност. Заслепеноста вклучува само страст. Романтичната љубов ги вклучува и интимноста и страста. Пријателската љубов вклучува интимност и посветеност. Несериозната љубов вклучува страст и посветеност. И на крај, совршената љубов ги вклучува сите три. За љубовта се водени војни , гардени се архитектонски чуда , пишувани се романи , стихови , песни. Agápē , Ljubav , Љубов , Любов , Dashuri , Тe yubesk …На сите Балкански јазици , како ли зчучи љубовта , кога за неа пее : Масимо Савиќ , Зоран Предин , Рита Ора… ГЛЕДАЈТЕ на LOVE TV!
