programme.title: People TV / Folk TV
programme.desc: Folk, originating from the German Volk in the sense of the people, as a whole. Folk music has certain features but cannot be specifically determined through purely musical terms. One of the meanings is what indicates old songs, without a well-known artist, and another meaning is that music is subject to the evolutionary process of oral transfer… Modernization and re-modernization of music by the society giving the folk character of music. Bosnian Sevdalins, Croatian Singing, Montenegrin Gularers, Kosovo Shota, Greek Syrtaki, Macedonian Dances… Heart in the Balkans in the original edition. Only on Folk TV. / Фолк, потекнува од германскиот Volk во смисла народот, како целина. Фолк музиката има одредени карактеристики но не може конкретно да се определи преку чисто музички поими. Едно од значењата е тоа кое укажува на стари песни, без познат изведувач,а друго значење е дека музиката подлежи на еволуциски процес на усно пренесување… модернизирањето и повторното модернизирање на музиката од страна на општеството што го дава фолк-карактерот на музиката. Босански севдалинки , хравтско клапско пеење , црногорски гуслари , косовска шота , грчко сиртаки,македонски ора … Срцевината на Балканот во изворно издание. Единствено на FOLK TV.

За остварување на оваа цел, НАША ТВ има редовна соработка со сегашините и поранешните организатори на сите детски музички фестивали, чии изданија од години наназад, но и најновите, редовно ги емитува на својата програма. Секој ден на НАША ТВ се присутни Златно славејче, Поточиња, СИ-ДО, Тра-ла-ла, Лавчиња Од 55 концерти, продуциравме 165 емисии во времетраење од 30 минути.

programme.title: Three business news / Три бизнис вести
programme.desc: Every day. New 3 minutes of business news. 3 new news for 3 events for 3 companies. Business news is intended to monitor and inform current economic developments in the country and in the world. The main emphasis is on domestic companies, their projects, new jobs, investments, successes and achievements. / Секој ден. Нови 3 минути бизнис вести. 3 нови вести за 3 настани за 3 компании. Бизнис вестите се наменети за следење и информирање на актуелни економските случувања во државата и во светот. Главен акцент е ставен на домашните компании, нивните проекти, нови вработувања, инвестиции, успеси и достигнувања.

programme.title: Stars and stories / Ѕвезди и приказни
programme.desc: As part of our TV program is the project titled stars and stories. Our TV and Suzana Turundzieva take you on the most revolt in the world of our youngest and dearest. Where it is colorful and cheerful, where it is full of creative games and children's smiles. A children's show that entertained, informs, educates, tells and recounts for past times. / Како дел од програмата на НАША ТВ е и проектот со наслов Ѕвезди и приказни. НАША ТВ и Сузана Турунџиева Ве носат на најволшебното патување во светот на нашите најмали и најмили. Таму каде што е шарено и весело, таму каде што е полно со креативни игри и детски насмевки. Детска емисија која забавува, информира, едуцира, раскажува и прераскажува за минатите времиња.

programme.title: Reports / Репортажи
programme.desc: Reports on the Macedonian areas, mountains, observatories, lakes, gorges, villages, cities, monasteries… but also the beauties of the nostalgic Montenegrin beauty, to the pearl of the Orient, scattered on two continents, to the lavishness of the modern West. In the reports of our TV, through a picture and a nice word, there are woven kilometers passed through beautiful places, drawing the beauty of Macedonia. / Репортажи за македонските предели, планини, опсерватории, езера, клисури, села, градови,манастири…Но и убавините на носталгичната црногорска убавица, до бисерот на ориентот, распослан на два континенти, до раскошноста на современите западни метрополи. Во репортажите на НАША ТВ, преку слика и убав збор, се вткаени километри поминати низ убави места, кои ја цртаат убавината на Македонија.

programme.title: Macedonian sports legends with Zoran Mihajlov / Македонски спортски легенди со Зоран Михајлов
programme.desc: The author and host of the show, the doyen of Macedonian sports journalism, Mr This project has a permanent archive and historical value, which over the years will be increasing as a result of the time distance. / Авторот и водител на емисијата, доајенот на македонското спортско новинарство г-дин Зоран Михајлов, сведок и хроничар на најзначајните моменти во македонската спортска историја ви ја остава оваа телевизиска енциклопедија. Овој проект има трајна архивска и историска вредност, која со текот на годините ќе биде сè поголема како резултат на временската дистанца.

programme.title: Marjan Gjorgjievski Live / Марјан Ѓорѓиевски LIVE
programme.desc: Marjan Gjorgjievski - Live is a documentary feature series showing, the adventures, challenges and all the upcoming and accidents that are happening to the actor, the standup comedian, Marjan Gjorgjievski. We look at his personal, social and professional life. We follow all the way behind the camera to the ultimate goal (writing materials for standup comedy, creation of plays, the struggle for life and the handling to survive in the Macedonian reality). You will have a chance to look at the background of: Marjan's real life, without censorship and as in the brutally ridiculous plot, which they expect. / МАРЈАН ЃОРЃИЕВСКИ – LIVE е документарно играна серија, во која се прикажани, авантурите, предизвиците и сите згоди и незгоди, кои му се случуваат на актерот, стендап комичарот, Марјан Ѓорѓиевски. Погледнуваме во неговиот, личен, социјален и професионален живот. Го следиме целиот пат зад камерата до крајната цел (пишување материјали за стендап комедија, создавање на претстави, борбата за живот и снаоѓањето за да се преживее во македонската реалност). Ќе имате шанса да погледнете во позадината на: реалниот живот на Марјан, без цензура и како и во брутално смешните сплетки, кои го очекуваат.

programme.title: Heads / Бушави глави
programme.desc: 260 episodes after 25 minutes! 2200 children 130 public figures. And why are we proud of this project? Family show with children and public figures heads is a project in which main actors and protagonists are children (from a large group in kindergarten and first and second grade) with their vision, how things in the world operate, open many discussion topics and do not convey to a world that is reserved for open children. Adults are here just to help that world remain what the children's imagination created. With the shaggy heads, despite their children, they will learn many new things in the field of culture and art, learn how to keep their health by sporting and caring for their diet. / 260 епизоди по 25 минути! 2200 деца 130 јавни личности. И зошто сме горделиви на овој проект? Семејната емисија со деца и јавни личности БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ е проект во која главни актери и протагонисти се децата (од голема група во градинка и од прво и второ одделение) со нивната визија, за тоа како нештата во светот фунционираат, отвораат многу теми за дискусија и не пренесуваат во свет кој е резервиран само за отворените детски умови. Возрасните се тука само да помогнат тој свет да остане онаков каков го создала детската фантазија. Со проектот БУШАВИ ГЛАВИ, покрај тоа што децата ќе се забавуваат, тие ќе научат многу нови нешта од областа на културата и уметноста, ќе научат како да го чуваат своето здравје со тоа што ќе спортуваат и ќе внимаваат на својата исхрана.

programme.title: Culturo / Културо
programme.desc: The Cultural Project is a TV format aimed at approximating all important cultural, artistic and social events, the philosophy of living, open issues, perspectives, directions of reasoning and acting, through several different forms, not only to the expert public, artists and all cultural activists in our country, but also to our country, Macedonia. In this way, it supports the main concept of our TV, to affirm, share, nurture positive events, which represents its cultural, cultural and educational function, as a contribution to the basic principles of our TV for nurturing true and lasting values. / Проектот КУЛТУРО е ТВ формат кој има за цел приближување на сите значајни културни, уметнички и општествени настани, филозофијата на живеење, отворени прашања, перспективи, насоки на расмислување и делување, преку неколку различни форми да ги приближи, не само до стручната јавност, уметниците и сите културни дејци во нашата земја, туку и на љубителите на културата и на општиот ТВ аудиториум, што го прави уникатен во медиумскиот простор во Македонија. На тој начин го поткрепува главниот концепт на НАША ТВ, да афирмира, споделува, негува позитивни настани, со што ја претставува својата културна, културолошка и едукативна функција, како придонес кон основните начела на НАША ТВ за негување вистински и трајни вредности.

programme.title: My own boss / Сам свој газда
programme.desc: One of the most common problems for individuals and interested groups who want to open their own business is how to implement the idea in business. They have an idea, they may have money but you don't know the way to realization and the risks of each business individually ... The project itself is focused on stages and experiences in entrepreneurship and problems that hinder the greater development of entrepreneurship. / Еден од најчестите проблеми на поединците и заинтересираните групи кои сакаат да отворат сопствен бизнис е како идејата да ја спроведат во бизнис. Имаат идеа , можеби имаат и пари но не го знаете патот до реализација и ризиците на секој бизнис поединечно... Проектот Сам свој газда е фокусиран на фази и искуства во претприемништвото и проблеми кои го попречуваат поголемиот развој на претприемништвото.

programme.title: Alarm / Аларм
programme.desc: Alarm is a 50-minute debate show that processes socially engaged and lifestyle topics, with an emphasis on socio-social topics, which require urgent reaction from competent state authorities, NGOs and citizens. Some of the topics that are part of the show have an emphasis on gender issues and the place of women in Macedonian society, but there are also topics that are not directly related to this issue, such as family, morality, ethics, aesthetics, culture, art, style, health… / АЛАРМ е дебатна емисија во траење од 50 минути која обработува општествено ангажирани и lifestyle теми, со акцент на социјално-општествените теми, кои бараат итна реакција од надлежните државни органи, невладините организации и граѓаните. Еден дел од темите кои се дел од емисијата, имаат акцент на родовите прашања и местото на жената во македонското општество, но има и теми кои не се директно поврзани со ова прашање, како на пример семејство, морал, етика, естетика, култура, уметност, стил, здравје…

programme.title: Beauty UFC 22 / MMA UFC 22
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: New diplomacy / Nova diplomatija
programme.desc: We take you to the fascinating world of Brazil, directly from the residence of the Ambassador Jose Maura de Fonsake Koste Kouta. Brazil is a country that radiates the energy of the carnival, football, Samba and the Nobrotive Amazon. But at the same time a country of rich in history and principles. Brazil is consistently committed to non-compliance policies in the interior of other countries, respect for sovereignty and the rule of law. This principle closely connects Brazil and Serbia, especially when we look at historical relations. Yugoslavia and Brazil built a firm friendship through the movement of non-aligned. Although the world has changed, our peoples continue to share values and a common past. / Vodimo vas u fascinantni svet Brazila i to direktno iz rezidencije ambasadora Žozea Maura de Fonseke Koste Kouta. Brazil je zemlja koja zrači energijom karnevala, fudbala, sambe i neukrotive Amazonije. Ali je istovremeno zemlja bogate istorije i principa. Brazil se dosledno zalaže za politiku nemešanja u unutrašnje poslove drugih zemalja, poštovanje suvereniteta i vladavine prava. Taj princip blisko povezuje Brazil i Srbiju, posebno kada se osvrnemo na istorijske odnose. Jugoslavija i Brazil su kroz Pokret nesvrstanih gradili čvrsto prijateljstvo. Iako se svet promenio, naši narodi i dalje dele vrednosti i zajedničku prošlost.

programme.title: Decade / Dekade
programme.desc: In the occupied Serbia, during the Second World War, the newspapers were printed that spread propaganda that popularized the third Reich. The famous collaborative newspapers of the new time, renovation, our struggle, and in Vojvodina, the new post office, which had a key task that the Serbian people of conquers presented in the Belgrade, which had the Serbian people in the country. / U okupiranoj Srbiji, tokom Drugog svetskog rata, štampale su se novine koje su širile propagandu koja je popularisala Treći Rajh. U Beogadu izlaze čuvene kolaboracionističke novine Novo vreme, Obnova, Naša borba, a u Vojvodini Nova pošta, koje su imale ključni zadatak da srpskom narodu osvajača predstave kao onoga koji uspostavlja bolji državni poredak u zemlji.

programme.title: Diagnosis / Dijagnoza
programme.desc: The guest of emission diagnosis is the former Prime Minister of Montenegro and the leader of the Civic Movement of URA Dritan Abazovic. The deputies will decide again in the following days for the Emirates Agreement in the field of tourism and real estate because the president of the state did not want to sign a ratified document. Abazovic believes that everything in the agreement smells of corruption, especially, as he stated, which only one potential investor appears in the entire announced business. The former Prime Minister also spoke about the Sinovac Andrija Mandic, who was suspected in Podgorica, was shot in two fellow citizens as an announced honorary citizenship in the controversial businessman Naser Ramaja to whom the Montenegrin passport awarded Abazovic's government. / Gost emisije Dijagnoza je nekadašnji premijer Crne Gore i lider Građanskog pokreta URA Dritan Abazović. Poslanici će narednih dana ponovo odlučivati o Sporazumu s Emiratima u oblasti turizma i nekretnina jer predsednik države nije želeo da potpiše ratifikovani dokument. Abazović smatra da sve u Sporazumu miriše na korupciju, pogotovo, kako je naveo, što se u celom najavljenom poslu pojavljuje samo jedan potencijalni investitor. Nekadašnji premijer govorio je i o slučaju sinovca Andrije Mandića koji je osumnjičen da je u Podgorici pucao u dvojicu sugrađana kao i najavljenoj reviziji počasnog državljanstva kontroverznom biznismenu Naseru Ramaju kome je crnogorski pasoš dodelila Abazovićeva Vlada.

programme.title: Flag film / Zastava film
programme.desc: The film brings a personal story of director (Željko Mirović) and his friends served with a military service. It is about young men of various destinies, from different parts of the then Yugoslavia, immediately after the 1999 NATO aggression. Years. Twenty years later, director Mirkovic decided to look for friends with whom he once shared military bread and record a story about friendship for his whole life. The film of military love forever represents a spending story of the search for love and meaningful lifestyle told through the twentieth time lenta of the military life of the main heroes. / Film donosi ličnu priču reditelja (Željko Mirović) i njegovih prijatelja sa kojima je služio vojni rok. Reč je o mladićima različitih sudbina, iz različitih krajeva tadašnje Jugoslavije, neposredno nakon NATO agresije 1999. godine. Dvadeset godina kasnije, reditelj Mirković odlučio je da potraži prijatelje sa kojima je svojevremeno delio vojnički hleb i da snimi priču o prijateljstvu za ceo život. Film Vojničke ljubavi zauvek predstavlja vanvremensku priču o traganju za ljubavlju i smislom života ispričanu kroz dvadesetogodišnju vremensku lentu vojničkog života glavnih junaka.

programme.title: Synthesis / Sinteza
programme.desc: After the change in Washington, the Serbian external policy is in place and corresponds to the interests of what is in its basis - independence, military neutrality and the absence of membership in anything. Serbia has open communication with key actors in the world, Diplomat Zoran Milivojević said. Speaking of the international position of Serbia, the guest of Sintez emissions pointed out that Serbia has something that has no one in the region. Commenting customs, the US Second President Donald Tramp introduced numerous countries, including Serbia, the diplomat stated that they touch us, but that their delay provides us with the opportunity to communicate. Looking at the guest appearance of President Aleksandar Vučić, where he emphasized that Serbia would not introduce countermeasures, Milivojević commented that it was the chance of Serbia for negotiations. Zoran Milivojević: Foreign policy of Serbia in place, open communication with all key actors. / Posle promena u Vašingtonu pokazuje se da je spoljna politika Srbije na mestu i odgovara interesima onoga što je u njenoj osnovi - nezavisnost, vojna neutralnost i odsustvo članstva u bilo čemu. Srbija ima otvorenu komunikaciju sa ključnim akterima na svetu, izjavio je diplomata Zoran Milivojević. Govoreći o međunarodnom položaju Srbije, gost emisije Sinteza istakao je da Srbija ima nešto što nema niko u regionu. Komentarišući carine koje je američki predsednik Donald Tramp uveo brojnim zemljama, među kojima je i Srbija, diplomata je naveo da nas se one dotiču, ali da nam njihovo odlaganje pruža priliku za komunikaciju. Osvrnuvši se na gostovanje predsednika Aleksandra Vučića u emisiji Stav dana, gde je naglasio da Srbija neće uvoditi kontramere, Milivojević je prokomentarisao da je to šansa Srbije za pregovore. Zoran Milivojević: Spoljna politika Srbije na mestu, otvorena komunikacija sa svim ključnim akterima.

programme.title: Red buds / Crveni pupoljci
programme.desc: The story follows Merim, a woman who is forced to marry at the age of 14 within the strict Islamic sect. Although her fate has already been determined, Mary refuses to allow her daughter Zaynep the same. When she learns that Zaynep is destined to become the bride of the grandson of a powerful Sheikh, she makes the hardest decision in life - to escape before it is too late. With the help of Pajeva, which used to be part of the sect, Merim is looking for a way to collect money and give her daughter a chance for a different future. Destiny leads her to Levent, a secular psychiatrist who offers her the job of a caregiver. The two come from completely different worlds - it symbolizes modernity and progressive values, while spent all her life in a strictly controlled environment. Although they are often clashed at first because of different views of life, over time, interrelations between them develop mutual trust and strong emotional connection. However, the escape from the past is never easy. The power of the sect and its influence extends further than Mary can imagine, and the dangers lurk at every turn. When the truth about Levento's daughter is discovered, their lives are further complicated, and fate Merje and Zaynep becomes even more uncertain. / Priča prati Merjem, ženu koja je s 14 godina primorana na brak unutar stroge islamske sekte. Iako je njena sudbina već određena, Merjem odbija da isto dopusti svojoj kćerki Zejnep. Kada sazna da je Zejnep predodređena da postane nevjesta unuka moćnog šejha, donosi najtežu odluku u životu – pobjeći prije nego što bude prekasno. Uz pomoć zaove, koja je nekada i sama bila dio sekte, Merjem traži način da sakupi novac i pruži svojoj kćerki šansu za drugačiju budućnost. Sudbina je vodi do Leventa, sekularnog psihijatra koji joj nudi posao njegovateljice. Njih dvoje dolaze iz potpuno različitih svjetova – on simbolizira modernost i progresivne vrijednosti, dok je Merjem cijeli život provela u strogo kontrolisanom okruženju. Iako se u početku često sukobljavaju zbog različitih pogleda na život, s vremenom se među njima razvija uzajamno povjerenje i snažna emocionalna povezanost. Međutim, bijeg od prošlosti nikada nije jednostavan. Moć sekte i njenog utjecaja proteže se dalje nego što Merjem može zamisliti, a opasnosti vrebaju na svakom koraku. Kada se otkrije istina o Leventovoj kćerki, njihovi životi se dodatno zakomplikuju, a sudbina Merjem i Zejnep postaje još neizvjesnija.

programme.title: House from the heart / Kuća od srca
programme.desc: The Heart House project aims to dispose of the most vulnerable families in the territory of the Republic of Serbia. The Ministry of Labor and Social Policy recognized common goals and joined the project in assistance in meeting the basic needs of vulnerable families. Families that are part of the HEAR's house with the support of the Ministry of Labor and Social Policies have the opportunity to be housed, materially supported, returned to the education system, which results in the resocialization of all family members with the youngest members of society. The basic idea of the project is, the involvement of the entire community in the help of families that are declared the most vulnerable. / Projekat Kuća od srca ima za cilj zbrinjavanje najugroženijih porodica na teritoriji Republike Srbije. Ministarstvo rada i socijalne politike prepoznalo je zajedničke ciljeve i priključilo se projektu u pomoći pri zadovoljavanju osnovnih potreba ugroženih porodica. Porodice koje su dio projekta Kuća od srca uz podršku Ministarstva rada i socijalne politike imaju priliku da budu stambeno zbrinute, materijalno potpomognute, vraćene u obrazovni sistem, što rezultira resocijalizacijom svih članova porodice uz akcentovanje na najmlađe članove društva. Osnovna ideja projekta jeste, uključivanje cjelokupne zajednice u pomoć porodicama koje su od strane Ministarstva proglašene najugroženijim.

programme.title: Peasants / Seljaci
programme.desc: The peasant series is Saga about several rural families living in our village of Treskavica, whose many members are scattered around the world from Paris to New Zealand. There is a mixing of old and new customs and habits, which is the source of many conflict and comic situations. Why do the spectators like to watch a series of peasants? Because it is authentic, ours, which talks about our flaws and bad habits with mild irony and humor, and with great sympathy about our traditional values. / Serija Seljaci je saga o nekoliko seoskih porodica koje žive u našem selu Treskavica, a čiji su mnogi članovi rasuti po svetu od Pariza do Novog Zelanda. Dolazi do mešanja starih i novih običaja i navika, što je izvor mnogih konfliktnih i komičnih situacija. Zašto gledaoci vole da gledaju seriju Seljaci? Zato što je autentična, naša, što sa blagom ironijom i humorom govori o našim manama i lošim navikama, a sa velikom simpatijom o našim tradicionalnim vrednostima.

programme.title: Love and hatred / Ljubav i mržnja
programme.desc: The series follows the hands and accidents of the rich Belgrade family Lazarević. No one has overwhelmed the death of the mother, which was a pillar of the family. Bogdan's new wife says is morally unfit. It is temperamental and often creates problems within the family. He also hides secrets from the past, which is persecuted. In essence is an insecure personality and shy on its peasant roots. Bogdan's son Bojan is a womanizer and has an affair with his stepmother. It creates a series of trouble for him, because he promised her to divorce his wife and establish a new life with her. However, Bojan has a number of love affairs. His wife Ljubica is a noble and loyal person. A successful business woman. Bojan's brother Miloš is a journalist, she was dissatisfied, because he actually wanted to be a writer. Therefore, he often reaches for alcohol. His wife Ivan desperately wants to get pregnant, but it doesn't work for her. Her father Dušan is a former drug addict and makes her extra problems. Judka's journalist is Miloševa colleague from the leaves of the morning star, to which the Lazarevic family is a favorite topic. Bojanov and Miloseva sister Olja is the youngest member of the family and she suffers the most because of his mother's death. Olja unexpectedly pregnant, the father of the child is her professor Vojin from the faculty. Not sure what to do. / Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista Jutarnja Zvezda, kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: House from the heart / Kuća od srca
programme.desc: The Heart House project aims to dispose of the most vulnerable families in the territory of the Republic of Serbia. The Ministry of Labor and Social Policy recognized common goals and joined the project in assistance in meeting the basic needs of vulnerable families. Families that are part of the HEAR's house with the support of the Ministry of Labor and Social Policies have the opportunity to be housed, materially supported, returned to the education system, which results in the resocialization of all family members with the youngest members of society. The basic idea of the project is, the involvement of the entire community in the help of families that are declared the most vulnerable. / Projekat Kuća od srca ima za cilj zbrinjavanje najugroženijih porodica na teritoriji Republike Srbije. Ministarstvo rada i socijalne politike prepoznalo je zajedničke ciljeve i priključilo se projektu u pomoći pri zadovoljavanju osnovnih potreba ugroženih porodica. Porodice koje su dio projekta Kuća od srca uz podršku Ministarstva rada i socijalne politike imaju priliku da budu stambeno zbrinute, materijalno potpomognute, vraćene u obrazovni sistem, što rezultira resocijalizacijom svih članova porodice uz akcentovanje na najmlađe članove društva. Osnovna ideja projekta jeste, uključivanje cjelokupne zajednice u pomoć porodicama koje su od strane Ministarstva proglašene najugroženijim.

programme.title: DNA / DNK
programme.desc: Head of Natalija Simović, you have already had the opportunity to meet in the previous season, continues to visit our country and determine the doubt in parenting, the most accurate and most accurate DNA method. During the previous season, Natalija visited many families that were in conflict precisely because of suspicion of paternity, and you could see numerous interesting stories, with an unexpected outcome. In front of the team, led by Natalia, is many more unexplained and shocking stories, and they will try to solve the most interesting in the coming season. / Voditeljka Natalija Simović, koju ste već imali priliku da upoznate u prethodne sezone, nastavlja da obilazi našu zemlju i utvrđuje podudarnost u slučaju sumnje u roditeljstvo, najtačnijom i najpreciznijom DNK metodom. Tokom prethodne sezone, Natalija je posetila mnoge porodice koje su bile u sukobu upravo zbog sumnje u očinstvo, a mogli ste da vidite i brojne zanimljive priče, sa neočekivanim ishodom. Pred ekipom, na čelu sa Natalijom, je još mnogo nerazjašnjenih i potresnih priča, a one najinteresantnije pokušaće da reši u nastupajućoj sezoni.

Kroz svoju autorsku emisiju, Sanja Marinković će nastaviti da javne ličnosti pita sve ono što biste i vi željeli da znate, i baviće se zanimljivom, ali ponekad i škakljivom temom muško - ženskih odnosa. Kako bi svake sezone bila inovativna i opravdala povjerenje milionskog auditorijuma, Sanja pomno prati svjetske trendove i implementira ih u svoju autorsku emisiju, zbog čega je u domovima širom regiona subotnje popodne rezervisano upravo za Magazin In.

programme.title: Buried secretly / Zakopane tajne
programme.desc: The burrow series is a combination of TV Novela and family series, with a wide range of vibrant characters, which combines various genres: from the vortex of love and passion, the pronounced dramatic moments, the crime - plot, mystery and humor. In addition to the exciting story with many shocking crafts and surprises, in this series we follow the psychology of characters, whose lives are dramatically changing. Love, family, the crash of the world's rich and world, friendship, publishes, envy, a bitter struggle for money, the power of triler, the old family secrets that go light, mystery, with an abundance of drama, but also humor, with extremely colored characters. / Serija Zakopane tajne je kombinacija TV novele i porodične serije, sa širokom lepezom živopisnih likova, koja u sebi spaja različite žanrove: od vrtloga ljubavi i strasti, izrazitih dramskih momenata, do krimi - zapleta, misterija i humora. Pored uzbudljive priče sa mnogo šokantnih obrta i iznenađenja, u ovoj seriji pratimo psihologiju likova, čiji se životi dramatično mijenjaju. Ljubav, porodica, sudar svijeta bogatih i svijeta siromašnih, prijateljstva, izdaje, mućke, podmetanja, spletke, zavist, pohlijepa, iznevjerena očekivanja, ogorčena borba za novac, moć i uticaj, težnje za pravim vrijednostima, ali i elementi trilera, stare porodične tajne koje izlaze na vidjelo, misterije, uz obilje drame, ali i humora, sa izrazito koloritnim likovima.

programme.title: Take / Oteta
programme.desc: The story of the Orhun, who wants to revenge his sister, and hiri, which is a prisoner of his conscience ... Orhun is a successful businessman who grew up in a rich family without love with his sister by Nursah and his cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan went to work voluntarily as a doctor in Eritrea, but it was unable to contact, and her family was worried about her. As he seeks his sister, he encounters a hira, a poor girl who lives as a prisoner in the hands of people. When they learn that Nihan has poisoned and killed a local gang, Orhun breaks. When it turns out that Hira was actually the one who poisoned his sister, Orhun bitches the evil plan for revenge: he will take the hira home with him and make her worse. In the meantime, Afife, their mother, secretly held Orhun's father away from his childhood. Orhun decides to marry a hiree of revenge. Afife hates people of lower status and is obsessed with clean blood. Will this marriage close afife, or will a couple find redemption after paying all your obligations? / Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savjesti... Orhun je uspješan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao ljekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu djevojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog djetinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsjednuta je čistom krvlju. Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Feature film / Igrani film
programme.desc: Enjoy the film program of our television and relax with the feature film that we chose for you. / Uživajte uz filmski program naše televizije i opustite se uz igrani film koji smo za vas odabrali.

programme.title: Scena region / Scena region
programme.desc: The emission deals with the current developments from the familiar life, monitors important events on the domestic public scene and adopts a handful of interesting news, interviews and reports on the famous. The largest domestic and regional stars were spoken for this fun show about the famous and regional stars, and it is also the current news from the world of show, both domestic and foreign. The team of the show scene region brings all important news from life known and monitors all the most significant events, not only in the country, but also in the region. / Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Disadvantages of hearts and diadems / Nežna srca i dijademe
programme.desc: The action is happening in Edwardian in the early 20th. Century and shows how the depleted and humiliated son of the opera singer and aristocracy, makes the series of murders of their cousins and their wealth and the Vojvoding title. / Radnja se dešava u edvardijanskoj Britaniji početkom 20. veka i prikazuje kako osiromašeni i poniženi sin operskog pevača i aristokratkinje, čini seriju ubistava svojih rođaka kako bi nasledio njihovo bogatstvo i vojvodsku titulu.

programme.title: Lorens of Arabia / Lorens od Arabije
programme.desc: The story begins with the death of Lawrence in a motorcycle accident in London, when he was 47 years old. Then he returns us to the past, his youth. He was a respected officer in Cairo, and 1916. He received the task of investigating the growing hostility of the Arabs against the Turks, during the First World War. In the desert, he organized a guary, and led Arab rebels against the Turks. After numerous troubles, he manages to take the army to the north, and help the British general in the determination battle against the Ottoman Empire. / Priča počinje smrću Lorensa u nesreći na motociklu u Londonu, kada je imao 47 godina. Zatim nas vraća u prošlost, njegovu mladost. Bio je ugledan oficir u Kairu, i 1916. godine je dobio zadatak da istraži rastuće neprijateljstvo Arapa protiv Turaka, tokom Prvog svetskog rata. U pustinji, on je organizovao gerilu, i dve godine vodio arapske pobunjenike protiv Turaka. Posle brojnih nevolja, uspeva da odvede vojsku na sever, i pomogne britanskom generalu u odlučnoj bici protiv Otomanske imperije.

programme.title: Bitka na midveju / Bitka na Midveju
programme.desc: Six months after the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor are American planes 18. April 1942. bombarded Tokyo and several more Japanese cities. Therefore, it will approve the Admiral Jamamot, the Commander of the Japanese War Fleet, to implement a plan that has long prepared. He intends to take the US military base on the island of Midve in the Pacific Ocean, destroy the American fleet that is significantly weaker than Japanese and forced America to the capitulation. / Šest meseci nakon japanskog napada na Pearl Harbor američki su avioni 18. aprila 1942. bombardovali Tokio i još nekoliko japanskih gradova. Zbog toga će odobriti admiralu Jamamotu, zapovedniku japanske ratne flote, da sprovede plan koji je dugo pripremao. Namerava zauzeti američku vojnu bazu na ostrvu Midvej u Tihom okeanu, uništiti američku flotu koja je znatno slabija od japanske i prisiliti Ameriku na kapitulaciju.

programme.title: BruBejker / Brubejker
programme.desc: A new group of prisoners arrives in the U.S. South, and Among them and Henry Brubeeker. The Brubeeker witnesses the difficult conditions of life in prison, constant, often brutal violence and corruption that everyone accepts as a normal state of affairs. No one knows that Brubeeker is actually a new prison manager who pretends to be a prisoner, in order to personally meet prison conditions. / U zatvor na američkom jugu stiže nova grupa zatvorenika, a među njima i Henri Brubejker. Brubejker je svedok teškim uslovima života u zatvoru, neprestanom, neretko brutalnom nasilju i korupciji koju svi prihvataju kao normalno stanje stvari. Niko ne zna da je Brubejker zapravo novi upravnik zatvora koji se pretvara da je robijaš, kako bi lično upoznao zatvorske uslove.

programme.title: Exactly at 12 o'clock / Tačno u 12 sati
programme.desc: War drama on air force, ie suffering in the Second World War. It is a realistic overview of events in one elite war unit, described in sequences of depression, aggression, pride. The story of the strict general, which takes over the commandment of an elite bombardian unit, which is missing discipline. / Ratna drama o vazdušnim snagama, odnosno stradanjima u Drugom svetskom ratu. To je realističan prikaz dešavanja u jednoj elitnoj ratnoj jedinici, opisan u sekvencama depresije, agresivnosti, ponosa. Priča o strogom generalu, koji preuzima zapovedništvo nad jednom elitnom bombarderskom jedinicom, kojoj fali discipline.

programme.title: A blue angel / Plavi Anđeo
programme.desc: As a bachelor who constantly advocates puritanism and strict moral principles, Professor Rath is quite unpopular among students. When one day during classes in the student finds lola lola (M. Dietrich), Kabaretke singers in the local nightclub, Professor Rath decides to visit her and draw her harmful and immoral to his disciples. However, when he enters her wardrobe, Rath falls in love with a lush and an extremely attractive girl at first glance. When he also visits the next evening to return his underwear, which he stole from his pocket one of his students, Rath will not even notice how easy Lola seduces him and playing him. Including that he had never been happier in his life, Rath despite teasing students and warnings of the school warden (E. von Winterstein) to lose his job, quickly decides to marry Lolom. It does not serve that the non-real lola will soon turn it into real clown, that they will lose jobs in school and will become strenuous and boring. / Kao neženja koji neprestano zagovara puritanizam i stroga moralna načela, profesor Rath je prilično nepopularan među učenicima. Kad jednog dana tokom nastave kod đaka pronađe fotografije zanosne Lole Lole (M. Dietrich), kabaretske pevačice u lokalnom noćnom klubu, profesor Rath ju odluči posetiti i skrenuti joj pažnj na to da štetno i nemoralno deluje na njegove učenike. Međutim, kada uđe u njenu garderobu, Rath se na prvi pogled zaljubi u bujnu i izuzetno privlačnu devojku. Kad je poseti i sledeće večeri da bi joj vratio donje rublje koje je ukrao i u njegov džep podmetnuo jedan od njegovih učenika, Rath neće ni primetiti kako ga lako Lola zavodi i poigrava se njime. Zaključivši da nikad u životu nije bio srećniji, Rath se uprkos zadirkivanju učenika i upozorenjima školskog upravnika (E. von Winterstein) da bi mogao izgubiti posao, brzopleto odluči oženiti Lolom. Ne sluti da će ga neverna Lola ubrzo pretvoriti u pravog klovna, da će izgubiti posao u školi i da će supruzi postati naporan i dosadan.

programme.title: Marni / Marni
programme.desc: Psychological thriller from 1964. year, directed by Alfred Hitchchok, with a Tipi Hedren and a china conery in the main roles. Marni Edgar is a problematic young woman, which has a great fear of people and red. In addition, she loves and steals. He manifests the Secretary's job in a very cunning manner for which there is no reference, then steals confidential documents and disappears. A certain Mark falls in love with it, trying to help her change and compel her to marry him. Their honeymoon turns into the right catastrophe and Mark begins to explore horrific events from her childhood in order to save her. / Psihološki triler iz 1964. godine, u režiji Alfreda Hičkoka, sa Tipi Hedren i Šonom Konerijem u glavnim ulogama. Marni Edgar je problematična mlada žena, koja ima veliki strah od ljudi i crvene boje. Pored toga ona voli i da krade. Na vrlo lukav način manipuliše ljudima i dobija posao sekretarice za koji nema reference, zatim krade poverljiva dokumenta i nestaje. U nju se zaljubljuje izvesni Mark, koji pokušava da joj pomogne da se promeni i primorava je da se uda za njega. Njihov medeni mesec se pretvara u pravu katastrofu i Mark počinje da istražuje stravične događaje iz njenog detinjstva kako bi je spasio.

programme.title: Kramer Protiv Kramera / Kramer protiv Kramera
programme.desc: The TED Kramer's marketing wizard returns home after an extremely successful day at work and finds his wife Joanna packing the suitcases and leaves him. He neglected it somewhat, but her problems are still a deeper nature. The superbly educated and talented, she spent six years as a housewife worrying for their six-year-old Billy Son, and neglected himself and their wishes. She has to find himself and therefore goes and leaves her husband to take care of their son. Ted passes through the stage of anger, sadness and disbelief, and then slowly accepts a new situation. There is no idea how his wife is preparing breakfast or leading his son to school, he doesn't know him in essence at all, but I was teaching him anything soon. And just when the two people succeed in returning to normal, Joanna returns and seeks guardianship over a child. / Marketinški čarobnjak Ted Kramer vraća se kući nakon izuzetno uspešnog dana na poslu i pronađe svoju ženu Džoanu kako pakuje kofere i napušta ga. On ju je donekle zapostavio, ali njeni su problemi ipak dublje prirode. Vrhunski obrazovana i talentovana ona je šest godina provela kao domaćica brinući se za njihovog šestogodišnjeg sina Bilija, te zapostavila sebe i svoje želje. Ona mora pronaći sebe i stoga odlazi i ostavlja mužu da se za promenu brine za njihovog sina. Ted prolazi kroz fazu ljutnje, tuge i neverice, a zatim polako prihvata novu situaciju. Nema pojma kako njegova žena priprema doručak ili kako vodi sina u školu, on ga u suštini uopšte ne poznaje, no Bili ga ubrzo svemu poduči. I upravo kad njih dvojica uspeju vratiti život u normalu, vraća se Džoana i traži starateljstvo nad detetom.

programme.title: Sheriff in New York / Šerif u Njujorku
programme.desc: Kungan is a bit raw sheriff from Arizona, a cowboy coming on the task in New York, to take over a runway in James Ringermen's prisoner. Police Lieutenant Mc Elroj explains him that the killer recovered from the excessive amount of drugs in the hospital. Kugan manages to deceive Dr. Ringermen from the hospital earlier, but on the way to Ringermen's airport runs thanks to his cunning girlfriend and her helper beating Kugan as a little who until then. Kegan reviews the girl's file, she finds her in a club that is terribly looked like one twisted electric circus. This is by no means to be a favorite place for one real cowboy. / Kugan je pomalo sirovi šerif iz Arizone, kauboj koji dolazi na zadatak u Njujork, da bi preuzeo odbeglog zatvorenika Džejmsa Ringermena. Policijski poručnik Mek Elroj mu objašnjava da se ubica oporavlja od prekomerne količine droge u bolnici. Kugan uspeva da prevari doktore koji Ringermena otpuštaju iz bolnice ranije, ali na putu prema aerodromu Ringermen beži zahvaljujući svojoj lukavoj devojci i njenom pomagaču koji je prebio Kugana kao malo ko do tada. Kugan pregleda dosije od devojke, pronalazi je u klubu koji strahovito liči na jedan uvrnuti električni circus. To nikako ne može da bude omiljeno mesto za jednog pravog kauboja.

programme.title: Remagen bridge / Most kod Remagena
programme.desc: At the end of the Second World War, German forces retreated before the Allies, and the last obstacle is the bridge over the Rhine, with remagens. German forces want to destroy the bridge to prevent American penetration, but General Von Brok tries to preserve the bridge, because on the other hand, fifty thousand German soldiers remain. / Krajem Drugog svetskog rata nemačke snage se povlače pred Saveznicima, a poslednja prepreka je most preko Rajne, kod Remagena. Nemačke snage žele da unište most kako bi sprečile američki prodor, ali general von Brok pokušava da sačuva most, jer je s druge strane ostalo pedeset hiljada nemačkih vojnika.

programme.desc: June 1942. years. The British army is pulling under the attacks of General Romel, and a desorted John Bramble was the only survivor and stuck on the Egyptian border. programme.desc: Paid murderers Juls Vinfield and Vincent Vega, should be recovered by money stolen by their employer Marselas Volas. The story also includes a buč kulidge, a boxer at a career set, bribed by Marselas to lose his next match. / Plaćene ubice Džuls Vinfild i Vinsent Vega, treba da povrate novac koji je ukraden njihovom poslodavcu Marselas Volasu. Kao čovek od poverenja, Vinset Vega ima dodatni zadatak da nekoliko dana kasnije, kada Marselas bude van grada, izvede u provod Miu Volas, Marselasovu suprugu. U priču se uključuje i Buč Kulidž, bokser na zalasku karijere, potplaćen od strane Marselasa da izgubi svoj sledeći meč.

programme.title: Dolphin roads / Putevima delfina
programme.desc: The Protector of Dolphins decides to oppose the American Navy when he realized that one of their projects endangers the dolphins. / Zaštitnik delfina odlučuje da se suprostavi Američkoj mornarici kada shvati da jedan od njihovih projekata ugrožava delfine.

programme.title: Without output / Bez izlaza
programme.desc: Experienced filmophiles somewhere in the middle of this thriller realize that it was a big hour Rimejk from 1948. The main role of the Naval Officer interprets Kevin Kostner. At one party in Washington, he meets an elite prostitute played by Sean Young. The two spend the night together, to meet again after six months. Meanwhile, she became a mistress of the American Minister of Defense. Her new status is thrown in the whirlpool of conspiracy and intrigue at the political top. / Iskusni filmofili negde na sredini ovog trilera shvataju da je u pitanju rimejk Velikog sata iz 1948. Glavnu ulogu mornaričkog oficira tumači Kevin Kostner. Na jednoj zabavi u Vašingtonu, upoznaje elitnu prostitutku koju igra Šon Jang. Njih dvoje provode noć zajedno, da bi se ponovo sreli posle šest meseci. U međuvremenu, ona je postala ljubavnica američkog ministra odbrane. Njen novi status baca je u kovitlac zavere i intriga u samom političkom vrhu.

programme.title: Prank / Podvala
programme.desc: The Clifford Irving writer performed one of the largest media fraud in history, when he published a false biography of the controversial billionaire of Hauard Hujuz, the famous Mizanthrope. Design, carry out fraud, get the money was easy, but try to get out of it all ... It was all just not simply! / Pisac Kliford Irving izveo je jednu od najvećih medijskih prevara u istoriji, kada je objavio lažnu biografiju kontroverznog milijardera Hauarda Hjuza, poznatog mizantropa koji nikada nije davao intervjue.. Irving je tvrdio da je biografija napisana na osnovu intervjua koje mu je lično Hjuz dao. Osmisliti, sprovesti prevaru, dobiti novac bilo je lako, ali pokušati izvući se iz svega toga... bilo je sve samo ne jednostavno!

programme.title: Meta / Meta
programme.desc: Chris Loyd does not agree with his father. Walter is quiet, modest, cautious and too boring to your son. Chris gave up at the faculty in the intention of consecrating the career of racing car drivers. But all the plans they had fall into the water when Volter's wife Dona was kidnapped while traveling Europe. Trying to do everything in his power, Walter goes to Paris with his son. When they arrive in France, Chris will be shocked with knowing that his father was a top CIA agent. The two visit Voltair's friends in the hope of being able to find a don. Finally, Walter reveals that his wife was kidnapped by a spy that wants to take revenge on something that happened eighteen years ago. Walter must resort to the old ways of working to save his wife from the former colleague ... / Kris Lojd se nikako ne slaže sa svojim ocem. Volter je tih, skroman, oprezan i previše dosadan svom sinu. Kris je odustao od fakulteta u nameri da se posveti karijeri vozača trkačkih automobila. Ali, svi planovi koje su imali padaju u vodu kada Volterova supruga Dona bude kidnapovana dok je na proputovanju Evropom. Pokušavajući da učini sve što je u njegovoj moći, Volter odlazi u Pariz sa sinom. Kada stignu u Francusku, Kris će biti šokiran saznanjem da je njegov otac bio vrhunski agent CIA. Njih dvojica posećuju Volterove prijatelje u nadi da će uspeti da nađu Donu. Konačno, Volter otkriva da je njegovu suprugu oteo odmetnuti špijun koji želi da mu se osveti za nešto što se dogodilo pre osamnaest godina. Volter ponovo mora da pribegava starim načinima rada da bi spasio svoju suprugu od bivšeg kolege...

programme.title: SHERLOK HOLMS: Game of Senki / Šerlok Holms: Igra senki
programme.desc: Sherlock Holms have always been the smartest man in the room ... Until now. A new criminal genius, Professor Moriarti, and except that the Intellectual Holmes, his capacity for evil, was paired with the full absence of conscience. When the crowned Prince of Austria was found dead, the evidence point to suicide. But Sherlock Holms concludes that the Prince was a victim of murder - murder, which is just one part in a larger and much more dangerous puzzle designed by Professor Moriarti. Lunny Moriarti is always one step ahead of Holmes while the network of death and destruction is defiled - all within a larger plan that will, if he succeeds, change the course of history. / Šerlok Holms je oduvek bio najpametniji čovek u sobi... sve do sada. Na pozornicu je stupio novi kriminalni genije, profesor Moriarti i osim što je intelektualni Holmsov parnjak, njegov kapacitet za zlo, uparen sa potpunim odsustvom savesti, možda će mu dati prednost u odnosu na poznatog detektiva. Kada je krunisani princ Austrije pronađen mrtav, dokazi ukazuju na samoubistvo. Ali, Šerlok Holms zaključuje da je princ bio žrtva ubistva - ubistva koji je samo jedan deo u većoj i mnogo opasnijoj slagalici koju je osmislio profesor Moriarti. Lukavi Moriarti je uvek jedan korak ispred Holmsa dok raspreda mrežu smrti i uništenja - sve u sklopu većeg plana koji će, ako uspe, promeniti tok istorije.

programme.title: Killer from the lake / Ubica s jezera
programme.desc: Cops Lisa and Klovic met three years ago near the lake, while researching the disappearance of a young teenager. Their job took them somewhere else, on the banks of the second lake: Anesy, where they face a challenge of a new family life with his nine-month son Tom. While the couple takes over a demanding new investigation, Klovis gets secret calls and scary visions - and begins to discover the dark side. On top of everything, the corpses of two women were found, one after the other. Lisa and Klovis don't doubt: It's the work of the serial killer. This is again a painful memories for Lisa, which must face its past while Klovis faces its own demons. But the two of them will have to join and work as a team if they want to succeed in finding a killer ... / Policajci Lisa i Klovis upoznali su se pre tri godine u blizini jezera, dok su istraživali nestanak mladog tinejdžera. Njihov posao ih je odveo negde drugde, na obale drugog jezera: Anesi, gde se suočavaju s izazovom novog porodičnog života sa svojim devetomesečnim sinom Tomom. Dok par preuzima zahtevnu novu istragu, Klovis dobiva tajne pozive i zastrašujuće vizije - i počinje otkrivati mračnu stranu. Povrh svega, upravo su pronađeni leševi dve žene, jedan za drugim. Lisa i Klovis ne sumnjaju: to je delo serijskog ubice. Ovo ponovo budi bolna sećanja za Lise, koja se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću dok se Klovis suočava sa sopstvenim demonima. Ali njih dvoje će se morati udružiti i raditi kao tim ako žele uspeti pronaći ubicu...

programme.title: Four venues and funerals / Četiri venčanja i sahrana
programme.desc: Maja, boss communication Senator campaign in New York, gets a call for a wedding from a college friend who now lives in London. May leave his business and private life in New York to travel to England and connected with old friends, but there are their personal life crises. The links are established and terminated, political scandals are exposed, social life in London is ridiculed, love relationships flourish and vein, and of course, there are four weddings ... and funeral. / Maja, šefica komunikacija senatorske kampanje u Njujorku, dobija poziv za venčanje od prijateljice sa koledža koja sada živi u Londonu. Maja ostavlja svoj poslovni i privatni život u Njujorku da bi otputovala u Englesku i povezala se sa starim prijateljima, ali tamo je dočekaju njihove lične životne krize. Veze se uspostavljaju i raskidaju, politički skandali se razotkrivaju, društveni život u Londonu se ismeva, ljubavne veze cvetaju i venu, a naravno, pred njima su četiri venčanja... i sahrana.

programme.title: No other chance / Nema druge šanse
programme.desc: The world Alice Lambert crashed like a tower of cards after criminals fell into the home of her family, killed her husband and kidnapped their six-month baby. Once recovered from sustained injuries, Alice moves in search of her daughter ... / Svet Alis Lambert se srušio kao kula od karata nakon što su kriminalci upali u dom njene porodice, ubili njenog supruga i kidnapovali njihovu šestomesečnu bebu. Nakon što se oporavila od zadobijenih povreda, Alis kreće u potragu za svojom ćerkom...

programme.title: Zombie nation / Nacija zombija
programme.desc: Several years since the scary zombie virus was bursting now, these people found a man who survived the virus. He decided to put it urgently from New York to California to try to detect a virus drug in the only remaining laboratory. Although antibodies from that man are the only hope for the medicine, he hides a dark secret that could jeopardize them. / Nekoliko godina otkako je zastrašujući zombi virus poharao SAD, tim ljudi pronašao je čoveka koji je preživeo virus. Odluče ga hitno prebaciti iz Njujorka u Kaliforniju kako bi u jedinoj preostaloj laboratoriji pokušali otkriti lek za virus. Iako su antitela iz tog čoveka jedina nada za lek, on krije mračnu tajnu koja bi ih sve mogla ugroziti.

programme.title: Beware ... neighbors / Čuvaj se... komšije
programme.desc: The shop is located in a residential building in the vicinity of Madrid, and follows the life and mutual relations of its tenants. On top of everything, the corpses of two women were found, one after the other. Lisa and Klovis don't doubt: It's the work of the serial killer. This is again a painful memories for Lisa, which must face its past while Klovis faces its own demons. But the two of them will have to join and work as a team if they want to succeed in finding a killer ... / Policajci Lisa i Klovis upoznali su se pre tri godine u blizini jezera, dok su istraživali nestanak mladog tinejdžera. Njihov posao ih je odveo negde drugde, na obale drugog jezera: Anesi, gde se suočavaju s izazovom novog porodičnog života sa svojim devetomesečnim sinom Tomom. Dok par preuzima zahtevnu novu istragu, Klovis dobiva tajne pozive i zastrašujuće vizije - i počinje otkrivati mračnu stranu. Povrh svega, upravo su pronađeni leševi dve žene, jedan za drugim. Lisa i Klovis ne sumnjaju: to je delo serijskog ubice. Ovo ponovo budi bolna sećanja za Lise, koja se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću dok se Klovis suočava sa sopstvenim demonima. Ali njih dvoje će se morati udružiti i raditi kao tim ako žele uspeti pronaći ubicu...

programme.title: Four venues and funerals / Četiri venčanja i sahrana
programme.desc: Maja, boss communication Senator campaign in New York, gets a call for a wedding from a college friend who now lives in London. May leave his business and private life in New York to travel to England and connected with old friends, but there are their personal life crises. The links are established and terminated, political scandals are exposed, social life in London is ridiculed, love relationships flourish and vein, and of course, there are four weddings ... and funeral. / Maja, šefica komunikacija senatorske kampanje u Njujorku, dobija poziv za venčanje od prijateljice sa koledža koja sada živi u Londonu. Maja ostavlja svoj poslovni i privatni život u Njujorku da bi otputovala u Englesku i povezala se sa starim prijateljima, ali tamo je dočekaju njihove lične životne krize. Veze se uspostavljaju i raskidaju, politički skandali se razotkrivaju, društveni život u Londonu se ismeva, ljubavne veze cvetaju i venu, a naravno, pred njima su četiri venčanja... i sahrana.

programme.title: Fourth man / Četvrti čovek
programme.desc: The man wakes up after two months from which. Total amnesia. It does not remember anything that has to do with his previous life. He learns he had a wife. And a son. They were killed when he was wounded. The colonel, who claims his best friend, reveals his past identity. He is the Major Military Security Agency. Inspector who claims to have information on the death of his family is soon intervened in his life. Major comes out of the hospital. He tries to return to normal life. He faces emptiness and hopelessness. The only chance to reach its own identity again is to embark on the game offered by the inspector. That's why it agrees. U njegov život se ubrzo upliće i inspektor koji tvrdi da poseduje informacije o smrti njegove porodice. Major izlazi iz bolnice. Pokušava da se vrati u normalan život. Suočava se sa prazninom i beznađem. Jedina šansa da ponovo dođe do sopstvenog identiteta jeste da se upusti u igru koju mu nudi inspektor. Zato pristaje. U međuvremenu sreće Teodoru, nekadašnju ljubavnicu, koje se ne seća, ali ona u njemu prepoznaje novog čoveka.

programme.title: Ivkova Slava / Ivkova slava
programme.desc: Ivko is a distinguished nier craftsman. For which day, his fame will, Đurđevdan. That morning the door of his house opened widely called and unofficially. The whole day welcomes, richly served and wastes dozens of reputable guests. Before he and his paraskeva fall off his feet, his inseparable friends, a famous hunter, whose hunting fantasies doesn't believe, the kurk, called the enormous appetite, and Smuk, who can endlessly drink, and stay on his feet. Tog jutra vrata njegove kuće se širom otvaraju zvanim i nezvanim. Ceo dan dočekuje, bogato poslužuje i ispraća desetine uglednih gostiju. Predveče, kad on i njegova Paraskeva padnu s nogu, stižu, kako je to red, njegovi nerazdvojni prijatelji Kalča, poznati lovac, u čije lovačke fantazije niko ne veruje, Kurjak, nazvan po enormnom apetitu, i Smuk, koji može beskrajno da pije, a da ostane na nogama. Tu je i jedan momak o kome niko ništa ne zna. To je Svetislav, putujući glumac, koji je došao nezvan, sve idući za lepom Mariolom, koja pomaže domaćici. Ta četiri čoveka zasednu u kuću jednu noć, pa sutra, kad dolaze gosti ranga vladike, predsednika opštine i visokih vojnih lica, pređu u dvorište i tu sebi organizuju slavlje koje pred očima celog grada traje čitav taj dan, sledeću noć, pa i ceo treći dan. Trećeg dana Ivko je prinuđen da od predsednika opštine zatraži zaštitu.

programme.title: Protiv Kinga / Protiv Kinga
programme.desc: The children of the small town raise the money for the boat, which constantly takes off their bully. Not knowing how to resist him, in the arrival of the sickly rogue, the former boxer, see the hero of his dreams who give refuge in the hope of, recovering, to go to a duel with bully. Finally, the tramp will accept the fight with a physically stronger opponent, aware that there will be a battle that he will lose, but also that he will get something much more - love and trust of the son who was among children. / Deca malog grada skupljaju novac za čamac, koji im neprestano oduzima siledžija. Ne znajući kako da mu se odupru, u prispelom bolesnom skitnici, nekadašnjem bokseru, vide junaka svojih snova kome pružaju utočište u nadi da će, oporavljen, da izađe na dvoboj sa siledžijom. Konačno, skitnica će prihvatiti borbu sa fizički mnogo jačim protivnikom, svestan da će tu bitku da izgubi, ali i da će dobiti nesto mnogo više - ljubav i poverenje sina koji se nalazio među decom.

programme.title: Thrown / Odbačen
programme.desc: The film was discarded about a man in the late forties. These are years when nature ceases to take care of man, he denies his immunity and let him go down the water. The troubles of the main character is that he lives in the middle, which also loses immunity and which is released down the water. In order to survive in the transition situation, radical change and ascetic discipline is needed. The hero is with all his heart for changing the environment and life circumstances, but not to do it. He doesn't want to change, that is, he thinks he's late; He does not want to transfer his false sense of freedom, his bohemian, slope and hedonism. But he is a gentleman, he does not want to obstruct his middle, nation and the whole progressive world, his former friends, his child, and that's why he leaves forever ... / Film Odbačen govori o čoveku u kasnim četrdesetim godinama. Nevolja glavnog junaka je u tome što živi u sredini koja takođe gubi imunitet i koja je puštena niz vodu. Da bi se opstalo u tranzicionoj situaciji, potrebna je radikalna promena i asketska disciplina. Junak je svim srcem za promenu sredine i životnih okolnosti, ali ne da na sebe. On ne želi da se promeni, to jest, misli da je zakasnio; ne želi da transferiše svoje lažno osećanje slobode, svoju boemiju, aljkavost i hedonizam. programme.title: Age of Dundjerski / Doba Dunđerskih
programme.desc: The documentary filmed film brings a beautiful story of Laza Kostić poets and the youngest Lazar's daughter Jelena - Lenka, who wrote in honor by many the most beautiful Serbian song Santa Maria Della Salute. As he struggled to solve the overwhelm of the situation in which he found himself, Laza hid his crush on Lenka in all ways. In the end, he even participated in the efforts to find her groom, addressing his friend Nikola Tesla with the plan that he marries the richest and most desirable Serbian bridge of that time. All that intrigue interrupted Lenk's sudden death in one Viennese hotel. / Dokumentarno igrani film donosi predivnu priču o odnosu pesnika Laze Kostića i najmlađe Lazareve ćerke Jelene - Lenke, kojoj je u čast napisao po mnogima najlepšu srpsku pesmu Santa Maria della salute. Dok se borio da reši pretešku situaciju u kojoj se našao, Laza je na sve načini sakrivao svoju simpatiju ka Lenki. Na kraju je čak i učestvovao u naporima da joj se nađe mladoženja obraćajući se svom prijatelju Nikoli Tesli sa planom da on oženi najbogatiju i najpoželjniju srpsku udavaču tog vremena. Svu tu intrigu prekinula je Lenkina iznenadna smrt u jednom bečkom hotelu.

programme.desc: The film deals with the topic of the Serbian community that remained in Kosovo to live in small isolated communities - enclaves. What happens when someone passes in the enclave, and the cemetery is out of it, on the enemy territory? In this story, with a lot of peripetia, one eight-year old man will, however, thanks to his grandson, a ten-year-old boy who dared to do something impossible for both communities in Kosovo, and Serbian and Albanian and gain friends on the opposite side. / Film obrađuje temu srpske zajednice koja je ostala na Kosovu da živi u malim izolovanim zajednicama - enklavama. Primorani na ovakav život, ograničeni da žive na skučenom prostoru, Srbi koji su ostali da žive na Kosovu i Metohiji žive svoje živote na veoma težak način. Šta se dešava kad neko premine u enklavi, a groblje se nalazi van nje, na neprijateljskoj teritoriji? U ovoj priči, uz mnogo peripetija, jedan osamdesetogodišnji starac će, ipak, biti sahranjen zahvaljujući svom unuku, desetogodišnjem dečaku koji se usudio da učini nešto nemoguće za obe zajednice na Kosovu, i srpsku i albansku: da zavoli i stekne prijatelja na suprotnoj strani.

programme.title: Nightmare / Košmar
programme.desc: The club band is unsuccessfully looking for its chance under the stars until the basist, after one bad assessment and romantic recklessness, does not become a vampire. Nevertheless, the band moves on tour, and new circumstances make them new followers and new challenges and distress. / Klupski bend bezuspešno traži svoju šansu pod zvezdama sve dok basistkinja, nakon jedne loše procene i romantične nesmotrenosti, ne postane vampirica. I pored toga, bend kreće na turneju, a nove okolnosti im donose kako nove sledbenike, tako i nove izazove i nevolje.

programme.title: Monsters / Čudovišta
programme.desc: NASA revealed the existence of aliens in the solar system and the probe that was launched to collect samples collapsed upon return over Central America. Shortly afterwards, a new form of life begins and half Mexico was declared quarantine as an infected zone. The American and Mexican army are still struggling to stop creatures ... The whole chaos of journalists agrees to follow the crazy tourist through the infected zone in Mexico, to Safe USA borders. / NASA je otkrila postojanje vanzemaljaca u Sunčevom sistemu i sonda koja je lansirana za prikupljanje uzoraka srušila se po povratku iznad Srednje Amerike. Ubrzo nakon toga počinje da se pojavljuje novi oblik života i pola Meksika je proglašeno karantinom kao zaražena zona. Američka i meksička vojska se i dalje bore da zaustave bića... U čitavom haosu novinarka pristaje da prati ludog turistu kroz zaraženu zonu u Meksiku, do sigurne SAD granice.

programme.title: Stan 32 / Stan 32
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, the century. Century, the Olmedo family buys an apartment 32 in Manuel Malasenja Street, in the old part of Madrid. Leaving a little provincial place left the way the capital that offers them prosperity and dream life. But there is something that Olmedi don't know: In the apartment they bought - they are not alone. Unexplained phenomena that accompany them in the rate will soon endanger their lives ... in the film, which is based on true events, the fight to life or death begins. / Krajem sedamdesetih godina 20. veka, porodica Olmedo kupuje stan 32 u ulici Manuela Malasenja, u starom delu Madrida. Napuštajući malo provincijsko mesto krenuli su put prestonice koja im nudi prosperitet i život iz snova. Ali, postoji nešto što Olmedovi ne znaju: u stanu koji su kupili - nisu sami. Neobjašnjive pojave koje ih prate u stopu uskoro će im ugroziti živote… U filmu, koji je zasnovan na istinitim događajima, počinje borba na život ili smrt.

programme.title: Gulisi 4 / Gulisi 4
programme.desc: Gulisi again manage to pass through the portal and come to Los Angeles, where, looking for a path to the house, make up the massacre. The last fight between them and a police officer begins who does not respect the rules ... / Gulisi opet uspeju da prođu kroz portal i dolaze u Los Anđeles, gde, tražeći put do kuće, čine masakr. Počinje poslednja borba između njih i policajca koji ne poštuje pravila...

programme.title: Urban Caption / Urbana legenda
programme.desc: They all heard about urban legends even though their source is not possible to detect. These are modern fairy tales that take pictures of vivid forms, and then continue to live in human conscripts. When stories about the strange death start to circle the student's city of one college, the Natali student begins to suspect that urban legends someone realize in an ominous way. Her friend brand, ambitious journalist POL and the main prankster in the class, Damon, insisting that the murders are pure coincidence despite unusual circumstances. But when Natali is too close to the discovery of what the urban legend turns into reality, they realize that it could become the next victim itself. / Svi su čuli za urbane legende iako im izvor nije moguće otkriti. To su savremene bajke koje poprimaju živopisne oblike, a potom nastavljaju da žive u svestima ljudi. Kada priče o čudnovatoj smrti počnu da kruže studentskim gradom jednog koledža, studentkinja Natali počinje da sumnja da urbane legende neko ostvaruje na zloslutan način. Njena prijateljica Brenda, ambiciozni novinar Pol i glavni šaljivdžija u klasi, Dejmon, insistiraju na tome da su ubistva čista slučajnost uprkos neobičnim okolnostima. Ali, kada se Natali isuviše približi otkrivanju onoga koji urbane legende pretvara u stvarnost, shvata da bi i sama mogla da postane sledeća žrtva.

programme.title: Halloween / Noć veštica
programme.desc: Michael Majers returns in this terrifying continuation of the visionary reflection of the witch's goods of the goods Zombies. Again, that day of the year and Michael Majers returns to Stalominated Hedonfield in Illinois, not to take care of some unfinished family affairs. But the city has a new hero, provided it manages to survive long enough to prevent unstoppable ... / Majkl Majers se vraća u ovom zastrašujućem nastavku vizionarskog promišljanja Noći veštica Roba Zombija. Opet je taj dan u godini i Majkl Majers se vraća u učmali Hedonfild u Ilinoisu, ne bi li se pobrinuo za neke nezavršene porodične poslove. Ali grad ima novog heroja, pod uslovom da uspe da preživi dovoljno dugo da spreči nezaustavljivo...

programme.title: Psychosis / Psihoza
programme.desc: Susan arrives in a remote farmhouse in England to find inspiration for a new book. She does not know that her new home hides a dark past. Namely 12 years before her arrival, a frightening crime occurred in the same place. A crime whose consequences can be felt today. / Suzan stiže u zabačenu seosku kuću u Engleskoj kako bi pronašla inspiraciju za novu knjigu. Ona ne zna da njen novi dom skriva mračnu prošlost. Naime 12 godina pre njenog dolaska na istom se mestu dogodio zastrašujući zločin. Zločin čiji se posledice mogu osetiti i danas.

programme.title: Lost guys / Izgubljeni momci
programme.desc: Sam and his older brother Michael are typical American teenagers. But when they reached the california in California in California. There they reveal that local teenagers are vampires. Of course, no one believes them and are forced to fight themselves. / Sem i njegov stariji brat Majkl su tipični američki tinejdžeri. Ali kada se dosele u mirni gradić u Kaliforniji sve se menja. Tamo otkrivaju da su lokalni tinejdžeri vampiri. Naravno, niko im ne veruje i prinuđeni su da se sami izbore sa njima.

programme.title: Bloody city / Krvavi grad
programme.desc: The investigator of the batch of murders reveals that the ancient tribal sorcerer is guilty of murder ... / Istražitelj serije ubistava prostitutki otkriva da je za ubistva kriv drevni plemenski vrač...

programme.title: Gargoylova osveta / Gargojlova osveta
programme.desc: The two CIA agents were invited to Bucharest in order to solve the case of abduction of an important and very famous person as faster and without raising unnecessary media pompa as possible. However, when they arrive in Romania, she will realize that they don't have work with ordinary kidnappers, but with dangerous, monstrous force. Abuse, which was thought to have been exiled forever, is the eager for revenge back? / Dvoje agenata CIA pozvano je u Bukurešt kako bi što brže i bez dizanja nepotrebne medijske pompe rešili slučaj otmice važne i jako poznate osobe. Međutim, kada stignu u Rumuniju, shvatiće kako nemaju posla s običnim otmičarima, nego s opasnom, čudovišnom silom. Zloduh, za kojeg se mislilo da je zauvek prognan, vraća se željan osvete?

programme.title: Cold heads / Hladne glave
programme.desc: Lieutenant John Barton was sent to a special mission to deliver a special vaccine to a remote mining colony. He broke out what he found, a blind passenger in his spacecraft. Barton has only fuel enough to bring himself and his precious load, and her extra weight ensures that it will crash if she stays on board. They went too far to return, and Barton's superiors clearly put it to knowledge: the mission has an advantage and should be thrown into space. But she won't go just like that, quietly. / Poručnik Džon Barton je poslat u specijalnu misiju da isporuči specijalnu vakcinu u udaljenu rudarsku koloniju. Razbesneo je što je pronašao Li, slepu putnicu u njegovoj letelici. Barton ima samo dovoljno goriva da ponese sebe i svoj dragoceni teret, a njena dodatna težina osigurava da će se srušiti, ako ona ostane na brodu. programme.title: Lost guys / Izgubljeni momci

programme.desc: When the ship with a group of friends fell apart after the storm, the sea throws them into the jungle of the unexplored islands, where one by one is a kanibal, which evolution has forgotten. programme.title: Fear of darkness / Strah od mraka
programme.desc: The blind boy before eye surgery becomes obsessed with violence, and slowly being trapped in their misconceptions, so it becomes convinced that the killer, mixing illusions and reality. / Slepi dečak pred operaciju očiju postaje opsednut nasiljem, i polako biva zarobljen u svojim zabludama, pa tako postaje ubeđen da je ubica, mešajući iluzije i stvarnost.

programme.title: Animalia / Animalija
programme.desc: Follow 11-year-old Zoe and Alex into a fascinating and exciting world. Their great adventure adventure begins when in the library due to a series of strange events, suddenly find themselves in the country of the animals that speak. Their arrival is closely linked to strange events that increasingly weaken this unusual civilization and the heart of Animali, mag. Our main heroes with the help of a sharp intellect and creativity GBUBU and Iguane Igi try to find the solution to these mysterious events and re-establish order and harmony in the country of Animalija. / Pratite 11-godišnju Zoe i Aleksa u fascinantan i uzbudljiv svet. Njihova velika životna avantura započinje kada se u biblioteci usled niza čudnih događaja, odjedanput nađu u zemlji životinja koje govore. Zoe i Aleks ubrzo otkrivaju da nešto nije u redu u nekada tako mirnom kraljevstvu. Njihov dolazak usko je povezan sa čudnim događajima koji sve više slabe ovu neuobičajenu civilizaciju i srce Animalije, Mag. Naši glavni junaci uz pomoć oštrog intelekta i kreativnosti gorile GBubu i iguane Igi pokušavaju pronaći rešenje ovih misterioznih događaja i ponovo uspostaviti red i harmoniju u zemlji Animaliji.

programme.title: Baltazar / Baltazar
programme.desc: Professor Baltazar is an animated humorous series made in the period from 1967. until 1978. in Zagreb film. It consists of a total of 59 episodes that last from 5 to 10 minutes. The author of the series is the Croatian Animator Zlatko Grgić, and the recognizable introductory topic was written by the famous composer of Film Music Tomislav Simović. The series became very popular, and recorded a solid success and was broadcast in countries such as Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Sweden and Iran. The action revolves around the unusual scientist of Balthazar, which with the help of their inventions facilitates the lives of other people from Baltazar. / Profesor Baltazar je animirana humoristička serija pravljena u periodu od 1967. do 1978. u Zagreb filmu. Sastoji se od ukupno 59 epizoda koje traju od 5 do 10 minuta. Autor serijala je hrvatski animator Zlatko Grgić, a prepoznatljivu uvodnu temu napisao je poznati kompozitor filmske muzike Tomislav Simović. Serija je postala vrlo popularna, a zabeležila je solidan uspeh i emitovana je u zemljama kao što su Danska, Finska, Holandija, Norveška, Portugal, Švedska i Iran. Radnja se vrti oko nesvakidašnjeg naučnika Baltazara koji uz pomoć svojih izuma olakšava živote drugih ljudi iz Baltazar - grada.

programme.title: Medvedic of a good heart / Medvedići dobrog srca

programme.title: The first bastard of Serbia / Prvi kuvar Srbije
programme.desc: The real treat for all lovers of the Gastronomic show program will be the new TV PINK format, which is the title of the first chef of Serbia. programme.desc: Your thoughts - our topics slogan is the show magazine in. programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people together solve the problems they would never have to be together. They are constantly arguing, but it should not be different. When love becomes a habit of whether everything becomes panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rješavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno. Oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije. Oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu. Oni su srećni u svađama, nevjerovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje. Kada ljubav postane navika da li sve postaje panika.

Ali Paula u potpunosti prihvata svoj novi identitet, preuzimajući Kendinu karijeru i dečka, da bi na kraju izbacila Kendi iz sopstvene kuće! Kendi sada mora da preživi u stvarnom svetu dok se Paula grčevito drži krhkog, ali slavnog života o kojem je oduvek sanjala.

programme.title: Put u Kosmos / Put u Kosmos
programme.desc: This film is about the emergence of the American space program, following the Astronauts of the first program under the name Merkjuri, for 15 years. programme.title: Challenger / Izazivač
