programme.title: Civic litigation / Građanska parnica
programme.desc: Jan Šlitman, a lawyer who is a tough nut, takes over the case of eight families whose children have died of leukemia, threw a toxic waste from which the city was supplied with the lawyers of these companies, the battle in which everyone will survive. / Jan Šlitman, advokat koji je tvrd orah, preuzima slučaj osam porodica čija su deca umrla od leukemije nakon što su dve velike korporacije bacale toksični otpad u reku iz koje se taj grad snabdeva i upušta se u nemilosrdnu bitku sa advokatima tih kompanija, bitku u kojoj će jedva svi preživeti.

programme.title: Steno / Steno
programme.desc: After he maintained the violence that he committed in the youth, once a promising baseball player returned to his neighborhood in the Bronx. / Nakon što je 17 godina odrobijao zbog nasilja koje je počinio u mladosti, nekada obećavajući bejzbol igrač vraća se u svoj komšiluk u Bronksu.

programme.title: Big boss / Veliki gazda
programme.desc: The classic story of honor and revenge, the charismatic action Brus Lia has strengthened his status of King Kung Fu, around the world. Shanghai in the early 20th century. Young student of the school of borilic skills, Chen Zen returns home, to discover the tragic murder of his teacher, committed by the notorious church of Japanese martial arts. On the edge of the bess, Chen Zen takes himself to explore the murder of his teacher, finding the perpetrators and demonstrates his way of revenge with strong shocks. / Klasična priča o časti i osveti, harizmatična akcija Brus Lija je učvrstila njegov status kralja kung fua, širom sveta. Šangaj početkom 20 veka. Mladi učenik škole borilčkih veština, Čen Zen se vraća kući, kako bi otkrio tragično ubistvo njegovog učitelja, počinjenog od strane ozloglašene suparničke škole japanskih borilačkih veština. Na ivici besa, Čen Zen uzima na sebe da istraži ubistva njegovog učitelja, pronađe počinitelje i demonstrira svoj način osvete uz jake udarce.

programme.title: When the look could be killed / Kada bi izgled mogao da ubije
programme.desc: Michael Corben falls on the exam from French and can't graduate. The assessment is forced to correct by going to Europe with the French club. However, in the same plane, another Michael Corben, an international spy, was killed during the summer. When the British intelligence replacements for the agent, young Corben is convinced of how it could be an interesting experience. It surrounds him with handsome girls, he gets a car, a number of toys, but also the enemy who wants him dead. The only thing you need to do now is to protect the beautiful girl, save Europe and graduate. / Majkl Korben pada na ispitu iz francuskog i zbog toga ne može maturirati. Ocenu je prisiljen ispraviti odlaskom u Evropu sa francuskim klubom. Međutim, u istom avionu je još jedan Majkl Korben, međunarodni špijun, ubijen tokom leta. Kad britanski obaveštajci zamene srednjoškolca za agenta, mladi Korben uveren je kako bi to moglo biti zanimljivo iskustvo. Okruže ga zgodne devojke, dobije automobil, brojne igračke, ali i neprijatelja koji ga želi mrtvog. Jedino što sada treba napraviti je zaštititi prelepu devojku, spasiti Evropu i maturirati.

programme.title: Neotkriveno / Neotkriveno
programme.desc: A story about a group of entertainers trying to create a career under the lights of Los Angeles. Onions and bri are two young and beautiful people accidentally encountered in the New York Metro, where they fall in love at first sight. However, each of them goes its own way, Bridge becomes a successful model, with large plans for acting careers ... / Priča o grupi zabavljača koja pokušava da stvori karijeru pod svetlima Los Anđelesa. Luk i Bri su dvoje mladih i lepih ljudi koji se slučajno susreću u njujorškom metrou, gde se na prvi pogled zaljubljuju. Međutim, svako od njih odlazi svojim putem, Bri postaje uspešna manekenka, sa velikim planovima za glumačku karijeru...

programme.title: Vod / Vod
programme.desc: The young man just came out of college and full of enthusiasm volunteers and goes to war. There is facing countless horror of the Vietnam War, where his platoon patrolls, fights and dies in jungles. Two veterans are conflicted after one of them massacreds innocent inhabitants and a young soldier who are both of them soon to run two battles, and another formed from the conflict of soldiers in his water. / Mladić je tek izašao iz koledža i pun entuzijazma volontira i odlazi u rat. Tu se suočava sa bezbroj užasa Vijetnamskog rata, gde njegov vod patrolira, bori se i umire u džunglama. Dva vodnika veterana se sukobljavaju nakon što je jedan od njih masakrirao nevine stanovnike jednog seoceta i mladi vojnik kome su obojica nadređeni će uskoro voditi dve bitke, jednu protiv neprijatelja, i drugu koja je nastala iz konflikta vojnika u njegovom vodu.

programme.title: Bafalo soldiers / Bafalo vojnici
programme.desc: Defending in one military base located in the West Germany in front of the Soviet Death, the soldier of Ray Elvud, the Colonel Veles Berman and sleeping with his dissatisfied woman, manages to fix his life as he can only dream of. Local blackzers sell everything that fails steal in inexhaustible military warehouses, and their colleagues drugs made in their own laboratory. Money just presses, and where there is money there are everything else needed for infinite partying. As long as one day a good soldier does not fall in love with Lep Robin, the daughter of Vietnam Veterans, Sergeant Robert Leah. The Berlin Wall is just falling and the Cold War ends, but the unsteaded war between the strict officer and the fourth class debassion just begins. / Braneći u jednoj vojnoj bazi smeštenoj u Zapadnoj Nemačkoj američke vrednosti pred sovjetskom pogibelji, vojnik Rej Elvud, ulizujući se svom nesposobnom nadređenom, pukovniku Velesu Bermanu i spavajući s njegovom nezadovoljnom ženom, uspeva da sredi život o kakvom se u civilstvu može samo sanjati. Lokalnim crnoberzijancima prodaje sve što uspe ukrasti u neiscrpnim vojnim skladištima, a svojim kolegama drogu napravljenu u sopstvenoj laboratoriji. Novac samo pritiče, a gde ima novca ima i svega ostaloga potrebnog za beskonačno tulumarenje. Sve dok se jednoga dana dobri vojnik ne zaljubi u lepu Robin, ćerku vijetnamskog veterana, narednika Roberta Lija. Berlinski zid upravo pada i Hladni rat završava, ali bespoštedni rat između strogog oficira i raspusnog vojnika četvrte klase tek započinje.

programme.desc: Veteran from World War II takes justice into his own hands when his neighborhood starts terrorizing gangs and drug dealers. / Veteran iz Drugog svetskog rata uzima pravdu u svoje ruke kada njegov komšiluk počnu terorisati bande i dileri droge.

programme.title: Carla's Christmas wish / Čarlina Božićna želja
programme.desc: When the Veteran John Hall returns home to Christmas, and he does not seem to wake the Holiday Spirit, a new family member, Charlie, he believes his mission to help him find the right path. John finds inspiration in a lively new terrier of his son, which helps the city together to gather and build homes for displaced veterans. / Kad se veteran Džon Hol vrati kući na Božić, a izgleda da ne može da probudi praznični duh, novi član porodice, Čarli, smatra da mu je misija da mu pomogne da nađe pravi put. Džon pronalazi inspiraciju u živahnom novom terijeru svog sina, koji pomaže da se grad na vreme okupi i izgradi domove za raseljene veterane.

programme.title: Very good girls / Veoma dobre devojke
programme.desc: This gentle and sensitive drama about young people follows two New York teenagers and events that burden their connection during the last summer of their adolescence. Lili is withdrawn, imagined and introspective. On the other hand, Jerry is free, open and mildly in orderly. Just before going to college, girls spend a lot of time together, enjoying a pleasant afternoons, but they both soon fall in love with the same guy - an artist David, which sells ice cream in Rocavej Bic. He realizes that Lili likes him more than Jerry and Lily loses innocence with him. The affair becomes more serious, but Lily can't tell Jerry what happened, because it's afraid she'll break her heart ... / Ova nežna i osetljiva drama o mladima prati dve njujorške tinejdžerke i događaje koji opterećuju njihovu vezu za vreme poslednjeg leta njihove adolescencije. Lili je povučena, zamišljena i introspektivna. S druge strane, Džeri je slobodoumna, otvorena i blago zajedljiva. Neposredno pre odlaska na koledž, devojke provode mnogo vremena zajedno, uživajući u prijatnim popodnevima, ali obe se uskoro zaljubljuju u istog momka - umetnika Dejvida, koji prodaje sladoled u Rokavej Biču. On shvata da mu se Lili dopada više nego Džeri i Lili gubi nevinost s njim. Afera postaje ozbiljnija, ali Lili ne može da kaže Džeri šta se desilo, jer se plaši da će joj to slomiti srce...

programme.desc: Once Happiness turned his back, Gary breaks into financial difficulties. It is associated with charismatic young poker, Kurtis, would not begin to get on the maps. programme.title: Nobel prize / Nobelova nagrada
programme.desc: The Nobel Prize is an international award, which granted Swedish and Norwegian institutions annually, as a sign of recognition for academic, cultural, and / or scientific achievements. / Nobelova nagrada je internacionalna nagrada, koju godišnje dodeljuju švedske i norveške institucije, kao znak priznanja za akademska, kulturna, i/ili naučna dostignuća.

programme.title: Wonderful nature / Čudesna priroda
programme.desc: Documentary series that gives you the opportunity to go on an exciting journey and get to know the numerous miracles of nature! Visit the different ends of the world and get to know the plant and animal species you have not known before. / Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

programme.title: Holy Heritage / Svetska baština
programme.desc: The documentary series Svetjska heritage deals with the most famous Holy painters, their parts and the stories that are hiding behind them. / Dokumentarni serijal Svetska baština bavi se najpoznatijim svetskim slikarima, njihovim delima i pričama koje se kriju iza njih.

programme.title: To the religious monuments / Verski spomenici
programme.desc: The documentary series religious monuments brings views of artistic and architectural achievements that are woven into temples and churches around the world. / Dokumentarni serijal Verski spomenici donosi pogled na umetnička i arhitektonska dostignuća koja su utkana u hramove i crkve širom sveta.

programme.title: Almost the truth / Skoro pa istina
programme.desc: Have fun with this humorous, animated series that will introduce us to a real person in just a few minutes, or a fictional character. / Zabavite se uz ovaj šaljivi, animirani serijal koji će nam u svega nekoliko minuta predstaviti neku stvarnu osobu, ili pak izmišljeni lik.

programme.title: Liberation Day / Dan oslobođenja
programme.desc: Under the kind, but the solid guidelines of the old fan, which became a director and cultural diplomat, and on the surprise of the whole world, the cult band Leibah from the former Yugoslavia became the first foreign rock-group that performed in the State-Fortress North Korea. Faced with strict ideology and cultural differences, the band is struggling to pierce their poems through the needling ears of censorship, before reaching the audience that has never had the opportunity to hear an alternative rock-en-roll. Meanwhile, propaganda speakers are placed on the border between the two Korea, and the countdown was announced until the beginning of the war. programme.title: Daydreams of a networked holy / Sanjarenja umreženog sveta
programme.desc: Director Verner Hercog reconstructs the virtual world, starting to the end of its range, exploring the digital background with the same curiosity and creativity he approached different terrestrial areas, such as Amazon, Sahara, South Pole and abandoned areas of Australia. The Hercog viewer leads to a single journey, through a number of provocative talks that reveal how the world has transformed the way in which the real world works - from trade to education to health, all the way to the central issue of human behavior in society. / Reditelj Verner Hercog rekonstruiše virtuelni svet, počev od njegovog postanka, sve do krajnjih dometa, istražujući digitalnu pozadinu sa istom radoznalošću i kreativnošću kojima je pristupao različitim zemaljskim predelima, poput Amazona, Sahare, Južnog pola i napuštenih predela Australije. Hercog gledaoce vodi na jedinstveno putovanje, kroz niz provokativnih razgovora koji otkrivaju kako je onlajn svet transformisao način na koji realni svet funkcioniše - od trgovine do obrazovanja, od putovanja u svemir do zdravstva, sve do središnjeg pitanja ljudskog ponašanja u društvu.

programme.title: Why do I jump / Zašto skačem
programme.desc: Based on the bestseller of Higašide, the reason why I jump is ... is a filmmaking and researching our neurological difference through experiences of muric and autistic people around the world. The film is a combination of hyguisids of personal experiences of autism, written when he was only 13 years old, with the intimate portraits of five extraordinary young people. He opens us the door of the sensual universe, powerful and comprehensive, often joyful. Thoroughly monitored moments from life of each of the five characters are connected by motifs and paragraphs from the book. The film is following the Japanese boy who travels through the epic landscape gradually revealing what his autism represents, how his world's notion differs, and why he behaves in the way he behaves, and after all: why they jump. The film winced all these elements in a sensually rich visual story that leads us to the core of the glasses: if someone can't talk, doesn't mean there's nothing to say. / Baziran na bestseleru Naokija Higašide, Razlog zbog kog skačem je... je filmsko uranjanje i istraživanje naše neurološke različitosti kroz iskustva nemih i autističnih ljudi širom sveta. Film je spoj Higašidinih ličnih doživljaja autizma, napisanih kada je imao samo 13 godina, sa intimnim portretima petoro izvanrednih mladih ljudi. Otvara nam vrata čulnog univerzuma, moćnog i sveobuhvatnog, često i radosnog. Temeljno praćeni momenti iz života svakog od pet likova povezani su motivima i odlomcima iz knjige. Film prati japanskog dečaka koji putuje kroz epski pejzaž postepeno otkrivajući šta njegov autizam predstavlja, kako se njegovo poimanje sveta razlikuje, i zašto se ponaša na način na koji se ponaša, i na kraju krajeva: zašto skače. Film je sve ove elemente utkao u čulno bogatu vizuelnu priču koja nas vodi do srži Naokijeve poruke: Ako neko ne ume da priča, ne znači da nema šta i da kaže.

programme.title: Some better people / Neki bolji ljudi
programme.desc: Some better people are a family series whose main heroes are represented by members of the Urošević family and Graovac. The drama action is initiated by events that lead to the situation in situations through which their personal interests and ambitions will be expressed, striving for strong mutual emotions. Three generations under one roof, in the neighbor's apartments Graovac and Urošević, represent the ideal terrain for the conflicts of generations and the value systems, but also a fine humor. Đuro and his wife Jovanka belong to the post-war, Baby Bum generation, worked and educated children in the socialist spirit. Dragan and Marija are representatives of the Generation X, which spent the best years of his life during the 1990s last century. And while Mary managed to be highly positioned in the business hierarchy, Dragan accepted the role of housewives in the house. Nikola, Sarah and Filip are children of a new millennium, a generation that life on the net is equally important as reality. However, when they catch up with the original urges, as love, they will be forced to turn to themselves and face feelings. Then they slowly begin to realize that you can't hide in the virtual world from reality. The Graovac family - Urošević is under constant pressure with which it can be seen in and can, and rather often neither knows, nor can it. Children press the challenges and temptations of growing up, parents' expectations and parents themselves; Parents are pressed by marital problems and children, and grandparents - family and existential problems. How our heroes will be worn with them and whether they will become some after all / Neki bolji ljudi porodična je serija čije glavne junake predstavljaju članovi porodice Urošević i Graovac. Dramsku radnju pokreću događaji koji protagoniste dovode u situacije kroz koje će se ispoljiti njihovi lični interesi i ambicije, prožeti jakim međusobnim emocijama. Tri generacije pod jednim krovom, u komšijskim stanovima Graovac i Urošević, predstavljaju idealan teren za sukobe generacija i sistema vrednosti ali i fini humor. Đuro i njegova žena Jovanka pripadaju posleratnoj, bejbi bum generaciji koja se školovala, radila i vaspitala decu u socijalističkom duhu. Dragan i Marija su predstavnici generacije X koja je najbolje godine svog života potrošila tokom devedesetih godina 20 veka prošlog veka. I dok je Marija uspela da se visoko pozicionira u poslovnoj hijerarhiji, Dragan je prihvatio ulogu domaćice u kući. Nikola, Sara i Filip su deca novog milenijuma, generacija kojoj je život na mreži podjednako važan kao i realnost. Ipak, kad ih sustignu iskonski porivi, kao što je ljubav, biće prinuđeni da se okrenu sebi i suoče sa osećanjima. Tada polako počinju shvatati da se u virtuelnom svetu ne možeš sakriti od stvarnosti. Porodica Graovac - Urošević je pod konstantnim pritiskom s kojim se mosi kako zna i ume, a prilično često niti zna, niti ume. Decu pritiskaju izazovi i iskušenja odrastanja, očekivanja roditelja i sami roditelji; roditelje pritiskaju bračni problemi i deca, a babu i dedu - porodični i egzistencijalni problemi. Kako će se naši junaci sa njima nositi i da li će posle svega postati neki

Grozdin mlađi sin Ljubiša je nastavnik matematike permanentno nesrećan u ljubavi. Njena ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica , čiji doživljaj života zapravo shvataju jedino oženjeni muškarci. Stariji sin Siniša, po zanimanju obućar, navučen je na pivo, slab na žene, a pomalo i one na njega. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. programme.title: Some better people / Neki bolji ljudi
programme.desc: Some better people are a family series whose main heroes are represented by members of the Urošević family and Graovac. The drama action is initiated by events that lead to the situation in situations through which their personal interests and ambitions will be expressed, striving for strong mutual emotions. Three generations under one roof, in the neighbor's apartments Graovac and Urošević, represent the ideal terrain for the conflicts of generations and the value systems, but also a fine humor. Đuro and his wife Jovanka belong to the post-war, Baby Bum generation, worked and educated children in the socialist spirit. Dragan and Marija are representatives of the Generation X, which spent the best years of his life during the 1990s last century. And while Mary managed to be highly positioned in the business hierarchy, Dragan accepted the role of housewives in the house. Nikola, Sarah and Filip are children of a new millennium, a generation that life on the net is equally important as reality. However, when they catch up with the original urges, as love, they will be forced to turn to themselves and face feelings. Then they slowly begin to realize that you can't hide in the virtual world from reality. The Graovac family - Urošević is under constant pressure with which it can be seen in and can, and rather often neither knows, nor can it. Children press the challenges and temptations of growing up, parents' expectations and parents themselves; Parents are pressed by marital problems and children, and grandparents - family and existential problems. How our heroes will be worn with them and whether they will become some after all / Neki bolji ljudi porodična je serija čije glavne junake predstavljaju članovi porodice Urošević i Graovac. Dramsku radnju pokreću događaji koji protagoniste dovode u situacije kroz koje će se ispoljiti njihovi lični interesi i ambicije, prožeti jakim međusobnim emocijama. Tri generacije pod jednim krovom, u komšijskim stanovima Graovac i Urošević, predstavljaju idealan teren za sukobe generacija i sistema vrednosti ali i fini humor. Đuro i njegova žena Jovanka pripadaju posleratnoj, bejbi bum generaciji koja se školovala, radila i vaspitala decu u socijalističkom duhu. Dragan i Marija su predstavnici generacije X koja je najbolje godine svog života potrošila tokom devedesetih godina 20 veka prošlog veka. I dok je Marija uspela da se visoko pozicionira u poslovnoj hijerarhiji, Dragan je prihvatio ulogu domaćice u kući. Nikola, Sara i Filip su deca novog milenijuma, generacija kojoj je život na mreži podjednako važan kao i realnost. Ipak, kad ih sustignu iskonski porivi, kao što je ljubav, biće prinuđeni da se okrenu sebi i suoče sa osećanjima. Tada polako počinju shvatati da se u virtuelnom svetu ne možeš sakriti od stvarnosti. Porodica Graovac - Urošević je pod konstantnim pritiskom s kojim se mosi kako zna i ume, a prilično često niti zna, niti ume. Decu pritiskaju izazovi i iskušenja odrastanja, očekivanja roditelja i sami roditelji; roditelje pritiskaju bračni problemi i deca, a babu i dedu - porodični i egzistencijalni problemi. Kako će se naši junaci sa njima nositi i da li će posle svega postati neki

programme.title: Love and hatred / Ljubav i mržnja
programme.desc: The series follows the hands and accidents of the rich Belgrade family Lazarević. No one has overwhelmed the death of the mother, which was a pillar of the family. Bogdan's new wife, Kaca, is morally unfit. It is temperamental and often creates problems within the family. He also hides secrets from the past, which is persecuted. In essence is an insecure personality and shy on its peasant roots. Bogdan's son Bojan is a womanizer and has an affair with his stepmother. It creates a series of trouble for him, because he promised her to divorce his wife and establish a new life with her. However, Bojan has a number of love affairs. His wife Ljubica is a noble and loyal person. A successful business woman. Bojan's brother Miloš is a journalist, she was dissatisfied, because he actually wanted to be a writer. Therefore, he often reaches for alcohol. His wife Ivan desperately wants to get pregnant, but it doesn't work for her. Her father Dušan is a former drug addict and makes her extra problems. Judka's journalist is Miloševa colleague from the leaves of the morning star, to which the Lazarevic family is a favorite topic. Bojanov and Miloseva sister Olja is the youngest member of the family and she suffers the most because of his mother's death. Olja unexpectedly pregnant, the father of the child is her professor Vojin from the faculty. Not sure what to do. / Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga, Kaća, je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista Jutarnja Zvezda, kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.desc: The film follows the Sorena, the young owl of the Father's epic stories of Gahula, the mythical group of winged warriors who led a large battle for the salvation of all owls from the evil pure. programme.title: The dead do not die / Mrtvi ne umiru
programme.desc: Mirni town Sentervil is fighting with zombie hordes after the dead begin to rise from their graves. The plot arises when the Earth's rotation comes out of its own axis and that is why strange things are going on in nature such as running animals, extending the day and, finally, waking the dead ... / Mirni gradić Sentervil bori se sa zombi hordama nakon što mrtvi počnu da se dižu iz svojih grobova. Zaplet nastaje kada zemljina rotacija izađe iz svoje ose i zbog toga krenu da se dešavaju čudne stvari u prirodi poput bežanja životinja, produžavanja dana i, napokon, buđenja mrtvih…

programme.title: Snezana and hunter / Snežana i lovac
programme.desc: Snezana is a princess and the most beautiful person in the kingdom. After marrying her father, whom he soon kills, evil Queen Raven takes into absolute power over the kingdom and locks our heroine in the tower, is forever distancing it from the world. Ravenna is a witch and must feed the beauties of young girls to stay forever young. Her magical mirror indicates the danger that her young snowman can be and that if she consumes her heart - will remain young forever. Snezana manages to escape from captivity from the young hunter trying to form an army with which he will be able to defeat the evil queen. / Snežana je princeza i najlepša osoba u kraljevstvu. Nakon što se uda za njenog oca, kojeg ubrzo i ubija, zla kraljica Ravena preuzima apsolutnu vlast nad kraljevstvom i zaključava našu junakinju u kulu, zauvek je distancirajući od sveta. Ravena je veštica i mora da se hrani lepotama mladih devojaka kako bi ostala zauvek mlada. Njeno magično ogledalo ukazuje na opasnost koju joj mlada Snežana može biti i da ako konzumira njeno srce - ostaće zauvek mlada. Snežana uspeva da pobegne iz zatočeništva iz uz pomoć mladog lovca pokušava da oformi armiju sa kojom će moći da porazi zlu kraljicu.

programme.title: Everything you want / Sve što poželiš
programme.desc: Nil Clark, teacher, will suddenly discover that he owns magical powers. In fact, one hand movement can make something happen. From that he wiped out the entire disobedient class (and return them and everything who ever died in life) to the conversion of his best other in a man for which women not just sigh, but adore him for the rest of his life. The only problem is to hit the right words and, of course, to know what really wants. Accident accident will finally take him to the final problem from which all men fear and which many have been wrong: whether to choose a girl ... or a dog. / Nil Klark, nastavnik, iznenada će otkriti da poseduje magične moći. Zapravo, jednim pokretom ruke on može da učini da se desi šta god poželi. Od toga da zbriše ceo neposlušni razred (i vrati njih i sve koji su ikad umrli u život) do pretvaranja svog najboljeg druga u muškarca za kojim žene ne samo da uzdišu, već ga obožavaju do kraja života. Jedini problem je da pogodi prave reči i, naravno, da zna šta stvarno želi. Nesreća za nesrećom će ga konačno odvesti do krajnjeg problema od kojeg svi muškarci strahuju i koju su mnogi pogrešno rešili: da li da izabere devojku... ili psa.

programme.title: Bullets resistant / Otporni na metke
programme.desc: Kits and Archi are the best friends and tiny criminals who do in what they do have quite success. Everything will change when they get involved in a large drug smuggling surgery, and it turns out that Kits is actually a policeman. / Kits i Arči su najbolji su prijatelji i sitni kriminalci koji u onome što rade imaju prilično uspeha. Sve će se promeniti kada se budu upleli u veliku operaciju krijumčarenja droge, i ispostavi se da je Kits zapravo policajac.

programme.title: Jumandzi: Welcome to the jungle / Džumandži: Dobro došli u džunglu
programme.desc: Four high school students reveal an old video game that they have never heard before. From that moment, it will be drawn into the fun world of Jungle and become the avatars of your own choice: the Spencer will become a nerd, athletes, the real Einstein will turn into a middle-aged professor, and the fragile marta will become a fearless warrant. However, the party will soon turn into something else, when they find that Jumandians are not played - already survives. To win and return to the real world, they must go to the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discovering what Alan Paris left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or will remain in the game forever. / Četvoro srednjoškolaca otkrivaju staru video igru za koju nikad ranije nisu čuli. Od tog trenutka biće uvučeni u zabavan svet džungle i postati avatari prema sopstvenom izboru: Spenser će tako postati štreberski istraživač, sportista Fridž će postati pravi Ajnštajn, popularna devojka Betani će se pretvoriti u sredovečnog profesora, a krhka Marta postaće neustrašiva ratnica. Međutim, zabava će se uskoro pretvoriti u nešto drugo, kada otkriju da se Džumandži ne igra - već preživljava. Da bi pobedili i vratili se u stvaran svet, moraju da odu u najopasniju avanturu njihovih života, otkriju šta je Alan Pariš ostavio pre 20 godina, i promene način na koji razmišljaju o sebi - ili će zauvek ostati u igrici.

programme.title: Being of blood / Biće krvi
programme.desc: Daniel persistently looking for oil and continues to buy a country in cheap that has such potential. When he gets information about the important site on the possession of the Sandej family, Daniel goes to the registration negotiations. He manages to redeem the Earth, but in turn, he will have to ensure a great donation to a young elije, who wants to become the main preacher of the area. / Danijel uporno traži naftu i nastavlja da jeftino kupuje zemlju koja ima takvog potencijala. Kada dobije informaciju o važnom nalazištu na posedu porodice Sandej, Danijel odlazi na pregovore o otkupu. On uspeva da otkupi zemlju, ali će zauzvrat morati da osigurati veliku donaciju mladom Eliju, koji želi postati glavni propovednik oblasti.

programme.title: Application / Aplikacija
programme.desc: The life of one of the world's most famous hackers is in danger after developing an application that can hack any social networking order and get any information using only the phone number. / Život jednog od najpoznatijih svetskih hakera je u opasnosti nakon što je razvio aplikaciju koja može da hakuje bilo koji nalog na društvenim mrežama i dobije bilo koje informacije koristeći samo broj telefona.

programme.title: Hostel 2 / Hostel 2
programme.desc: In the production of Quentina Tarantina and directed by Elija Rota, Hostel 2 is a shocking and frightening of the underground organization where the rich people pay and kill the innocent victims. Girls accept and come to Slovakia where they are placed in a fatal hostel. It will soon become innocent victims put on auction. / U produkciji Kventina Tarantina i režiji Elija Rota,Hostel 2 je šokantan i zastrašujući nastavak o podzemnoj organizacije gde bogataši plaćaju da bi mučili i ubijali nevine žrtve.Tri mlade Amerikanke koje studiraju u Rimu, bivaju pozvane na egzotičan vikend-odmor sa ciljem uživanja. Devojke prihvataju i dolaze u Slovačku gde se smeštaju u kobni Hostel. Uskoro će postati nevine žrtve stavljene na aukciju.

programme.title: Path to the center of the earth / Put u središte zemlje
programme.desc: During the scientific expedition in Iceland, the scientist and visionary Trevor Anderson, his Bratan Sean and their Guide Hannah, remain trapped in the cave from which the only way out leads even and deeper into the depths of the earth. Traveling throughout unprecedented worlds, they face supernatural and unimaginable creatures - including plants of cannibals, giant flying piran, birds that bright and terrifying dinosaurs from ancient times. Adventurists soon notice that volcanic activity is growing around them and conclude that they have to find the way to the Earth before it becomes too late. / Tokom naučne ekspedicije na Islandu, naučnik i vizionar Trevor Anderson, njegov bratanac Šon i njihov vodič Hana, neočekivano ostaju zarobljeni u pećini iz koje jedini izlaz vodi sve dublje i dublje u dubine Zemlje. Putujući kroz do sada neviđene svetove, oni se suočavaju sa natprirodnim i nezamislivim stvorenjima — uključujući biljke ljudožderke, džinvosku leteću piranu, ptice koje svetle i užasavajuće dinosauruse iz davnih vremena. Avanturisti uskoro primećuju da vulkanska aktivnost raste oko njih i zaključuju da moraju da nađu put do zemljine površine pre nego postane prekasno.

programme.title: Application / Aplikacija
programme.desc: The life of one of the world's most famous hackers is in danger after developing an application that can hack any social networking order and get any information using only the phone number. / Život jednog od najpoznatijih svetskih hakera je u opasnosti nakon što je razvio aplikaciju koja može da hakuje bilo koji nalog na društvenim mrežama i dobije bilo koje informacije koristeći samo broj telefona.

programme.title: Hostel 2 / Hostel 2
programme.desc: In the production of Quentina Tarantina and directed by Elija Rota, Hostel 2 is a shocking and frightening of the underground organization where the rich people pay and kill the innocent victims. Girls accept and come to Slovakia where they are placed in a fatal hostel. It will soon become innocent victims put on auction. / U produkciji Kventina Tarantina i režiji Elija Rota,Hostel 2 je šokantan i zastrašujući nastavak o podzemnoj organizacije gde bogataši plaćaju da bi mučili i ubijali nevine žrtve.Tri mlade Amerikanke koje studiraju u Rimu, bivaju pozvane na egzotičan vikend-odmor sa ciljem uživanja. Devojke prihvataju i dolaze u Slovačku gde se smeštaju u kobni Hostel. Uskoro će postati nevine žrtve stavljene na aukciju.

programme.title: Bullets resistant / Otporni na metke
programme.desc: Kits and Archi are the best friends and tiny criminals who do in what they do have quite success. Everything will change when they get involved in a large drug smuggling surgery, and it turns out that Kits is actually a policeman. / Kits i Arči su najbolji su prijatelji i sitni kriminalci koji u onome što rade imaju prilično uspeha. Sve će se promeniti kada se budu upleli u veliku operaciju krijumčarenja droge, i ispostavi se da je Kits zapravo policajac.

programme.title: Jumandzi: Welcome to the jungle / Džumandži: Dobro došli u džunglu
programme.desc: Four high school students reveal an old video game that they have never heard before. From that moment, it will be drawn into the fun world of Jungle and become the avatars of your own choice: the Spencer will become a nerd, athletes, the real Einstein will turn into a middle-aged professor, and the fragile marta will become a fearless warrant. However, the party will soon turn into something else, when they find that Jumandians are not played - already survives. To win and return to the real world, they must go to the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discovering what Alan Paris left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or will remain in the game forever. / Četvoro srednjoškolaca otkrivaju staru video igru za koju nikad ranije nisu čuli. Od tog trenutka biće uvučeni u zabavan svet džungle i postati avatari prema sopstvenom izboru: Spenser će tako postati štreberski istraživač, sportista Fridž će postati pravi Ajnštajn, popularna devojka Betani će se pretvoriti u sredovečnog profesora, a krhka Marta postaće neustrašiva ratnica. Međutim, zabava će se uskoro pretvoriti u nešto drugo, kada otkriju da se Džumandži ne igra - već preživljava. Da bi pobedili i vratili se u stvaran svet, moraju da odu u najopasniju avanturu njihovih života, otkriju šta je Alan Pariš ostavio pre 20 godina, i promene način na koji razmišljaju o sebi - ili će zauvek ostati u igrici.

programme.title: Being of blood / Biće krvi
programme.desc: Daniel persistently looking for oil and continues to buy a country in cheap that has such potential. When he gets information about the important site on the possession of the Sandej family, Daniel goes to the registration negotiations. He manages to redeem the Earth, but in turn, he will have to ensure a great donation to a young elije, who wants to become the main preacher of the area. / Danijel uporno traži naftu i nastavlja da jeftino kupuje zemlju koja ima takvog potencijala. Kada dobije informaciju o važnom nalazištu na posedu porodice Sandej, Danijel odlazi na pregovore o otkupu. On uspeva da otkupi zemlju, ali će zauzvrat morati da osigurati veliku donaciju mladom Eliju, koji želi postati glavni propovednik oblasti.

programme.title: Who survives talking / Ko preživi pričaće
programme.desc: The action of this hilarious comedy takes place in 1882. in Arizona, Albert, a farmer without self-confidence, loses his beloved girl withdrawing from the duel. He soon lucky to the enchanting Anna, so he reveals his courage and full potential when Anna's husband, a famous criminal, announce his arrival. / Radnja ove urnebesne komedije odvija se 1882. godine u Arizoni, Albert, farmer bez samopouzdanja, gubi svoju voljenu devojku povlačenjem iz dvoboja. Ubrzo sreće zanosnu Anu, pa otkriva svoju hrabrost i puni potencijal kada Anin muž, poznati kriminalac, najavi svoj dolazak.

programme.title: Pentecost executives / Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: When ghosts start obsessing New York, the four scientists first understand what is happening. To try to stop them, they create special weapons and form a unit that will fight ghosts. / Kada duhovi počnu opsedati Njujork, četiri naučnice prve shvate šta se događa. Kako bi ih pokušale zaustaviti, one kreiraju posebna oružja i oformljuju jedinicu koja će se boriti protiv duhova.

programme.title: The other day / Drugi dan
programme.desc: Shenen Doerti and Julian McMahon play the main roles in this drama with science and fantastic crude. Doerti starring Kate, whose boy half dies, and leaves her pregnant with his child. Years later, Kate manages to move on thanks to the new love in her life. However, the accident shifts Kate back in the days before pole was killed, and now he has to make a difficult choice between men he loves. / Šenen Doerti i Džulijan Mekmahon igraju glavne uloge u ovoj drami sa naučno-fantastičnim obrtom. Doerti glumi Kejt, čiji dečko Pol umire, i ostavlja je trudnu sa njegovim detetom. Godinama kasnije, Kejt uspeva da krene dalje zahvaljujući novoj ljubavi u njenom životu. Međutim, nesreća prebacuje Kejt natrag u dane pre nego što je Pol poginuo, i sada mora da napravi težak izbor između muškaraca koje voli.

programme.title: Sister, sister / Sestra, sestra
programme.desc: Sisters Lucy and Charlotte Bonar live in a luxury villa that inherited from their parents. Secrets from the past that the villa keeps, two of them can never forget. / Sestre Lusi i Šarlot Bonar žive u luksuznoj vili koju su nasledile od svojih roditelja. Tajne iz prošlosti koje vila čuva, njih dve nikada ne mogu zaboraviti.

programme.title: Aloha with love / Aloha sa Ljubavlju
programme.desc: The city architect stimulates the house in Hawaii. Renovation with a local contractor again awakens her love for life and an unexpected romance. / Gradska arhitektica nasleđuje kuću na Havajima. Renoviranje s lokalnim izvođačem radova opet budi njenu ljubav prema životu i neočekivanu romansu.

programme.title: Stone gardens / Kameni vrtovi
programme.desc: In this touching, war story, the veteran - the Sergeant, he takes the young soldier, who is trying to prepare for mortally dangerous war situces, despite the fact that Vietnam's teaching and transferring his experience from Vietnam to young soldiers. / U ovoj dirljivoj, ratnoj priči, veteran - narednik, uzima pod svoje okrilje mladog vojnika, sina svog starog prijatelja, kojeg pokušava da pripremi za smrtno opasne ratne situcije, uprkos činjenici da veteranu zabranjuju podučavanje i prenošenje svog iskustva iz Vijetnama mladim vojnicima.

programme.title: Kings of Dance: At the tips of the fingers / Kraljevi plesa: Na vrhovima prstiju
programme.desc: Jonathan Rivs received the task of introducing more contemporary styles on the American Ballet Academy, Charlie (ITAN Stifel) and Tomija (Keni Vormal) asks to find dancers who will compete in the camp, and the winners will be admitted to the academy. Bela Parker (Nicol Munjoz), who always lived in the shadow of his successful sister Kate, finally got the opportunity to find himself in the center of attention as one of the dancers selected for the camp. / Džonatan Rivs (Piter Galager) je dobio zadatak da uvede više savremenih stilova na Američku baletsku akademiju pa od svojih najboljih koreografa, Čarlija (Saša Radecki), Kupera (Itan Stifel) i Tomija (Keni Vormald) traži da pronađu plesače koji će se takmičiti u kampu, a pobednici će biti primljeni na akademiju. Bela Parker (Nikol Munjoz), koja je uvek živela u senci svoje uspešne sestre Kejt, konačno dobija priliku da se nađe u centru pažnje kao jedna od plesačica odabranih za kamp.

programme.title: Ema / Ema
programme.desc: Beautiful, smart and rich, Ema Vudhaus, is like a restless nut for a small sleepy city in which he lives. This is a shining satire of society and growing up, in which Emma must go through the adoption of wrong decisions in the choice of suits, to find the love that has always been there. / Lepa, pametna i bogata, Ema Vudhaus, je kao nemirna matica za mali uspavani grad u kome živi. Ovo je blistava satira društva i odrastanja, u kojoj Ema mora proći kroz donošenje pogrešnih odluka u izboru udvarača, kako bi pronašla ljubav koja je oduvek bila tu.

programme.title: Return to the blue lagoon / Povratak u plavu lagunu
programme.desc: Salvation looked for in a small, isolated island in the middle of the ocean. They stay alone in the wild, supported by each other, revealing his love. While they seemed to be perfect, one day things were beginning to change. / Spas su potražili na malom, izolovanom ostrvu usred okeana. Ostaju sami u divljini, oslonjeni jedno na drugo, otkrivajući svoju ljubav. Iako im se činilo da je život savršen, jednog dana stvari počinju da se menjaju.

programme.title: Baby in sight / Beba na vidiku
programme.desc: The two of them are in a romantic relationship full of love - until the unexpected angel's pregnancy takes them to nine-month ride. Through a joint trip, they must face jealousy ... suspicion, Andjelina, too late by the boss, but also the entire drama of their happy married best friends Danny and Silvie. / Njih dvoje su u romantičnoj vezi punoj ljubavi - sve dok ih neočekivana Andjelina trudnoća ne odvede na devetomesečnu vožnju. Kroz zajedničko putovanje moraju da se suočiti s ljubomorom... sumnjom, Andjelinom prezahtevnom šeficom, ali i čitavom dramom njihovih srećno venčanih najboljih prijatelja Denija i Silvije.

programme.title: The path of love / Put ljubavi
programme.desc: When bris and julie, second grade students, they first meet, Julie knows it's love. Brice is not so sure. For the next six years, young bris will do whatever it takes to keep the distance from your unsolicited girl - what is not so easy, given that they go to the same school and live one across from another. Smart, independent and willing to take place for their views, Julie is different from everyone who knows. After all, what does the boy need to do when his girlfriend tells him his hair smells like a watermelon or when he wants to sit next to her on a tree and observe the spectacular sunset? Although disappointed that bris does not want to observe things like her or at least those things he finds the most important, Julie continues to believe in them until one day doubts do not accumulate. Maybe she was wrong about him. And at the same time bris begins to think that he may have been wrong about her. But is it too late? / Kada se Brajs i Džuli, učenici drugog razreda, prvi put upoznaju, Džuli zna da je to ljubav. Brajs nije tako siguran. Narednih šest godina, mladi Brajs će raditi sve što je potrebno kako bi se držao na distanci od svoje nesuđene devojke - što i nije tako lako, s obzirom da idu u istu školu i žive jedno preko puta drugog. Pametna, samostalna i voljna da se zauzme za svoje stavove, Džuli je drugačija od svih koje poznaje. Uostalom, šta dečak treba da uradi kada mu devojčica kaže da mu kosa miriše na lubenicu ili kada želi da sedne pored nje na drvetu i posmatra spektakularan zalazak sunca? Iako razočarana što Brajs ne želi da posmatra stvari kao ona ili bar one stvari koje smatra najvažnijim, Džuli nastavlja da veruje u njih sve dok se jednog dana sumnje ne nagomilaju. Možda je ipak pogrešila u vezi njega. A u isto vreme Brajs počinje da misli da je možda ipak pogrešio u vezi nje. Ali, da li je prekasno?

programme.desc: The incredible successor of the fast food empires reveals the city in Novi Mexico in which goures balaves over culinary treats fierce cooks. / Neverovatni naslednik imperije brze hrane otkriva grad u Novom Meksiku u kojem gurmani balave nad kulinarskim poslasticama žestoke kuvarice.

programme.title: What do I want more / Šta želim više
programme.desc: Ana has become everything that was expected from her: It has a modest, but a stable job, it is close to family, friends and partner Alesija, which is planning a child. Maybe the only thing that is missing is her courage to take responsibility for their future. When her life suddenly entered Domeniko, married with Miriam, the father of two children, for the first time all the boundaries in Ana's life are deleted. However, love has a firmly set boundaries. / Ana je postala sve što se od nje očekivalo: ima skroman, ali stabilan posao, bliska je s porodicom, prijateljima i partnerom Alesijem, s kojim planira dete. Možda jedino što joj nedostaje jeste hrabrost da preuzme odgovornost za svoju budućnost. Kad u njen život iznenada uđe Domeniko, oženjen s Miriam, otac dvoje dece, po prvi put sve granice u Aninom životu se brišu. Međutim, i ljubav ima čvrsto postavljene granice.

programme.title: Last kiss / Poslednji poljubac
programme.desc: Majkl had just learned that his girlfriend was pregnant and now he could see the rest of his life horrified. Although he is aware that Jenna is perfect for such a venture, he will panic and think more and more about the young who openly seizes him. The temptation to make life is unpredictable again is great, and his friends are in front of his, no less important life decisions. / Majkl je upravo saznao da mu je devojka Džena trudna i sada može da vidi ostatak života što ga užasava. Iako je svestan toga da je Džena savršena za takav poduhvat, on će da se uspaniči i sve više razmišlja o mladoj Kim koja ga otvoreno zavodi. Iskušenje da opet učini život nepredvidljivim je velik, a njegovi prijatelji se nalaze pred svojim, ništa manje važnim životnim odlukama.

programme.title: What do I want more / Šta želim više
programme.desc: Ana has become everything that was expected from her: It has a modest, but a stable job, it is close to family, friends and partner Alesija, which is planning a child. Maybe the only thing that is missing is her courage to take responsibility for their future. When her life suddenly entered Domeniko, married with Miriam, the father of two children, for the first time all the boundaries in Ana's life are deleted. However, love has a firmly set boundaries. / Ana je postala sve što se od nje očekivalo: ima skroman, ali stabilan posao, bliska je s porodicom, prijateljima i partnerom Alesijem, s kojim planira dete. Možda jedino što joj nedostaje jeste hrabrost da preuzme odgovornost za svoju budućnost. Kad u njen život iznenada uđe Domeniko, oženjen s Miriam, otac dvoje dece, po prvi put sve granice u Aninom životu se brišu. Međutim, i ljubav ima čvrsto postavljene granice.

programme.title: Last kiss / Poslednji poljubac
programme.desc: Majkl had just learned that his girlfriend was pregnant and now he could see the rest of his life horrified. Although he is aware that Jenna is perfect for such a venture, he will panic and think more and more about the young who openly seizes him. The temptation to make life is unpredictable again is great, and his friends are in front of his, no less important life decisions. / Majkl je upravo saznao da mu je devojka Džena trudna i sada može da vidi ostatak života što ga užasava. Iako je svestan toga da je Džena savršena za takav poduhvat, on će da se uspaniči i sve više razmišlja o mladoj Kim koja ga otvoreno zavodi. Iskušenje da opet učini život nepredvidljivim je velik, a njegovi prijatelji se nalaze pred svojim, ništa manje važnim životnim odlukama.

programme.title: The path of love / Put ljubavi
programme.desc: When bris and julie, second grade students, they first meet, Julie knows it's love. Brice is not so sure. For the next six years, young bris will do whatever it takes to keep the distance from your unsolicited girl - what is not so easy, given that they go to the same school and live one across from another. Smart, independent and willing to take place for their views, Julie is different from everyone who knows. After all, what does the boy need to do when his girlfriend tells him his hair smells like a watermelon or when he wants to sit next to her on a tree and observe the spectacular sunset? Although disappointed that bris does not want to observe things like her or at least those things he finds the most important, Julie continues to believe in them until one day doubts do not accumulate. Maybe she was wrong about him. And at the same time bris begins to think that he may have been wrong about her. But is it too late? / Kada se Brajs i Džuli, učenici drugog razreda, prvi put upoznaju, Džuli zna da je to ljubav. Brajs nije tako siguran. Narednih šest godina, mladi Brajs će raditi sve što je potrebno kako bi se držao na distanci od svoje nesuđene devojke - što i nije tako lako, s obzirom da idu u istu školu i žive jedno preko puta drugog. Pametna, samostalna i voljna da se zauzme za svoje stavove, Džuli je drugačija od svih koje poznaje. Uostalom, šta dečak treba da uradi kada mu devojčica kaže da mu kosa miriše na lubenicu ili kada želi da sedne pored nje na drvetu i posmatra spektakularan zalazak sunca? Iako razočarana što Brajs ne želi da posmatra stvari kao ona ili bar one stvari koje smatra najvažnijim, Džuli nastavlja da veruje u njih sve dok se jednog dana sumnje ne nagomilaju. Možda je ipak pogrešila u vezi njega. A u isto vreme Brajs počinje da misli da je možda ipak pogrešio u vezi nje. Ali, da li je prekasno?

programme.title: Baby in sight / Beba na vidiku
programme.desc: The two of them are in a romantic relationship full of love - until the unexpected angel's pregnancy takes them to nine-month ride. Through a joint trip, they must face jealousy ... suspicion, Andjelina, too late by the boss, but also the entire drama of their happy married best friends Danny and Silvie. / Njih dvoje su u romantičnoj vezi punoj ljubavi - sve dok ih neočekivana Andjelina trudnoća ne odvede na devetomesečnu vožnju. Kroz zajedničko putovanje moraju da se suočiti s ljubomorom... sumnjom, Andjelinom prezahtevnom šeficom, ali i čitavom dramom njihovih srećno venčanih najboljih prijatelja Denija i Silvije.

programme.title: Return to the blue lagoon / Povratak u plavu lagunu
programme.desc: Salvation looked for in a small, isolated island in the middle of the ocean. They stay alone in the wild, supported by each other, revealing his love. While they seemed to be perfect, one day things were beginning to change. / Spas su potražili na malom, izolovanom ostrvu usred okeana. Ostaju sami u divljini, oslonjeni jedno na drugo, otkrivajući svoju ljubav. Iako im se činilo da je život savršen, jednog dana stvari počinju da se menjaju.

programme.title: Locked / Zaključani
programme.desc: Linda is a successful director of marketing, which, because of their new duties at work, is disappointed by the corporate world, while Pakston, a criminal criminal past, remains without work. In addition to poetry and generous amounts of wine, as they try to live together in peace, they are an old life zeal in them and they become municipalized in a sudden opportunity to participate in the great looting jewelry. / Linda je uspešna direktorka marketinga koja se, zbog svojih novih zaduženja na poslu, razočarava korporativnim svetom, dok Pakston, kreativac sa kriminalnom prošlošću, ostaje bez posla. Uz poeziju i izdašne količine vina, dok pokušavaju da žive zajedno u miru, u njima se budi stari životni žar i oni postaju opčinjeni iznenadnom prilikom da učestvuju u velikoj pljački nakita.

programme.title: Love drink number 9 / Ljubavni napitak broj 9
programme.desc: The sex is awkward in relations with a better pole and therefore will go to the vracar that has a solution for him. A love potion to make every girl fall in love with him. / Pol je nespretan u odnosima sa lepšim polom i zato će otići kod vračare koja ima rešenje za njega. Ljubavni napitak koji će učiniti da se svaka devojka zaljubi u njega.

programme.title: The dead do not die / Mrtvi ne umiru
programme.desc: The story of a journalist who explores the smuggling of deadly drugs, after which the corpse of the corpse becomes a zombie using Voodle magic. / Priča o novinaru koji istražuje krijumčarenje smrtonosne droge, nakon čije konzumacije leš postaje zombi pomoću vudu magije.

programme.title: Video Kaseta / Video Kaseta
programme.desc: A group of friends of Dane spends in the hooligan actions that record and after looking at television. They get a task from someone to break into one house and steal a certain VHS cassette from it. The plan was quick to enter, take the cassette and escape, but the best plans stabbed. In the house are on the body of the owner and a hill of different VHS cassettes. In search of the right one, they put one by one in the video player. Each cassette is one of the stories in this omnibus. / Grupa prijatelja dane provodi u huliganskim akcijama koje snimaju i posle gledaju na televiziji. Od nekoga dobijaju zadatak da provale u jednu kuću i iz nje ukradu određenu VHS kasetu. Plan je bio brzo ući, uzeti kasetu i pobeći, ali i najbolji planovi se izjalove. U kući nalaze na telo vlasnika i brdo različitih VHS kaseta. U potrazi za onom pravoj, jednu po jednu stavljaju u video plejer. Svaka kaseta je jedna od priča u ovom omnibusu.

programme.title: Moon / Mesečari
programme.desc: Tanja (Madchen Amick) is a curious girl who begins to like Charles (Brian Krause), a new student in school. However, Tanja finds out that he is a monthly drinker who drinks blood. Charles and his mother Mari (Alice Krige) are the last of the dying species that keeps driving a drinking blood of young people, innocent girls. Thanks to the abilities of mutations, they wander the land and skillfully avoid detection while looking for the next victim. However, the weak point of the moonman seems to be a domestic home cat. Saturday, 04.05.2024. / Tanja (Madchen Amick) je znatiželjna devojka koja se počne sviđati Čarlsu (Brian Krause), novom učeniku u školi. Međutim, Tanja saznaje da je on mesečar koji pije krv. Čarls i njegova majka Mari (Alice Krige) poslednji su od umiruće vrste koja se na životu održava pijući krv mladih, nevinih devojaka. Zahvaljujući sposobnosti mutacije, lutaju zemljom i vešto izbegavaju otkrivanje dok traže sledeću žrtvu. Međutim, čini se da je slaba tačka mesečara domaća kućna mačka. Subota, 04.05.2024.

programme.title: Simulant / Simulant
programme.desc: Humanity in the near future, defying the laws of existence, free of fear of losing loved ones. Androids are developed, capable of reproducing the appearance of a loved one. Fay recently lost her husband, so she decided to take advantage of the achievements of technology. However, the artificial intelligence agent notes the unusual behavior of his android. What is it? An incomprehensible game of artificial intelligence or passionate desire to become a human being and win Feja's heart? / Čovečanstvo se u bliskoj budućnosti, prkoseći zakonima postojanja, oslobodilo straha od gubitka voljenih. Razvijeni su androidi sposobni reprodukovati izgled voljene osobe. Fej je nedavno izgubila muža, pa je odlučila iskoristiti dostignuća tehnologije. Međutim, agentica veštačke inteligencije primećuje neobično ponašanje svog androida. Što je to? Neshvatljiva igra veštačke inteligencije ili strastvena želja da postane ljudsko biće i osvoji Fejino srce?

programme.title: Nine / Devetke
programme.desc: The lives of three people are intertwined in mysterious and disturbing ways. The actor and television presenter, the creator of the game, arguing with the former girl, falls into a dangerous trap and pulls into trouble another eight people. / Životi troje ljudi isprepleću se na misteriozne i uznemirujuće načine. Glumac i televizijski voditelj, tvorac igrica prepirući se sa bivšom devojkom upada u opasnu zamku i povlači u nevolje još osam ljudi.

programme.title: Spread! / Šazam!
programme.desc: We all have superheroes in yourself, it takes only a little magic that they come out. In the case of the 14 - year old boy Bisca Batson need to say Šazam! Him the ancient wizard gave the power to transform in an adult man with superhuman powers if necessary. Still a boy in the soul, Shaman reveals his adult version by making what every teenager would do with superpowers - entertained with him! Can it fly? Does X-ray vision? Can he break the lightning out of his hands? Sham is trying the boundaries of their powers, but will need to master them quickly to fight the deadly forces of evil that controlled by Dr. Tadeus Sivan. / Svi imamo superjunake u sebi, potrebno je samo malo magije da oni izađu. U slučaju 14 - godišnjeg dečaka Bilija Batsona potrebno je reći šazam! Njemu je drevni čarobnjak dao moć da se po potrebi transformiše u odraslog muškarca s nadljudskim moćima. Još uvek dečak u duši, Šazam otkriva svoju odraslu verziju čineći ono što bi svaki tinejdžer učinio sa supermoćima - zabavlja se s njim! Može li leteti? Ima li rendgenski vid? Može li izbaciti munje iz svojih ruku? Šazam isprobava granice svojih moći, ali moraće brzo ovladati njima kako bi se borio protiv smrtonosnih sila zla koje kontroliše dr Tadeus Sivana.

programme.title: Who is afraid of the spirit yet / Ko se boji duha još
programme.desc: Oscar winner, director Peter Jackson, showing us his incredibly inserts in this story about the psychic-cheater that teamed up with three benevolent Spirit would not stop the spells of the executed killer. One of the rare films that successfully combines laughter and great. Michael J. Fox interprets the character of Frank Banister, the outsurface of the ghosts from the small town, associated with the ghosts that should be expelled. The fraud works great until one powerful spirit goes into a murderous hike, forcing Frank to find a way to stop this diabolic avet in this supernatural thriller, who is so much fun! / Dobitnik Oskara, reditelj Piter Džekson, prikazuje nam svoje neverovatno umeće u ovoj priči o vidovnjaku-prevarantu koji se udružuje sa tri dobroćudna duha ne bi li zaustavio divljanje duha pogubljenog ubice. Jedan od retkih filmova koji uspešno spaja smeh i stravu. Majkl Dž. Foks tumači lik Frenka Banistera, isterivača duhova iz male varoši, udruženog sa duhovima koje bi trebalo da istera. Prevara odlično funkcioniše sve dok jedan moćni duh ne krene u ubilački pohod, primoravajući Frenka da pronađe način da zaustavi ovu dijaboličnu avet u ovom natprirodnom trileru, koji je toliko zabavan da je to strašno!

programme.title: Birth / Rađanje
programme.desc: As a very young Ana, she remained without her husband who passed away in New York Park. It is difficult to bear with the loss of the loved one, Ana after the full decade of grief, however, decides further after agreeing to marry the long-standing Joseph's suitor. Due to Ana's decisions, her sister Laura, the best friend of Clara and mother Elenor, where the birthday celebration arrives. It is a ten-year-old boy, which is beginning Ana to convince that the reincarnation of her deceased husband is. At first without attaching any attention to his words, Anna little and a little start disturbing the boy's warnings not to marry Joseph. / Kao veoma mlada Ana je ostala bez supruga koji je preminuo u njujorškom parku. Teško se noseći s gubitkom voljene osobe, Ana nakon pune decenije tugovanja ipak odluči krenuti dalje nakon što pristane udati se za dugogodišnjeg udvarača Jozefa. Zbog Anine odluke posebno su srećne njena sestra Laura, najbolja prijateljica Klara i majka Elenor na čiju proslavu rođendana stigne neobični gost. To je desetogodišnji dečak Šon koji Anu počne uveravati da je reinkarnacija njenog preminulog supruga. Isprva ne pridajući nikakvu pažnju njegovim rečima, Anu malo-pomalo počnu uznemiravati dečakova upozorenja da se ne udaje za Jozefa.

programme.title: King Scorpio 2 / Kralj škorpija 2
programme.desc: In the ancient city of Akkad, Matajas grows up in the Proud Son of Ashur, the captain of the Military Unit of Black Scorpions. When I despite the opposition of the Father, she wants to become a member of the detachment, a tragedy that changes Matajas' life is happening ... / U drevnom gradu Akkad, Matajas odrasta u ponosnog sina Ašura, kapetana vojne jedinice Crnih Škorpiona. Kada sam uprkos protivljenju oca poželi postati član odreda, dešava se tragedija koja menja Matajasov život...

programme.title: Purge / Pročišćenje
programme.desc: In America, flooded crime and overcrowded prisons, the government has introduced 12-hour, annual period in which all criminal actions become legal. You can't call the police. Hospitals do not provide help. That is one night where citizens can do whatever wants to and will not be punished for that. This night full of crime epidemic, one family will fight with a decision who will become when their foreigner is nailed to the door. / U Americi, preplavljenoj kriminalom i pretrpanim zatvorima, vlada je uvela 12-časovni, godišnji period u kome sve kriminalne radnje postaju legalne. Policiju ne možete zvati. Bolnice ne pružaju pomoć. To je jedna noć u kojoj građani mogu da rade šta god hoće i za to neće biti kažnjeni. Ove noći prepune nasilja i epidemije kriminala, jedna porodica će se boriti sa odlukom ko će postati kad im stranac zakuca na vrata.

programme.title: A snake horror / Zmijoglavi užas
programme.desc: A small town in the American crush, which is still recovering from a difficult economic situation, is in front of a new danger when a kind of local fish survives chemical poisoning and mutations in aggressive carnivores. The transformation in the predators was made when the human growth hormones were inserted into the lake, in order to improve the results of the local fishing industry. In contact with these hormones, fish grow to giant sizes, so they adopt the ability to move and feed and dry. When food disappears in the lake, they move towards the town. / Mali grad u američkoj zabiti, koji se još uvek oporavlja od teške ekonomske situacije, nađe se pred novom opasnošću kada jedna vrsta lokalnih riba preživi hemijsko trovanje i mutira u agresivne mesoždere. Transformacija u predatore izvršena je kada su ljudski hormoni rasta ubačeni u jezero, kako bi se poboljšali rezultati lokalne ribarske industrije. U dodiru s tim hormonima, ribe rastu do gigantskih veličina, pa usvajaju sposobnost kretanja i hranjenja i na suvom. Kada u jezeru nestane hrane, kreću prema gradiću.

programme.title: V H S Virus / V H S Virus
programme.desc: Teenagers eager for celebrations become stars of the following internet sensations. But they do it - not your will! Film parts relate to: a disappointed illusionist finding a magical subject of huge power, an inventor of the machine that opens the door to a parallel world, teenage skepto that become the Mexican sect sect, and the secret organization that accompanies the serial killer. / Tinejdžeri željni slave postaju zvezde sledeće internet-senzacije. Ali, oni to rade - ne svojom voljom! Delovi filma odnose se na: razočaranog iluzionistu koji pronalazi magični predmet ogromne moći, pronalazača mašine koja otvara vrata u paralelni svet, tinejdžerske skejtere koji postaju mete meksičke sekte smrti, i tajnu organizaciju koja prati serijskog ubicu.

Kada sam uprkos protivljenju oca poželi postati član odreda, dešava se tragedija koja menja Matajasov život...

programme.title: Hidden / Skriveni
programme.desc: Ray, Claire and their seven-year-old daughter Zoe for 301 days live in his shelter after they avoided a disaster that changed everything. They turned their underground shelter into a home, but they still hope to return their old life once. Three hundred days managed to avoid a danger that lurks from the surface, but that came to the end - their safe refuge is no longer that safe and unknown danger comes for them. / Rej, Kler i njihova sedmogodišnja kći Zoi već 301 dan žive u svom skloništu nakon što su izbegli katastrofu koja je sve promenila. Svoje podzemno sklonište su pretvorili u dom, ali svejedno se nadaju da će jednom vratiti svoj stari život. Trista dana uspeli su izbegavati opasnost koja vreba s površine, ali tome je došao kraj - njihovo sigurno utočište više nije toliko sigurno i nepoznata opasnost dolazi po njih.

programme.title: Jason X / Džejson X
programme.desc: Through long, Jason killed over 200 people. Now the legendary killer from the crystal lake returns in space action, seeking new victims ... / Kroz dugi niz godina Džejson je ubio preko 200 ljudi. Sada se legendarni ubica sa Kristalnog jezera vraća u svemirskoj akciji tražeći nove žrtve...

programme.title: Our little editorial staff / Naša mala redakcija
programme.desc: What does a work day look like in one newsroom? Employees and accidents of employees in the news editorial office of Panorama. / Kako izgleda radni dan u jednoj novinskoj redakciji? Zgode i nezgode zaposlenih u novinskoj redakciji Panorama.

programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: The series will definitely follow the tradition of the best domestic series that abound in humor, which stems from the nature and character of the protagonist. In the center of attention, Sitka is the life of the Life are members of the Savković family. The mother of the gross, proud owner of the florists, her children and daughters. GroZdin younger son Ljubisa is a teacher of mathematics permanently unhappy in love. Her daughter Silvana is a misunderstood, whose experience of life actually understands only married men. The older son of Siniš, by occupation of the shoemaker, is drawn to beer, weak on women, and somewhat on it. However, the main obstacle to the Sinišine Love Adventures is the fact that a married temperative person from whose farting character is all a little closer. Katarina has completed management in management at the Faculty of Management and seek work in the profession in vain. Her mother Radmila persistently persuades her to divorce the shoes and marrying for the Lufthanza pilot. However, Katarina cannot without sinning, and the secret of their marriage will be revealed in one of the episodes. The biggest friend of the family Savković is a dam, the owner of the cafe to which all Savkovići is happy to stop by. The dam loves to serve their guests, but more than that likes to transport them. It's often stronger than him. The truth for the will, knows and help when he affects. / Serija će svakako slediti i tradiciju najboljih domaćih serija koje obiluju humorom, koji proističe iz naravi i karaktera protagonista. U centru pažnje sitkoma Nek ide život su članovi porodice Savković. Majka Grozda, ponosna vlasnica cvećare, njena deca i snaja. Grozdin mlađi sin Ljubiša je nastavnik matematike permanentno nesrećan u ljubavi. Njena ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica , čiji doživljaj života zapravo shvataju jedino oženjeni muškarci. Stariji sin Siniša, po zanimanju obućar, navučen je na pivo, slab na žene, a pomalo i one na njega. Ipak, glavna prepreka za Sinišine ljubavne avanture jeste činjenica da je oženjen temperamentnom osobom od čijeg prgavog karaktera svi pomalo zaziru. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. A Miki, Johnny, Cherry, Sunčica, Marun, Maja and Caslav, are not capable of succeeding in new circumstances like the Father of their friend Gagges. The reasons for this is neither upbring, nor the 1990s, neither communism (so soothed communists are very easily successful capitalists). On his way to success, they bother their big heart and a weak stomach. All their ventures are sad to laugh, because every rupture between the overcome feeling of community and desire for personal success. However, when the crucified dreamer Johnny appears in their lives, a strange family begins to create that, they all want to, or not, they make much stronger connections than those relatives. And along the way they get a much more valuable prize than the time to chase. / Pare ili život je dramska, komična TV serija koja prati nekoliko različitih karaktera u sudaru s našom svakodnevnicom. Dramski realizam ove serije nekad se graniči s apsurdom, ali oslobođen je humora po svaku cenu i radije problematizuje neke socijalne fenomene. U društvu koje priželjkuje da je tranzicija već gotova, a ona tek što je počela, javljaju se brojne zamke za sve one koji se nisu snašli. A Miki, Džoni, Višnja, Sunčica, Marun, Maja i Časlav, nisu sposobni da u novim okolnostima uspeju poput oca njihovog prijatelja Gagija. Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Ideal relationships / Idealne veze
programme.desc: For the first time in our series, we will peek behind the scenes of one artistic marriage. He is a large acting star, celebrated and sought in all directions, eager that at least she finds the necessary peace at her own house. She is a young and attractive actress, eager excitement, always ready for action ... / Prvi put u našim serijama zavirićemo iza kulisa jednog umetničkog braka. On je velika glumačka zvezda, slavljen i tražen na sve strane, željan da bar u sopstvenoj kući nađe neophodan mir. Ona je mlada i atraktivna glumica, željna uzbuđenja, uvek spremna na akciju...

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Ideal relationships / Idealne veze
programme.desc: For the first time in our series, we will peek behind the scenes of one artistic marriage. He is a large acting star, celebrated and sought in all directions, eager that at least she finds the necessary peace at her own house. She is a young and attractive actress, eager excitement, always ready for action ... / Prvi put u našim serijama zavirićemo iza kulisa jednog umetničkog braka. On je velika glumačka zvezda, slavljen i tražen na sve strane, željan da bar u sopstvenoj kući nađe neophodan mir. Ona je mlada i atraktivna glumica, željna uzbuđenja, uvek spremna na akciju...
