programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: The series will definitely follow the tradition of the best domestic series that abound in humor, which stems from the nature and character of the protagonist. In the center of attention, Sitka is the life of the Life are members of the Savković family. The mother of the gross, proud owner of the florists, her children and daughters. GroZdin younger son Ljubisa is a teacher of mathematics permanently unhappy in love. Her daughter Silvana is a misunderstood, whose experience of life actually understands only married men. The older son of Siniš, by occupation of the shoemaker, is drawn to beer, weak on women, and somewhat on it. However, the main obstacle to the Sinišine Love Adventures is the fact that a married temperative person from whose farting character is all a little closer. Katarina has completed management in management at the Faculty of Management and seek work in the profession in vain. Her mother Radmila persistently persuades her to divorce the shoes and marrying for the Lufthanza pilot. However, Katarina cannot without sinning, and the secret of their marriage will be revealed in one of the episodes. The biggest friend of the family Savković is a dam, the owner of the cafe to which all Savkovići is happy to stop by. The dam loves to serve their guests, but more than that likes to transport them. It's often stronger than him. The truth for the will, knows and help when he affects. / Serija će svakako slediti i tradiciju najboljih domaćih serija koje obiluju humorom, koji proističe iz naravi i karaktera protagonista. U centru pažnje sitkoma Nek ide život su članovi porodice Savković. Majka Grozda, ponosna vlasnica cvećare, njena deca i snaja. Grozdin mlađi sin Ljubiša je nastavnik matematike permanentno nesrećan u ljubavi. Njena ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica , čiji doživljaj života zapravo shvataju jedino oženjeni muškarci. Stariji sin Siniša, po zanimanju obućar, navučen je na pivo, slab na žene, a pomalo i one na njega. Ipak, glavna prepreka za Sinišine ljubavne avanture jeste činjenica da je oženjen temperamentnom osobom od čijeg prgavog karaktera svi pomalo zaziru. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

Ipak, glavna prepreka za Sinišine ljubavne avanture jeste činjenica da je oženjen temperamentnom osobom od čijeg prgavog karaktera svi pomalo zaziru. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. A Miki, Johnny, Cherry, Sunčica, Marun, Maja and Caslav, are not capable of succeeding in new circumstances like the Father of their friend Gagges. The reasons for this is neither upbring, nor the 1990s, neither communism (so soothed communists are very easily successful capitalists). On his way to success, they bother their big heart and a weak stomach. All their ventures are sad to laugh, because every rupture between the overcome feeling of community and desire for personal success. However, when the crucified dreamer Johnny appears in their lives, a strange family begins to create that, they all want to, or not, they make much stronger connections than those relatives. And along the way they get a much more valuable prize than the time to chase. / Pare ili život je dramska, komična TV serija koja prati nekoliko različitih karaktera u sudaru s našom svakodnevnicom. Dramski realizam ove serije nekad se graniči s apsurdom, ali oslobođen je humora po svaku cenu i radije problematizuje neke socijalne fenomene. U društvu koje priželjkuje da je tranzicija već gotova, a ona tek što je počela, javljaju se brojne zamke za sve one koji se nisu snašli. A Miki, Džoni, Višnja, Sunčica, Marun, Maja i Časlav, nisu sposobni da u novim okolnostima uspeju poput oca njihovog prijatelja Gagija. Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Ideal relationships / Idealne veze
programme.desc: For the first time in our series, we will peek behind the scenes of one artistic marriage. He is a large acting star, celebrated and sought in all directions, eager that at least she finds the necessary peace at her own house. She is a young and attractive actress, eager excitement, always ready for action ... / Prvi put u našim serijama zavirićemo iza kulisa jednog umetničkog braka. On je velika glumačka zvezda, slavljen i tražen na sve strane, željan da bar u sopstvenoj kući nađe neophodan mir. Ona je mlada i atraktivna glumica, željna uzbuđenja, uvek spremna na akciju...

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. A Miki, Johnny, Cherry, Sunčica, Marun, Maja and Caslav, are not capable of succeeding in new circumstances like the Father of their friend Gagges. The reasons for this is neither upbring, nor the 1990s, neither communism (so soothed communists are very easily successful capitalists). On his way to success, they bother their big heart and a weak stomach. All their ventures are sad to laugh, because every rupture between the overcome feeling of community and desire for personal success. However, when the crucified dreamer Johnny appears in their lives, a strange family begins to create that, they all want to, or not, they make much stronger connections than those relatives. And along the way they get a much more valuable prize than the time to chase. / Pare ili život je dramska, komična TV serija koja prati nekoliko različitih karaktera u sudaru s našom svakodnevnicom. Dramski realizam ove serije nekad se graniči s apsurdom, ali oslobođen je humora po svaku cenu i radije problematizuje neke socijalne fenomene. U društvu koje priželjkuje da je tranzicija već gotova, a ona tek što je počela, javljaju se brojne zamke za sve one koji se nisu snašli. A Miki, Džoni, Višnja, Sunčica, Marun, Maja i Časlav, nisu sposobni da u novim okolnostima uspeju poput oca njihovog prijatelja Gagija. Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: Vila Mary / Vila Marija
programme.desc: The greater the greater part of the assets after the Second War, but they did not remain poor. They live in a good Zagreb neighborhood. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) works with his father in the company. A handsome Zagreb boyfriend, a twenty -five -year -old, but irresponsible, prone to vice, in short, a bad character of a nice face. On the other hand, there is a family of banker Maks Lovrek (Ante Cedo Martinic), who gives Jurak's company a large loan to take over the retail chain. He and Tomislav Jurak (not) have been friends since Falultet days. In addition to work, Jurakovi and Lovrekovi are also related to private, and the period of apparent friendship from the beginning of the story soon grows into rivalry. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) je pedesetogodišnjak, vodi porodični biznis koji uključuje lanac restorana i hotel u centru grada, koji je počeo da gradi još u vreme socijalizma, ali ga je u vlasništvo preuzeo tokom privatizacije devedesetih novcem svoje tete Mitzy. programme.title: Shoulder strap / Bandolera
programme.desc: Sara Rejes is a student literature on Oxford during the 19th century. As a great respector of Spanish literature, the opera and culture Sara will escape the Andalusia in the desire for adventure, true love and family. Andalusia will enchant Sarah and she will find his home in a small Andalusian village, where she will be done to finally fulfill his life's dream and write his first novel. Everything will take place at her will until her uncle returns to the intention to return to England one day. Sara will become an outlawful of Robin Hud, who will dedicate life to help people in trouble. This series will enchant your hearts as you meet the protagonist, her character, virtue and flaws. You will fall in love with her love and beautiful pictures of Andalusia that boots you and leave you breathless. / Sara Rejes je studentkinja književnosti na Oksfordu tokom XIX veka. Kao veliki poštovalac španske književnosti, opere i kulture Sara će pobeći u Andaluziju u želji za avanturom, pravom ljubavi i porodicom. Andaluzija će očarati Saru i ona će pronaći svoj dom u malom andaluzijskom selu, gde će joj se učiniti da će konačno ispuniti svoj živoni san i napisati svoj prvi roman. Sve će se odvijati po njenoj volji dok se jednog dana ne vrati njen ujak u nameri da je vrati u Englesku. Sara će postati odmetnik nalik Robin Hudu, koji će posvetiti život da pomogne ljudima u nevolji. Ova serija će očarati vaša srca dok upoznajete protagonistu, njen karakter, vrline i mane. Zaljubićete se u njenu ljubav i prelepe slike Andaluzije koje vas plene i ostavljaju bez daha.

programme.title: Ordinary people / Obični ljudi
programme.desc: Drama series Ordinary people is an urban story, which accompanies the life of three sisters and their parents of the actors, each of which has a totally different life path. In a different way, in their lives and lives of people surrounding them, their childhood frustrations: by the departure of their mother Karolina when it was 11, Matija (Majlja) 7, and Sasha (the youngest) were 3 years old. The story follows their lives the moment each has its own life and / or family. After the departure of Karolina, the oldest sister played a maternal figure in the family. The most indictatory sister Matija, married with Luka Dragan, son of Ante Dragan, one of the most successful auto-representatives in Croatia. Luka, as his brother Paul work for his father in the carcasses Dragan. In parallel, we also follow the life of that Herzegovinian family. The youngest sister graduated from the Faculty of Medicine and began working on Zagreb's Peščenica. At the moment of the beginning, Karolina got a great acting chance: the role of his ex-husband and father three sisters of the edges in the renovated series that brought him fame ... / Dramska serija Obični ljudi je jedna urbana priča , koja prati život tri sestre i njihovih roditelja glumaca, od kojih svaka ima totalno različit životni put. Na različit način, u njihovim životima i životima ljudi koji ih okružuju, prelamaju se i njihove frustracije iz detinjstva: odlaskom njihove majke Karoline kad je Vanji (najstarijoj) bilo 11, Matiji (srednjoj) 7, a Saši (najmlađoj) su tada bile 3 godine. Priča prati njihove živote u trenutku kad svaka ima svoj život i/ili porodicu. Nakon odlaska Karoline, najstarija sestra odigrala je majčinsku figuru u porodici. Najemotivnija sestra Matija, u braku je s Lukom Draganom, sinom Ante Dragana, jednog od najuspešnijih auto-zastupnika u Hrvatskoj. Luka, kao i njegov brat Pavle rade za oca u Autokući Dragan. Paralelno pratimo i život te hercegovačke porodice. Najmlađa sestra je diplomirala na Medicinskom fakultetu i počela raditi na zagrebačkoj Peščenici. U trenutku početka priče, Karolina dobija veliku glumačku šansu: ulogu žene svog bivšeg supruga i oca tri sestre Ivice u obnovljenoj seriji koja je njemu donela slavu...

programme.title: Love and hatred / Ljubav i mržnja
programme.desc: The series follows the hands and accidents of the rich Belgrade family Lazarević. No one has overwhelmed the death of the mother, which was a pillar of the family. Bogdan's new wife, Kaca, is morally unfit. It is temperamental and often creates problems within the family. He also hides secrets from the past, which is persecuted. In essence is an insecure personality and shy on its peasant roots. Bogdan's son Bojan is a womanizer and has an affair with his stepmother. programme.title: Legend of being / Legenda o Enju
programme.desc: On an exotic and exciting background of fantastic prehistoric beasts and shamanism, smart and talented 12-year-old boy Enjo lead us to the spectacular journey of fantasy, fun and wild adventures. / Na egzotičnoj i uzbudljivoj pozadini fantastičnih praistorijskih zveri i šamanizma, pametni i talentovani 12-godišnji dečak Enjo vodi nas na spektakularno putovanje fantazije, zabave i divlje avanture.

programme.title: K3 / K3
programme.desc: French-Belgian animated series about Kim, Kate and Kyles, which are three ordinary girls, top teenage stars on a glamorous global tour full of unexpected trades that lead them to fun stories. / Francusko-belgijska animirana serija o Kim, Kejt i Kajli koje su tri obične devojke, vrhunske tinejdžerske pop zvezde na glamuroznoj globalnoj turneji punoj neočekivanih obrta koji ih dovode do zabavnih priča.

programme.title: Old Tom / Stari Tom
programme.desc: Adventures of the angel of Trogmorton and her benevolent but lazy cat named Old Tom. An angel is obsessed with good and fine behavior, but the old Tom is a restless joker who breaks her harmony and order. / Pustolovine Anđele Trogmorton i njenog dobrodušnog, ali lenjog mačka po imenu Stari Tom. Anđela je opsednuta dobrim i finim ponašanjem, ali Stari Tom je nemirni šaljivdžija koji razbija njen sklad i red.

programme.title: Five aliens / Pet vanzemaljac
programme.desc: Five naughty spaces come to Earth and decide to settle at 12-year-old Tommy Kadlija. They soon realize that Tommy is not the most popular among his peers, so they decide to help him in their own specific way. The lively aliens do not realize that the life of the adolescent itself is not very easy, and their interference will literally turn things up ancient. / Petorica nestašnih svemiraca dolaze na Zemlju i odluče se nastaniti kod 12-godišnjeg Tomija Kadlija. Ubrzo shvate da Tomi nije baš najpopularniji među svojim vršnjacima, pa mu odluče pomoći na svoj specifičan način. Živahni vanzemaljci ne shvataju da život adolescenta sam po sebi nije baš lak, a njihovo uplitanje doslovce će stvari okrenuti naglavačke.

programme.title: Polo / Polo
programme.desc: Polo lives in the world of dreams. He has his island, where his home is in a tree. It's free like a bird. He lives alone, but his friends are always around. You can travel through the body of a whale in the Polo's world, snowblows can revive and you can safely drop down the crater of the volcano! This peaceful world that Polo loves and wants to protect, is full of fantasies. Because Polo is a vigilant and friendly guardian of the world that represents the child's imagination ... / Polo živi u svetu snova. On ima svoje ostrvo, gde je njegov dom u drvetu. Slobodan je kao ptica. Živi sam, ali njegovi prijatelji su uvek u blizini. U Poloovom svetu možete putovati kroz telo kita, Sneško Belići može oživeti i možete se sigurno spustiti niz krater vulkana! Ovaj miran svet koji Polo voli i želi zaštititi, pun je fantazije. Jer Polo je budan i prijateljski čuvar sveta koji predstavlja dečju maštu...

programme.title: Beti BUP / Beti Bup
programme.desc: Betty Bup is an animated cartoon character created by Max Fleischer. Her character is inspired by the famous singer and acre Helen Kane. At first the character was conceived as a French poodle, but over time, her creator was added to her by the 1932. The character we know today was finalized, and instead of a small bitch, the frosty little nose. / Beti Bup je animirani lik iz crtanog filma koji je stvorio Max Fleischer. U početku je lik bio zamišljen kao francuska pudlica, ali sa vremenom, njen kreator joj je dodavao ljudska obeležja i 1932. lik Beti Bup kakav znamo danas je finalizovan, pa je umesto šlampavih ušiju dobila minđuše a umesto malog kučećeg nosa, prćasti mali nos.

programme.title: Animalia / Animalija
programme.desc: Follow 11-year-old Zoe and Alex into a fascinating and exciting world. Their great adventure adventure begins when in the library due to a series of strange events, suddenly find themselves in the country of the animals that speak. Zoe and Alex soon discover that something is wrong in the once so peaceful kingdom. Their arrival is closely linked to strange events that increasingly weaken this unusual civilization and the heart of Animali, mag. Our main heroes with the help of a sharp intellect and creativity GBUBU and Iguane Igi try to find the solution to these mysterious events and re-establish order and harmony in the country of Animalija. / Pratite 11-godišnju Zoe i Aleksa u fascinantan i uzbudljiv svet. Zoe i Aleks ubrzo otkrivaju da nešto nije u redu u nekada tako mirnom kraljevstvu. Njihov dolazak usko je povezan sa čudnim događajima koji sve više slabe ovu neuobičajenu civilizaciju i srce Animalije, Mag. Naši glavni junaci uz pomoć oštrog intelekta i kreativnosti gorile GBubu i iguane Igi pokušavaju pronaći rešenje ovih misterioznih događaja i ponovo uspostaviti red i harmoniju u zemlji Animaliji.

programme.desc: There are various worlds, and in this animated series, the words become the main characters. / Postoje razni svetovi, a u ovom animiranom serijalu, reči postaju glavni junaci.

programme.title: Beti BUP / Beti Bup
programme.desc: Betty Bup is an animated cartoon character created by Max Fleischer. Her character is inspired by the famous singer and acre Helen Kane. At first the character was conceived as a French poodle, but over time, her creator was added to her by the 1932. The character we know today was finalized, and instead of a small bitch, the frosty little nose. / Beti Bup je animirani lik iz crtanog filma koji je stvorio Max Fleischer. Njen lik je inspirisan poznatom pevačicom i glumicom Helen Kejn. U početku je lik bio zamišljen kao francuska pudlica, ali sa vremenom, njen kreator joj je dodavao ljudska obeležja i 1932. lik Beti Bup kakav znamo danas je finalizovan, pa je umesto šlampavih ušiju dobila minđuše a umesto malog kučećeg nosa, prćasti mali nos.

programme.title: Animalia / Animalija
programme.desc: Follow 11-year-old Zoe and Alex into a fascinating and exciting world. Their great adventure adventure begins when in the library due to a series of strange events, suddenly find themselves in the country of the animals that speak. Zoe and Alex soon discover that something is wrong in the once so peaceful kingdom. Their arrival is closely linked to strange events that increasingly weaken this unusual civilization and the heart of Animali, mag. Our main heroes with the help of a sharp intellect and creativity GBUBU and Iguane Igi try to find the solution to these mysterious events and re-establish order and harmony in the country of Animalija. / Pratite 11-godišnju Zoe i Aleksa u fascinantan i uzbudljiv svet. Njihova velika životna avantura započinje kada se u biblioteci usled niza čudnih događaja, odjedanput nađu u zemlji životinja koje govore. Zoe i Aleks ubrzo otkrivaju da nešto nije u redu u nekada tako mirnom kraljevstvu. Njihov dolazak usko je povezan sa čudnim događajima koji sve više slabe ovu neuobičajenu civilizaciju i srce Animalije, Mag. Naši glavni junaci uz pomoć oštrog intelekta i kreativnosti gorile GBubu i iguane Igi pokušavaju pronaći rešenje ovih misterioznih događaja i ponovo uspostaviti red i harmoniju u zemlji Animaliji.

programme.title: Bobi i bil / Bobi i Bil
programme.desc: Do you want to see the sweetest comradest in the world? The adventure of the young boy Bobby, his funny house and Karolina, a turtle driving a skate, will surely be a lot of fun to watch. Laugh with them every day! / Da li želiš da vidiš najslađe drugarstvo na svetu? Avanture mladog dečaka Bobija, njegovog smešnog kučeta Bila i Karoline, kornjače koja vozi skejt, sigurno će celoj porodici biti jako zabavne za gledanje. Smej se sa njima svakog dana!

programme.title: Mumuhag / Mumuhag
programme.desc: The cartoon series follows the Avatnure Mumuhag, a small dolphin that lives on the island of Muava. Mumuhag is always cheerful and in the mood and meet new friends every day. / Crtani serijal prati avatnure Mumuhaga, malog delfina koji živi na ostrvu Muava. Mumuhag je uvek veseo i raspoložen i svakodnevno upoznaje nove prijatelje.

programme.title: Legend of being / Legenda o Enju
programme.desc: On an exotic and exciting background of fantastic prehistoric beasts and shamanism, smart and talented 12-year-old boy Enjo lead us to the spectacular journey of fantasy, fun and wild adventures. / Na egzotičnoj i uzbudljivoj pozadini fantastičnih praistorijskih zveri i šamanizma, pametni i talentovani 12-godišnji dečak Enjo vodi nas na spektakularno putovanje fantazije, zabave i divlje avanture.

programme.title: K3 / K3
programme.desc: French-Belgian animated series about Kim, Kate and Kyles, which are three ordinary girls, top teenage stars on a glamorous global tour full of unexpected trades that lead them to fun stories. / Francusko-belgijska animirana serija o Kim, Kejt i Kajli koje su tri obične devojke, vrhunske tinejdžerske pop zvezde na glamuroznoj globalnoj turneji punoj neočekivanih obrta koji ih dovode do zabavnih priča.

programme.title: Old Tom / Stari Tom
programme.desc: Adventures of the angel of Trogmorton and her benevolent but lazy cat named Old Tom. An angel is obsessed with good and fine behavior, but the old Tom is a restless joker who breaks her harmony and order. / Pustolovine Anđele Trogmorton i njenog dobrodušnog, ali lenjog mačka po imenu Stari Tom. Anđela je opsednuta dobrim i finim ponašanjem, ali Stari Tom je nemirni šaljivdžija koji razbija njen sklad i red.

programme.title: Five aliens / Pet vanzemaljac
programme.desc: Five naughty spaces come to Earth and decide to settle at 12-year-old Tommy Kadlija. They soon realize that Tommy is not the most popular among his peers, so they decide to help him in their own specific way. The lively aliens do not realize that the life of the adolescent itself is not very easy, and their interference will literally turn things up ancient. / Petorica nestašnih svemiraca dolaze na Zemlju i odluče se nastaniti kod 12-godišnjeg Tomija Kadlija. Ubrzo shvate da Tomi nije baš najpopularniji među svojim vršnjacima, pa mu odluče pomoći na svoj specifičan način. Živahni vanzemaljci ne shvataju da život adolescenta sam po sebi nije baš lak, a njihovo uplitanje doslovce će stvari okrenuti naglavačke.

programme.title: Polo / Polo
programme.desc: Polo lives in the world of dreams. He has his island, where his home is in a tree. It's free like a bird. He lives alone, but his friends are always around. You can travel through the body of a whale in the Polo's world, snowblows can revive and you can safely drop down the crater of the volcano! This peaceful world that Polo loves and wants to protect, is full of fantasies. Because Polo is a vigilant and friendly guardian of the world that represents the child's imagination ... / Polo živi u svetu snova. On ima svoje ostrvo, gde je njegov dom u drvetu. Slobodan je kao ptica. Živi sam, ali njegovi prijatelji su uvek u blizini. U Poloovom svetu možete putovati kroz telo kita, Sneško Belići može oživeti i možete se sigurno spustiti niz krater vulkana! Ovaj miran svet koji Polo voli i želi zaštititi, pun je fantazije. Jer Polo je budan i prijateljski čuvar sveta koji predstavlja dečju maštu...

programme.title: Danika / Danika
programme.desc: Danik Merik lives in a seemingly perfect family, has three children and her husband who adores. Unfortunately, behind the mask of that life hides a dark secret. Namely, Daniku is her husband, Randy, cheated with the nanny of their children and since then she has all the more terrible nightmares. Soon the sea are not limited to dreams only, so Danik starts experiencing strange and frightening visions, in which he sees the death of his children. / Danika Merik živi u naizgled savršenoj porodici, ima troje dece i muža kojeg obožava. Nažalost, iza maske tog života skriva se mračna tajna. Naime, Daniku je njen muž, Rendi, prevario sa dadiljom njihove dece i od tada ona ima sve strašnije noćne more. Uskoro te more nisu ograničene samo na snove pa Danika počne doživljavati čudne i zastrašujuće vizije, u kojima vidi smrt svoje dece.

programme.title: Deca Huang on this / Deca Huang Šia
programme.desc: The true epic story from the war-rift short 30's, about how Young Englishman Jeord Hog translated 60 orphans through the snow mountains Liu Pan Shan, almost 1,500 kilometers to the Security of the Ivica Mongol Desert. / Istinita epska priča iz ratom razorene Kine kasnih 30-ih, o tome kako je mladi Englez Džordž Hog preveo 60 siročića preko snežnih planina Liu Pan Šan, skoro 1.500 kilometara do bezbednosti ivice Mongolske pustinje.

programme.title: The city of evil / Grad zla
programme.desc: A violent gang begins to fall apart when their leader finds love and decides to leave Badsvil - a city where love does not exist ... / Nasilna banda počinje se raspadati kada njihov lider pronađe ljubav i odluči je da napusti Badsvil - grad u kome ljubav ne postoji...

programme.title: On top / Na vrhu
programme.desc: LincoLn Hok will fight for his son in the only way ... He is a strong trucker who fights to build his life from the beginning, after his wife's death. / Linkoln Hok će se boriti za svog sina na jedini način koji zna... On je snažni kamiondžija koji se bori da izgradi svoj život iz početka, nakon smrti svoje žene.

programme.title: Escape / Bekstvo u lancima
programme.desc: Two convicts are drawn in the race where they will have to outwit and overcome enemies on both sides of the law. After the dramatic escape from prison, the convicts of Piper and Dodge are at large-tied handcuffs. Besomely driven through the wilds of Georgia, reluctant allies are pierced to Atlanta, clashing all the time with the authorities, but also among themselves. / Dva robijaša uvučena su u trku u kojoj će morati da nadmudre i savladaju neprijatelje sa obe strane zakona. Posle dramatičnog bekstva iz zatvora, osuđenici Pajper i Dodž nalaze se na slobodi vezani lisicama. Besomučno gonjeni kroz divljinu Džordžije, nevoljni saveznici probijaju se do Atlante, sukobljavajući se sve vreme sa vlastima, ali i među sobom.

programme.title: Maliciously / Zloćudno
programme.desc: The story revolves around Madison, who begins to experience strong visions of murders after trauma. Her suffering and panic are increasing when it finds out that these are not just visions, that is, that you wake dreams are not imaginary but intimidating visions of reality - Madison sees murders as they actually happen. Madison also reveals that she was associated with the killer in the past. That is why he starts working with the police to prevent the killer in further campaigns. Wednesday, 15.05.2024. / Priča se vrti oko Madison, koja nakon traume počinje doživljavati snažne vizije ubistava. Njena patnja i panika se povećavaju kada otkrije da to nisu samo vizije, odnosno da ti budni snovi nisu imaginarni već zastrašujuće vizije stvarnosti - Madison vidi ubistva dok se ona zapravo događaju. Madison otkriva i da je u prošlosti bila povezana sa ubicom. Zbog toga počinje raditi sa policijom kako bi ubicu sprečili u daljnjim pohodima. Sreda, 15.05.2024.

programme.title: A calculation in the little Tokyo / Obračun u malom Tokiju
programme.desc: The action takes place in Los Angeles. Cop Kris Kener works in Mali Tokyo, Japanese district Los Angeles, and fights organized crime as best. He grew up in Japan, Chris's parents died from the Hand of Jakuza Killer, and he will remember the appearance of the criminal who broke into their house forever. One day, the authorities are sent by the Kenar of the new partner, Johnny Murat. Johnny, although the semi-Japanese himself, lived in the United States from his childhood and was educated in the spirit of American culture. Initially, Murato and Kenar is not easy to cooperate with each other, but the joint investigation and cold-blooded bills help partners find a common language. The murder of the dancer in the nightclub and the spread of the new drug metamphetamine in that area puts the police on the trail of the Klanu Jakuza and their leaders, relentless Jošida. Seeing Josid, Kener recognizes the killer of his parents, and the investigation turns into revenge ... / Radnja se odvija u Los Anđelesu. Policajac Kris Kener radi u Malom Tokiju, japanskom okrugu Los Anđelesa, i bori se protiv organizovanog kriminala najbolje što može. Odrastao u Japanu, Krisovi roditelji su umrli od ruke ubice jakuze, a on će zauvek pamtiti izgled kriminalca koji je provalio u njihovu kuću. Jednog dana, vlasti šalju Keneru novog partnera, Džonija Muratu. Džoni, iako i sam polu-Japanac, od detinjstva je živeo u Sjedinjenim Državama i vaspitavan je u duhu američke kulture. Muratu i Keneru u početku nije lako da sarađuju jedan sa drugim, ali zajednička istraga i hladnokrvni obračuni pomažu partnerima da pronađu zajednički jezik. Ubistvo plesačice u noćnom klubu i širenje nove droge metamfetamina u toj oblasti stavlja policiju na trag klanu jakuza i njihovom vođi, nemilosrdnom Jošidi. Videvši Jošidu, Kener prepoznaje ubicu svojih roditelja, a istraga se pretvara u osvetu...

programme.title: Resurrection / Uskrsnuće
programme.desc: Keyfly, a powerful Roman military tribun, and his assistant Lucius, get the mstand to resolve Jesus on Sundays after the crucifixion, to deny rumors about the Easter Messiah, and prevented the Uprising in Jerusalem. / Klavijus, moćni rimski vojni tribun, i njegov pomoćnik Lucijus, dobijaju zadatak da reše misteriju šta se desilo sa Isusom u nedeljama posle raspeća, da bi opovrgli glasine o uskrslom Mesiji, i sprečili ustanak u Jerusalimu.

programme.title: Brick / Cigla
programme.desc: High school brendan Frye is intelligent and withdrawn. An eternal outsider is astonished with a sudden disappearance of his ex-girlfriend Emily, according to which he still grows deep emotions. On his way to her finding the luck of numerous unusual people, who will open his eyes and do the search for an unforgettable life experience .. / Srednjoškolac Brendan Frye inteligentan je i povučen. Večni autsajder zaprepašćen je iznenadnim nestankom svoje bivše devojke Emily prema kojoj još gaji duboke emocije. Na putu do njenog pronalaska srešće brojne neobične ljude, koji će mu otvoriti oči i učiniti potragu nezaboravnim životnim iskustvom..

programme.title: Pobuna Na Brodu Baunti / Pobuna na brodu Baunti
programme.desc: Captain Grimmed and Admiral Hood examine Captain William Blajz at the trial in which he tries to explain what events led to the loss of the command on the Baunte ship. Captain Blajz gathered the crew and headed for the ship by boat towards Tahiti. He is also his friend, young and ambitious Christian Fletcher on board. In order to obtain time, the Bluj decides to sail around the cape horn, a route that is insecure and unknown. The crew barely survives that endeavor, which only increases the tension and dissatisfaction due to its extremely cruel imposition of discipline. When they finally arrive on the island, the paradise atmosphere deletes memory of all conflicts and problems. Fletcher falls in love and engages in a passionate love relationship with the Tahičan Princess, which is even more destroyed by discipline and destroys the friendship between him and the Captain. The time of return and the crew is reluctant to leave the island, and the conflicts on board continue. When the captain ordered a return to the same dangerous road, the Fletcher brings a fateful decision and takes over the ship. / Kapetan Gritam i admiral Hud ispituju kapetana Vilijama Blajdža na suđenju u kojem on pokušava da objasni koji su događaji doveli do gubitka komande na brodu Baunti. Kapetan Blajdž okupio je posadu i krenuo na putovanje brodom prema Tahitiju. Na brodu je i njegov prijatelj, mladi i ambiciozni Kristjian Flečer. Kako bi dobio na vremenu, Blajdž odlučuje da otplovi oko Rta Horna, rutom koja je nesigurna i nepoznata. Posada jedva preživljava taj poduhvat, što samo povećava napetost i nezadovoljstvo zbog njegovog izuzetno okrutnog nametanja discipline. Kada napokon stignu na ostrvo, rajska atmosfera briše sećanje na sve sukobe i probleme. Flečer se zaljubljuje i upušta u strastvenu ljubavnu vezu s tahićanskom princezom, što još više uništava disciplinu i razara prijateljstvo između njega i kapetana. Vreme je povratka i posada nerado napušta ostrvo, a sukobi na brodu se nastavljaju. Kad kapetan bude naredio povratak istim opasnim putem, Flečer donosi sudbonosnu odluku i preuzima brod.

programme.title: Inkubus / Inkubus
programme.desc: The police station does the last shift only with the most perpetrator staff because it will soon be demolished. When a demon incubus quietly walked into the station by carrying a wedding head of the murdered girl, the night moves a strange course. It allows him to keep and question him, and he admits all his crimes. Why? It has a debt that needs to be resolved with one of the detectives that almost took care of it thirteen years ago. The cops soon become toys in the arms of incubus. / Policijska stanica radi poslednju smenu samo sa najnužnijim osobljem jer će uskoro biti srušena. Kada se demon Inkubus mirno ušeta u stanicu noseći odrubljenu glavu ubijene devojke, noć krene čudnim tokom. Dopušta da ga zadrže i ispituju, i on priznaje sve svoje zločine. Zašto? Ima dug koji treba razrešiti sa jednim od detektiva koji ga je zamalo sredio pre trinaest godina. Policajci ubrzo postaju igračke u rukama Inkubusa.

programme.title: Ruthless 3 / Nemilosrdni 3
programme.desc: SEM DIC, a relentless police detective, returns to Los Angeles from a self-motion exile to help the police resolve another series of brutal killers committed by another cunning serial killer whose target is the last love. / Sem Dic, neumoljivi policijski detektiv, vraća se u Los Anđeles iz samonametnutog egzila kako bi pomogao policiji u rešavanju još jednog niza brutalnih ubistava koje je počinio još jedan lukavi serijski ubica čija je meta Dicova poslednja ljubav.

programme.desc: Keyfly, a powerful Roman military tribun, and his assistant Lucius, get the mstand to resolve Jesus on Sundays after the crucifixion, to deny rumors about the Easter Messiah, and prevented the Uprising in Jerusalem. / Klavijus, moćni rimski vojni tribun, i njegov pomoćnik Lucijus, dobijaju zadatak da reše misteriju šta se desilo sa Isusom u nedeljama posle raspeća, da bi opovrgli glasine o uskrslom Mesiji, i sprečili ustanak u Jerusalimu.

programme.title: Brick / Cigla
programme.desc: High school brendan Frye is intelligent and withdrawn. An eternal outsider is astonished with a sudden disappearance of his ex-girlfriend Emily, according to which he still grows deep emotions. On his way to her finding the luck of numerous unusual people, who will open his eyes and do the search for an unforgettable life experience .. / Srednjoškolac Brendan Frye inteligentan je i povučen. Večni autsajder zaprepašćen je iznenadnim nestankom svoje bivše devojke Emily prema kojoj još gaji duboke emocije. Na putu do njenog pronalaska srešće brojne neobične ljude, koji će mu otvoriti oči i učiniti potragu nezaboravnim životnim iskustvom..

programme.title: Octagon / Oktagon
programme.desc: Scott Jams (even noris) remains without the best friend and meets the circle of mobsters known as octagon. By entering their society, she realizes that maybe one of them is the killer of his friend. How will the truth come? / Skot Džems (Čak Noris) ostaje bez najboljeg prijatelja i upoznaje krug mafijaša poznat kao Oktagon. Ulazeći u njihovo društvo, shvata da je možda jedan od njih ubica njegovog prijatelja. Kako će doći do istine?

programme.title: Cobra / Kobra
programme.desc: A gang of NeoPhashist criminals, led by self-proclaimed sections, breaks into the houses and cars, killing people without any occasion. When one of the members of the gang tries to orobi to the small store, whose customers, whose hostages, is invited by an uncompromising police officer Cobrita who resolving the case occurs. Later that night, another murder occurs, which is witnessed by young Ingrid. Ingrid begins to get numerous threats, and the only one who can protect her is just a cobra. / Banda neofašističkih kriminalaca, predvođena samoproglašenim Slešerom, provaljuje u kuće i automobile, ubijajući ljude bez ikakvog povoda. Kada jedan od pripadnika bande pokuša da orobi maleni dućan, čije mušterije uzima kao taoce, na mesto zločina je pozvan beskompromisni policajac Kobreti koji rešivši slučaj dolazi do korisnih informacija o Slešeru. Kasnije te noći, dolazi do još jednog ubistva, o kojem svedoči mlada Ingrid. Ingrid počinje da dobija brojne pretnje, a jedini koji može da je zaštiti upravo je Kobra.

programme.title: Cup, without Kočizov / Taza, sin Kočizov
programme.desc: Three years after the war was terminated in his credited war between Indians and Belaces, the Chief Apache Kočise died, and his place took over the older son of Taz. Like the Father and Taza advocates peace, but his younger brother came prone to warfare and try to kill Tazu. TAZA mastered him and spared him, however, and his men soon kills three whites, initiating a new war. Thanks to the Tazi and Equestrian Captain Burnet, the war is avoided and Apaches go to the reservation where peace will keep the Indian police, led by Taza. However, the danger to peace represent the Indians who do not agree, as soon as soon as possible, the arrival of mostly rebeled by Jeroni. / Tri godine nakon što je njegovom zaslugom okončan rat između Indijanaca i belaca, poglavica Apača Kočise je umro, a njegovo mesto preuzima stariji sin Taza. Poput oca i Taza zagovara mir, ali njegov mlađi brat Naiči sklon je ratovanju i pokuša ubiti Tazu. Taza ga savlada i poštedi, međutim Naiči i njegovi ljudi ubrzo ubiju troje belaca, inicirajući novi rat. Zahvaljujući Tazi i konjičkom kapetanu Burnetu rat je izbegnut i Apači odlaze u rezervat gde će mir među njima čuvati indijanska policija, predvođena Tazom. Međutim, opasnost za mir predstavljaju Indijanci koji se s tim ne slažu, kao i skori dolazak večito pobunjenog Džeronima.

programme.title: Rider / Jahač
programme.desc: After a tragic riding accident, a young cowboy from Rodea, Brady, was warned that he must no longer compete. When he returns home, Brady begins to wonder what to live for when he can no longer deal with what he gives him a purpose. / Nakon tragične jahačke nesreće, mladi kauboj sa rodea, Brejdi, upozoren je da više ne sme da se takmiči. Kada se vrati kući, Brejdi počinje da se pita za šta da živi kada više ne može da se bavi onim što mu daje svrhu.

programme.title: Gray owl / Siva sova
programme.desc: The main character is a denim that has accepted the way of life in the wild and found love among its inhabitants. When he discovered that his holy threatening the danger of extermination, passion cited him to fight and protect the land he loved ... / Glavni junak je traper koji je prihvatio način života u divljini i našao ljubav među njenim stanovnicima. Kada je otkrio da njegovom svetu preti opasnost od istrebljenja, strast ga je navodila da se bori i zaštiti zemlju koju voli...

programme.title: In the Nevada gorge / U klancu Nevade
programme.desc: After the alert on the diphtheria epidemic in one isolated military base in the west, the US government sends a special railway composition with medicines and other necessary material. There are, among the others, the Deputy Federal Sheriff, Neutan Pierce, Sergeant Clermont, Governor Richard Firjald and Governor's companion of Maris. Due to the technical problems, the train temporarily stops at the incoming station on which Deputy Pierce arrested a cheater on the maps, mysterious John Mare. The real problems will only be up after the path of the road, because someone will kill Dr. Molineks. But it won't be the only murder in the train ... / Nakon dojava o epidemiji difterije u jednoj izolovanoj vojnoj bazi na zapadu, američka vlada šalje posebnu železničku kompoziciju sa lekovima i ostalim potrebnim materijalom. U vozu su, među ostalima, i zamenik saveznog šerifa Nejtan Pirs, vodnik Klermont, guverner Ričard Ferčajld i guvernerova pratilja Marisa. Zbog tehničkih problema voz se privremeno zaustavlja na usputnoj stanici na kojoj zamenik Pirs hapsi varalicu na kartama, tajanstvenog Džona Mareja. Pravi problemi iskrsnuće tek nakon nastavka puta, jer neko će ubiti dr Molineksa. Ali to neće biti jedino ubistvo u vozu...

programme.title: Arizona / Arizona
programme.desc: 1860. Years. The infinite convoy moved to the west. All families, old and young people, people with dreams, rushed to the West to the new country. Indian attacks, mountains and deserts, hunger and thirst, could not stop them. These were people who determined the fate of the great new territory. A woman doctor stops in a small town and decides to start the practice there. Feb (J. Arthur), although a strong and pioneering woman, becomes extremely feminine when he falls in love with Peter (V. Holden). However, Peter will not give up on the plan of capturing the vessels of Jefferson Karteret (V. Viliam) and Lazarus Word (P. Hal), but in that case he will have to leave Feb. Will she last see him? / 1860. godina. Beskonačni konvoj kretao se ka zapadu. Čitave porodice, stari i mladi, ljudi sa snovima, hrlili su na zapad ka novoj zemlji. Napadi Indijanaca, planine i pustinja, glad i žeđ, nisu mogli da ih zaustave. Bili su to ljudi koji su određivali sudbinu velike nove teritorije. Žena lekar zaustavlja se u malom gradu i odlučuje da tamo započne praksu. Feb (Dž. Artur), iako snažna i pionirska žena, postaje izrazito ženstvena kada se zaljubi u Pitera (V. Holden). Ipak, Piter neće odustati od plana hvatanja zlikovaca Džefersona Kartereta (V. Viliam) i Lazarusa Vorda (P. Hal), ali će u tom slučaju morati da ostavi Feb. Da li će ga ona poslednji put videti?

programme.title: Three hours to kill / Tri sata za ubijanje
programme.desc: Jim Gatri was falsely accused of murder, and from the accusation and the persecution barely escaped and pulled out a living head. The next three years he spends himself as a wanted fugitive, but returned to the city to find the right murderer and the one who placed him, because he is tired of running away and injustice. / Džim Gatri je lažno optužen za ubistvo, a od optužbe i progona je jedva pobegao i izvukao živu glavu. Sledeće tri godine provede kao traženi begunac, ali se vrati u grad pronaći pravog ubicu i onog ko mu je smestio, jer je umoran od bežanja i nepravde.

programme.title: River without a return / Reka bez povratka
programme.desc: On his way to the house, the farmer of Meta Caldera (Robert Mitch), who recently came out of prison, robbed Harry Veston gambler (Rori Kalhun). Mark's son Mark (Tomi Retig) and an ambitious singer from Salun, Kay (Merilin Monro), were witnesses of the attack. Not wanting to help Veston, who left her, Kay decides to stay with an injured target. Given that they are located on the Indian, enemy territory, the safest way to the house is the river. Wishing to take revenge on a runway to the spest, the target makes a raft and with Brand and Kay moving in search. When he finally finds it, it turns out that Kay could change his mind very easily and that it is possible to help the spest of escaping. / Na putu do kuće, farmera Meta Kaldera (Robert Mičam), koji je nedavno izašao iz zatvora, opljačkao je kockar Hari Veston (Rori Kalhun). Metov sin Mark (Tomi Retig) i ambiciozna pevačica iz saluna, Kej (Merilin Monro), bili su svedoci napada. Ne želeći da pomogne Vestonu, koji ju je napustio, Kej odlučuje da ostane sa povređenim Metom. S obzirom na to da se nalaze na indijanskoj, neprijateljskoj teritoriji, najsigurniji put do kuće im je reka. Želeći da se osveti odbeglom Vestonu, Met pravi splav i sa Markom i Kej kreće u potragu. Kada ga konačno pronađe, ispostavlja se da bi Kej vrlo lako mogla da promeni mišljenje i da je moguće da pomogne Vestonu da pobegne.

programme.title: Cizum / Čizum
programme.desc: John Boots is the old king of the cattle breeding, which decides to defend his empire from the greenhouse. Vejon's personality perfectly suits this reconstruction of the event in Novi Mexico in 1878. known as the Lincoln War of the District. / Džon Čizm je stari kralj stočara, koji odlučuje da brani svoje carstvo od zelenaša u usponu. Vejnova ličnost savršeno odgovara ovoj rekonstrukciji događaja u Novom Meksiku 1878. poznatoj kao Linkolnov Rat Okruga.

programme.title: Nice day to hang / Lep dan za vešanje
programme.desc: As very young Eddi, he came to the city with a gang to rob a bank, but was caught and convicted. The sheriff, Marshall Ben helps him and he is in charge, and he becomes a honorable citizen. Many years later, that same gang returned to the city to reboot the bank. At their escape, they kill Marshall. Edi is the only one who can identify the killer - but he is in great doubt whether to be loyal to new friends or his old friend. / Još kao veoma mlad Edi je došao u grad sa bandom da opljačka banku, ali je uhvaćen i osuđen. Šerif, Maršal Ben mu pomaže i prevaspitava ga, i on postaje častan građanin. Mnogo godina kasnije, ta ista banda se vraća u grad da ponovo opljačka banku. Pri njihovom bekstvu oni ubijaju Maršala. Edi je jedini koji može da identifikuje ubicu - ali on je u velikoj nedoumici da li da bude lojalan novim prijateljima ili pak svojoj staroj družini.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and Indians / Bafalo Bil i Indijanci
programme.desc: Colonel Viliam Kodi, better known as the Bufalo Bil, is looking for fame and money traveling to America with his circus show made on the basis of a myth created by a writer Ned Bantlajn. The play encounters a standing ovation of audiences who buy tickets massively. The well -established color is broken by a chief who engulfs a greater dose of authenticity, which in turn will not like Bil. Namely, he is important to him exclusively. / Pukovnik Viliam Kodi, poznatiji kao Bufalo Bil, u potrazi za slavom i novcem putuje Amerikom sa svojom cirkuskom predstavom napravljenoj na osnovu mita koji je o njemu stvorio pisac Ned Bantlajn. Predstava nailazi na ovacije publike koja masovno kupuje ulaznice. Uhodanu kolotečinu razbija poglavica koji zahteva veću dozu autentičnosti što se pak neće svideti Bilu. Njemu je, naime, važan isključivo novac.

programme.title: Zeaous znns / Znak Zoroa
programme.desc: Adventure on a camouflaged hero and his effort to bring down cruel power, which collects huge taxes from poor farmers. / Avantura o maskiranom heroju i njegovom nastojanju da sruši okrutnu vlast, koja ubira ogromne poreze od siromašnih zemljoradnika.

programme.title: Seventh cavalry / Sedma konjica
programme.desc: Returning to Fort Lincoln, Captain Benson finds out about Kaster's defeat at Litl Big Horn. At the hearing of Kaster's officers to blame the defeat kaster, while Benson defends him. However, the caster was indeed absent during the battle and that is why the army now despises it. Benson is applying for the dangerous body of returning the bodies of the dead from the Indian territory where the battle took place. / Vraćajući se u Fort Linkoln, kapetan Benson saznaje za Kasterov poraz kod Litl Big Horna. Na saslušanju Kasterovi oficiri krive Kastera za poraz, dok ga Benson brani. Međutim, Kaster je zaista bio odsutan za vreme bitke i zbog toga ga vojska sada prezire. Benson se prijavljuje za opasnu misiju vraćanja tela poginulih sa indijanske teritorije gde se bitka odigrala.

programme.title: Revenge of the dead / Osveta mrtvaca
programme.desc: Gorki and vindictive fugitive Lacquer, a former slave who is a hunter on the heads of the American Marshal Bošin, gather in a small town to resolve the intricate consciousness and the ruthless railway speculator of Pejton McKeja. / Gorki i osvetoljubivi begunac Lak Hečer, bivši rob koji je sada lovac na glave Džesap Buš i lukavi zamenik američkog maršala Bodin, okupljaju se u malom gradu kako bi rešili zamršenu zaveru i uhapsili pohlepnog i nemilosrdnog železničkog špekulanta Pejtona MekKeja.

programme.title: Cowboys / Kauboji
programme.desc: American West, in the second half of 19. century. The old livestock Vil Andersen prepares large transportation cattle, but due to the discovery of gold in the area, suddenly remain without already engaged assistants, who leaves him hoping for better and easier earnings. Andersen's old friend Ans Petersen suggested he hires boys from a nearby school. Andersen seems to be stupid at first, but without the second solution, in the end of discounts and decide to convert guille guys into cowboys. The task is not at all simple, but the group of boys led by the old man goes on the road soon. To keep things up, Andersen, Boys and Black Kuvar, Jedediahu Najtlinger for heels are robbers led by Cruel Eyes Vats, who would be happy to grab a livestock. / Američki zapad, u drugoj polovini 19. veka. Ostareli stočar Vil Andersen priprema veliki transport stoke, no zbog otkrića zlata u okolici iznenada ostane bez već angažovanih pomoćnika, koji ga napuste nadajući se boljoj i lakšoj zaradi. Andersenov stari prijatelj Ans Petersen predloži mu da angažuje dečake iz obližnje škole. Andersenu se ideja isprva učini glupom, no nemajući drugog rješenja, na koncu popusti i odluči pretvoriti golobrade dečke u kauboje. Zadatak nije nimalo jednostavan, no skupina dečaka predvođena starcem uskoro krene na put. Da stvari budu gore, Andersenu, dečacima i crnom kuvaru Jedediahu Najtlindžeru za petama su razbojnici predvođeni okrutnim Ejsom Vatsom, koji bi se rado dočepali stoke.

programme.title: The steps of the revolver / Koraci revolveraša
programme.desc: Li Haket is a rancher of the old-coffin, accustomed to his laws and solve the problem with a gun. He also tried his two sons on the model of himself, and he was more than successful, even so much that this was accused of killing Melez. The younger son leaves the old rules and is closer to the sister of the killed man. Does he realize that his way of resolving things doesn't work anymore. / Li Haket je rančer starog kova, navikao na svoje zakone I na rešavanje problema pištoljem. Pokušao je i svoja dva sina da podigne po uzoru na sebe, I sa starijim je i više nego uspeo, čak toliko da je ovaj optužen da je ubio meleza. Mlađi sin napušta stara pravila i zbližava se sa sestrom ubijenog čoveka. Li uviđa da njegov način rešavanja stvari više ne funkcioniše.

programme.title: Don't think about it / Ne misli o tome
programme.desc: The cute Stefano Nardini 36-year-old is a Roman panker that remembers better days. For a long time, he does not find satisfaction in the music he performs. When one day he found his girlfriend in the arms of the other, he concluded that time for big changes. In search of internal peace and perhaps a new beginning, he goes to her gender rimini believing that his companionship with family members will help him arrest life. It will very quickly realize that it is not only he who has problems. While his father Walter still recovered from a recent heart attack, and time spends golf course, Stefan's mother calming and consolation seeks at sessions in trendy guru and self-defiant shaman. There are also Stefan's brother Alberto, a once-gifted athletes, who took the company from the sick father, and the younger sister of Mihael, which was interrupted by the studies. / Simpatični Stefano Nardini 36-godišnji je rimski panker koji pamti i bolje dane. Već duže vreme ne pronalazi zadovoljstvo u muzici koju izvodi. Kada jednog dana zatekne svoju devojku u naručju drugoga, zaključi da je vreme za velike promene. U potrazi za unutrašnjim mirom i možda novim početkom, odlazi u rodni Rimini verujući da će mu druženje s članovima porodice pomoći u sređivanju života. Vrlo brzo će shvatiti da nije samo on taj koji ima probleme. Dok se njegov otac Valter još uvek oporavlja od nedavnog srčanog udara, i vreme provodi igrajući golf, Stefanova majka smirenje i utehu traži na seansama kod trendovskog gurua i samozvanog šamana. Tu su i Stefanov brat Alberto, nekad darovit sportista, koji je od bolesnog oca preuzeo vođenje firme, i mlađa sestra Mihaela, koja je zbog posla sa delfinima prekinula studije.

programme.title: The Benjament Institute or this dream that people call human life / Institut Benjamenta ili ovaj san koji ljudi zovu ljudski život
programme.desc: The famous Benjement Institute was dilapidated, an outdated servant schooling, whose program consists of an infinite repetition of one lesson. Jakob is enrolled at the Institute and gradually draws into the world of the enigmatic brother and his sister who leads to school: Johanes Benjamente and his sad sisters Lisa. / Poznati institut Benjamenta je oronuli, zastareli internat za školovanje sluga, čiji se program sastoji od beskonačnog ponavljanja jedne lekcije. Jakob se upisuje na institut i postupno se uvlači u svet zagonetnog brata i njegove sestre koji vode školu: sadiste Johanesa Benjamente i njegove žalosne sestre Lise.

programme.title: Twin / Dvojnici
programme.desc: The agency that deals with the rental of replacement hires a saxophonist and surfers to occupy the two reputable gentlemen that must be in 2 places at the same time. What will follow will lead to madness all those who find themselves near them. / Agencija koja se bavi iznajmljivanjem zamena unajmljuje saksofonistu i surfera kako bi zauzeli mesta dvojice uglednih gospodina koji moraju biti na 2 mesta u isto vreme. Ono što će uslediti dovešće do ludila sve one koji se nađu u njihovoj blizini.

programme.title: Goodbye, Queen / Zbogom, Kraljice
programme.desc: Bye the Queen signs the return of the recognized director Benoîta Jakot and remarkably shows passions, intrigues, luxury and finally chaos who ran in the court of Marija Antoanete in the last days before the revolution outbreaks. The film was filmed according to the bestseller of Šantal Tomas, and focuses on the relationship between the Queen and one of her ladies accompanied. / Zbogom kraljice označava povratak priznatog reditelja Benoiîta Žakota i izvanredno prikazuje strasti, spletke, raskoš i na kraju haos koji je zavladao na dvoru Marije Antoanete u poslednjim danima pre izbijanja revolucije. Film je snimljen prema bestseleru Šantal Tomas, i fokusira se na odnos između kraljice i jedne od njenih dama u pratnji.

programme.title: Service / Kadrovska služba
programme.desc: Frank is a young Parisian student who returns to the hometown because he got the opportunity to internship in the factory in which his father was employed by his almost entire service life. Employers accept it very well, so it gets the task to carry out a survey on the reduction of working hours. The trade union in the factory are very distrustful according to that idea, because they serve that superiors actually want to increase their intensity of work. Naive Frank still believes his bosses, although their ultimate goal is to release a few workers and those who have been retirement left, including Frank's father. / Frank je mladi pariski student koji se vraća u rodni gradić jer je dobio priliku stažirati u fabrici u kojoj je njegov otac zaposlen svoj gotovo čitav radni vek. Poslodavci ga vrlo dobro prihvataju, pa dobija zadatak provesti anketu o smanjenju radnih sati. Sindikalci u fabrici su jako nepoverljivi prema toj ideji, jer slute da nadređeni zapravo žele povećati njihov intenzitet rada. Naivni Frank ipak veruje svojim šefovima, iako je njihov krajnji cilj otpustiti nekolicinu radnika i to baš one kojima je ostalo malo do penzije, među kojima je i Frankov otac.

programme.title: Red as the sky / Crveno kao nebo
programme.desc: A film based on a true story about Mincaći Menkaci, who blinded into the accident when he was ten, and today he is one of the most brilliant film director. That fat afternoon, while playing with his grandfather, the old partisan rifle exploded right in his face. As the time in Tuscany blind children could not attend the school with the other normal children, Mirko sent to the Institute of Blind in Genoa. However, he never stopped nurturing his passion for film. Once accidentally finds the old tape recorder, it starts shooting sounds immediately and edit them into stories. The teachers try to discourage him, because they want to spare him disappointments. However, he does not stop following his dream, even when that is why they throw him out of school, so he loses the only chance to school. / Film zasnovan na istinitoj priči o Mirku Menkaćiu, koji je oslepeo u nesreći kad je imao deset godina, a danas je jedan od najbriljantnijih filmskih reditelja zvuka. Tog kobnog poslepodneva, dok se igrao sa svojim dedom, stara partizanska puška mu je eksplodirala pravo u lice. Kako u to vreme u Toskani slepa deca nisu mogla pohađati školu sa ostalom normalnom decom, Mirko je poslat u institut za slepe u Đenovi. Međutim, on nikad nije prestao negovati svoju strast prema filmu. Kad jednom slučajno pronađe stari magnetofon, odmah počinje snimati zvukove i uređivati ih u priče. Učitelji ga pokušavaju obeshrabriti, jer ga žele poštediti razočaranja. Međutim, on ne prestaje slediti svoj san, čak ni kad ga zato izbacuju iz škole, te tako izgubi jedinu priliku za školovanje.

programme.title: L.627 / L.627
programme.desc: After an incident Inspector Marget, a member of the anti-drug brigade, was transferred to the police station in which he must deal with administrative work. However, he soon managed to switch to another station in which he can at least partially deal with the job he subordinates all his life. This most understanding for its obsession with the fight against drugs is in the young inspector Marie, but other team members, the head of Dodo and Milo, try to earn their salary as easily. They fully obey administrative regulations such as the number of arrests, not the importance that is arrested in the world of the underground. / Nakon jednog incidenta inspektor Marget, član brigade za borbu protiv droge, prebačen je u policijsku stanicu u kojoj se mora baviti administrativnim poslom. Međutim, ubrzo se uspeva prebaciti u drugu stanicu u kojoj se barem delimično može baviti poslom kojem je podredio sav život. Tu najviše razumevanja za svoju opsednutost borbom protiv droge nalazi kod mlade inspektorke Marie, ali ostali članove ekipe, šef Dodo i Milo, pokušavaju na najlakši mogući način zaraditi svoju plaću. Oni se potpuno pokoravaju administrativnim propisima kao što je broj hapšenja, a ne važnost koju uhapšeni ima u svetu podzemlja.

programme.title: Too personally / Previše lično
programme.desc: The film is about three women who know each other or get to know each other. He unites them friendship, a man and a small five-year-old girl. Simona renews his life after being divorced and her son decides to live with his father. Natalia Love is located in the widower with a daughter and a dedicated grandmother. And Eva, although the retirement, finds out that her love includes that partner, not just love for his grandchildren. / Film govori o tri žene koje se poznaju ili upoznaju. Ujedinjuje ih prijateljstvo, muškarac i mala petogodišnja devojčica. Simona obnavlja svoj život nakon što se razvede i njen sin odluči da živi s ocem. Natalija ljubav nalazi u udovcu s ćerkicom i predanom bakom. A Eva, iako penzionerka, saznaje da njena ljubav uključuje i onu partnersku, a ne samo ljubav prema unuci.

programme.title: Go back and get back / Otići i vratiti se
programme.desc: The reputable doctor Simon is happily married, he has friends doctors and live an idyllic life until it started talking about war. With the arrival of Germans, Gestapo Haps and takes him to jail. Many years later, his daughter of Salome traces who discovered Gestapo that he was a Jew and offers a great sum of money for the answer ... / Ugledni lekar Simon srećno je oženjen, ima prijatelje lekare i živi idiličnim životom sve dok nije počelo da se govori o ratu. Dolaskom Nemaca, Gestapo ga hapsi i odvodi u zatvor. Mnogo godina kasnije, njegova ćerka Salome traga ko je otkrio Gestapou da je on Jevrej i nudi veliku sumu novca za odgovor...

programme.title: Gusarem Verenica / Gusareva verenica
programme.desc: The oppressed and exploited young woman begins to charge his sexual services and completely disrupts the self-sufficient patriarchal capitalist society from the village of Telier. / Potlačena i iskorišćavana mlada žena počinje naplaćivati svoje seksualne usluge i potpuno remeti samozadovoljno patrijarhalno kapitalističko društvo iz sela Telier.

programme.title: A reasonable man / Razuman čovek
programme.desc: The story of the lawyer goes to South Africa to defend the boy from Zulu tribes who killed a baby believing that he killed the evil spirit, better known as Tokolosh. Dark secrets that lie buried deep in the lawyer, will connect him with the boy. He takes the case and enters the world of African wizardery and mystic, and by discovering the truth about the murder, the discovery of the truth about himself ... / Priča o advokatu koji odlazi u Južnu Afriku da brani dečaka iz Zulu plemena koji je ubio bebu verujući da je ubio zlog duha, poznatijeg kao Tokoloshe. Mračne tajne koje leže zakopane duboko u advokatu, spojiće ga sa dečakom. On uzima slučaj i ulazi u svet afričkog čarobnjaštva i mistike, a otkrivanjem istine o ubistvu, otkriće istinu o sebi samom...

programme.title: Roman crime / Krimi roman
programme.desc: In Rome in the 1960s, three young offenders decide to enter the world of organized crime. Lebanese is the cold-blooded leader of the minor delinquent - loyal fring and the power of hungry Diand. Since they kidnapped and killed Baron, Deliskvents manage to make friends with local gangsters, corrupt police officers and members of the secret organization. Lebanese is especially emphasized in that he solved firmly to obey the Roman underworld. To achieve this, it must form a larger group of well-organized cold-blooded killers. / U Rimu šezdesetih godina, troje mladih prestupnika odlučuje da uđe u svet organizovanog kriminala. Libaneze je hladnokrvni predvodnik maloletnih delikvenata - lojalnog Freda i moći gladnog Dandija. Pošto su kidnapovali i ubili barona, delikventi uspevaju da se sprijatelje sa lokalnim gangsterima, korumpiranim policajcima i pripadnicima tajne organizacije. Libaneze se posebno ističe po tome što je čvrsto rešio da pokori rimsko podzemlje. Da bi to ostvario, mora da formira veću grupu dobro organizovanih hladnokrvnih ubica.

programme.title: Icy heart / Ledeno srce
programme.desc: The Lepa violinist Kamil has two obsessions: the music of Ravel and her husband's friend who makes violins. But his heart seems to be cold. / Lepa violinistkinja Kamil ima dve opsesije: muziku Ravela i prijatelja njenog muža koji pravi violine. Ali, čini se da je njegovo srce hladno.

programme.title: Hana / Hana
programme.desc: Through the intimate portrait, we follow one woman how he struggles with reality and imaginary, while trying to accept her husband's departure to prison. / Kroz intimni portret pratimo jednu ženu kako se bori sa stvarnošću i imaginarnim, dok pokušava prihvatiti odlazak njenog muža u zatvor.

programme.title: The day I died / Dan kad sam umrla
programme.desc: The se-jin disappears in a dark and stormy night leaving shoes on a cliff and a farewell letter behind. Kim Hiun-Soo is in charge of investigating the case. Due to the bad weather, the body was not found, so the case cannot be closed. Local detectives simply reject it as suicide. Hyeon-Soo must find the truth about a suspicious disappearance of a teenager ... / Se-jin nestaje u mračnoj i olujnoj noći ostavljajući cipele na litici i oproštajno pismo iza sebe. Kim Hiun-soo je zadužena za istragu slučaja. Zbog lošeg vremena telo nije pronađeno, pa slučaj ne može biti zatvoren. Lokalni detektivi to jednostavno odbacuju kao samoubistvo. Hyeon-soo mora pronaći istinu o sumnjivom nestanku tinejdžerke...

programme.title: Open studio / Otvoreni studio
programme.desc: The emission covers a wide range of areas, including politics, economics, culture, sports, science and technology. Through a dynamic format and guests from different professions and experts in relevant areas, emissions allows deep analysis, comments and discussions on the most important events of the day. / Emisija pokriva širok spektar oblasti, uključujući politiku, ekonomiju, kulturu, sport, nauku i tehnologiju. Kroz dinamičan format i sa gostima iz različitih profesija i stručnjacima iz relevantnih oblasti, emisija omogućava dubinsku analizu, komentare i diskusije o najvažnijim događajima dana.

programme.title: As time goes on / Kako vrijeme prolazi
The alphabet of our lives / Azbuka našeg života
programme.desc: In the center of the intriguing, entertainment, but on moments and heavy and tragicomic stories is an urban Belgrade family and a married couple Popović. Behind Vesna and Uroš is twenty-five years of living together, in which, from juvenile cone and passion, they entered with student love, eager for a better morning and success in a trivial society in which it is all allowed to take place, career and money. Nevertheless, a quarter of a century later, after they acquired all material goods, while their children are studying abroad, this seemingly ideal family, begins to break up. / U središtu intrigantne, zabavne, ali na momente i teške i tragikomične priče je urbana beogradska porodica i bračni par Popović. programme.title: Balkan Express / Balkan ekspres
programme.desc: A group of small thieves and cheaters wanders from the city to the city disguised in the Band Balkan Express. During the occupation, in the first months, the members of the group mostly effort to stay alive. The tragicomic combat of circumstances become assistants in Partisan Sabotage. They rise to hero from insignificant people at the bottom of the social scale. When gestato enters their trace, they must run to the other side of the country. They hide in the Marlen Salon, forgetting that the brothels are in war, ideal spying places. Thus intrude into the kindergarten of new tragicomic situations. / Grupa sitnih lopova i varalica luta od grada do grada prerušena u bend Balkan Ekspres. Tokom okupacije, u prvim mJesecima, članovi grupe se uglavnom trude da ostanu živi. Tragikomičnim spletom okolnosti postaju pomoćnici u partizanskoj sabotaži. Kriju se u Salonu Marlen, zaboravljajući da su bordeli u ratu idealna mJesta za špijunažu. Tako upadaju u vrtešku novih tragikomičnih situacija.

programme.title: Stopwatch / Štoperica
programme.desc: The stopwatch quiz consists of two rounds, whereby the answer time is measured by the stopwatch. programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out of freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: Stopwatch / Štoperica
programme.desc: The stopwatch quiz consists of two rounds, whereby the answer time is measured by the stopwatch. In the first round competitors respond to three questions, and for each response they have 10 seconds each. If exactly the answers, they conquer the guaranteed amount. In another round waiting for six questions, with 20 seconds for each answer. Depending on the speed and accuracy of the answers they give, they can conquer up to 15,000 dinars. / Kviz Štoperica se sastoji iz dve runde, pri čemu se vreme za odgovaranje meri štopericom. U prvoj rundi takmičari odgovaraju na tri pitanja, a za svaki odgovor imaju na raspolaganju po 10 sekundi. Ukoliko tačno odgovore, osvajaju zagarantovanu sumu. U drugoj rundi ih čeka šest pitanja, sa po 20 sekundi za svaki odgovor. U zavisnosti od brzine i tačnosti odgovora koje daju, mogu da osvoje i do 15.000 dinara.

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out of freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: Explosive / Exploziv
programme.desc: Stories of forgotten heroes, customs, the most famous prophecies, miraculous love, gurus and unusual people. New, the twelfth season of one of your favorite emissions explosive. As in previous years, the editorial and journalistic team worked with full steam during the summer. In search of good, interesting and life stories, we traveled through Serbia but also the region. We went the trails of Kovid Tourists in Greece, Albania and Montenegro and checked that the summer of masks conducted passengers but also hosts. Who had a good time, who earned, and who lost, we will find out in the series ready, notes the editor of the Mary Prebeg Emission. / Priče o zaboravljenim herojima, običajima, najpoznatijoj proročici, čudesnim ljubavima, guruima i neobičnim ljudima. Počinje nova, dvanaesta sezona jedne od omiljenih emisija EXploziv. Kao i prethodnih godina, urednički i novinarski tim radio je punom parom tokom leta. U potrazi za dobrim, zanimljivim i životnim pričama putovali smo kroz Srbiju ali i region. Išli smo stazama kovid turista u Grčku, Albaniju i Crnu Goru i proveravali kako su leto pod maskama proveli putnici ali i domaćini. Ko se dobro proveo, ko je zaradio, a ko izgubio saznaćemo u serijalu koji je spreman, napominje urednica emisije Marija Prebeg.

programme.title: Exclusive / Exkluziv
programme.desc: We reveal the picanteries about domestic and foreign stars, we present exclusive attachments. Find out all about the famous ones - what they do, where they go out, where they are coming, where we travel ... I discover everything about their lives, terminants ... The editor-in-law, Ilic, will still be the first and in the right place with the proven exclusive information. / Otkrivamo pikanterije o domaćim i inostranim zvezdama, prikazujemo ekskluzivne priloge. Saznajte baš sve o poznatima - šta rade, gde izlaze, šta spremaju, gde putuju... Otkrivamo sve o njihovim ljubavima, raskidima... programme.title: Three out of five / Tri od pet
programme.desc: Quiz 3 of the 5 is a dynamic and fun format that exudes obsession and spontaneity, and participants are accidental passers-by. This quiz provides the opportunity to participants to - almost by the way, while on the street and preoccupied with everyday life - fun, they test their knowledge and maybe something. Each episode is specific to the choice of competitors. It used to be men with a mustache, the competitors who are lasting Petrović, women of blue hair ... in each circle participates in two candidates, and the winner of the previous round is answered by or duplicated by the amount won. The leaders of the quiz are an actress Slavica Ljujić and the actor Uroš Milojević. / Kviz 3 od 5 dinamičan je i zabavan format koji odiše nepretencioznošću i spontanošću, a učesnici su slučajni prolaznici. Ovaj kviz pruža priliku učesnicima da se - gotovo usput, dok su na ulici i zaokupljeni svakodnevicom - zabave, testiraju svoje znanje i možda nešto zarade. Svaka epizoda je specifična po izboru takmičara. Nekada su to muškarci sa brkovima, takmičari koji se na primer prezivaju Petrović, žene plave kose… U u svakom krugu učestvuje dva kandidata, a pobednik iz prethodnog kruga odgovara na pitanje koje mu ili duplira osvojeni iznos ili oduzima ceo iznos osvojene nagrade. Voditelji kviza su glumica Slavica Ljujić i glumac Uroš Milojević.
