programme.title: TV Čorba / TV Čorba
programme.desc: The show is processed by daily occurrences from another angle, with subtle irony impurities. The inspiration finds in shows, series, films, rials, news, social networks and everything that fascinates viewers, and very often is completely meaningless or in itself funny. So, everything that makes our TV life, everyday life with a remote control in your hands, present in a twisted, slightly distorted way, and the message clears the viewers. / Emisija obrađuje svakodnevne pojave iz drugog ugla, sa suptilnim primesama ironije. Ekipa inspiraciju pronalazi u emisijama, serijama, filmovima, rijalitijima, vestima, na društvenim mrežama i svemu onome što fascinira gledaoce, a vrlo često je potpuno besmisleno ili samo po sebi smešno. Dakle, sve što čini naš TV život, svakodnevicu sa daljinskim upravljačem u rukama, predstavljamo na uvrnut, malo iskrivljen način, a poruku gledaoci izvlače sami.

programme.title: Djatlov's passage / Djatlovljev prolaz
programme.desc: At the beginning of 1959. year, a group of mountaineers led by Igor Djatlov was killed on the Ural under mysterious circumstances. The group of KGB officials under the leadership of the Cape Officer was sent to this inhospitable area to reveal the truth about the causes of this tragedy. / Početkom 1959. godine, grupa planinara koje je predvodio Igor Djatlov poginula je na Uralu pod misterioznim okolnostima. Grupa službenika KGB-a pod vođstvom oficira Kostina poslata je u ovo negostoljubivo područje kako bi se otkrila istina o uzrocima ove tragedije.

programme.title: Ambis / Ambis
programme.desc: Although they have been married for twenty years, Elsa and Loran seems to be still crazy in love with each other. Their seemingly perfect life situation gets a dark craft when Elsa does not return from their usual morning jogging. While Loran tries to find out where Elsa, for their daughter and him begins a real nightmare when the evidence that reveals that Elsa is not as they represented. / Iako su u braku već dvadeset godina, čini se da su Elsa i Loran i dalje ludo zaljubljeni jedno u drugo. Njihova naizgled savršena životna situacija dobiva mračan obrt kada se Elsa jednog dana ne vrati sa svog uobičajenog jutarnjeg džogiranja. Dok Loran pokušava da otkrije gde je Elsa, za njihovu ćerku i njega počinje prava noćna mora kada isplivaju dokazi koji otkrivaju da Elsa nije onakva kakvom se predstavljala.

programme.title: Automoto Show / Automoto Show
programme.desc: Automoto Show is a broadcasting emission and criticisms of all types of vehicles (focused on cars and motorcycles available for sale in the Serbian market), travel and tourism. / Automoto Show je emisija koja se bavi vestima i kritikama svih vrsta vozila (fokusirana na automobile i motocikle koji su dostupni za prodaju na srpskom tržištu), putovanjima i turizmu.

programme.title: Death tunnels / Tuneli smrti
programme.desc: The group of American soldiers, trained to fight underground, comes to camp in the Vietnamese jungle. They spend their first day introducing himself, and for the second day they move in the research of underground tunnels, who used hostile soldiers. Armed bayonets, pistols, grenades and battery lamps, enter tunnels, with the aim of finding the enemies and destroy. They meet primitive, but extremely efficient traps, deadly even, as well as armed Vietnamese soldiers. They start to die, some manage to escape, the fight happens underground, but also in the US military camp in the jungle. Soldiers both sides are on the border of their own humanity. The US military bombs the area where the tunnels are, in which two soldiers remain: one American and one Vietnamese. They try to dig the road to the surface, but they fail, they die underground. / Grupa američkih vojnika, obučenih za borbu u podzemlju, dolazi u kamp u vijetnamskoj džungli. Prvi dan provode upoznajući se, a već drugog dana kreću u istraživanje podzemnih tunela, koje su koristili neprijateljski vojnici. Naoružani bajonetima, pištoljima, granatama i baterijskim lampama, ulaze u tunele, sa ciljem da neprijatelja pronađu i unište. Susreću se sa primitivnim, ali izuzetno efikasnim zamkama, smrtonosnim čak, kao i naoružanim vijetnamskim vojnicima. Počinju da ginu, neki uspevaju da pobegnu, borba se dešava pod zemljom, ali i u američkom vojnom kampu u džungli. Vojnici obe strane nalaze se na granici sopstvene ljudskosti. Američka vojska bombarduje oblast gde su tuneli, u kojima ostaju dva vojnika: jedan američki i jedan vijetnamski. Pokušavaju da iskopaju put do površine, ali ne uspevaju, te umiru pod zemljom.

programme.title: Free arrows / Slobodni strelci
programme.desc: The son of the Killed New York Police officer plugged into the police, where he invades the team with his father's former partner and the team of Bright Gotam police officers. His new chief of Sarkone will see if he has everything it takes to be a concentrated police officer through a series of loyalty, trust and respect. However, when the truth of his father's death came out, the desire for revenge is predominantly and he will not stop until justice is satisfied. / Sin ubijenog njujorškog policajca priključuje se policiji, gde upada u ekipu sa bivšim partnerom svog oca i ekipu pritajenih Gotam policajaca. Njegov novi šef Sarkone će videti da li on ima sve što je potrebno da bi bio pritajeni policajac kroz niz testova odanosti, poverenja i poštovanja. Međutim, kada na videlo izađe istina o smrti njegovog oca, u njemu preovladava želja za osvetom i on neće stati sve dok pravda ne bude zadovoljena.

programme.title: Chairman / Predsednik
programme.desc: The shop film is based on a true story that 2015 played in Fifi. Millions of dollars were in the game, and arrested arrests at the top of this organization. The leaders of the world football were in the center of attention, taking bribes. The head of the small football club in Chile became the president of the Chilean Football Association. He invades the trap, and becomes a key scandal player. / Radnja filma bazirana je na istinitoj priči koja se 2015. godine odigrala u Fifi. Milioni dolara bili su u igri, a odigrala su se hapšenja u vrhu ove organizacije. Vođe svetskog fudbala našle su se u centru pažnje, uzimajući mito. Šef malog fudbalskog kluba u Čileu postaje predsednik čileanskog fudbalskog saveza. On upada u zamku, i postaje ključni igrač skandala.

However, when the truth of his father's death came out, the desire for revenge is predominantly and he will not stop until justice is satisfied. / Sin ubijenog njujorškog policajca priključuje se policiji, gde upada u ekipu sa bivšim partnerom svog oca i ekipu pritajenih Gotam policajaca. Njegov novi šef Sarkone će videti da li on ima sve što je potrebno da bi bio pritajeni policajac kroz niz testova odanosti, poverenja i poštovanja. Međutim, kada na videlo izađe istina o smrti njegovog oca, u njemu preovladava želja za osvetom i on neće stati sve dok pravda ne bude zadovoljena.

programme.title: Chairman / Predsednik

The leaders of the world football were in the center of attention, taking bribes. The head of the small football club in Chile became the president of the Chilean Football Association. He invades the trap, and becomes a key scandal player. / Radnja filma bazirana je na istinitoj priči koja se 2015. godine odigrala u Fifi. Milioni dolara bili su u igri, a odigrala su se hapšenja u vrhu ove organizacije. Vođe svetskog fudbala našle su se u centru pažnje, uzimajući mito. programme.title: Wrong man / Pogrešan čovek
programme.desc: We follow the story of the mother's sixteen-year-old, who must overcome his greatest fear and trauma to face a long-forgotten father of his daughter, a man he believed to rape her 16 years ago. He is now the only one who can save the life to her child. Zoe is a teenager, rebel, full of life, is mortally ill and she needs a transplant. From pregnancy and zone, her mother Lea did not tell anyone who was actually Zoin father. All these years, she was trying to forget her greatest trauma and a man who was responsible for that and who attacked her 16 years ago. Her hatred of him is deep and honest, she never fully recovered from that night but this time no choice, he is the only one who can donate an organ and save a sick girl. But as life always writes unpredictable stories, so Leina's search for the child's father show that every story has two sides ... / Pratimo priču majke šesnaestogodišnje tinejdžerke, koja mora da savlada svoj najveći strah i traumu da bi se suočila sa davno zaboravljenim ocem svoje ćerke, čovekom za kojeg veruje da ju je silovao pre 16 godina. On je sada jedini koji može da spase život njenom detetu. Zoe je tinejdžerka, buntovnica, puna života, smrtno je bolesna i potrebna joj je transplantacija. Od trudnoće i Zoinog rađanja, njena majka Lea nikome nije rekla ko je zapravo Zoin otac. Svih ovih godina pokušavala je da zaboravi svoju najveću traumu i čoveka koji je odgovoran za to i koji ju je napastvovao pre 16 godina. Njena mržnja prema njemu je duboka i iskrena, nikada se nije potpuno oporavila od te noći ali ovaj put nema izbora, on je jedini koji može da donira organ i spasi bolesnu devojčicu. Ali, kako život uvek piše nepredvidlve priče, tako će i Leina potraga za ocem deteta pokazati da svaka priča ima dve strane...

programme.title: Truths and lies / Istine i laži
programme.desc: It all starts from one prom night ... That night connects Paul and Marina, the most popular teens in the school, with Nikola, Kristina and Slobom, the most famous school outsiders. That night, filled with excitements, loud music and alcohol, will remain them with everyone in memory as an end of one era, and the beginning of a new phase in their lives. Twenty years later, their lives crossed again. Pavle and Marina are in not such happy marriage, and Nikola, Kristina and Sloba live lives as if nothing has changed in those twenty years ago, they would never have a steady job, nor a serious relationship, no family ... / Sve počinje od jedne maturske večeri... To veče spaja Pavla i Marinu, najpopularnije tinejdžere u školi, sa Nikolom, Kristinom i Slobom, najpoznatijim autsajderima škole. Ta noć, ispunjena uzbuđenjima, glasnom muzikom i alkoholom, ostaće im svima u sećanju kao kraj jedne ere, i početak nove faze u njihovim životima. Dvadesetak godina kasnije, njihovi životi se ponovo ukrštaju. Pavle i Marina su u ne tako srećnom braku, imaju sina koji je i sam tinejdžer, a Nikola, Kristina i Sloba žive živote kao da se u tih dvadeset godina ništa nije promenilo - i dalje poštujući zakletvu koju su položili pre mnogo vremena, da nikada neće imati stalan posao, ni ozbiljnu vezu, ni porodicu...

programme.title: Biostiles - Your Health, Our Care / Biostile - Vaše zdravlje, naša briga
programme.desc: A program for all lovers of shopping from the warmth of your home, without going anywhere! TV sales is a real place for you! / Program za sve ljubitelje kupovine iz topline svog doma, bez odlaska bilo gde! Tv prodaja je pravo mesto za vas!

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out of freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social events in Italy, just before the outbreak of the First World War, the series follows two passionate love stories and one story about the Great Victim. We will follow the main heroes of this series through their life and class struggles, all the way to the most horrified corners of their soul. / U pozadini društvenih događaja u Italiji, neposredno pre izbijanja Prvog svetskog rata, serija prati dve strastvene ljubavne priče i jednu priču o velikoj žrtvi. Pratićemo glavne junake ove serije kroz njihove životne i klasne borbe, sve do najskrivenijih kutaka njihove duše.

programme.title: Love on you looks like / Ljubav na tebe liči
programme.desc: A young girl Deniz, after a terrible relationship falls in love with the beautiful young man Ali in a small town. Love is mutual, but fate has different plans for the two. Fall in love Deniz and Alija Interpreters Fahri Evdzhen Histical and burst History, popular Turkish acting couple. The drama was filmed in 2015. in beautiful locations, the gleaming beaches of Turkey. It is an interesting fact that the film was recorded in the production of bures irritated immediately after the series of the Diary of the Love in which they both played. / Mlada devojka Deniz, nakon užasne veze zaljubljuje se u divnog mladića Alija u jednom malom gradu. Ljubav je obostrana, ali sudbina ima drugačije planove za njih dvoje. Zaljubljne golupčiće Deniz i Alija tumače Fahrije Evdžen Ozčivit i Burak Ozčivit, popularni turski glumački par. Drama je snimljena 2015. godine na predivnim lokacijama, blistavim plažama Turske. Zanimljiv je podatak da je film snimljen u produkciji Buraka Ozčivita odmah nakon serije Dnevnik ljubavi u kojoj su oboje igrali.

programme.title: Work action / Radna akcija
programme.desc: First Serbian humanitarian rial show! Rial emissions Work action has a humanitarian mission - to help families living in the difficult living conditions. Each episode has a family faced with some kind of adversity, the difficult life of the family, illness of a member of the same or some other disaster. The show begins with the arrival of the head of Tamara Grujić to visit the elected family. She tells them that their house will be restored. The entire job is done in 5 days, while the family stays with relatives or friends. During this time, a large number of masters and volunteers are ready to change the conditions of housing completely, which involves complete renovation of interiors and exteriors, as well as all necessary repairs and improvements. / Prva srpska humanitarna rijaliti emisija! Rijaliti emisija Radna akcija ima humanitarnu misiju - da pomogne porodicama koje žive u teškim uslovima života. Svaka epizoda ima porodicu suočenu sa nekom vrstom nedaće, teški život porodice, bolest nekog člana iste ili neka druga katastrofa. Emisija počinje dolaskom voditeljke Tamare Grujić u posetu izabranoj porodici. Ona im saopštava da će njihova kuća biti restaurirana. Celokupan posao se obavlja za 5 dana, dok porodica odseda kod rodbine ili prijatelja. Za to vreme, veliki broj majstora i volontera spreman je da tim porodicama u potpunosti promeni uslove stanovanja što podrazumeva kompletno renoviranje enterijera i eksterijera, kao i sve potrebne popravke i poboljšanja.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: In addition to vivid and authentic figures with the viewers will be easily identified, the series is full of exciting and unexpected crafts and comic situations, intriguing kinds of trillage plots, intrigue, deception and betrayals in the world of business, but also the most attractive Emotion, love and friendship, and shows that with real friends and family any obstacle, no matter how insurmountable, can be overcome. Like that, that true love does not know about borders. / Pored živopisnih i autentičnih likova sa čijim svakodnevnim dogodovštinama će se gledaoci lako identifikovati, serija je prepuna uzbudljivih i neočekivanih obrta, urnebesnog humora i komičnih situacija, porodičnih tajni, intrigantnih ljubavnih afera i skandala, napetih trilerskih zapleta, spletki, obmana i izdaja u svetu šou biznisa, ali i najiskrenijih emocija, ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokazuje da uz prave prijatelje i porodicu svaka prepreka, ma koliko delovala nepremostiva, može da se prevaziđe. Kao i to, da prava ljubav ne zna za granice.

programme.title: Work action / Radna akcija
programme.desc: First Serbian humanitarian rial show! Rial emissions Work action has a humanitarian mission - to help families living in the difficult living conditions. Each episode has a family faced with some kind of adversity, the difficult life of the family, illness of a member of the same or some other disaster. The show begins with the arrival of the head of Tamara Grujić to visit the elected family. She tells them that their house will be restored. The entire job is done in 5 days, while the family stays with relatives or friends. During this time, a large number of masters and volunteers are ready to change the conditions of housing completely, which involves complete renovation of interiors and exteriors, as well as all necessary repairs and improvements. / Prva srpska humanitarna rijaliti emisija! Rijaliti emisija Radna akcija ima humanitarnu misiju - da pomogne porodicama koje žive u teškim uslovima života. Svaka epizoda ima porodicu suočenu sa nekom vrstom nedaće, teški život porodice, bolest nekog člana iste ili neka druga katastrofa. Emisija počinje dolaskom voditeljke Tamare Grujić u posetu izabranoj porodici. Ona im saopštava da će njihova kuća biti restaurirana. Celokupan posao se obavlja za 5 dana, dok porodica odseda kod rodbine ili prijatelja. Za to vreme, veliki broj majstora i volontera spreman je da tim porodicama u potpunosti promeni uslove stanovanja što podrazumeva kompletno renoviranje enterijera i eksterijera, kao i sve potrebne popravke i poboljšanja.

programme.title: Truths and lies / Istine i laži
programme.desc: It all starts from one prom night ... That night connects Paul and Marina, the most popular teens in the school, with Nikola, Kristina and Slobom, the most famous school outsiders. That night, filled with excitements, loud music and alcohol, will remain them with everyone in memory as an end of one era, and the beginning of a new phase in their lives. Twenty years later, their lives crossed again. Pavle and Marina are in not such happy marriage, and Nikola, Kristina and Sloba live lives as if nothing has changed in those twenty years ago, they would never have a steady job, nor a serious relationship, no family ... / Sve počinje od jedne maturske večeri... To veče spaja Pavla i Marinu, najpopularnije tinejdžere u školi, sa Nikolom, Kristinom i Slobom, najpoznatijim autsajderima škole. Ta noć, ispunjena uzbuđenjima, glasnom muzikom i alkoholom, ostaće im svima u sećanju kao kraj jedne ere, i početak nove faze u njihovim životima. Dvadesetak godina kasnije, njihovi životi se ponovo ukrštaju. Pavle i Marina su u ne tako srećnom braku, imaju sina koji je i sam tinejdžer, a Nikola, Kristina i Sloba žive živote kao da se u tih dvadeset godina ništa nije promenilo - i dalje poštujući zakletvu koju su položili pre mnogo vremena, da nikada neće imati stalan posao, ni ozbiljnu vezu, ni porodicu...

programme.title: Waiting for the handke / Čekajući Handkea
programme.desc: When he learned that Peter Handke received the Nobel Prize, Srdjan Petrovic, Vinar from Velika, has placed a plate with the relief figure of the famous writer, who had repeatedly stayed in his winery. His intention to place the plate in front of the winery, becomes a sizifsky hard work in a large hoist, where the majority of the population consists of Albanians, and points to the drama with which the remaining Serbs in Kosovo and Metohija are facing. / Kada je saznao da je Peter Handke dobio Nobelovu nagradu, Srđan Petrović, vinar iz Velike Hoče sa Kosova, postavio je ploču sa reljefnim likom slavnog pisca, koji je više puta boravio u njegovoj vinariji. Njegova namera da ploču postavi ispred vinarije, postaje sizifovski težak posao u Velikoj Hoči, gde većinu stanovništva čine Albanci, te upućuje na dramu sa kojom se suočavaju preostali Srbi na Kosovu i Metohiji.

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out of freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social events in Italy, just before the outbreak of the First World War, the series follows two passionate love stories and one story about the Great Victim. Pratićemo glavne junake ove serije kroz njihove životne i klasne borbe, sve do najskrivenijih kutaka njihove duše.

programme.title: Little wife / Mala supruga
programme.desc: Telenovela Little wife, inspired by the motifs of the Romanes of the same name of our celebrated writer Milica Jakovljević Mir - Jam, is located today as strong melodrams with the elements of thrillers and Noara, which is allocated from all existing telenoveles. The main heroine is Đurđica, eliminating and beautiful girl adult in Germany, who now lives in a small town in Vojvodina, in his magnificent house with a swimming pool. Her life takes place in the monotony of estates and villages, as long as the Branko unexpectedly is in the local health center, which is at the very long problem of its older brother SIM: a huge long than a hundred thousand euros, borrowed from the local greener. Branko wants to help brother back on each price to return the debt, but it does not work, until the Đurđica offers his money. Branko fits, returns his brother's debt, but at that time an unknown but dangerous Miodrag Hadži Orlović - a man who conditiones Branka to marry a lily-led money. Branko fits that reluctantly. The decision to give birth to the Đurđica, hopes, a fatal girl with which he is in a long-term secret relationship. Thus, an exciting series about two women and a man in crucified in a love triangle begins, full of passions, excitement and betrayed expectations. Simultaneously with love stories, secret events from the past two families are also developed, which explain the sudden arrival of mysterious Hadža Orlović near Djurdjicina Majke / Telenovela Mala supruga, inspirisana motivima istoimenog romana naše proslavljene spisateljice Milice Jakovljević Mir - Jam, smeštena je u današnje vreme kao snažna melodrama sa elementima trilera i noara, što je izdvaja od svih postojećih telenovela u ponudi. Glavna junakinja je Đurđica, otmena i lepa devojka odrasla u Nemačkoj, koja sada sa svojom majkom Marom živi u jednom malom mestu u Vojvodini, u svoj velelepnoj kući sa bazenom koju je sagradio njen pokojni otac. Njen život se odvija u monotoniji imanja i sela, sve dok se neočekivano ne zaljubi u Branka, doktora u lokalnom domu zdravlja, koji se baš u tom trenutku suočava sa velikim problemom svog starijeg brata Sime: ogromnim dugom od stotinu hiljada evra, pozajmljenim od lokalnog zelenaša. Branko po svaku cenu želi da pomogne bratu da vrati dug, ali u tome ne uspeva, sve dok mu Đurđica ne ponudi svoj novac. Branko na to pristaje, vraća bratov dug, ali se u tom trenutku pojavljuje nepoznati ali opasni Miodrag Hadži Orlović - čovek koji uslovljava Branka da se zbog pozajmljenog novca oženi zaljubljenom Đurđicom. Branko na to nevoljno pristaje. Odluku da oženi Đurđicu saopštava Nadi, fatalnoj devojci sa kojom je u dugogodišnjoj tajnoj vezi. Tako započinje uzbuljiva serija o dve žene i muškarcu raspetom u ljubavnom trouglu, prepuna strasti, uzbuđenja i izneverenih očekivanja. Istovremeno sa ljubavnim pričama, razvijaju se i tajni događaji iz prošlosti dve porodice, koji objašnjavaju iznenadni dolazak misterioznog Hadži Orlovića kod Đurđicine majke

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out of freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: The passions / Strasti Toskane
programme.desc: The death of the genuine winemaker of Luka Monforte and the conviction of the young girl for his murder, they shook the life of the inhabitants of Vilalb. Aurora is a modern heroine that fights against those who conspired against her and closed behind bars. In the background, everything is a ruthless struggle for home, old hostility of opposing families, secrets, two brother's fight for the love of a woman. The seemingly idyllic Tuscany hides many secrets, and the intrigues and intrigues of her inhabitants will pinpect the viewers for small screens! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) was only 18 years old when she was charged with the murder of his boyfriend Alesandra Monforte (Roberto Farnesi). After years spent in prison, Aurora returns to the freedom much stronger than before and more determined to spare a bar from his name. He still loves Alesandra who renounced after his father's death. He is aimed at building a family empire, but it still fights their feelings towards Aurora especially when he saw him after eight years. Still broke because of his father's death he does not want to believe in Aurora's innocence, but he still wants. Alessandro has a younger edo-lady brothers launching a competition with an older brother, and Matthew who thinks there is nothing in common with them. There is also a sister Elena who never managed to be independent. Their mother of Livia accepts the death of his husband Luka Monforte in unbearable ease. Tesa Taviani intends to return to recalls after her sister's outright in prison to sound the richest and most powerful man in Vilalba, Ruđera chamber. / Smrt uglednog vinara Luke Monfortea i osuđivanje mlade devojke za njegovo ubistvo, uzdrmali su život stanovnika mesta Vilalba. Aurora je moderna junakinja koja se za svoju slobodu bori protiv onih koji su se urotili protiv nje i zatvorili je iza rešetaka. U pozadini svega stoji nemilosrdna borba za dom, staro neprijateljstvo suprotstavljenih porodica, tajne, borba dva brata za ljubav jedne žene. Naizgled idilična Toskana krije mnoge tajne, a spletke i intrige njenih stanovnika prikovaće gledaoce za male ekrane! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) je imala samo 18 godina kada je optužena za ubistvo oca svog dečka Alesandra Monfortea (Roberto Farnesi). Nakon godina provedenih u zatvoru, Aurora se vraća na slobodu mnogo jača nego pre i odlučnija u nameri da spere ljagu sa svog imena. I dalje voli Alesandra koji je se odrekao nakon očeve smrti. On je usmeren na izgradnju porodičnog carstva ali se i dalje se bori protiv svojih osećanja prema Aurori pogotovu kad je ugleda nakon osam godina. Još uvek slomljen zbog očeve smrti ne želi da veruje u Aurorinu nevinost, ali i dalje je želi. Alesandro ima mlađu braću Edoarda kojeg pokreće takmičenje sa starijim bratom, i Mateja koji smatra da nema ništa zajedničko s njima. Tu je i sestra Elena koja nikada nije uspela da se osamostali. Njihova majka Livia nepodnošljivom lakoćom prihvata smrt svog supruga Luke Monfortea. Tesa Taviani namerava da se vrati u Primaluće nakon izlaska njene sestre iz zatvora kako bi zavela najbogatijeg i najmoćnijeg čoveka u Vilalbi, Ruđera Kamerana.

programme.desc: The first television channel arrives a planetary popular quiz guess price correctly. So come on the channels to play together, because the hunting season is open. What this quiz publishes from the others is the fact that you need knowledge and happiness in it. In a quiz that will occupy the whole family, it is important that you know the prices. How much is the paprika, tomato, biscuit, or microwave, garden set, winter tire set - that knowledge and happiness - prescription are for a safe victory. The quiz in Serbia on the Channel of the First Television arrives from America in which it is broadcast for decades, and whose popularity is not eaten. The quiz on the first television is led by our famous actress Natasa Aksentijević, whom the audience has loved and in television series, but also in the theater. Natashinuu Harisma and a specific humor in quiz hit price will accurately complement her dear colleague, also an actor, Pedja Damjanovic. In the quiz hit price, the price is exactly the most interesting part is the fact that the product prices of competitors affect the market knowledge, and this can be fun because prices change constantly. These are games in which competitors affect product prices and try to win prizes. The goal is to guess the price as accurately, and those closest, without exceeding the right price - win. The quiz is known for exciting moments when competing compete for a multitude of awards, but none of the participants leave without a reward. So, although someone did not win the main reward, he still won and had a good time. And the party is and in what competitors never know what awaits them, and the questions are often / Na kanal Prve televizije stiže planetarno popularni kviz Pogodi cenu tačno. Pa hajde cenolovci da se radnim danima igramo zajedno, jer je sezona lova na cene otvorena. Ono što ovaj kviz izdavaja od ostalih je činjenica da vam u njemu treba i znanja i sreće. U kvizu koji će zaokupiti celu porodicu važno je da znate cene. Koliko košta paprika, paradajz, keks ili mikrotalasna, baštenski set, komplet zimskih guma – to znanje i sreća - recept su za sigurnu pobedu. Kviz u Srbiju na kanal Prve televizije stiže iz Amerike u kojoj se emituje već decenijama, a čija popularnost ne jenjava. Kviz na Prvoj televiziji vodi naša poznata glumica Nataša Aksentijević, koju je publika zavolela i u televizijskim serijama, ali i u pozorištu. Natašinuu harizmu i specifičan humor u kvizu Pogodi cenu tačno dopunjavaće njen dragi kolega, takođe glumac, Peđa Damjanović. U kvizu Pogodi cenu tačno najzanimljiviji deo je što cene proizvoda takmičari pogađaju na osnovu saznanja o tržištu, a to može biti zabavno jer se cene stalno menjaju. U pitanju su igre u kojoj takmičari pogađaju cene proizvoda i pokušavaju da osvoje nagrade. programme.desc: Guest 656. The show is the cyclist Mićo Brković. He competed for 24 years, and 19 was a national team player. The state's champion was 11 times, won 143 races. Training and competing at two wheels, used about 550 thousand miles. In the show, he will speak, inter alia: about the conditions he had for engaging in cycling compared to his foreign rivals. About the participation in Olympic Games in Seoul in 1988. and Barcelona four years later. Where did he find him the news of sanctions towards our country 30. May 1992? Why could he be disqualified from Games in Spain? About the influence of sanctions and non-imminent in the first half of the 90's on his career. About the relationship between the organizers, the media and the viewers towards cyclists on the races abroad and treatment cyclists in traffic in our country and France. Why didn't he drive for a foreign team and in addition to the numerous successes he achieved? About motives to deal with cycling, despite symbolic awards in most careers. Why did a rain man called him in the world of cycling? About fear while down when speed is about 100 kilometers in class as well as falls. About tactics in cycling and is this sport monotonous? Why didn't he give up on the crisis moments of the race, and even when he had a temperature of 40 degrees? About life after the end of the competitive career ... / Gost 656. emisije je biciklista Mićo Brković. Takmičio se 24 godine, a 19 bio reprezentativac. Prvak države bio je 11 puta, pobedio na 143 trke. Trenirajući i takmičeći se na dva točka prevezao je oko 550 hiljada kilometara. U emisiji će između ostalog govoriti: o uslovima koje je imao za bavljenje biciklizmom u odnosu na svoje inostrane rivale. O učešću na Olimpijskim igrama u Seulu 1988. i Barseloni četiri godine kasnije. Gde ga je zatekla vest o sankcijama prema našoj zemlji 30. maja 1992.? Zbog čega je mogao da bude diskvalifikovan sa Igara u Španiji? O uticaju sankcija i nemaštine u prvoj polovini 90-ih na njegovu karijeru. O odnosu organizatora, medija i gledalaca prema biciklistima na trkama u inostranstvu i tretmanu biciklista u saobraćaju u našoj zemlji i Francuskoj. Zašto nije vozio za neku inostranu ekipu i pored brojnih uspeha koje je ostvario? O motivima da se bavi biciklizmom, uprkos simboličnim nagradama u većem delu karijere. Zašto su ga u svetu biciklizma zvali kišni čovek? O strahu prilikom spusteva kada je brzina oko 100 kilometara na čas kao i padovima. O taktici u biciklizmu i da li je ovaj sport monoton? programme.title: At two bela pigeons / Kod dva bela goluba
programme.desc: Nikola Doksat de Mores was a builder of the Belgrade Fortress. In this form, what we see today, the fortress was built from 1723. until 1736. years and is one of the 600 fortresses raised on the banks of the Danube from the source to the mouth. A prominent fortifier in the long-term imperial majesty of the Austrian Emperor Carl VI, it was ordered that the existing Belgrade Fortress has made an insurmountable obstacle in front of the Turks, and the town of building. He joined the fundamental reorganization of the fortress because the existing represented only the sum of low weak walls, almost bumps and shallow trenches, completely unaccustomed with the development of weapons and assholes and attack on fortified cities. Then the Nebojsa Tower was rebuilt, with a floor more, a large well, better known as the Roman well, and the city of Karl VI, one of the most beautiful baroque gates, saved to this day. Docsat destroyed everything, so the remains of the Celtic Fortress and many remains of the Roman, Byzantine, Serbian and Turkish cultural and historical heritage. About how the Belgrade Fortress was built and what was the fate of her builder, we talk in tonight's show. / Nikola Doksat de Mores bio je graditelj Beogradske tvrđave. U ovom obliku, kakvu je mi danas vidimo, tvrđava je građena od 1723. do 1736. godine i jedna je od 600 tvrđava podignutih na obalama Dunava od izvora do ušća. Uglednom fortifikatoru u dugogodišnjoj službi carskog veličanstva austrijskog imperatora Karla VI, naređeno je da postojeću Beogradsku tvrđavu učini nesavladivom preprekom pred Turcima, a varoš da izgradi novom. On je pristupio temeljnom preuređenju tvrđave jer je postojeća predstavljala samo zbir niskih nejakih zidova, gotovo grudobrana i plitkih rovova, potpuno neprilagođenih tadašnjem razvoju oružja i oruđa za opsadu i napad na utvrđene gradove. Tada je ponovo sagrađena Kula Nebojša, sa spratom više, sazidan Veliki bunar, poznatiji kao Rimski bunar, a Donji grad je dobio kapiju Karla VI, jednu od najlepših baroknih kapija, sačuvanu do danas. Doksat je sve porušio, tako da su nestali ostaci keltske tvrđave i mnogi ostaci rimskog, vizantijskog, srpskog i turskog kulturno-istorijskog nasleđa. O tome kako je građena Beogradska tvrđava i kakva je bila sudbina njenog graditelja, govorimo u večerašnjoj emisiji.

programme.desc: In the show, you can listen to the prose paths of the narrators siniša gavrić pigs, knife and mud and reflections from the manuscript collection So. The present turns out as dark as the past, because hope persistently avoids these unfortunate spaces. All of this bear the heroes of Gavrić's story, as they carry / U emisiji Putevi proze možete slušati pripovetke Siniše Gavrića Svinje, nož i blato i Refleksija iz rukopisa zbirke So. Priča Svinje, nož i blato jedna je od retkih (i retko briljantnih) kockarskih priča na ovome jeziku. Još od Dostojevskog naovamo znamo da je kockar osoba koja se mnogo manje bori sa okolinom nego sa sobom, a zavisnost od kockanja nalazi se vrlo visoko na listi samodestruktivnih zavisnosti. Kockar se, naime, u jednakoj meri igra sa sudbinom kao i sa sobom. A, opet, ako igra rulet on to radi zajedno s nekim drugim ljudima. I nikada ne zna ko su ti drugi. U Gavrićevoj se priči grupa mladih kockara susreće s iskusnim i, ispostaviće se, opasnim kockarom. Susreću se, dakle, ljudi koji svoj život tek počinju i čovek koji je svoj život, na neki način, već završio. U izuzetnoj igri intuicije, pronicljivosti, racionalnih odluka, iskustva i neiskustva, razvija se priča koja, uprkos tome što slušalac sluti kuda ona vodi, kreće neočekivanim tokovima. Priča Refleksija uvlači nas u drugu vrstu igre. Posle deset godina izbivanja iz svog grada – koji bi mogao biti bilo koji manji grad u Srbiji – pripovedač dolazi na sahranu svoga prijatelja. U neužurbanom, ali postojanom pripovedačkom ritmu, u toku u kojem se, naizgled, ne događa ništa, napetost raste gotovo sa svakim novim redom, dok iz prošlosti naviru aveti koje ne žele da nestanu. programme.title: The Case / The Case
programme.desc: The new film St. Basils: An icon of Russia on RT Documentary takes the viewers inside one of Russias oldest and most famous churches and tells its many legends. St. Basils Cathedral was built on the orders of Ivan the Terrible to mark the taking down of the Kazan Khanate - a victory equal to that in WWII for the 20th century. However, from the moment it was built, mysteries surrounded it. For example, people say that because the cathedral was so beautiful, Tsar Ivan didnt want a copy of it constructed anywhere else and poked the architects eyes out. There is also a legend the beautiful domes of Saint Basil were brought by the Russian troops from Kazan. People from different backgrounds notice familiar features - to some, it looks like a gothic church, while others see signatures of the Taj Mahal. The actual name St. Basils is not the real one. It is really called the Cathedral of the Intercession on the Moat - St. Basils real name - by people to honour Basil the Blessed. He was the holy fool who chose a simple life, walked barefoot and abandoned his clothes, for which God granted him the gift of miracles working. People loved him, and even Ivan the Terrible was said to be afraid of him. / The new film St. Basils: An icon of Russia on RT Documentary takes the viewers inside one of Russias oldest and most famous churches and tells its many legends. programme.title: American Story / American Story
programme.desc: These New Yorkers have money to buy food, but they think its a good thing to dumpster dive for food that goes unsold and uneaten. They are called freegans and they save food from waste. An astounding 100 million tons of food is trashed in the US every year. So why let a perfectly edible bagel go to waste? New Yorks freegans rummage in garbage bins and show how much good food is thrown away just because it doesnt look perfect, or its approaching its expiry date. programme.title: Out of Cycle / Out of Cycle
programme.desc: A non-governmental organisation based in Tanzania, APOPO (Anti-Personnel Landmines Removal Product Development), breeds African giant pouched rats and trains them to detect explosives. The rodents are then sent to sniff out landmines in places like Vietnam, Laos, Angola and Cambodia. The rats sharp sense of smell, intelligence and ability to learn fast make them perfect candidates for the task. They are indispensable helpers for landmine-disposal experts. Their work means mine-free land can be restored and lives saved. The rodents, nicknamed HeroRATs for their heroism, are social animals, which helps them to get used to working with humans. Their large cheek pouches (hence the name pouched rats) give them a hamster-like appearance and cuteness. They are good at following commands and memorising what is expected of them. One of these HeroRATs is Isaac, who an RTD film crew met when he was a baby. Together with his siblings, he undergoes training in APOPO, learning all the ins and outs of explosives detection. When hes ready for missions, hes sent to Cambodia, where they suffer more landmine accidents a year than any other country. Millions of dormant landmines pose a threat to citizens and tourists alike, and have a bad effect on development and economic growth. Now, Isaac is there to sort it out! / A non-governmental organisation based in Tanzania, APOPO (Anti-Personnel Landmines Removal Product Development), breeds African giant pouched rats and trains them to detect explosives. programme.title: Meeting with Nature / Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If youre in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, youll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailands endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. programme.title: The Case / The Case
programme.desc: The new film St. Basils: An icon of Russia on RT Documentary takes the viewers inside one of Russias oldest and most famous churches and tells its many legends. St. Basils Cathedral was built on the orders of Ivan the Terrible to mark the taking down of the Kazan Khanate - a victory equal to that in WWII for the 20th century. However, from the moment it was built, mysteries surrounded it. For example, people say that because the cathedral was so beautiful, Tsar Ivan didnt want a copy of it constructed anywhere else and poked the architects eyes out. There is also a legend the beautiful domes of Saint Basil were brought by the Russian troops from Kazan. People from different backgrounds notice familiar features - to some, it looks like a gothic church, while others see signatures of the Taj Mahal. The actual name St. Basils is not the real one. It is really called the Cathedral of the Intercession on the Moat - St. Basils real name - by people to honour Basil the Blessed. He was the holy fool who chose a simple life, walked barefoot and abandoned his clothes, for which God granted him the gift of miracles working. People loved him, and even Ivan the Terrible was said to be afraid of him. / The new film St. Basils: An icon of Russia on RT Documentary takes the viewers inside one of Russias oldest and most famous churches and tells its many legends. programme.title: American Story / American Story
programme.desc: These New Yorkers have money to buy food, but they think its a good thing to dumpster dive for food that goes unsold and uneaten. They are called freegans and they save food from waste. An astounding 100 million tons of food is trashed in the US every year. So why let a perfectly edible bagel go to waste? New Yorks freegans rummage in garbage bins and show how much good food is thrown away just because it doesnt look perfect, or its approaching its expiry date. Check out how to eat in New York for free, and help curb the US food waste problem. / These New Yorkers have money to buy food, but they think its a good thing to dumpster dive for food that goes unsold and uneaten. programme.title: Out of Cycle / Out of Cycle
programme.desc: A non-governmental organisation based in Tanzania, APOPO (Anti-Personnel Landmines Removal Product Development), breeds African giant pouched rats and trains them to detect explosives. The rodents are then sent to sniff out landmines in places like Vietnam, Laos, Angola and Cambodia. The rats sharp sense of smell, intelligence and ability to learn fast make them perfect candidates for the task. They are indispensable helpers for landmine-disposal experts. Their work means mine-free land can be restored and lives saved. The rodents, nicknamed HeroRATs for their heroism, are social animals, which helps them to get used to working with humans. Their large cheek pouches (hence the name pouched rats) give them a hamster-like appearance and cuteness. They are good at following commands and memorising what is expected of them. One of these HeroRATs is Isaac, who an RTD film crew met when he was a baby. Together with his siblings, he undergoes training in APOPO, learning all the ins and outs of explosives detection. When hes ready for missions, hes sent to Cambodia, where they suffer more landmine accidents a year than any other country. Millions of dormant landmines pose a threat to citizens and tourists alike, and have a bad effect on development and economic growth. Now, Isaac is there to sort it out! / A non-governmental organisation based in Tanzania, APOPO (Anti-Personnel Landmines Removal Product Development), breeds African giant pouched rats and trains them to detect explosives. programme.title: Peoples Problems / Peoples Problems
programme.desc: The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law. / The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. programme.title: Peoples Problems / Peoples Problems
programme.desc: The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law. / The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law.

programme.title: Ar / Ar
programme.desc: On Rainews24 the column dedicated to Italian cultural heritage, entrusted to the historic Dellarto and essayist Costantino Dorazio. According to Monica Maggioni, former director of RaiNews24 and current president of Rai, the new pills are attributed to AR - fragments Dares and aired during Saturday and Sunday (as well as various reruns during the week). The care of the program is entrusted to Raffaella Soleri, the direction to Francesca Bartolomei and Alessia Vitali. The column explores some great masterpieces of Italian art and precious places less known to the general public, revealing secrets, revealing puzzles and telling little known stories, in an attempt to give a modern and captivating vision of the extraordinary cultural heritage of the Bel Paese. AR leads the viewers also to discover secret places not open to the public, which Costantino Dorazio also presents in his books. / Su RaiNews24 la rubrica dedicata ai beni culturali italiani, affidata allo storico dellarte e saggista Costantino DOrazio. Ideate da Monica Maggioni, già direttore di RaiNews24 e attuale presidente della RAI, le nuove pillole darte si intitolano AR – Frammenti darte e vanno in onda durante il Sabato e la Domenica (oltre a varie repliche durante la settimana). La cura del programma è affidata a Raffaella Soleri, la regia a Francesca Bartolomei e Alessia Vitali. La rubrica esplora alcuni grandi capolavori dellarte italiana e luoghi preziosi meno conosciuti al grande pubblico, rivelando segreti, svelando enigmi e raccontando storie poco note, nel tentativo di dare una visione moderna e accattivante dello straordinario patrimonio culturale del Bel Paese. AR conduce i telespettatori anche alla scoperta di luoghi segreti non aperti al pubblico, che Costantino DOrazio presenta anche nei suoi libri.

programme.title: New Life under the Sun: Traveling / Novi život pod suncem: Putovanje
programme.desc: The journey is a new version of the British franchise new life under the sun that leads viewers to beautiful European destinations where the British are trying to start new lives and start jobs from which they will live. In ten episodes, Fred Sirieix leader takes us to Spain, in Andalusia, where we get to know the couple who wants to plan and organize weddings and business gatherings. In the wine region of Bordeaux and Bergerac we meet winemakers, Sommelier and his wife, a cookbook launching Gîte, ie a holiday home and cooking school. / Putovanje je nova inačica britanske franšize Novi život pod suncem koja gledatelje vodi na prekrasne europske destinacije na kojima Britanci pokušavaju započeti nove živote i pokrenuti poslove od kojih će živjeti. U deset epizoda voditelj Fred Sirieix vodi nas u Španjolsku, u Andaluziju, gdje upoznajemo par koji želi planirati i organizirati vjenčanja, ali i poslovna druženja. U vinskoj regiji Bordeaux i Bergerac susrećemo vinare, sommeliera i njegovu suprugu kuharicu koji pokreću gîte, tj. kuću za odmor i školu kuhanja.

This season building (it) brings a project to create a modern holiday home, located on Samobor hills. Through nine episodes, viewers will have the opportunity to follow the whole process. The new season also brings four new columns that will educate viewers about the process of building a dream home. / Stigla je nova, četvrta sezona emisije Gradi(ONA). Popularna emisija osvojila je gledatelje tijekom tri sezone prikazivanja na RTL-u autentičnim prikazom procesa stvarne gradnje - od temelja do posljednjeg detalja tijekom uređenja interijera. Ovosezonska Gradi(ONA) donosi projekt stvaranja moderne kuće za odmor, smještene na samoborskim brežuljcima. Kroz devet epizoda gledatelji će imati priliku pratiti cijeli proces. On the new RTL Streaming platform Voyo users can watch all live channels live, and are expected by as many as 1500 different titles-a wide selection of new films of all genres, as well as famous film classics, foreign series and regional hits, top documentaries, sports and music megazetkataks, the biggest reality shows and rich children's content. / Voyo svojim korisnicima pruža jedinstveno iskustvo streamanja - raznovrstan i recentan sadržaj, gledanje bez reklama, fantastičnu opciju da pogledaju svoj omiljeni show 24 sata prije prikazivanja na televiziji te brojne druge mogućnosti! programme.title: Hidden in paradise / Skriveno u raju
programme.desc: What happens when tourists arrive in an idyllic Istrian camp, and each of them, with suitcases, also brings with them numerous desires, secrets, spirits of the past and hidden motives? Among others, the Steiner, surgeon Edward and his grandson Mark, a medical student, arrives on vacation. At first glance, Mark seems to have everything, a guaranteed successful career at the family clinic and a comfortable life, but behind his cynicism and inappropriateness, hides a tragic event from the past that has changed his life and priorities, which is why he is often conflict with his family members. There is also Mark's mother Julius, an entrepreneur and a doctor from Ljubljana, where he runs a family business, a clinic trying to make all the forces famous and successful. The camp also houses the Kovac family who has been visiting the resort for years. The camp is full of events and, although seemingly seems to be another carefree summer in front of them, a real drama is happening behind the scenes! / Što se dogodi kad turisti stignu u idilični istarski kamp, a svatko od njih, uz kofere, sa sobom donese i brojne želje, tajne, duhove prošlosti i skrivene motive? Između ostalih, na ljetovanje stiže obitelj Steiner, kirurg Edvard i njegov unuk Mark, student medicine. Na prvi pogled čini se da Mark ima sve, zajamčenu uspješnu karijeru u obiteljskoj klinici i lagodan život, ali iza njegovog cinizma i nepristupačnosti, krije se tragičan događaj iz prošlosti koji mu je promijenilo život i prioritete, zbog čega često dolazi u sukob s članovima svoje obitelji. Tu je i Markova majka Julija, poduzetnica i liječnica iz Ljubljane, gdje vodi obiteljski posao, kliniku koju se trudi svim silama učiniti poznatom i uspješnom. U kampu se nalazi i obitelj Kovač koja godinama posjećuje odmaralište. Kamp je prepun događanja te, iako se naizgled čini da je ispred njih još jedno bezbrižno ljeto, iza kulisa se zbiva prava drama!

programme.title: Poirot / Poirot
programme.desc: The British Criminal Drama Poirot is the most famous adaptation of the famous detective from Agatha Christie. The Poirot series, originally shown on ITV from 1989 to 2013, lasted impressive 13 seasons and became synonymous with a top-notch criminal story. In the lead role, David Suchet is brilliant, chosen by the Agathe Christie family for the role of Hercule Poirot. Poirot was nominated for as many as 20 baft prizes, which confirms its quality and popularity. This cult series offers impeccable acting, intriguing plot and an unforgettable atmosphere, making it an indispensable classic of a criminal genre. / Britanska kriminalistička drama Poirot najpoznatija je ekranizacija slavnog detektiva iz djela Agathe Christie. Serija Poirot, koja se originalno prikazivala na ITV-u od 1989. do 2013., trajala je impresivnih 13 sezona i postala sinonim za vrhunsku kriminalističku priču. U glavnoj ulozi briljira David Suchet, kojeg je za ulogu Herculea Poirota odabrala sama obitelj Agathe Christie. Poirot je bio nominiran za čak 20 BAFTA nagrada, što potvrđuje njegovu kvalitetu i popularnost. Ova kultna serija nudi besprijekornu glumu, intrigantne zaplete i nezaboravnu atmosferu, čineći je nezaobilaznim klasikom kriminalističkog žanra.

programme.title: Mucke / Mućke
programme.desc: The British Humorous Mutter series follows the Trotter brothers, Dereka del Boy and Rodney, who deals with the resale of suspicious quality and origin at the market in the London suburbs. The main character del Boy, who is brilliantly embodied by David Jason, dreams of wealth and millions, but he ends up every job in complete chaos. Mutters bring hilarious events, family grasps and love clumsiness that often deprive the plans. With unforgettable characters, British humor and a warm story about family, the shakes have become a cult series, which still wins the hearts of viewers around the world today. / Britanska humoristična serija Mućke prati braću Trotter, Dereka Del Boya i Rodneyja, koji se na tržnici u londonskom predgrađu bave preprodajom robe sumnjive kvalitete i porijekla. Glavni junak Del Boy, kojeg briljantno utjelovljuje David Jason, sanja o bogatstvu i milijunima, no svaki njegov posao završi u potpunom kaosu. Mućke donose urnebesne zgode, obiteljske zavrzlame i ljubavne nespretnosti koje Delu često pomrse planove. S nezaboravnim likovima, britanskim humorom i toplom pričom o obitelji, Mućke su postale kultna serija koja i danas osvaja srca gledatelja diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Option / Kosti
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) is a top forensic anthropologist, employed by the Premiest Institute of Jeffersonian, which police and other ranks are often called to assist those cases in which the standard methods of identifying victims are insufficient. programme.title: Poirot / Poirot
programme.desc: The British Criminal Drama Poirot is the most famous adaptation of the famous detective from Agatha Christie. This cult series offers impeccable acting, intriguing plot and an unforgettable atmosphere, making it an indispensable classic of a criminal genre. / Britanska kriminalistička drama Poirot najpoznatija je ekranizacija slavnog detektiva iz djela Agathe Christie. Serija Poirot, koja se originalno prikazivala na ITV-u od 1989. do 2013., trajala je impresivnih 13 sezona i postala sinonim za vrhunsku kriminalističku priču. U glavnoj ulozi briljira David Suchet, kojeg je za ulogu Herculea Poirota odabrala sama obitelj Agathe Christie. Poirot je bio nominiran za čak 20 BAFTA nagrada, što potvrđuje njegovu kvalitetu i popularnost. Ova kultna serija nudi besprijekornu glumu, intrigantne zaplete i nezaboravnu atmosferu, čineći je nezaobilaznim klasikom kriminalističkog žanra.

programme.title: Hidden in paradise / Skriveno u raju
programme.desc: What happens when tourists arrive in an idyllic Istrian camp, and each of them, with suitcases, also brings with them numerous desires, secrets, spirits of the past and hidden motives? Among others, the Steiner, surgeon Edward and his grandson Mark, a medical student, arrives on vacation. At first glance, Mark seems to have everything, a guaranteed successful career at the family clinic and a comfortable life, but behind his cynicism and inappropriateness, hides a tragic event from the past that has changed his life and priorities, which is why he is often conflict with his family members. There is also Mark's mother Julius, an entrepreneur and a doctor from Ljubljana, where he runs a family business, a clinic trying to make all the forces famous and successful. The camp also houses the Kovac family who has been visiting the resort for years. The camp is full of events and, although seemingly seems to be another carefree summer in front of them, a real drama is happening behind the scenes! / Što se dogodi kad turisti stignu u idilični istarski kamp, a svatko od njih, uz kofere, sa sobom donese i brojne želje, tajne, duhove prošlosti i skrivene motive? Između ostalih, na ljetovanje stiže obitelj Steiner, kirurg Edvard i njegov unuk Mark, student medicine. Na prvi pogled čini se da Mark ima sve, zajamčenu uspješnu karijeru u obiteljskoj klinici i lagodan život, ali iza njegovog cinizma i nepristupačnosti, krije se tragičan događaj iz prošlosti koji mu je promijenilo život i prioritete, zbog čega često dolazi u sukob s članovima svoje obitelji. Tu je i Markova majka Julija, poduzetnica i liječnica iz Ljubljane, gdje vodi obiteljski posao, kliniku koju se trudi svim silama učiniti poznatom i uspješnom. U kampu se nalazi i obitelj Kovač koja godinama posjećuje odmaralište. Kamp je prepun događanja te, iako se naizgled čini da je ispred njih još jedno bezbrižno ljeto, iza kulisa se zbiva prava drama!

programme.title: Poirot / Poirot
programme.desc: The British Criminal Drama Poirot is the most famous adaptation of the famous detective from Agatha Christie. The Poirot series, originally shown on ITV from 1989 to 2013, lasted impressive 13 seasons and became synonymous with a top criminal story. In the lead role, David Suchet is brilliant, chosen by the Agathe Christie family for the role of Hercule Poirot. Poirot was nominated for as many as 20 baft prizes, which confirms its quality and popularity. This cult series offers impeccable acting, intriguing plot and an unforgettable atmosphere, making it an indispensable classic of a criminal genre. / Britanska kriminalistička drama Poirot najpoznatija je ekranizacija slavnog detektiva iz djela Agathe Christie. Serija Poirot, koja se originalno prikazivala na ITV-u od 1989. do 2013., trajala je impresivnih 13 sezona i postala sinonim za vrhunsku kriminalističku priču. U glavnoj ulozi briljira David Suchet, kojeg je za ulogu Herculea Poirota odabrala sama obitelj Agathe Christie. Poirot je bio nominiran za čak 20 BAFTA nagrada, što potvrđuje njegovu kvalitetu i popularnost. Ova kultna serija nudi besprijekornu glumu, intrigantne zaplete i nezaboravnu atmosferu, čineći je nezaobilaznim klasikom kriminalističkog žanra.

The murder department, which solves the most subsequent cases on the streets of Vienna. / Nakon što mu je dotadašnji vlasnik ubijen, Rex pripadne inspektoru Richardu Moseru (Tobias Moretti), koji se nadavno rastao. programme.title: Option / Kosti
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) is a top forensic anthropologist, employed by the Premiest Institute of Jeffersonian, which police and other ranks are often called to assist those cases in which the standard methods of identifying victims are insufficient. Namely, the temperance special is its unusual ability to read traces in the victim's burnt, destroyed or heavier bones. Brennanan is most often cooperating with the Special Agent Seeley Booth (David Boreanaz), a member of the Special FBI Team for Teaching Team. / Doktorica Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) vrhunska je forenzična antropologinja, zaposlena u uglednom institutu Jeffersonian, koju policija i druge snage reda često zovu u pomoć pri onim slučajevima ubojstava u kojima su standardne metode identificiranja žrtava nedovoljne. Naime, Temperanceina specijalnost njezina je nesvakidašnja sposobnost čitanja tragova u žrtvinim izgorenim, uništenim ili teže oštećenim kostima. Brennanova najčešće surađuje sa specijalnim agentom Seeleyem Boothom (David Boreanaz), članom posebnog FBI-jeva tima za istraživanje ubojstava.

A játeknapon a legtobb teruletet elfoglalo 500.000 forint napi nyeremenyt vihet haza. Aki a het vegen a teljes Floort birtokolja, aze a győzelem es a vele járo 8 millio forintos heti fődíj. A műsor hangulatát tovább fokozza a nepszerű műsorvezető, Szujo Zoltán szemelye, aki első alkalommal vezet kvízshow-t, es amellyel egy regi álma vált valora. A vetelkedő gyártoja a Scripted Productions. A The Floor - Csak egy maradhat nem csupán a stúdioban versenyzőknek nyújt elmenyt, hanem izgalmas kikapcsolodást biztosít. programme.title: Bloody diamond / Krvavi dijamant
programme.desc: In order to achieve their goals, former Zimbabwery Danny Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) and a fisherman from Mende - Solomon Vandy (Djimon Hounsou) are joining during the Civil War, which engulfed Sierra Leone in the 1990s. programme.desc: The Morningstar Lucifer Archangel (Tom Ellis) costs a persecution in paradise, waiting for him for millennia in hell and punishing the human race. programme.title: Stop to tell you / Stani da ti kažem
programme.desc: The show primarily aims to promote the freedom of expressing children as well as respecting their opinion. It wants to show that the child is able to shape a sophisticated attitude and that he has a full right to make him. Adults often experience children as people who only need protection, and very rarely people who have certain knowledge and attitudes that are well worth listening to because, in many cases, children have a rational approach to the solution of numerous situations without even being aware of this. Numerous situations and contributions shown through this TV show, open up various current life themes, learn things from general culture, exchange experiences, and through all this we strive for interacting between adults and children. We often know to tell our children that they will never be nicer than in their childhood, forgetting that they have their fears and their hopes, just like us, and that we owe them to their lives as a series of and beautiful and less beautiful moments that change independently of the age, interest and time in which we live. Every child is a man in a small, and every man is a great child, which creates a suitable climate for the development of one solid connection between the two individuals. Based on these views, the characters of the lucky all -known and Tamara were born. Both play a big and equal role in this series. With her way of expressing her way of expressing her way to her little friend, her way of expression, and she, with her childish wisdom, pure heart and firm attitude, wins his, but also the heart of the viewers. Tamara / Emisija prvenstveno ima za cilj promociju slobode izražavanja djece, kao i uvažavanja njihovog mišljenja. Njime se želi pokazati da je dijete sposobno oblikovati sopstveni stav i da ima puno pravo da ga iznese. Odrasli često djecu doživljavaju kao osobe kojima samo treba zaštita, a vrlo rijetko osobama koje imaju određena znanja i stavove koje itekako vrijedi saslušati jer, u velikom broju slučajeva, djeca imaju racionalan pristup rješenju brojnih situacija, a da odrasli toga nisu ni svjesni. Brojnim situacijama i prilozima prikazanim kroz ovu TV emisiju, otvaramo razne aktuelne životne teme, učimo stvari iz opšte kulture, razmjenjujemo iskustva i kroz sve to težimo interakciji između odraslih i djece. Često znamo reći svojoj djeci da im nikad neće biti ljepše nego u doba djetinjstva, pritom zaboravljajući da i oni imaju svoje strahove i svoja nadanja, baš kao i mi, te da smo dužni da im život predočimo kao niz i lijepih i manje lijepih trenutaka koji se smjenjuju nezavisno od uzrasta, zanimanja i vremena u kojem živimo. Svako dijete je čovjek u malom, a svaki čovjek veliko dijete, što i stvara pogodnu klimu za razvoj jedne čvrste veze između te dvije jedinke. Na temelju tih stavova, rodili su se likovi Srećka Sveznalice i Tamare. I jedno i drugo imaju veliku, a i podjednaku ulogu u ovom serijalu. Srećko Sveznalica se svojim načinom izražavanja i vedrim ponašanjem prilagođava svojoj maloj prijateljici, a ona svojom dječjom mudrošću, čistim srcem i čvrstim stavom osvaja njegovo, ali i srce gledalaca. programme.title: Krajina guard / Čuvari Krajine
programme.desc: The documentary series of Karajina Karajina aims to present the rich cultural and historical heritage of Serbs from the area of Lika and Dalmatia, their historical rootness in these parts, but also all the few returnees today faces. Given the complexity of turbulent historical processes, Serbs from Lička and Dalmatian villages and cities have always been guards of national identity, and more than ten centuries are present on historic stage. At the first Split Parliament, held in 925. years, Serbs were mentioned as inhabitants of the Dalmatian hinterland. At the 14th century, the three most important and most common Serbian monastery - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) and Dragović (1395) were filed. The great names of Serbian history, spirituality and art are arguing out of these parts, and is enough to mention only some of them: Stojan Knežević, Vladan Knežević, Nikola Tesla ... The areas of Lika and northern Dalmatia were inhabited by the majority Orthodox population affected that today majority in just a few local communities. All this is enough for these parts, as well as the population that inhabits them today, dedicate media attention as they deserve, with the desire to not forget people and the ends enriched by the Serbian national and spiritual being. / Dokumentarni serijal Čuvari Krajine ima za cilj predstaviti bogato kulturno-istorijsko nasljeđe Srba sa područja Like i Dalmacije, njihovu istorijsku ukorijenjenost u ovim krajevima, ali i sve ono sa čim se malobrojno povratničko stanovništvo danas suočava. Imajući u vidu složenost burnih istorijskih procesa, Srbi iz ličkih i dalmatinskih sela i gradova oduvijek su bili čuvari nacionalnog identiteta, a na istorijskoj pozornici prisutni su više od deset vijekova. Na Prvom splitskom saboru, održanom 925. godine, pominju se Srbi kao stanovnici dalmatinskog zaleđa. U 14. vijeku podignuta su tri najznačajnija i najzapadnija srpska manastira - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) i Dragović (1395). Velika imena srpske istorije, duhovnosti i umjetnosti potiču upravo iz ovih krajeva, a dovoljno je pomenuti samo neka od njih: Stojan Јanković, Vuk Mandušić, Simo Matavulj, Vladan Desnica, Nikodim Milaš, Stefan Knežević, Nikola Tesla... Područja Like i Sjeverne Dalmacije bila su vijekovima naseljena većinskim pravoslavnim stanovništvom, dok su posljednja ratna dešavanja uticala na to da su danas većinski u samo nekoliko lokalnih zajednica. Sve ovo dovoljan je razlog da se ovim krajevima, kao i stanovništvu koje ih danas nastanjuje, posveti medijska pažnja kakvu i zaslužuju, sa željom da se ne zaborave ljudi i krajevi koji su u mnogome obogatili srpsko nacionalno i duhovno biće.

programme.title: My place / Moje Mjesto
programme.desc: In the show, we bring stories of individuals who, through their work, experience and knowledge, create a better life for themselves and their family in Republika Srpska and serve as an example of a narrow and wider community. Through life stories, the series deals with the idea and way of returning from abroad and question - is life in abroad better than here? Why do we do pharmacies, developers, economists and everyone else who painstakingly acquired their diplomas can charge humanity? Do foreigners and nostalgia destroy the soul? My place brings you answers to all these questions. In the first shows, we talk to artists, doctors of science, professors, people who, by their example, promote survival in Republika Srpska. They speak about their closest, friends, godparents, work colleagues. Each story has its own stamp that is woven into the depths of the soul and remains like the wind in the back of future generations. Is it a real success to be the master of your time and live on your own? Can we change the way you look, stay and start? / U emisiji donosimo priče pojedinaca koji svojim radom, iskustvom i znanjem stvaraju kvalitetniji život za sebe i svoju porodicu u Republici Srpskoj i služe kao primjer užoj i široj zajednici. Serijal se kroz životne priče ljudi bavi idejom i načinom povratka iz inostranstva i pitanjem - Zar je život u inostranstvu bolji nego ovdje? Zašto nam odlaze ljekari, programeri, ekonomisti i svi drugi koji svoje diplome mukotrpno stečene mogu ljudski da naplate? Da li tuđina i nostalgija razaraju dušu? Moje mjesto vam donosi odgovore na sva ova pitanja. U prvim emisijama pričamo sa umjetnicima, doktorima nauka, profesorima, ljudima koji svojim primjerom promovišu opstanak u Republici Srpskoj. O njima govore njihovi najbliži, prijatelji, kumovi, radne kolege. Svaka priča ima svoj pečat koji je utkan u dubinu duše i ostaje kao vjetar u leđa budućim generacijama. Da li je pravi uspjeh biti gospodar svoga vremena, a živjeti na svome? Možemo li promijeniti način gledanja, ostati i pokrenuti se?

programme.title: The heritage of native creatives / Baština Zavičajnih Stvaralaca
programme.desc: Documentary TV series The heritage of the Homeland Writers aims to preserve the cultural heritage of Kozara, Podkozarje and Krajina, in the works of the greats of Serbian literature. We decided on the creators who woke the color of the environment in which they were born and adults in their works. We don't mention many of them often, we forgot some. We want to present the literary and historical heritage of our climate in a modern way and preserve the valuable works and headquarters, said Sanja Subotic Cumbo, an editor of the 12 Epizor series. Branko Ćopić dedicated, Mladen Oljaca, Petra Kočić, Vesi Radumil, Stevki Kozić Pradovic, Sadiku Tabaković, Vasilija Karana, Mljko Šindić, Nebojsa Ivaštanin, Rakiti Stanko Rakiti ... / Dokumentarni TV serijal Baština zavičajnih pisaca ima za cilj očuvanje kulturne baštine Кozare, Potkozarja i Кrajine, u djelima velikana srpske književnosti. Odlučili smo se za stvaraoce koji su u svoja djela utkali kolorit sredine u kojoj su rođeni i odrasli. Mnoge od njih ne pominjemo često, neke smo zaboravili. Želimo da na moderan način prikažemo književnu i istorijsku baštinu našeg podneblja i sačuvamo od zaborava vrijedna djela i zavičajne stvaraoce, rekla je Sanja Subotić Cumbo, urednik serijala od 12 epizora. Posvećene su Branku Ćopiću, Mladenu Oljači, Petru Kočiću, Draganu Kolundžiji, Vesi Radumilu, Stevki Kozić Preradović, Sadiku Tabakoviću, Vasiliju Karanu, Miljku Šindiću, Nebojši Ivaštaninu, Stanku Rakiti…

programme.title: Duke / Vojvoda
programme.desc: The year is 1961. Kempton Bunton, sixty-year-old taxi drivers, steals Goyin Portrait of the Duke of Wellington from the National Gallery in London. The first is (and so far the only) theft in the history of this respectable institution. Kempton sends information on the recovery of celebrities provided that the government invests more in care for older people - after which the campaign is led by the purpose of providing free television services to the retirement population. What happens then becomes legend. Only 50 years later, the light of the day will emerge the right truth - Kempton has blown the network of lies. The only truth was that it was a good man, determined to change the world and save his own marriage - how and why he used the Duke not to achieve a special story. We have more than an exemplary example of how the procedures of each of us can make a difference and change the company for the best. / Godina je 1961. Kempton Bunton, šezdesetogodišnji taksist, krade Goyin portret Vojvode od Wellingtona iz Nacionalne galerije u Londonu. Prva je to (i do sada jedina) krađa u istoriji ove ugledne institucije. Kempton šalje informaciju o povratu slavne slike pod uslovom da vlada uloži više u brigu za starije osobe - nakon čega predvodi kampanju s ciljem pružanja usluge besplatne televizije penzionerskoj populaciji. Ono što se zatim događa postaje legendom. Tek 50 godina kasnije, na svjetlo dana isplivaće prava istina - Kempton je ispleo mrežu laži. Jedina istina bila je to da je riječ o dobrom čovjeku, odlučnom promijeniti svijet i spasiti vlastiti brak - kako i zašto je iskoristio Vojvodu ne bi li to postigao posebna je priča.
