programme.title: Krajina guard / Čuvari Krajine
programme.desc: The documentary series of Karajina Karajina aims to present the rich cultural and historical heritage of Serbs from the area of Lika and Dalmatia, their historical rootness in these parts, but also all the few returnees today faces. Given the complexity of turbulent historical processes, Serbs from Lička and Dalmatian villages and cities have always been guards of national identity, and more than ten centuries are present on historic stage. At the first Split Parliament, held in 925. years, Serbs were mentioned as inhabitants of the Dalmatian hinterland. At the 14th century, the three most important and most common Serbian monastery - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) and Dragović (1395) were filed. The great names of Serbian history, spirituality and art are arguing out of these parts, and is enough to mention only some of them: Stojan Knežević, Vladan Knežević, Nikola Tesla ... The areas of Lika and northern Dalmatia were inhabited by the majority Orthodox population affected that today majority in just a few local communities. All this is enough for these parts, as well as the population that inhabits them today, dedicate media attention as they deserve, with the desire to not forget people and the ends enriched by the Serbian national and spiritual being. / Dokumentarni serijal Čuvari Krajine ima za cilj predstaviti bogato kulturno-istorijsko nasljeđe Srba sa područja Like i Dalmacije, njihovu istorijsku ukorijenjenost u ovim krajevima, ali i sve ono sa čim se malobrojno povratničko stanovništvo danas suočava. Imajući u vidu složenost burnih istorijskih procesa, Srbi iz ličkih i dalmatinskih sela i gradova oduvijek su bili čuvari nacionalnog identiteta, a na istorijskoj pozornici prisutni su više od deset vijekova. Na Prvom splitskom saboru, održanom 925. godine, pominju se Srbi kao stanovnici dalmatinskog zaleđa. U 14. vijeku podignuta su tri najznačajnija i najzapadnija srpska manastira - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) i Dragović (1395). Velika imena srpske istorije, duhovnosti i umjetnosti potiču upravo iz ovih krajeva, a dovoljno je pomenuti samo neka od njih: Stojan Јanković, Vuk Mandušić, Simo Matavulj, Vladan Desnica, Nikodim Milaš, Stefan Knežević, Nikola Tesla... Područja Like i Sjeverne Dalmacije bila su vijekovima naseljena većinskim pravoslavnim stanovništvom, dok su posljednja ratna dešavanja uticala na to da su danas većinski u samo nekoliko lokalnih zajednica. Sve ovo dovoljan je razlog da se ovim krajevima, kao i stanovništvu koje ih danas nastanjuje, posveti medijska pažnja kakvu i zaslužuju, sa željom da se ne zaborave ljudi i krajevi koji su u mnogome obogatili srpsko nacionalno i duhovno biće.

programme.desc: The show primarily aims to promote the freedom of expressing children as well as respecting their opinion. Odrasli često djecu doživljavaju kao osobe kojima samo treba zaštita, a vrlo rijetko osobama koje imaju određena znanja i stavove koje itekako vrijedi saslušati jer, u velikom broju slučajeva, djeca imaju racionalan pristup rješenju brojnih situacija, a da odrasli toga nisu ni svjesni. Često znamo reći svojoj djeci da im nikad neće biti ljepše nego u doba djetinjstva, pritom zaboravljajući da i oni imaju svoje strahove i svoja nadanja, baš kao i mi, te da smo dužni da im život predočimo kao niz i lijepih i manje lijepih trenutaka koji se smjenjuju nezavisno od uzrasta, zanimanja i vremena u kojem živimo. Svako dijete je čovjek u malom, a svaki čovjek veliko dijete, što i stvara pogodnu klimu za razvoj jedne čvrste veze između te dvije jedinke. Na temelju tih stavova, rodili su se likovi Srećka Sveznalice i Tamare. I jedno i drugo imaju veliku, a i podjednaku ulogu u ovom serijalu. programme.title: Memory Day on the Stradale and Exiled Serbs in Action / Dan sećanja na stradale i prognane Srbe u akciji
programme.desc: On the occasion of the thirty anniversary of the Croatian Military Action, Storm on Georgija Branković Square in Sremski Karlovci will be marked by the day of remembrance of all suffers and exiled Serbs. On that 4. August 1995 The Croatian Army and Police launched an offensive in the area of Dalmatia, Lika, Kordun and Banija. During that action, 1,903 Serbs were killed or disappeared, of which 1,247 civilians. Thirty years later in the records of the missing was 619 people. More than 220,000 Serbs have left their home and Krajina was devastated and looted. The commemorative gathering in Sremski Karlovci will begin with the parastos, which will serve the patriarch of Serbian porfiries at 7 pm and 30 minutes, after which they are planned to address the survivors as well as the President of the Republika Srpska and Serbia. We will broadcast a direct transfer of the state commemorative gathering on our first program from 7 pm and 50 minutes. / Povodom tridesetogodišnjice od hrvatske vojne akcije Oluja na Trgu Georgija Brankovića u Sremskim Karlovcima biće obeležen Dan sećanja na sve stradale i prognane Srbe. Tog 4. avgusta 1995. godine hrvatska vojska i policija pokrenule su ofanziju na području Dalmacije, Like, Korduna i Banije. Tokom te akcije ubijeno je ili nestalo 1.903 Srba, od toga 1.247 civila. Trideset godina kasnije u evidenciji nestalih je još 619 osoba. Više od 220.000 Srba napustilo je svoj dom a Krajina je opustošena i opljačkana. Komemorativni skup u Sremskim Karlovcima počeće parastosom koji će u 19 časova i 30 minuta služiti patrijarh srpski Porfirije, nakon čega su planirana obraćanja preživelih kao i predsednika Republike Srpske i Srbije. Direktan prenos državnog komemorativnog skupa prenosićemo na našem prvom programu od 19 časova i 50 minuta.

Očekujte bezvremenu i neodoljivu priču koja uspešno oživljava epohu i uvlači nas u viktorijansku englesku i sve njene raznolikosti. Iskrena dečja prijateljstva, težak život siročića, smešne i tragične trenutke gledamo kroz oči dečaka i devojčica koji u svemu što im se suprotstavlja ipak uspevaju da pronađu razlog za igru i zabavu!

programme.title: From plow to digital farm / Od Pluga do digitalne farme
programme.desc: The editorial office of the scientific program begins with the broadcast of a new series called the plow to the digital farm. We deal with the development of agriculture in modern Serbia where the periods of flourishing and stagnation are alternated from the middle of the XIX century. Great individuals appear, scientists and creators who move the boundaries by introducing the principles of modern agriculture, but their scientific and economic achievements are collapsing very quickly. The series includes the period of two centuries of statehood of Serbia and during that time, as in the vicious spiral, we always start from the beginning. The same matrix is recognized at the time of the establishment of a modern agriculture in the middle of the 19th century and in the modern race of today while trying to define what the opportunities are and what the goals of the agricultural development of the XXI century. / Redakcija naučnog programa počinje sa emitovanjem nove serije pod nazivom Od Pluga do digitalne farme. Bavimo se razvojem poljoprivrede u modernoj Srbiji gde se od polovine XIX veka do današnjih dana smenjuju periodi procvata i stagnacije. Pojavljuju se sjajni pojedinci, naučnici i stvaraoci koji pomeraju granice uvodeći principe moderne poljoprivrede ali se vrlo brzo njihova naučna i privredna dostignuća urušavaju. Serija obuhvata period dva veka državnosti Srbije a tokom tog vremenena, kao u začaranoj spirali, krećemo uvek iz početka. Ista matrica prepoznaje se u vreme uspostavljanja moderne poljoprivrede sredinom XIX veka i u savremenoj trci današnjice dok pokušavamo da definišemo šta su mogućnosti a šta ciljevi razvoja poljoprivrede XXI veka.

programme.title: Optimistic / Optimisti

Iako su naizgled šaljive, svaka priča verno oslikava stvarno stanje današnjice, koja se ulepšava uz pomoć lažnog optimizma i samim tim lakše preživljava. Priče su inspirisane čuvenim Volterovim romanom Kandid.

programme.title: Bitter revenge / Gorka osveta
programme.desc: Pain memories, desire for revenge, passion and love await us in one of the most watched Portuguese telenovels in the last few years, which 2018 was also received by the prestigious EMI Award. George Monforte is a Brazilian entrepreneur and the owner of the Auro Verde agricultural empire. After gaining a significant share in the company led by a rich and powerful portuguese family led by Miguel Fereiro de Fonsko, George becomes a member of the Board of Directors. The novelty is not well accepted in the De Fonsec family because they justifiably doubt the actual intentions of this foreigner. Namely, George Monforte is a new identity of Marie, for whom they all thought he was dead. Ze Maria returns to take revenge on the death of his family. Joao Magalhesa, Father Ze Marie, fifteen years ago, was the financial director at the time of great financial fraud and capital abuse in the company of the Faxes family. Joao was used as a sacrificial Capricorn and the firm accuses him of fraud. Joao threatens that the public will be presented by all dirty laundry company, if the charges do not withdraw. He and his family are killed, and the whole situation was expelled to look like murder and suicide. By playing the case, the only survivor is George. When he wakes up from which, Ze Maria is confused and at first he does not remember the event. He will look for Miguel, to help him find a job. On the same day he meets a girl in love with, not knowing that she is Miguel daughter. Over time, his memory is returned, and Miguela secret is no longer safe. / Bolne uspomene, želja za osvetom, strast i ljubav očekuju nas u jednoj od najgledanijih portugalskih telenovela u poslednjih nekoliko godina, koja je 2018. godine dobila i prestižnu nagradu Emi. Žorž Monforte je brazilski preduzetnik i vlasnik poljoprivrednog carstva Ouro verde. Nakon što stekne značajan udeo u kompaniji koju vodi bogata i moćna portugalska porodica na čelu sa Miguelom Fereirom de Fonsekom, Žorž postaje član Upravnog odbora. Novost nije dobro prihvaćena u porodici De Fonseka jer opravdano sumnjaju u stvarne namere ovog stranca. Naime, Žorž Monforte je novi identitet Ze Marie, za koga su petnaest godina svi mislili da je mrtav. Ze Maria se vraća kako bi osvetio smrt svoje porodice. Žoao Magalhesa, otac Ze Marie, pre petnaest godina je bio finansijski direktor u vreme velike finansijske prevare i zloupotrebe kapitala u kompaniji porodice De Fonseka. Žoao je iskorišten kao žrtveni jarac i firma ga optužuje za prevaru. Žoao preti da će u javnost izneti sav prljavi veš kompanije, ukoliko se optužbe ne povuku. On i njegova porodica bivaju ubijeni, a cela situacija je izlažirana kako bi izgledala kao ubistvo i samoubistvo. Igrom slučaja, jedini preživeli je Žorž. Kada se probudi iz kome, Ze Maria je zbunjen i u početku se ne seća događaja. Potražiće Miguela, kako bi mu pomogao da pronađe posao. Istog dana upoznaje devojku u koju se zaljubljuje, ne znajući da je ona Miguelova kćerka. Vremenom mu se vraća sećanje, a Miguelova tajna više nije sigurna.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, he learns that he is an uncle on the edge of bankruptcy and that he was accused of lighting the van of the reputable department stores for a paradise for the ladies that he loses his job. The owner of the department store is PieTro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to hire and show that he is an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon acquires the trust of the colleagues. The girl in the end is madly falling in love with Roeiter Moria, but he must return to Sicilia because her father promised the mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva ... / Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, verenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, posle rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva devojka koja ubrzo stiče poverenje kolega. Devojka se na kraju ludo zaljubljuje u Pijetra Morija, ali mora da se vrati na Siciliju jer je njen otac obećao gradonačelniku Kastelbuonoa da će se Tereza udati za njegovog sina Salva...

programme.title: Blasphemy - monastery / Bogotražitelji - Manastir Stanjevići
programme.desc: St. Trinity Monastery - Stanjevići, is located in the village of Pobori, near Budva at 800 meters above sea level. The renovation of the monastery was completed in 2018. years and today it is eagerly from the place visiting by believing from all over the world. According to the tradition, this lighthouse of Serb spirituality was founded in the first half of the 14th century, nobleman Nikola Stanjević whose bust is adorned with the entry into the monastery. In the monastery of Stanjevići in 1780. The Bogoslovska school was opened and St. Peter Cetinje attended. The modern renovation of the monastery began in 1994. years to the blessing of Bishop Amfilohi and the appointment of Jeromonah Dimitri Blagojević. He led the renovation of the monastery for ten years, all the way to the premature death, in 2004. years. His work continued Jeromonah Jefrim Dabanović, the current iguman. The wealth of the monastery is also a library with about 20,000 books, which Bishop Amfilohia caught the mastery as well as a memorial room with numerous cases used by the bishop for life. We also recorded the pedestrian church dedicated to the effeminate young men, in which the liturgy is served fly and in it are frequent and baptisms. We also stayed at the celebration of Petrovdan, where the believing people gather coming from all over the world to liturgically mark and celebrate this big holiday. After each weekly liturgy in the monastery, Stanjevići believing with the conversation remain on agape the despatch of love. Many believing the way to all spiritual ages will also find through spiritual conversations with the Iguman Monastery to Father Jefrem, which we have also talked about and about what are the most common issues and problems of modern man about / Manastir Svete Trojice – Stanjevići, nalazi se u ataru sela Pobori, kod Budve na 800 metara nadmorske visine. Obnova manastira završena je 2018. godine i danas je to jedano od mesta koje obilaze verujući iz celog sveta. Prema predanju ovaj svetionika srpske duhovnost osnovao je u prvoj polovini XIV veka, plemić Nikola Stanjević čija bista krasi ulazak u manastir. U manastiru Stanjevići 1780. godine bila je otvorena bogoslovska škola koju je pohađao i Sveti Petar Cetinjski. Savremena obnova manastira otpočela je 1994. godine blagoslovom vladike Amfilohija i imenovanjem jeromonaha Dimitrija Blagojevića. On je deset godina vodio obnovu manastira, sve do prerane smrti, 2004. godine. Njegov rad nastavio je jeromonah Jefrem Dabanović, sadašnji iguman. Bogatstvo manastira je i biblioteka sa oko 20 000 knjiga koje je vladika Amfilohije zaveštao manstiru kao i spomen-sobu s brojnim predmetima koje je vladika koristio za života. Zabeležili smo i pešternu crkvu posvećenoj efeskim mladićima, u kojoj se liturgije služe leti a u njoj su česta i krštenja. Boravili smo i na Cetnju o proslavi Petrovdana gde se verujući narod okuplja dolazeći iz celog sveta kako bi liturgijski obeležio i proslavio ovaj veliki praznik. Posle svake nedeljne liturgije u Manastiru Stanjevići verujući uz razgovor ostaju na Agape trpezi ljubavi. Mnogi verujući put ka svom duhovnom uzrastanju pronalaze i kroz duhovne razgovore s igumanom manastira ocem Jefremom s koji smo pričali i o tome koja su to najčešća pitanja i problemi savremenog čoveka o

programme.title: I love the classic / Volim klasiku
programme.desc: Tango inspires authors, performers and dancers. It is the music of passion and love, and in the new edition of the show, I like the classic of Liberquatro Ensemble: Martina Dimic Radovanovic - Violin, Petar Mirkov - Bandoneon, Boban Stošić - Konvir and Ksenija Ristic - Piano. Vocal art in this show are two ladies: Željka Zdjelar - Mecosopran, she is a soloist of the National Theater in Belgrade and Dr. Dentistry, and Danijela Jovanović - soprano, brokerage of the Serbian National Theater and it brings the interpretation of Arija Silva from Kalman's Operate Kneginja Čardasha, with Piano cooperation of singers and pianists Strahinje Đokić. The contributions will be discussed by RTS Symphony Orchestra, Dinić's conductine baton, with a solist flutist, Silvia Kared, on the Anthology of Serbian Horska's award, and a small portrait of the young violinist Luka Fausi. / Tango inspiriše autore, izvođače i plesače. To je muzika strasti i ljubavi, a u novom izdanju emisije Volim klasiku tango muziku interpretira ansambl Liberquatro čiji su članovi: Martina Dimić Radovanović – violina, Aleksandar Mišović – vokal, Petar Mirkov – bandoneon, Boban Stošić – kontrabas i Ksenija Ristić – klavir. Vokalnu umetnost u ovoj emisiju predstavljaju dve dame: Željka Zdjelar – mecosopran, ona je solistkinja opere Narodnog pozorišta u Beogradu i doktor stomatologije, a u emisiji izvodi Il Vito Obradorsa i Danijela Jovanović – sopran, prvakinja Opere Srpskog Narodnog pozorišta i ona donosi interpretaciju arije Silve iz Kalmanove operete Kneginja Čardaša, uz klavirsku saradnju pevača i pijaniste Strahinje Đokića. U prilozima će biti reči o koncertu Simfonijskog orkestra RTS pod dirigentskom palicom maestra Srboljuba Dinića, sa solistkinjom flautistkinjom Silvijom Karedu, o Antologiji srpske horske muzike, o ovogodišnjoj Mokranjčevoj nagradi, a biće prikazan i mali portret mladog violiniste Luke Fausija.

Istog dana upoznaje devojku u koju se zaljubljuje, ne znajući da je ona Miguelova kćerka. Vremenom mu se vraća sećanje, a Miguelova tajna više nije sigurna.

programme.title: Ten years with Haja Miazaki / Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem
programme.desc: The documentary for ten years with Haja Majazaki through four episodes is the chronicle of the creative process of the legendary director and the founder of even legendiary studies Gibli. Covering a period of work on the film on the cliff end of the 2008. The wind rises from 2013, the documentary shows Meisaki as a passionate artist, but also a father who is in a creative conflict with his son. If there are Japanese directions with which the Western world is well acquainted, it is probably a dead race between Kurosava and Mihazaki. But if we talk about animation, there is no takers. Midazaki was quiet, a modest man largest part of his career, and was only the last few decades among his fans (especially those who do not speak Japanese) became a clear relationship between Meusaki with Gibli. It is a great part of the merit of the student of the Acera, which received the permission to enter the Studio Gibli and record part of the atmosphere during work on Mijazaki's film. Arakava still does not know why Midazaki allowed that from a short documentary film, such, a completely exclusive series. Through four episodes of fifty minutes, we follow how the cult characters and plots are created from the imagination of a miraculous mind. There are also memories of Mother, Childhood, Mijazaki's relationship with his son, and then the devastating earthquake that shook Japan, followed by a nuceal disaster in Fukushima. The series ends with another Mijazaki triumph, but also the topics of aging and meaning to the creation of animated films in these turbulent times. / Dokumentarni film Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem kroz četiri epizode predstavlja hroniku kreativnog procesa legendarnog reditelja i osnivača još legendarnijeg Studija Gibli. Pokrivajući period od rada na filmu Ponjo na litici kraj mora iz 2008. godine do Vetar se diže iz 2013., dokumentarac prikazuje Mijazakija kao strastvenog umetnika, nepokolebljivog tragaoca, ali i oca koji je u kreativnom sukobu sa sinom. Ukoliko postoje japanski reditelji sa kojima je zapadni svet dobro upoznat, verovatno je mrtva trka izmedju Kurosave i Mijazakija. Ali ako govorimo o animaciji, takmaca nema. Mijazaki je bio tih, skroman čovek najvećim delom svoje karijere, a tek je poslednjih par decenija medju svojim obožavaocima (naročito onim koji ne govore japanski) postao jasan odnos Mijazakija sa Giblijem. Velikim delom to je zasluga studenta Kaku Arakave, koji je dobio dozvolu da dodje u Studio Gibli i snimi deo atmosfere tokom rada na Mijazakijevom filmu. Arakava i dalje ne zna zbog čega je Mijazaki dozvolio da od kratkog dokumentarnog filma nastane ovakav, sasvim ekskluzivan serijal. Kroz četiri epizode od pedeset minuta pratimo kako se iz mašte jednog čudesnog uma stvaraju kultni likovi i zapleti. Tu su i sećanja na majku, detinjstvo, Mijazakijev odnos sa sinom, a potom i razorni zemljotres koji je potresao Japan, praćen nukearnom katastrofom u Fukušimi. Serijal završava još jednim Mijazakijevim trijumfom, ali i temama starenja i smisla stvaranja animiranih filmova u ovim turbulentnim vremenima.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, he learns that he is an uncle on the edge of bankruptcy and that he was accused of lighting the van of the reputable department stores for a paradise for the ladies that he loses his job. The owner of the department store is PieTro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to hire and show that he is an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon acquires the trust of the colleagues. The girl in the end is madly falling in love with Roeiter Moria, but he must return to Sicilia because her father promised the mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva ... / Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, verenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, posle rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva devojka koja ubrzo stiče poverenje kolega. Devojka se na kraju ludo zaljubljuje u Pijetra Morija, ali mora da se vrati na Siciliju jer je njen otac obećao gradonačelniku Kastelbuonoa da će se Tereza udati za njegovog sina Salva...

programme.desc: Director Nikita Milivojević has been living and working in Greece and Serbia for years. His theater career is extremely rich and exciting. His second home is in Athens. More than two decades, there are exciting performances. We recorded the show in Elephsin, the European capital of culture and Athens. The long and successful Milivojević career can be accommodated in several frameworks: from the representators of Belgrade theaters, through the engaged realities, which is a richest truth in the most significant Greek theaters, then the important performances he directed in European theaters, The Shakespeare of the Festival established and with success leads, all the way to the show in the theater of mythic places: in Delfim, Glob Theater in London an ancient epidaurus, the European Capital of Elephsini. A significant segment of Milivojević's creativity is his Greek Opus, in which one for the second is immediately at first of the second exceptional achievements. His performances Ivanov and crime and punishment in the Amora theater were declared theater events in Athens, for the play three sisters received a prize for the best director in the Athens Theater. Njegova pozorišna karijera je izuzetno bogata i uzbudljiva. U Atini je njegov drugi dom. Više od dve decenije tu stvara uzbudljive predstave. Emisiju smo snimali u Elefsini, Evropskoj prestonici kulture i Atini. Duga i uspešna Milivojevićeva karijera se može smestiti u nekoliko okvira: od predstava koje su repertoare Beogradskih pozorišta vodile u savremene tokove, preko angažovanih ostvarenja koja su kroz dela klasika i savremenih pisaca kritički reagovala na našu stvarnost, do bogatog opusa koji ostavlja dubok trag u najznačajnijim grčkim pozorištima, zatim važnih predstava koje je režirao u evropskim pozorištima, Šekspir festivala koji je osnovao i sa uspehom vodi, sve do predstava koje je radio u za pozorište mitskim mestima: u Delfima, Glob teatru u Londonu antičkom Epidaurusu , Evropskoj prestonici kulture Elefsini. Nikita je prošao dug put od angažovanog buntovnika devedesetih do reditelja koji u svojim delima razmatra univerzalne teme koje se tiču ljudskog postojanja. Sve se dešava u vreme hladnog rata pedesetih godina prošlog veka u Poljskoj, Berlinu, Jugoslaviji i Parizu, i opisuje nemoguću ljubav u nemoguća vremena.

programme.title: The bite of China / Zalogaj Kine
programme.desc: This documentary series in the most beautiful way represents Chinese food. Kineska hrana nadilazi okvire kulinarstva, dajući još jedno, novo i prilično sveobuhvatno viđenje kineske civilizacije.

programme.title: Grain of respect / Zrno poštovanja
programme.desc: Documentary series of grain respect, author and director Tatjane Manojlović, deals with the issue of gender equality in modern Serbian society. Through the testimonies of women of different generations, professions and life circumstances, the series illuminates the obstacles they face in achieving their rights, as well as changes achieved through decades of alienation for equality. The series raises the question of how much respect and equality they are present in the daily lives of women in Serbia and where the boundaries are systemic and social change. Combining personal stories, professional analyzes and statistics, grain of respect gives a comprehensive insight into the challenges and potentials of further advancement in gender politics in Serbia, with the aim of raising awareness and initiating public dialogue. / Dokumentarni serijal Zrno poštovanja, autorke i rediteljke Tatjane Manojlović, bavi se pitanjem rodne ravnopravnosti u savremenom srpskom društvu. Kroz svedočenja žena različitih generacija, profesija i životnih okolnosti, serijal osvetljava prepreke sa kojima se suočavaju u ostvarivanju svojih prava, kao i promene koje su postignute kroz decenije borbe za jednakost. Serijal postavlja pitanje koliko su poštovanje i ravnopravnost prisutni u svakodnevnom životu žena u Srbiji i gde su granice sistemskih i društvenih promena. Kombinujući lične priče, stručne analize i statističke podatke, Zrno poštovanja daje sveobuhvatan uvid u izazove i potencijale daljeg unapređenja rodne politike u Srbiji, sa ciljem podizanja svesti i pokretanja javnog dijaloga.

programme.title: Portrait / Portreti
programme.desc: A lot of that in life did Bogdan Bogdanović. He taught to students, wrote essays, was the mayor of Belgrade ... in today's portrait of 1975. The focus camera will be directed on the author and his works. His largest works and today are under the clear sky: they are woven from pain, which is secreted by tears, blood, sweat, bile. These works although dedicated to concrete events of suffering, have a timeless character. They were created, as the author in the show Veli, in seeing his own place in the swirl of time. In times when victims were already collected, but not the pain left after them. / Mnogo toga za života je uradio Bogdan Bogdanović. Predavao je studentima, pisao eseje, bio je gradonačelnik Beograda… U današnjem Portretu iz 1975. godine fokus kamere biće usmeren na autora i njegova dela. Njegova najveća dela i danas se nalaze pod vedrim nebom: satkana su od bola, koji luče suze, krv, znoj, žuč. Ta dela iako posvećena konkretnim događajima stradanja, imaju vanvremenski karakter. Nastala su, kako sam autor u emisiji veli, u viđenju sopstvenog mesta u kovitlacu vremena. U vremenima kada su već bile sabrane žrtve, ali ne i bol koji je ostao posle njih.

programme.title: Archive. doc / ARHIV. doc
programme.desc: Summer 2018. In the eve of the 60. Birthdays of Belgrade television We filmed former studio 1 in the Television building in Aberdareva, which started working on the 1966. Years. It is the emissions of a dramatic, entertainment, music and informative program until the NATO bombing 99. years, when 23. April bomb took part of the building and lives of 16 workers who did their job. A few years later, in a partially rehabilitated space moved almost 200 devices - exhibits that form the base of the future television museum. / Leta 2018. Godine uoči 60. Rođendana Televizije Beograd snimali smo nekadašnji Studio 1 u zgradi Televizije u Aberdarevoj, koji je počeo da radi daleke 1966. Godine. U njemu su stvarane emisije dramskog, zabavnog, muzičkog i informativnog programa sve do NATO bombardovanja 99. Godine, kada je 23. Aprila bomba odnela deo zgrade i živote 16 radnika koji su obavljali svoj posao. Nekoliko godina kasnije, u delimično sanirani prostor uselilo se bezmalo 200 uređaja - eksponata koji čine bazu budućeg Muzeja televizije.

Ujedno, ova sposobna i strpljiva žena pokušava da vodi svoju malu, ali uspešnu marketinšku agenciju koja se nalazi na prekretnici sa novim, krupnim klijentom, Mitom Topalovićem koga ne prati baš dobar glas Za Aljošinu mlađu sestru, Milicu, odlazak starijeg brata iz kuće otvara čitavo novo polje slobode kako u stanu, tako i u Veljinom klubu. Za to vreme, Filipova zavisnost o pokeru kreće po zlu što samo dodatno komplikuje život njegovoj sestri Vanji koja se trudi da održi porodičnu kafanu Trst, u čemu joj ne pomaže ni alkoholizam oca Jakova. Nakon što je Tea saznala da ide na studije u Milano, njen i Aljošin odnos je u opasnosti.

programme.title: In a clinch / U klinču

programme.title: In a clinch / U klinču
programme.desc: In the Hower Family, the government advice before large business changes awaiting Father Jovan, and the tain emotional life is in turning over the Aljošina connection with the Iskra. During that time, spark is persistent in the idea to find a job, and Aljoša comes in an unexpected idea of how to help her. And Filip is obsessed with ideas about improving his business, which drives up. And Milica's job in this episode is to take advantage of the last days of the Veljina and Mira's absence from the apartment in the best possible way. / U Teinoj porodici vlada napetost pred velike poslovne promene koje čekaju oca Jovana, a i Tein emotivni život je u previranju zbog Aljošine veze sa Iskrom. Za to vreme, Iskra je uporna u ideji da pronađe posao, a Aljoša dolazi na neočekivanu ideju kako da joj pomogne. I Filip je obuzet idejama o unapređenju svog biznisa što izluđuje Vanju. A, Milicin posao u ovoj epizodi je da iskoristi poslednje dane Veljinog i Mirinog odsustva iz stana na najbolji mogući način.

programme.title: Penalty area / Kazneni prostor
programme.desc: Frightened and worried men from one, and ambitious, successful and beautiful women on the other hand, it is the thematic backbone of the Humorist series box. The urban humor in the spirit of a small, makes this series very dynamic. / Uplašeni i zabrinuti muškarci s jedne, i ambiciozne, uspešne i lepe žene s druge strane, to je tematska okosnica humorističke serije Kazneni prostor. Urbani humor u duhu sitkoma, čini ovu seriju vrlo dinamičnom.

programme.title: Pinch / Žmurke
programme.desc: The batch of Žmurke presents an intimate, autobiographical and anti-war story from the childhood of Miša Radivojević and his friends in a small town in Serbia. Blocks are a series with children, but intended primarily to adults. The series talks about children in the war, but it is directed to what adults could learn from Hal view. In a series of six episodes, touching, exciting and tragic stories through visor children were told. All the cruelty of the world is shown through turbulence in the newly liberated small town, where children did not have the same treatment, although they were not responsible for the sins or success of parents. The topic of Žmurki is not typical only for the period processing the series, but it is also related to the destiny of the modern world in which there are hundreds of millions of children, what is happiness for them, what is justice or guilt. / Serija Žmurke predstavlja intimnu, autobiografsku i antiratnu priču iz detinjstva Miše Radivojevića i njegovih drugara u malom mestu u Srbiji. Žmurke su serija sa decom, ali namenjena pre svega odraslima. Serija govori o deci u ratu, ali je usmerena ka tome šta bi odrasli mogli da nauče iz njhovog pogleda. U seriji od šest epizoda ispričane su dirljive, uzbudljive i tragične priče kroz vizuru dece. Sva surovost sveta prikazana je kroz turbulencije u tek oslobođenom malom gradu, gde deca nisu imala isti tretman, iako nisu bila odgovorna za grehe ili uspehe roditelja. Tema Žmurki nije tipična samo za period koji obrađuje serija, već je ona vezana i za sudbinu dece savremenog sveta u kome živimo, gde desetine, stotine miliona ljudi u potrazi za srećom ne pitaju i ne osluškuju vlastitu decu, šta je za njih sreća, šta je za njih pravda ili krivda.

programme.title: Group / Grupa
programme.desc: Boris came to Stanislay's parents and seeks five thousand euros from them, which Stanislav allegedly owed him. His parents don't have so much money, so Stanislav's mother goes to the bank and brings money to Boris. Vanja goes to Peter. He asks her to take him to SLOMIC. Petra helped him and bring him to SLOMIC which is ready to listen to him. Vanja Sremici announced that he knows who killed her brother, Rade Sremac. / Boris je došao kod Stanislavljevih roditelja i od njih traži pet hiljada evra koje mu Stanislav navodno duguje. Njegovi roditelji nemaju toliko para, pa Stanislavljeva majka odlazi u banku i donosi novac Borisu. Vanja ode kod Petre. Traži od nje da ga odvede do Sremice. Petra mu pomogne i dovede ga do Sremice koja je spremna da ga sasluša. Vanja Sremici saopšti da zna ko je ubio njenog brata, Radeta Sremca.

programme.title: Jagodici / Jagodići
programme.desc: Jagodići is the 2012 television series, the sequel to the series all that plain. The action of the series is located in the thirties of the last century in the Banatsko Selo. The main characters are the father and his sons, who pass through turbulent ties. Count Milan Jagodić reveals the sons of a long hidden family secret. The one, who believed that a robber who hides was hiding in the Tavan Kaštela, is actually their close relative. The rim around him is clenched and the Milan Count is requested from all to help a fugitive in hiding and escaping. But that's not the only secret that was discovered. Inspector of the International Police, Oto Kunc is involved in everything. Another crime is happening. / Jagodići je televizijska serija iz 2012. godine, nastavak serije Sva ta ravnica. Radnja serije je smeštena u tridesete godine prošlog veka u banatskom selu. Glavni likovi su otac i njegovi sinovi, koji prolaze kroz turbulentne veze. Grof Milan Jagodić otkriva sinovima dugo skrivanu porodičnu tajnu. Onaj, za koga su verovali da je razbojnik koji se krije na tavanu Kaštela, zapravo je njihov blizak rođak. Obruč oko njega se steže i grof Milan zahteva od svih da pomognu beguncu u skrivanju i bekstvu. Ali to nije jedina tajna koja je otkrivena. U sve je umešan i inspektor međunarodne policije Oto Kunc. Dešava se još jedan zločin.

programme.title: TV Theater / TV Teatar
programme.desc: Hit of the play of the Star Teatra - General Probro suicide, according to the text and directed by the most important modern Serbian Comediographer, Dusan Kovacevic. The man tries to kill himself with a jump from the bridge. However, however, in the most notional ways, interferes with other characters, which produces a range of humorous situations and absurdities, with a witty, occasional fantasagoric, and occasionally almost a coordinary tone. / Hit predstava Zvezdara teatra - Generalna proba samoubistva, po tekstu i u režiji najznačajnijeg modernog srpskog komediografa, Dušana Kovačevića. Čovek pokušava da se ubije skokom sa mosta. To, međutim, na najbizarnije načine ometa druge likove, što proizvodi niz humornih situacija i apsurdnih obrta, uz duhovit, povremeno fantazmagoričan, a povremeno gotovo prizeman ton.

programme.title: Film Magic: A concert of film music / Filmska čarolija: Koncert filmske muzike
programme.desc: The RTS Symphony Orchestra held a concert on 21. June 2016. years in the center of Sava on the occasion of the world's day of music. The program was music tracks from world film hits, such as Narnia, Harry Potter, the Lord of the Rings and Pirates from the Caribbean, whose sequels charged the cinema halls. programme.title: Concert on the occasion of the World Music Day - Choir and STS / Koncert povodom svetskog dana muzike - Hor i SO RTS
programme.desc: Radio-Television of Serbia broadcasts a television recording of the ceremonial concert held on 21. June in the MTS hall on the occasion of the world's day of music. In a program that celebrates the power of music and connects people and cultures, the Symphony Orchestra and Hor RTS, under the leadership of Maestro Srboljub Dinić, with two shiny guests from world scenes - Violinist Jožef Žigu and Tenor Hector Sandoval. The concert program is carefully designed, combines various music worlds and genres - from the classic to Musical, from Tang to Neapolitan and Mexican songs. The audience will have the opportunity to hear unforgettable tracks from the Opus Leonard Bernstein, Astora Pjacole, Arctor Market and other composers who connect virtuosity with emotion and rhythm. Tenor Hector Sandoval, one of the leading votes of the Latin American scene, on this occasion, has first performed in Serbia, with a special repertoire that includes music from their homeland - Mexico. Along with him, violin poetry, the audience transmitted Jožef Smark, an artist recognizable by deep emotional and technically impeccable performance. The Special Guest of the Concerto was soprano Oliver Gočenin, which appeared in numbers from Musician and the modern opera repertoire, enriching the evening with additional warmth and elegance. Mecosporan Jovana Bulatović and Virtuoso on Bandoneon Petar Mirkov, brought a unique blend of spiritual and world music tradition by reviving the spirit of Buenos Ayres. This RTS concert, recorded in the holiday atmosphere and with the ovation of the audience, is a sort of homage to the universality of music. / Radio-televizija Srbije emituje televizijski snimak svečanog koncerta koji je održan 21. juna u MTS dvorani povodom Svetskog dana muzike. U programu koji slavi snagu muzike i povezuje ljude i kulture, učestvuju Simfonijski orkestar i Hor RTS-a, pod vođstvom maestra Srboljuba Dinića, uz dva sjajna gosta sa svetskih scena - violinistu Jožefa Žigu i tenora Hektora Sandovala. Program koncerta pažljivo je osmišljen, kombinuje različite muzičke svetove i žanrove - od klasike do mjuzikla, od tanga do napolitanskih i meksičkih pesama. Publika će imati priliku da čuje nezaboravne numere iz opusa Leonarda Bernštajna, Astora Pjacole, Artura Markeza i drugih kompozitora koji spajaju virtuoznost sa emocijom i ritmom. Tenor Hektor Sandoval, jedan od vodećih glasova latinoameričke muzičke scene, ovom prilikom je prvi put nastupio u Srbiji, sa posebnim repertoarom koji uključuje i muziku iz svoje domovine - Meksika. Uz njega, violinsku poeziju publici je preneo Jožef Žiga, umetnik prepoznatljiv po duboko emotivnom i tehnički besprekornom izvođenju. Specijalna gošća koncerta bila je sopran Olivera Gočanin, koja se pojavila u numerama iz mjuzikla i savremenog operskog repertoara, obogativši veče dodatnom toplinom i elegancijom. Mecosporan Jovana Bulatović i virtuoz na bandoneonu Petar Mirkov, doneli su jedinstven spoj duhovne i svetovne muzičke tradicije oživljavajući duh Buenos Ajresa. Ovaj koncert RTS-a, snimljen u prazničnoj atmosferi i uz ovacije publike, svojevrstan je omaž univerzalnosti muzike.

U prilozima će biti reči o koncertu Simfonijskog orkestra RTS pod dirigentskom palicom maestra Srboljuba Dinića, sa solistkinjom flautistkinjom Silvijom Karedu, o Antologiji srpske horske muzike, o ovogodišnjoj Mokranjčevoj nagradi, a biće prikazan i mali portret mladog violiniste Luke Fausija.

programme.title: Life with music / Život sa muzikom
programme.desc: The series of emission life with the music of the Cultural and Educational Program of RTS has been broadcast for several years. / Serija emisija Život sa muzikom Kulturno-obrazovnog programa RTS-a emituje se već nekoliko godina.

programme.title: Itamar Zorman I Liza Stepanova / Itamar Zorman i Liza Stepanova
programme.desc: The Violinist of Itam Zorman and the Pianist Lisa Stepanov held a concert 2. February 2015. in the Kolarac's endowment hall, within the cycle winners. They presented to the works of Franco Šubert, Moris Ravel and Johannes Brams. Itamar Zorman was born in 1985. in Tel Aviv, and graduated from the Academy of Music and Game in Jerusalem, Master Studies ended at Jury-2012. Years. He won the Trust Award - Buleto-Buitoni in 2014, as well as the Eigher Fešer Mispinese for 2013, as a soloist performed with the Israeli Philharmonic, the American Symphony Orchestra and the Tokyo Symphony Orchestra and the Chamber Orchestra of the Polish Radio. The pianist Lisa Stepanov was born in Minsk, and was educated in Berlin and Jergiarna. Its career moves from solo and chamber music to very successful pedagogical results. It is a member of the Lisander Piano Trio with whom he won numerous awards. Is dedicated to modern creativity. / Violinista Itamar Zorman i pijanistkinja Liza Stepanova održali su koncert 2. februara 2015. godine u dvorani Kolarčeve zadužbine, u okviru ciklusa Pobednici. Predstavili su se delima Franca Šuberta, Morisa Ravela i Johanesa Bramsa. Itamar Zorman je rođen 1985. godine u Tel Avivu, a diplomirao je na Akademiji za muziku i igru u Jerusalimu, master studije završio je na Džulijardu 2012. godine. Dobitnik je nagrade Trusta Borleti-Buitoni za 2014. godinu, kao i EJVERI Fišer stipendije za 2013. Kao solista nastupao je sa Izraelskom filharmonijom, Američkim simfonijskim orkestrom, Tokijskim simfonijskim orkestrom i Kamernim orkestrom Poljskog radija. Pijanistkinja Liza Stepanova rođena je u Minsku, a školovala se u Berlinu i na Džulijardu. Njena karijera se kreće od solističke i kamerne muzike do vrlo uspešnih pedagoških rezultata.Član je Lisander klavirskog trija sa kojim je osvajala brojne nagrade. Posvećena je savremenom stvaralaštvu.

programme.title: Everything was music / Sve je bilo muzika
programme.desc: Enjoy the largest hits of the celebrated singer, the songwriter, arranger, the composer of Arsenia Arsen Dedic, loved and listened across the former Yugoslavia. / Uživajte u najvećim hitovima proslavljenog pevača, tekstopisca, aranžera, kompozitora Arsenija Arsena Dedića, voljenog i slušanog širom bivše Jugoslavije.

programme.title: Stefan Milenkovic and Art Link Young Virtuosozi / Stefan Milenković i Art link mladi virtuozi
programme.desc: The fourth edition of the Arthlink Youth Talent Festival opened, concert at Kolarac, Slavni Violinist Stefan Milenković. In the Kolarčevo endowment, Stefan Milenković performed with the Arthlink Orchestra young Virtuoso. Critics notice that Milenkovic has the beauty of David ojstrah, the purity and logic of Henrik Shering, virtuosity, Hanfec, love for Jehudi Menjuhin and the joy of werish perlman. Stefan Milenković for the commitment to humanitarian actions were awarded a number of recognitions, among other things, the most humorous person in 2003. years. He participated in many Gala concerts under the auspices of UNESCO in Paris, with Plasid Doming, Lorina Mazelo, Aleksis Vasenberg and Jehudi Menjuhin. He regularly cooperates with reputable interpreters in various instrumental formations. / Četvrto izdanje Artlink festivala mladih talenata otvorio je, koncertom na Kolarcu, slavni violinista Stefan Milenković. U Kolarčevoj zadužbini, Stefan Milenković je nastupio sa orkestrom Artlink mladi virtuozi. Kritičari primećuju da Milenković ima lepotu zvuka Davida Ojstraha, čistotu i logiku fraze Henrika Šeringa, virtuozitet Jaše Hajfeca, ljubav prema muzici Jehudija Menjuhina i temperament i radost Jicaka Perlmana. Stefanu Milenkoviću za posvećenost humanitarnim akcijama dodeljena su brojna priznanja, između ostalog, odličje Najhumanija ličnost 2003. godine. Učestvovao je na mnogim gala koncertima pod pokroviteljstvom Uneska u Parizu, s Plasidom Domingom, Lorinom Mazelom, Aleksisom Vajsenbergom i Jehudijem Menjuhinom. Redovno sarađuje s uglednim interpretatorima u različitim instrumentalnim formacijama.

programme.title: Gajtano, Mome, got / Gajtano, mome, mori
programme.desc: In the show, Gajtano Mori Moma from 1971. year, Zora Dremetić sings Vranjanske poems, and in addition to its top voice, the beauty of Vranjaci also evokes the costumes from that area, as well as an authentic ambience. The show was filmed in the native house of Borislav Stanković in Vranje. Zora Drempetic came to Radio Belgrade in 1952. years. She sang throughout Yugoslavia and Europe. She recorded her first gramophone board in Bulgaria (with us only a few more), and she recorded about 70 permanent shots for the sound archive of Radio Belgrade. / U emisiji Gajtano mori mome iz 1971. godine, Zora Drempetić peva vranjanske pesme, a pored njenog vrhunskog glasa, lepotu Vranja dočarava nam i nošnja iz tog kraja, kao i autentični ambijent. Emisija je snimana u rodnoj kući Borislava Stankovića u Vranju. Zora Drempetić došla je u Radio Beograd 1952. godine. Pevala je širom Jugoslavije i Evrope. U Bugarskoj je snimila svoju prvu gramofonsku ploču (kod nas svega nekoliko), a za Zvučni arhiv Radio Beograda snimila je oko 70 trajnih snimaka.

programme.title: From our archive / Iz naše arhive
programme.desc: About 3,000 research reports and publications of about 200,000 pages of different formats are kept in the Center for Public Opinion, Program and Auditorium. Reports include quantitative and qualitative research on the listeners of television and listeners and viewers about broadcasting programs, reviews, writers of the press of radio and television, content analysis, radio and TV programs. The first known edition consists of the results of the program research, and without a chronological order, we cite: the public opinionate, the RTV index, the RTV index, the public and RTB, which is primarily displayed by the programs of the Program Plan, RTV auditorium with The results of the measurement of listening and viewers, music and RTB, as well as the annual chronological and subject registry of publications and basic findings. In public, research systems were specially known: general quantitative survey, standard program and auditorium probe, daily barometer, regular content of auditorium and public opinion, barometer and media and opinion. At this place, we present some of the oldest research reports of the Center, in a concise version, with basic findings. / U Centru za istraživanje javnog mnjenja, programa i auditorijuma čuva se oko 3.000 istraživačkih izveštaja i publikacija od oko 200.000 strana različitog formata. Izveštaji obuhvataju kvantitativna i kvalitativna istraživanja o slušanosti radija, gledanosti televizije i stavovima i mišljenjima slušalaca i gledalaca o emitovanom programu, mnjenska ispitivanja o značajnim društvenim, političkim i kulturnim događajima, recenzije, analize napisa u štampi o programima radija i televizije, analize sadržaja, javne rasprave o radio i TV programima. Prvu poznatu ediciju čine Rezultati istraživanja programa, a bez nekog hronološkog reda, jer se međusobno prepliću tokom vremena, navodimo: Bilten javnog mnjenja, RTV svet, sa prikazima i prevodima inostrane i programske literature, RTV indeks, sa rezultatima panel ispitivanja, Javnost i RTB, koji pre svega prikazuje tokove i rezultate javnih rasprava o planu programa, RTV auditorijum sa rezultatima merenja slušanosti i gledanosti, Muzika i RTB, kao i godišnji Hronološki i predmetni registar publikacija i osnovnih nalaza. U javnosti su posebno bili poznati istraživački sistemi: Opšta kvantitativna anketa, Standarna sondaža programa i auditorijuma, Dnevni barometar, Redovna sondaža auditorijuma i javnog mnjenja, Sondaža-Barometar i Mediji i mnenje. Na ovom mestu predstavljamo neke od najstarijih istraživačkih izveštaja Centra, u sažetoj verziji, sa osnovnim nalazima.

Članovi grupe Lira Vega odlučili su da opasku organizatora da je ovo dobra prilika da se pozovu i neki gosti doslovno prevedu i da prepuste izvođenje kompletnog albuma odabranim gostima. Svi pozvani su se odazvali i podelili svoj nesvakidašnji entuzijazam i energiju sa publikom, dajući pesmama sa albuma novu dimenziju. programme.title: Vlatko Stefanovski - 50 years with you / Vlatko Stefanovski - 50 godina sa vama
programme.desc: Vlatko Stefanovski marked the 50 years of career concert in the Sava Center. His guests were reputable musicians, his friends and colleagues. Five decades of Career of the Vlatko Stefanovsky was marked by the repertoire that is the cross-section of his opus. In the evening, the emotions filled with all the most important points of the work of Stefanovski, from the Group's period of Leb and Salt to the Solo career. Almost 40 recorded albums, legendary music themes forgotten, Šmeker, Harvest, need three and others, only part of the rich career, in our area, as well as the boy's fascination guitar, present and after five decades of music. / Vlatko Stefanovski obeležio je 50 godina karijere koncertom u Sava centru. Gosti su mu bili ugledni muzičari, njegovi prijatelji i kolege. Pet decenija karijere Vlatka Stefanovskog obeleženo je repertoarom koji je presek njegovog opusa. U veče ispunjeno emocijama stale su sve najvažnije tačke rada Stefanovskog, od perioda grupe Leb i sol do solo karijere. programme.title: From the Senka past / Iz senke prošlosti
programme.desc: Time as a strict and unmistakable judge makes many facts hidden in the shadows of the past when it comes to life in some period. / Vreme kao strogi i nepogrešivi sudija, čini da mnoge činjenice skrivene u senkama prošlosti kad tad ožive u nekom razdoblju.

programme.title: Eco perspectives / Eko perspektive
programme.desc: We live so fast pace that we have all the lessons we have time to look at the surroundings with care - people, things, nature. The consumer society in the Universal Run of the Consumer Society has lost the culture of repairing. We lightly throw things that can be fixed. The concept of reparations and giving new life is developing and spreading among environmentally consolidated individuals inflammatory hope that the way in this way is led by TAS that is missing to establish a balance with the environment with the required balance. / Živimo toliko brzim tempom da sve ređe imamo vremena da sa pažnjom pogledamo okolinu - ljude, stvari, prirodu. U sveopštoj trci potrošačkog društva izgubila se kultura popravljanja. Olako bacamo stvari koje se mogu popraviti. Koncept reparacije i davanja novog života starim stvarima se razvija i širi među ekološki osvešćenim pojedincima ulivajući nadu da se baš u tom načinu razmišljanja krije tas koji nedostaje da se na vagi našeg odnosa sa okruženjem uspostavi preko potrebna ravnoteža.

programme.title: Cultural heritage of Serbia / Kulturna baština Srbije
programme.desc: The Government of the Republic of Serbia declared the area of the mountain work for the new nature park. This, the last, protected area in our country is dedicated to the emission from the series of the cultural heritage of Serbia. / Vlada Republike Srbije proglasila je područje planine Radan za novi park prirode. Ovom, poslednjem, zaštićenom području u našoj zemlji posvećena je emisija iz serije Kulturna baština Srbije.

programme.title: Kinseski mega project / Kineski mega projekti
programme.desc: The Beijing-Shanghai line is a pearl system that is already extending over 8,000km. The plan is to double the size of lines until 2020. years, transporting passengers everywhere from the southern industrial town Guangzhou to the frozen town of Harbin in the north and to the Western Border Town of Urumki. A slender blue-white trains known as Harmoni Express arrives in less than five hours from Peking to Shanghai. The distance between these two cities is about 1288km, and the average speed of the train is about 257.6km for class. / Linija Peking-Šangaj je biser sistema koji se već proteže preko 8.000km. Plan je da se duplira veličina linija do 2020. godine, prevozeći putnike svugde od južnog industrijskog grada Guangzhou do zamrznutog grada Harbin na severu i do zapadnog graničnog grada Urumki. Vitki plavo-beli vozovi poznati pod imenom Harmoni Ekspres stižu za manje od pet sati od Pekinga do Šangaja. Razdaljina između ova dva grada je oko 1288km, te prosečnu brzinu voza iznosi oko 257,6km na čas.

programme.title: History in Nauk / Istorija nauke
programme.desc: Mihajlo Idvorski Pupin (1854 - 1935) Scientist, University Professor Colombia, Honorary Consul of Serbia in America, winner of the Pulic Reward, member of numerous American and European scientific institutions. The scientist who has improved telecommunications, contributed to the establishment of wireless telegraphs and telephony, x-rays, was an exceptional writer, humanist, consistent fighter for science, but also the largest benefactor when Serbia has ever had. Its most significant discovery is a mathematical solution to the problem of transmission of alternating telephone currents per lines. With that theory and practical application, it has enabled the transfer of telephone conversations at intercity relations. Inductive coils, placed on strictly determined distances along the lines, in his honor were called Pupin's coils, and the process of inclusion in the line - Pupinization. / Mihajlo Idvorski Pupin (1854 - 1935) naučnik, pronalazač, profesor na Univerzitetu Kolumbija, počasni konzul Srbije u Americi, dobitnik Pulicerove nagrade, član mnogobrojnih američkih i evropskih naučnih ustanova. Naučnik koji je unapredio telekomunikacije, doprineo uspostavljanju bežične telegrafije i telefonije, rentgenologije, elektrotehnike, bio je izuzetan pisac, humanista, dosledni borac za razvoj nauke, ali i najveći dobrotvor koga je Srbija ikada imala. Njegovo najznačajnije otkriće je matematičko rešenje problema prenosa naizmeničnih telefonskih struja po vodovima. Tom teorijom i praktičnom primenom omogućio je prenos telefonskih razgovora na međugradskim relacijama. Induktivni kalemovi, postavljeni na strogo određenim rastojanjima duž vodova, u njegovu čast nazvani su Pupinovi kalemovi, a proces uključivanja u liniju - pupinizacija.

programme.title: China re -encountering the Arctic / Kina ponovni susret sa Arktikom
programme.desc: There are stones older in Greenland more than three billion years and is the oldest stones in the world. There are signs on it, which prove that there was already life on earth at the time. / Na Grenlandu postoji kamenje starije više od tri milijarde godina i ono je najstarije kamenje na svetu. Na njemu postoje znaci koji dokazuju da je u to vreme već postojao život na Zemlji.

programme.title: Hemis for everyone / Hemija za sve
programme.desc: If you have heard (and assumed) that something good is just because it comes from nature, that it is very good for your health to eat only raw foods, do not drink milk but take a zeolite or petroleum or pure lemon juice of the heart, think once again. / Ako ste čuli (i poverovali) da je nešto dobro samo zato što dolazi iz prirode, da je jako dobro za vaše zdravlje da jedete samo sirovu hranu, ne pijete mleko ali da uzimate zeolit ili petrolej ili čist limunov sok našte srca, razmislite još jednom.

programme.title: Studio of Knowledge / Studio znanja
programme.desc: Born between 1997. and 2012. The zoomers adults in the Internet. programme.title: Kinseski mega project / Kineski mega projekti
programme.desc: The Beijing-Shanghai line is a pearl system that is already extending over 8,000km. The plan is to double the size of lines until 2020. years, transporting passengers everywhere from the southern industrial town Guangzhou to the frozen town of Harbin in the north and to the Western Border Town of Urumki. A slender blue-white trains known as Harmoni Express arrives in less than five hours from Peking to Shanghai. The distance between these two cities is about 1288km, and the average speed of the train is about 257.6km for class. / Linija Peking-Šangaj je biser sistema koji se već proteže preko 8.000km. Plan je da se duplira veličina linija do 2020. godine, prevozeći putnike svugde od južnog industrijskog grada Guangzhou do zamrznutog grada Harbin na severu i do zapadnog graničnog grada Urumki. Vitki plavo-beli vozovi poznati pod imenom Harmoni Ekspres stižu za manje od pet sati od Pekinga do Šangaja. Razdaljina između ova dva grada je oko 1288km, te prosečnu brzinu voza iznosi oko 257,6km na čas.

programme.title: History in Nauk / Istorija nauke
programme.desc: Mihajlo Idvorski Pupin (1854 - 1935) Scientist, University Professor Colombia, Honorary Consul of Serbia in America, winner of the Pulic Reward, member of numerous American and European scientific institutions. The scientist who has improved telecommunications, contributed to the establishment of wireless telegraphs and telephony, x-rays, was an exceptional writer, humanist, consistent fighter for science, but also the largest benefactor when Serbia has ever had. Its most significant discovery is a mathematical solution to the problem of transmission of alternating telephone currents per lines. With that theory and practical application, it has enabled the transfer of telephone conversations at intercity relations. Inductive coils, placed on strictly determined distances along the lines, in his honor were called Pupin's coils, and the process of inclusion in the line - Pupinization. / Mihajlo Idvorski Pupin (1854 - 1935) naučnik, pronalazač, profesor na Univerzitetu Kolumbija, počasni konzul Srbije u Americi, dobitnik Pulicerove nagrade, član mnogobrojnih američkih i evropskih naučnih ustanova. Naučnik koji je unapredio telekomunikacije, doprineo uspostavljanju bežične telegrafije i telefonije, rentgenologije, elektrotehnike, bio je izuzetan pisac, humanista, dosledni borac za razvoj nauke, ali i najveći dobrotvor koga je Srbija ikada imala. Njegovo najznačajnije otkriće je matematičko rešenje problema prenosa naizmeničnih telefonskih struja po vodovima. Tom teorijom i praktičnom primenom omogućio je prenos telefonskih razgovora na međugradskim relacijama. Induktivni kalemovi, postavljeni na strogo određenim rastojanjima duž vodova, u njegovu čast nazvani su Pupinovi kalemovi, a proces uključivanja u liniju - pupinizacija.

programme.title: Eco perspectives / Eko perspektive
programme.desc: The main heroine show with science through life is a young scientist, a geophysician Dr. Anna Mladenović, who combined several scientific disciplines: geology, speleology and seismology. This exceptional woman is a real visionary who spreads the views, realizes new discoveries and knows how to decipher what the land from his womb tells us. Commitment to scientific work and research requires a lot of knowledge, exceptional commitment, mind and ambition to embody the greatest challenges. It is all woven into the character and work of the doctor of science Ana Mladenović from the Faculty of Mining and Geology, University of Belgrade. Ana's love for geology started in an early age in a five, when listening to a student decided that the tectonics of the plate, just what he wanted to explore. With Dr. Mladenovic, we discussed the earthquakes, which is specific to the territory of Serbia, why it is important to know how to react when threatening danger. Ana revealed to us in what way in exploring pits and caves studied earthquakes. We learned what projects are currently working and how dynamic and exciting life with science and science is. / Glavna junakinja emisije Naukom kroz život je mlada naučnica, geofizičar dr Ana Mladenović koja je u svom radu objedinila nekoliko naučnih disciplina: geologiju, speleologiju i seizmologiju. Ova izuzetna žena je prava vizionarka koja širi vidike, spoznaje nova otkrića i ume da dešifruje šta nam zemlja iz svoje utrobe poručuje. Posvećenost naučnom radu i istraživanju zahteva mnogo znanja, izuzetnu posvećenost, um i ambiciju da se upustiš u najveće izazove. Sve je to utkano u lik i delo doktora nauka Ane Mladenović sa Rudarsko-geološkog fakulteta Univerziteta u Beogradu. Anina ljubav prema geologiji počela je još u ranoj mladosti u Petnici, kada je slušajući jednu studentkinju odlučila da je tektonika ploča, baš ono što želi da istražuje. Sa dr Mladenović smo razgovarali o tome kako nastaju zemljotresi, šta je specifično za teritoriju Srbije, zašto je važno da znamo kako da reagujemo kada zapreti opasnost. Ana nam je otkrila na koji način istražujući jame i pećine proučava zemljotrese. Saznali smo na kojim projektima trenutno radi i koliko je dinamičan i uzbudljiv život sa naukom i za nauku.

programme.desc: In this episode of the show on the hidden and I go to Kopaonik. Kopaonik is the largest mountain massif in Serbia, with an altitude of 2017 meters. But we will not talk about the commercial side of Kopaonik, the people who know the hidden places of this beautiful mountain, people living in accordance with nature, are kept and respected and respected, and dealing with extreme sports. / U ovoj epizodi emisije Na skriveno te vodim mesto idemo na Kopaonik. Kopaonik je najveći planinski masiv u Srbiji, sa nadmorskom visinom od 2017 metara. Prostire se od severozapada ka jugoistoku, dužinom od oko 75 kilometara. To je naravno i najpopularniji, ali i najskuplji turistički centar naše zemlje. programme.title: History in Nauk / Istorija nauke
programme.desc: Milutin Milanković (1879-1958) The scientist who solved the secret of the ice age and founded modern climatology. He enabled the mathematical reconstruction of the climatic past and proved the crucial influence of the sun on earthly developments. Professor of heavenly mechanics and theoretical physics, he suggested the reform of the calendar and was a tireless traveler through the universe and centuries. / Milutin Milanković (1879-1958) naučnik koji je rešio tajnu ledenog doba i utemeljio savremenu klimatologiju. programme.title: From pigment to concept / Od pigmenta do koncepta
programme.desc: Painting techniques have countless - from fingers to brushes, thick pigments and airy watery nanos. Beautiful images arise in all these ways. Ova izuzetna žena je prava vizionarka koja širi vidike, spoznaje nova otkrića i ume da dešifruje šta nam zemlja iz svoje utrobe poručuje. programme.title: Personal cosmos / Lični kosmos
programme.desc: This show Personal cosmos, is dedicated to Ivo Andrić, Držiti Đukić Perišić, writers and literary historians, the author of the Nebo Over Belgrade: Andrić and the capital, leads the viewer through Beorad under German occupation and post-war Belgrade. The Nobel Literature Award received in 1961. years. Žaneta Đukić Perišić reveals how it is then / Ova emisija Lični kosmos, posvećena je Ivi Andriću, dr Žaneti Đukić Perišić, književnici i književnoj istoričarki, autorci knjige Nebo nad Beogradom: Andrić i prestonica, vodi gledaoca kroz Beorad pod nemačkom okupacijom i posleratnom Beogradu. Žaneta Đukić Perišić je u Zadužbini Ive Andrića radila dugi niz godina, od mesta stručne saradnice do upravnice. Svoj naučno-istražički rad posvetila je nobelovcu u brojnim objavljenim knjigama. Dobitnica je Vukove nagrade Kulturno-prosvetne zajednice Srbije za 2023. godinu. Emisija prati pisca koji 1941. stiže u bombama razrušeni Beograd. Na železničkoj stanici ga dočekuje advokat Milenković koji će mu ustupiti sobu svog stana u Prizrenskoj 7, kući u kojoj su nastala Andrićeva najveća dela: Na Drini ćuprija, Travnička hronika i Gospođica. U emisiji otkrivamo kako je Andrić, kao bivši diplomata i jugoslovenski ambasador u Berlinu, izbegao ispitivanja u Gestapou, na koji način je odbio da potpiše Apel srpskom narodu i zašto se naljutio na izdavača Cvijanovića. programme.title: Good, it's good to know / Dobro je, dobro je znati
programme.desc: Each bite of food is investing in health - or in disease. At the last year of specialization, she started working at the Dragiša Misovic - Dedinje Clinical and Hospital Center, at the anesthetise and resuscitation clinic. TE in 2019. Tragajući za naučnim dokazima - koja hrana predstavlja dobro ulaganje, otkrivamo dr Marinu Boboš, specijalistu anesteziologije, koja slobodno vreme koristi da podeli znanje o zdravim obrocima i antiinflamatornoj ishrani. programme.desc: Bleja is a short feature structure of about ten minutes, in which we follow the daily events at the entrance of a residential building in Belgrade. / Bleja je kratka igrana struktura u trajanju od desetak minuta, u kojoj pratimo svakodnevna dešavanja u ulazu jedne stambene zgrade u Beogradu.

programme.title: Open door / Otvorena vrata
programme.desc: The modern humorous series is closest to the popular American genre - the comedy of the situation, which are role models in modern Serbian literature. The center of attention is a modern civil family that is experiencing current life problems in Belgrade. The series is a picture of unusual character, comic situations and witty plots incurred in difficult times. The action takes place in the heart of Belgrade, in the apartment - studio conceptual artist Katarina Anđelić. Her daughter Milica, son of Vojkan, former Husband Dragoslav, Brother Svetislav - Bata, and closest to Neighbors, Mrs. Angelina and Ugrinovic, represent the collective main character series. / Moderna humoristička serija najbliža popularnom američkom žanru - komediji situacije, čiji su uzori u modernoj srpskoj literaturi. U centru pažnje je savremena građanska porodica koja aktuelne životne probleme proživljava u Beogradu. Serija je slika neobičnih karaktera, komičnih situacija i duhovitih zapleta nastalih u teškom vremenu. Radnja se odvija u srcu Beograda, u stanu - ateljeu konceptualne umetnice Katarine Anđelić. Njena kćerka Milica, sin Vojkan, bivši muž Dragoslav, brat Svetislav - Bata, njegova kćerka Ana, i najbliži susedi, gospođa Angelina i Ugrinović, predstavljaju kolektivnog glavnog junaka serije.

programme.title: Chick hits / Čik pogodi
programme.desc: In a fun and receptive way of children discover the enigmatic occupation of the guest of the show. When they hit, an enigmatic person's personality tells them about his life call and the way he does. / Na zabavan i prijemčiv način deca otkrivaju zagonetno zanimanje gosta emisije. Kada pogode, zagonetna ličnost im priča o svom životnom pozivu i načinom na koji ga obavlja.

programme.title: Dictionary / Slovarica
programme.desc: In each show, children have the opportunity to see and listen to the story of one letter of our alphabet. In each of the 30 episodes, the characters introduce us to customs, songs and games of our climate. The project has launched a diaspora program and is primarily intended for our children abroad, but also children in the country, aged five to eight years. / U svakoj emisiji deca imaju priliku da vide i saslušaju priču o jednom slovu naše azbuke. U svakoj od 30 epizoda, likovi nas upoznaju sa običajima, pesmama i igrama našeg podneblja. Projekat je pokrenuo Program za dijasporu i prvenstveno je namenjen našoj deci u inostranstvu, ali i deci u zemlji, uzrasta od pet do osam godina.

programme.title: Stories about words / Priče o rečima
programme.desc: The played series of words about the words is dedicated to ordinary words used in speech from the earliest childhood. It is intended primarily to students, attention is focused on the cases without which school days: pen, bag, ljenir, cheese. / Igrana serija Priče o rečima posvećena je običnim rečima koje se koriste u govoru od najranijeg detinjstva. Namenjena je prvenstveno đacima, pažnja je usredsređena ka predmetima bez kojih se ne mogu zamisliti školski dani: olovka, torba, lenjir, šestar.

programme.title: A girl with a trumpet / Devojčica sa trubom
programme.desc: This film brings us a story about the ten-year-old Daniel from Arilj. Her great love is a trumpet, and the life desire to deal with music. / Ovaj film donosi nam priču o desetogodišnjoj Danijeli iz Arilja. Njena velika ljubav je truba, a životna želja da se bavi muzikom.

programme.title: Curious / Radoznalci
programme.desc: In the fourth episode, Mio will find out: How to resolve conflicts, who was Marko Kraljević, what is the country, why should be made back up data, what the architect is doing. If you are curious as an alien, join the new team and learn together with Mio. / U četvrtoj epizodi Mio će saznati: kako da rešimo sukobe, ko je bio Marko Kraljević, šta je Zemlja, zašto treba praviti rezervne kopije podataka, šta radi arhitekta. Ako ste radoznali kao vanzemaljac, pridružite se novoj ekipi i učite zajedno sa Mio.

programme.title: Dragon Library / Zmajeva biblioteka
programme.desc: Librarian Bole Stošić and Children Jelena Nikolić and Aleksandar Radojcic will introduce us to how the book is given, how to keep the libraries and with many other things related to both books and readings. / Bibliotekar Bole Stošić i deca Jelena Nikolić i Aleksandar Radojčić upoznaće nas sa tim kako se knjiga daruje, kako je čuvati, kako su nastale biblioteke i sa mnogim drugim stvarima koje su vezane kako za knjige, tako i za čitanje.

programme.title: Bluebird / Plava ptica
programme.desc: Interactive children's magazine for the idea of Timothy John Bajford. / Interaktivni dečji magazin po zamisli Timotija Džona Bajforda.

programme.title: To the last chess / Do poslednjeg šaha
programme.desc: Two suite kings will be alive around one harmless thing and it will lead to a large conflict of two kingdoms. As in every war, ordinary people will be submitted by ordinary people. / Dva sujetna kralja posvađaće se oko jedne bezazlene stvari i to će dovesti do velikog sukoba dva kraljevstva. Kao i u svakom ratu, najveću žrtvu podneće obični ljudi.

programme.title: Bottomless hat / Šešir bez dna
programme.desc: The unforgettable Rasa Popov “The Wizard, the Elf and the Guard Guard Empire, in a fun and educational show, a bottomless hat. / Nezaboravni Raša Popov‚ čarobnjak, vilenjak i čuvar dečjeg carstva, u zabavnoj i obrazovnoj emisiji Šešir bez dna.

programme.title: Kolibri i Big bend RTS / Kolibri i Big bend RTS
programme.desc: The youngest ensemble of the music production of the Serbian radio and television presented the audience by performing hits from the album of the Humis Planet, as well as some of the most popular compositions from the former repertoire. / Najmlađi ansambl Muzičke produkcije Radio-televizije Srbije predstavio se publici izvodeći hitove sa albuma Kolibri planeta, kao i neke od najpopularnijih kompozicija iz nekadašnjeg repertoara.

programme.title: Reading - Do you read anything? / Čitalište - čitate li išta?
programme.desc: In this show, the antijunci: which are attractive to readers, which are the most famous anti-literatures, television series and films, which differ from negative characters, who are haunted by poets ... / U ovoj emisiji govori se o antijunacima: zbog čega su privlačni čitaocima, koji su to najpoznatiji antijunaci u književnosti, televizijskim serijama i u filmovima, po čemu se razlikuju od negativnih likova, ko su ukleti pesnici...

programme.title: TV time / Vreme televizije
programme.desc: Belgrade's dramatic program between 1981. and 1986. The basic repertoire and production imagines managed to enrich and engage gifts of young authors. At the same time, television Novi Sad is becoming an increasingly significant producer of dramatic programs. The striking features of the then drama programs of both televisions are drama created on the material from life itself. The Drama of Ratko Ilic's Life of Narcaman is representative in TV Belgrade in Tv Belgrade, and the Health of Novi Sad is a brakus Želimir Želnik. At the same time, Sava Mrmak persistently directed the drama created on the basis of score of recent history (Martovski kuč and around Sveta Lukić). Djordje Kadijevic will return to the Drama Karadjordjev's death of Danko Popovic. Younger writers arrive - Siniša Kovačević (solemn obligation, award for the male role of Bati Zivojinović at the International Festival in Plovdiv). Television Novi Sad broadcasts the dramatic program and in the languages of national minorities (Miso Jana Makana Mlađeg, awarded for the best scenario at the International Festival in Prague, the time of racial dogs Ferenca Deak and Nandor Giona blades. Cooperation between TV Belgrade and cinema continues in the realization of joint projects (Jellyfish raft, the dreams, the life and death of Filip Filipović Miloš Radivojević). / Dramski program Televizije Beograd između 1981. i 1986. godine svoje osnovne repertoarske i produkcione zamisli uspeva da obogati i da angažuje darovite mlade autore. Istovremeno Televizija Novi Sad postaje sve značajniji producent dramskih programa. Markantne odlike tadašnjih dramskih programa obe televizije su drame stvarane na građi od samog života. U TV Beograd u tom žanru reprezentativna je drama Ratka Ilića Život narkomana, a u TV Novi Sad Bolovanje i ozdravljenje Bude Brakusa Želimira Žilnika. Istovremeno, Sava Mrmak istrajno režira drame nastale na osnovu građe iz novije istorije (Martovski puč i oko njega Svete Lukića). U nešto dalju prošlost vratiće se Đorđe Kadijević sa dramom Karađorđeva smrt Danka Popovića. Pristižu mlađi pisci - Siniša Kovačević (Svečana obaveza, nagrada za mušku ulogu Bati Živojinoviću na Međunarodnom festivalu u Plovdivu). Televizija Novi Sad emituje dramski program i na jezicima nacionalnih manjina (Mišo Jana Makana Mlađeg, nagrađena za najbolji scenario na Međunarodnom festivalu u Pragu, Vreme rasnih pasa Ferenca Deaka i Bacač noževa Nandora Giona). Nastavlja se saradnja TV Beograd i kinematografije u realizaciji zajedničkih projekata (Splav meduze Karpa Godine; Snovi, život i smrt Filipa Filipovića Miloša Radivojevića).

programme.title: Destiny / Sudbine
programme.desc: In this episode of the Series of destiny, director Goran Paskaljević, a conversation with two drivers of heavy trucks from Cetinje was taken. The series originated in 1974. year, during the intensive engagement of Paskaljević in Belgrade television. As a young, promising and imaginative director, he works with great devotion on a series that depicts heavy and touching destinies of people. According to Filip David, our dramaturga, which at the time was the famous editor in Belgrade, Pascaljević imposed as a talented director, who had mastered his craft well. Therefore, he manages to find his own poetics through fate and a special angle that allows him to make warm and intimate film portraits of forgotten people. The series of destinies are simple, but mistral miniatures, which return us to the most important thing: goodness and compassion. / U ovoj epizodi serijala Sudbine, reditelja Gorana Paskaljevića, snimljen je razgovor sa dvojicom vozača teških kamiona sa Cetinja. Serijal je nastao 1974. godine, u vreme intenzivne angažovanosti Paskaljevića u Televiziji Beograd. Kao mlad, perspektivan i maštovit reditelj, sa velikom predanošću radi na seriji koja oslikava teške i dirljive sudbine ljudi. Prema rečima Filipa Davida, našeg dramaturga koji je u to vreme bio čuveni urednik u Televiziji Beograd, Paskaljević se nametnuo kao talentovani reditelj, koji je dobro savladao svoj zanat. Zbog toga uspeva da preko Sudbina pronađe sopstvenu poetiku i poseban ugao koji mu omogućava da napravi tople i intimne filmske portrete zaboravljenih ljudi. Serijal Sudbine jesu jednostavne, ali maestralne minijature, koje nas vraćaju na ono najvažnije: dobrotu i saosećanje.

programme.title: Optional / Neobavezno
programme.desc: Andre Malro (1901-1976), French writer, journalist and politician. After studying archeology, he goes to Indochina. He wrote for the newspaper that I also launched and in the articles was very critical about the colonial authority. He publishes his first novel's temptation in 1926. in France, and after that, the following are the conquerors, the Royal Road and Life Human, for which 1933 received the prestigious Goncourt award. Malro participated in the Chax Civil War, was the commander in the French Railway Motion, and after the Second World War, General Charlas De Gola, 1959, was the first Minister of Information and then culture. In the post-war period, he wrote novels Altenburg nuts, the voices of silence, antimonyo gods, antimamora ... in which he analyzed the problems of modern man in the spirit of the social revolutions and civil wars in the spirit of engaged art. Andre Malro is, in 1969, about his life and work, spoke in a special interview for Belgrade Television. / Andre Malro (1901-1976), francuski pisac, novinar i političar. Nakon studija arheologije odlazi u Indokinu. Pisao za novine koje je sam pokrenuo i u člancima bio je vrlo kritičan spram kolonijalne vlasti. Svoj prvi roman Iskušenje Zapada objavljuje 1926. godine u Francuskoj, a nakon tog, slede dela Osvajači, Kraljevski put i Život ljudski, za koji je 1933. godine dobio prestižnu nagradu Goncourt. Malro je učestvovao u Šanskom građanskom ratu, bio je komandant u francuskom Pokretu otpora, a nakon Drugog svetskog rata, u vladi generala Šarla de Gola, 1959. godine, bio je prvo ministar informacija a potom kulture. U posleratnom periodu, napisao je romane Altenburški orasi, Glasovi tišine, Metamorfoza bogova, Antimemoari... u kojima je, u duhu angažovane umetnosti analizirao probleme savremenog čoveka u zaoštrenim situacijama društvenih revolucija i građanskih ratova. Andre Malro je, 1969. godine, o svom životu i radu, govorio u specijalnom intervju za Televiziju Beograd.
