programme.title: Destiny / Sudbine
programme.desc: In this episode of the Series of destiny, director Goran Paskaljević, a conversation with two drivers of heavy trucks from Cetinje was taken. The series originated in 1974. year, during the intensive engagement of Paskaljević in Belgrade television. As a young, promising and imaginative director, he works with great devotion on a series that depicts heavy and touching destinies of people. According to Filip David, our dramaturga, which at the time was the famous editor in Belgrade, Pascaljević imposed as a talented director, who had mastered his craft well. Therefore, he manages to find his own poetics through fate and a special angle that allows him to make warm and intimate film portraits of forgotten people. The series of destinies are simple, but mistral miniatures, which return us to the most important thing: goodness and compassion. / U ovoj epizodi serijala Sudbine, reditelja Gorana Paskaljevića, snimljen je razgovor sa dvojicom vozača teških kamiona sa Cetinja. Kao mlad, perspektivan i maštovit reditelj, sa velikom predanošću radi na seriji koja oslikava teške i dirljive sudbine ljudi. Prema rečima Filipa Davida, našeg dramaturga koji je u to vreme bio čuveni urednik u Televiziji Beograd, Paskaljević se nametnuo kao talentovani reditelj, koji je dobro savladao svoj zanat. Zbog toga uspeva da preko Sudbina pronađe sopstvenu poetiku i poseban ugao koji mu omogućava da napravi tople i intimne filmske portrete zaboravljenih ljudi. Serijal Sudbine jesu jednostavne, ali maestralne minijature, koje nas vraćaju na ono najvažnije: dobrotu i saosećanje.

programme.title: Optional / Neobavezno
programme.desc: Andre Malro (1901-1976), French writer, journalist and politician. After studying archeology, he goes to Indochina. He wrote for the newspaper that I also launched and in the articles was very critical about the colonial authority. He publishes his first novel's temptation in 1926. in France, and after that, the following are the conquerors, the Royal Road and Life Human, for which 1933 received the prestigious Goncourt award. Malro participated in the Chax Civil War, was the commander in the French Railway Motion, and after the Second World War, General Charlas De Gola, 1959, was the first Minister of Information and then culture. In the post-war period, he wrote novels Altenburg nuts, the voices of silence, antimonyo gods, antimamora ... in which he analyzed the problems of modern man in the spirit of the social revolutions and civil wars in the spirit of engaged art. Andre Malro is, in 1969, about his life and work, spoke in a special interview for Belgrade Television. / Andre Malro (1901-1976), francuski pisac, novinar i političar. Nakon studija arheologije odlazi u Indokinu. Pisao za novine koje je sam pokrenuo i u člancima bio je vrlo kritičan spram kolonijalne vlasti. Svoj prvi roman Iskušenje Zapada objavljuje 1926. godine u Francuskoj, a nakon tog, slede dela Osvajači, Kraljevski put i Život ljudski, za koji je 1933. godine dobio prestižnu nagradu Goncourt. Malro je učestvovao u Šanskom građanskom ratu, bio je komandant u francuskom Pokretu otpora, a nakon Drugog svetskog rata, u vladi generala Šarla de Gola, 1959. godine, bio je prvo ministar informacija a potom kulture. U posleratnom periodu, napisao je romane Altenburški orasi, Glasovi tišine, Metamorfoza bogova, Antimemoari... u kojima je, u duhu angažovane umetnosti analizirao probleme savremenog čoveka u zaoštrenim situacijama društvenih revolucija i građanskih ratova. Andre Malro je, 1969. godine, o svom životu i radu, govorio u specijalnom intervju za Televiziju Beograd.

programme.title: The seventh art / Sedma umetnost
programme.desc: In this show the Seventh Art series, the editor of Snezana Zarić will introduce you to the image and part of Vitoria de Sike. The banking clerk, who is acquaintance with the daughter's owner of the theater, opened the way to the boards that mean, that he then discovered the charms of the Great Canvas where he started his career as an episodist. In the show you will see the recordings of Vitoria de Sike who talks about the beginning of your career and the people who helped him selflessly. There is also a collage of inserates of his films in which he was playing and directed by, as well as the saying of the famous director and actors he cooperated with. Knowers and Films of Film Arts will surely watch with a lot of attention because De Sika, who was directed by the 1940, the originator of Italian neorealism and in his post-war achievements can be seen by a nearly documentary approach to the topics he was processed. His four films, which directed were won by the Oscar: Shoe cleaners and bicycle thieves (honorary), while yesterday, today and tomorrow and garden fins - continents in the category best film in a foreign language. The films for which he received an honorary Oscar, are responsible for establishing the American Academy of Film Arts on a permanent prize for the best foreign film. / U ovoj emisiji serijala Sedma umetnost, urednica Snežana Zarić upoznaće vas sa likom i delom Vitoria de Sike. Bankarski činovnik, kome je poznanstvo sa kćerkom vlasnika pozorišta, otvorilo put prema daskama koje život znače, da bi potom otkrio čari velikog platna gde je karijeru započeo kao epizodista. U emisiji ćete videti snimke Vitoria de Sike koji govori o početku svoje karijere i ljudima koji su mu tada nesebično pomogli. Tu je i kolaž inserata njegovih filmova u kojima je glumio i koje je režirao, kao i kazivanja poznatih reditelja i glumaca sa kojima je sarađivao. Poznavaoci i ljubitelji filmske umetnosti ovu emisiju će sigurno odgledati sa puno pažnje jer je de Sika, koji je režijom počeo da se bavi 1940, začetnik italijanskog neorealizma i u njegovim posleratnim ostvarenjima vidi se gotovo dokumentaristički pristup temama koje je obrađivao. Njegova četiri filma, koje je režirao osvojila su Oskara: Čistači cipela i Kradljivci bicikla (počasni), dok su Juče, danas i sutra i Vrt Finci - Kontinijevih nagrađeni u kategoriji najbolji film na stranom jeziku. Filmovi za koje je dobio počasnog Oskara, zaslužni su što je američka Akademija filmskih umetnosti ustanovila stalnu nagradu za najbolji strani film.

His four films, which directed were won by the Oscar: Shoe cleaners and bicycle thieves (honorary), while yesterday, today and tomorrow and garden fins - continents in the category best film in a foreign language. The films for which he received an honorary Oscar, are responsible for establishing the American Academy of Film Arts on a permanent prize for the best foreign film. / U ovoj emisiji serijala Sedma umetnost, urednica Snežana Zarić upoznaće vas sa likom i delom Vitoria de Sike. Bankarski činovnik, kome je poznanstvo sa kćerkom vlasnika pozorišta, otvorilo put prema daskama koje život znače, da bi potom otkrio čari velikog platna gde je karijeru započeo kao epizodista. U emisiji ćete videti snimke Vitoria de Sike koji govori o početku svoje karijere i ljudima koji su mu tada nesebično pomogli. Tu je i kolaž inserata njegovih filmova u kojima je glumio i koje je režirao, kao i kazivanja poznatih reditelja i glumaca sa kojima je sarađivao. Poznavaoci i ljubitelji filmske umetnosti ovu emisiju će sigurno odgledati sa puno pažnje jer je de Sika, koji je režijom počeo da se bavi 1940, začetnik italijanskog neorealizma i u njegovim posleratnim ostvarenjima vidi se gotovo dokumentaristički pristup temama koje je obrađivao. Njegova četiri filma, koje je režirao osvojila su Oskara: Čistači cipela i Kradljivci bicikla (počasni), dok su Juče, danas i sutra i Vrt Finci - Kontinijevih nagrađeni u kategoriji najbolji film na stranom jeziku. Filmovi za koje je dobio počasnog Oskara, zaslužni su što je američka Akademija filmskih umetnosti ustanovila stalnu nagradu za najbolji strani film.

In the spiritual sense, Pjacola returned Tango to Arabal, the border zone in which Buenos Aires is lost in Pampasas and where European, African and Kreole cultures were created by Tango and Milonga. / Veliki majstor tanga i vrhunski inovator ovog žanra, Astor Pjacola, ovu igru je ukrao od umornih plesača, pospanih bandoneonista i nostalgičnih parodista i poveo je na svetsku turneju, kroz hrabru odiseju eksperimentisanja i oživljavanja. U duhovnom smislu, Pjacola je tango vratio u Arabal, graničnu zonu u kojoj se Buenos Ajres gubi u pampasima i gde su u sudaru evropske, afričke i kreolske kulture stvoreni tango i milonge.

programme.title: Adriatic Islands / Jadranska ostrva
programme.desc: Ivan Jurjevich Knez, Vinogradar, oliveber, fisherman, sculptor, painter, Masonry, Hunter, told his story of native Korcula. More than 700 years builders left a mark on this island, a lot was destroyed, but the new generations of neimar are considering. Loza and wine always meant life on Korcula. There is still a knight of the Moriška game, which used to play throughout the Mediterranean. There is a house in which it is, he is believed, grew up Marko Polo, and Legenda says that there was a court of Kirke's court on this island and that Odysseus stayed in it. / Ivan Jurjevič Knez, vinogradar, maslinar, ribar, vajar, slikar, zidar, lovac, ispričao je svoju priču o rodnoj Korčuli. Više od 700 godina graditelji su ostavljali trag na ovom ostrvu, mnogo toga je uništeno, ali stasavaju nove generacije neimara. Loza i vino uvek su na Korčuli značili život. Još uvek se tu izvodi viteška igra moreška, koja se nekada igrala na celom Mediteranu. Postoji kuća u kojoj je, veruje se, odrastao Marko Polo, a legenda kaže da se na ovom ostrvu nalazio dvor čarobnice Kirke i da je u njemu boravio Odisej.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: From Kornati, through Durmitor, Prokletie, Bačka, Obolje to Danube, through the canyon, went to Istria, a tireless television creator who was filming the RTB's in the very best of the most precious. / Od Kornata, preko Durmitora, Prokletija, Bačke, Đerdapa, od Homolja do Dunava, preko Tare, kroz kanjon Nevidio pa sve do Istre, vodili su putevi Milana Kovačevića, neumornog televizijskog stvaraoca koji je 60-ih i 70-ih godina snimao putopise, deo najdragocenije arhivske građe RTB-a.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: Krk island, next to Cres is one of the biggest pearls of the Adriatic Sea. The name of the Golden Island (Insula Aurea) received ancient times, thanks to the wealth of the country and the sea. The island was inhabited by Japodi and Liburna, Romans, Goti and Slavs since the earliest days. Located in the Kvarner Bay, the largest island of Adriatic Sea, framed by smaller islands, cliffs and ridges, interpreted by fertile fields, caves, bays, pebble beaches, lakes and rivers. The highest point of the island is 569 meters above sea level. Tourism is very well developed on the island and it is the main industry of the Krk. Since 1980. Krk island is connected to the mainland over Tito's bridge in length 1430 m whose works began in July 1976. Sponsorship of Josip Broz Tito. / Ostrvo Krk, je pored Cresa jedan od najvećih bisera Jadranskog mora. Ime Zlatno ostrvo (Insula Aurea) je dobilo još u antičko doba, zahvaljujući bogatstvu zemlje i mora. Ostrvo su još od najranijih dana naseljavali Japodi i Liburni, Rimljani, Goti i Sloveni. Smešteno u Kvarnerskom zalivu, najveće je ostrvo Jadranskog mora, uokvireno manjim ostrvima, hridima i grebenima, ispresecano plodnim poljima, pećinama, zalivima, šljunkovitim plažama, jezerima i rekama. Najviša tačka ostrva nalazi se na 569 metara nadmorske visine. Na ostrvu je veoma dobro razvijen turizam i to je glavna privredna grana na Krku. Od 1980. godine ostrvo Krk povezano je sa kopnom preko Titovog mosta dužine 1430 m čiji su radovi započeli u julu 1976. sponzorstvom Josipa Broza Tita.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Which island does the Latin name of Melita apply? Two significant shipwrecks occurred on this island: one Odysseus, and the other Sv. Apostle Paul. For a long time, the name of this island identified exclusively with Malta. And then ... at first, quiet, and then all the louder Echo truth echoed with the scientific world: Melita is actually Mljet, not Malta. The secret of this island continues to preserve the story of its legendary and mythological past. / Na koje ostrvo se odnosi latinski naziv Melita? Dva značajna brodoloma su se dogodila upravo na ovom ostrvu: Jedan Odisejev, a drugi Sv. apostola Pavla. Dugo vremena se ime ovog ostrva poistovećivalo isključivo sa Maltom. A onda... isprva tihi, a zatim sve glasniji eho istine je odjeknuo naučnim svetom: Melita je zapravo Mljet, a ne Malta. Tajna ovog ostrva i dalje čuva priču svoje legendarne i mitološke prošlosti.

programme.title: TV time / Vreme televizije
programme.desc: Ninety seventh episode series Television time refers to the genre in Belgrade television program since 1987. Including 1991. year. The editorial office of the Magazine Program until 1990 was operated within a broader-recreational program, and then renamed the contact program within a new, artistic-entertainment program. In programming documents until 1990. year as the basic task of the magazine program is raising entertainment levels and, quotes, information and vivals. In 1987. Ikarov flight quiz was launched - attempt to restore this type of program. Unfortunately, due to the way the issue of emission, as indicated in the editorial board report, the remarks of criticism and the public could not be met. The editor was Miloš Teodorović. The editorial office felt that one of its most significant results of emissions video club intended for youth. The success of the video club has contributed to the news from video production, rarity concerts of the pop and rock music and charming and modern inerpretation of young leaders. The editor was Dragoslav Ž. Savic. Cooperation with foreign televisions was achieved by TV bridges. They were so-called duplex programs in which television contents and the TV station were represented, which was established by a TV bridge, with the share of the program 50% to 50%. Thus, the emissions of Prague-Belgrade, Belgrade-Beijing (the first project, which Beijing television has realized with a foreign TV station), Belgrade-Warsaw, Belgrade-Lisbon et al. In the next episode we will testify about the work of the editorial office / Devedeset sedma epizoda serije Vreme televizije odnosi se na taj žanr u programu Televizije Beograd od 1987. zaključno sa 1991. godinom. Redakcija magazinskog programa do 1990. godine delovala je u okviru šireg Zabavno-rekreativnog programa, a potom je preimenovana u Redakciju kontakt programa u okviru novog, Umetničko-zabavnog programa. U programskim dokumentima do 1990. godine kao osnovni zadatak magazinskog programa je podizanje nivoa zabave i, citiramo, informativnost i životnost. U 1987. godini pokrenut je kviz Ikarov let - pokušaj da se obnovi ta vrsta programa. Na žalost, zbog načina pripreme emisije, kako je naznačeno u izveštaju redakcije, primedbama kritike i javnosti nije se moglo udovoljiti. Urednik je bio Miloš Teodorović. Redakcija je smatrala da je jedan od njenih najznačajnijih rezultata emisija Video klub namenjena omladini. Uspehu Video kluba doprinele su novosti iz video produkcije, raritetni koncerti pop i rok muzike i šarmantna i moderna inerpretacija mladih voditelja. Urednik je bio Dragoslav Ž. Savić. Saradnja sa inostranim televizijama ostvarivana je TV mostovima. Bili su to takozvani dupleks programi u kojima su bili zastupljeni i sadržaji Televizije Beograd i strane TV stanice kojom je uspostavljan TV most, pri čemu je udeo u programu bio 50% prema 50%. Tako su ostvarene emisije Prag-Beograd, Beograd-Peking (prvi projekat koju je pekinška televizija ostvarila sa nekom stranom TV stanicom), Beograd-Varšava, Beograd-Lisabon i dr. U narednoj epizodi svedočićemo o radu Redakcije

programme.title: Art evening / Umetničko veče
programme.desc: The show where Dragoslav Srejović, as he said, teaches his spiritual will. Explaining his human and scientific credo, Sretovic gives a completely specific view of archeology, as a layered and complex science. All his research, consciously or subconsciously, subordinated with aesthetic principles, which he considered primary and in the creation of cultural heritage. This is one of the last Srejović's appearances on television. Materials from the Gamzigrad Materials were used in the show - Seven questions about one late antique location and history of one discovery the imperial palace in Gamzigrad. / Emisija u kojoj Dragoslav Srejović, kako je sam rekao, predaje svoj duhovni testament. Objašnjavajući svoj ljudski i naučnički kredo, Srejović daje jedno sasvim specifično viđenje arheologije, kao slojevite i kompleksne nauke. Sva svoja istraživanja, svesno ili podsvesno, podređivao je estetskim načelima, koja je smatrao primarnim i u stvaranju kulturnog nasleđa. Ovo je jedno od poslednjih Srejovićevih pojavljivanja na televiziji. U emisiji su korišćeni materijali iz emisije Gamzigrad - sedam pitanja o jednom kasnoantičkom lokalitetu i Istorija jednog otkrića Carska palata u Gamzigradu.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Once the medieval structures of the cities were designed in relation to the defense against the attacking army; Today, they cannot resist many armies of visitors. The idea of the show is that through the prism of romantic dreams of the Adriatic Trash Snatk only one square - a long thousand miles, as our leader says. That square should be a syncretism of styles and spirits. Neimari east and west, they met in one place, but not in the same time. The coastal squares are the witnesses of that encounter. / Nekada srednjovekovne strukture gradova bile su projektovane u odnosu na odbranu od napadačke vojske; danas one ne mogu da odole mnogim armijama posetilaca. Ideja emisije je da se kroz prizmu romantičnog snoviđenja jadranskih trgova satka samo jedan trg - dug hiljadu milja, kako kaže naš voditelj. Taj trg treba da bude sinkretizam stilova i duhova. Neimari istoka i zapada, sreli su se na jednom mestu, ali ne i u istom vremenu. Primorski trgovi jesu svedoci tog susreta.

programme.title: Adriatic Islands / Jadranska ostrva
programme.desc: Stevan Krtinić lives on Brioni and cares about animals in the zoo. The archipelago has 14 islands, and the largest is Brion, who became known thanks to Titu and in which the whole archipelago was named. This island visited 600 guests every day. In his residence, Tito received the statesmen of 90 countries from all over the world. Brions are considered one of the largest salar reserves, many of the African statesmen. / Stevan Krtinić živi na Brionima i brine o životinjama u zoo vrtu. Arhipelag ima 14 ostrva, a najveći je Veli Brion, koji je postao poznat zahvaljujući Titu i po kome je ceo arhipelag dobio ime. Ovo ostrvo svakodnevno je posećivalo 600 gostiju. Tito je u svojoj rezidenciji primio državnike 90 zemalja iz celog sveta. Brioni se smatraju i jednim od najvećih rezervata divljači, mnoge su poklonili afrički državnici.

programme.title: Fantastic planeta / Fantastična planeta
programme.desc: The fantastic planet continues to explore in which state our civilization is today. This time on the road around the planet goes to the close and far east - United Arab Emirates and Thailand, as well as in Europe, to learn how the planet that doubled the human population supports it. In Thailand, Vladimir Banić lived a few days in Bangkok, where the traffic jams dictate people where to live. He visited Klong Toi Slum and learned how those who did not achieve sparkling dreams live in the most beautiful part of the capital, and he also traveled to the Mae Klong on the famous market and which moves and returns several times a day. The journey planet of the Earth is a fantastic planet continues in Dubrovnik, one of the most beautiful, but also the most obsessed cities in Europe. In this city, Banić finds out why everything and you have money for real estate, you can't have a neighbor in it, but also how the city that has always had the great flow of people, as well as whether the first contactless payment was created in this city. The fantastic planet journey ends in the absolute population growth champion - Emirates, who increased to ten million in 50 years. Vladimir Banić meets who the people who came on their Arab Slee area and whether the local population, which makes up only 10% afraid that the lack of oil in the future will go. / Fantastična planeta nastavlja da istražuje u kom je stanju naša civilizacija danas. Ovaj put na put oko planete odlazi na bliski i daleki istok - Ujedinjene Arapske Emirate i Tajland, kao i u Evropu - u Hrvatsku, da bi saznali kako planeta koja je udvostručila ljudsko stanovništvo u poslednjih pola veka to izdržava. Na Tajlandu, Vladimir Banić je živeo nekoliko dana u Bangkoku, gde saobraćajne gužve diktiraju ljudima gde da žive. Obišao je Klong Toi slum i saznao kako žive oni koji nisu ostvarili blistave snove da žive u najlepšem delu prestonice, a otputovao je i u Mae Klong na čuvenu pijacu koja je formirana oko železničke pruge i koja se nekoliko puta dnevno pomera i vraća. Putovanje planetom Zemljom Fantastična planeta nastavlja u Dubrovniku, jednom od najlepših, ali i najopterećenijih turističkih gradova u Evropi. U ovom gradu Banić saznaje zašto sve i da imate novac za nekretninu u Dubrovniku, ne možete da imate komšiju u njemu, ko su krivci sa overturizam, ali i kako je grad koji je oduvek imao veliki protok ljudi naučio davno da se nosi sa pandemijama, kao i da li je prvo beskontaktno plaćanje nastalo baš u ovom gradu. Fantastična planeta putovanje završava u apsolutnom šampionu rasta populacije - Emiratima, koji su sa milion u 50 godina porasli na deset miliona. Vladimir Banić tamo upoznaje ko su ljudi koji su došli po parče svog arapskog sna i da li se lokalno stanovništvo, koje čini samo 10% plaši da će nedostatkom potražnje za naftom u budućnosti, svi ti novi sugrađani otići.

programme.title: Serbian shrines in Kosovo and Metohija / Srpske svetinje na Kosovu i Metohiji
programme.desc: In front of the viewers, the episode dedicated to the monastery of a deep stream. The Duboki Potok Monastery is located in the north of Kosovo and Metohija, in Ibarska Kolašin, in the municipality of Zubin Potok. The church of the monastery dedicated to the importation of the Mother of God was built in the 14th. Century and during its long history was destroyed and renovated several times. The church was damaged and was rebuilt in 16th century, then in the first half of the 18th century, but unfortunately the damage was in recent times, during the conflict in Kosovo and Metohija. The Church of the Deep Potok Monastery has been expanded in 1868. years and the eyes were raised by the ends. Deep Potok Monastery is the only monastery in Kosovo and Metohija in which precious historical handwriting books are kept: the Fourmania, Official Minej and Proise Proceedings from 14, 15. and 16th century. The monastery also includes parts of the Holy Vrati and Damian, and especially the great reputation in the people has the hand of St. Martyr Nikita who was killed 372. years, known as the Holy Hand. Also, the monkery keeps the icon of St. John the Baptist from the 14th. Century. It is also important to note that in the monastery of the deep stream in 1891. The first school started working in the Ibar Kolašin. / Pred gledaocima je epizoda posvećena manastiru Duboki Potok. Manastir Duboki Potok nalazi se na severu Kosova i Metohije, u Ibarskom Kolašinu, u opštini Zubin Potok. Crkva manastira posvećena Vavedenju Bogorodice je sagrađena u 14. veku a tokom svoje duge istorije je rušena i obnavljana nekoliko puta. Crkva je stradala i obnovljena je u 16. veku, potom u prvoj polovini 18. veka, ali nažalost oštećenja je bilo i u novije vreme, tokom sukoba na Kosovu i Metohiji. Crkva manastira Duboki Potok je proširena 1868. godine i oke nje su podignuti konaci. Manastir Duboki Potok danas je jedini manastir na Kosovu i Metohiji u kome se čuvaju dragocene istorijske rukopisne knjige: četvorojevanđelje, službeni minej i zbornik propovedi iz 14, 15. i 16. veka. U manastiru se nalaze i delovi moštiju Svetih Vrača Kozme i Damjana, a posebno veliki ugled u narodu ima ruka svetog mučenika Nikite koji je stradao 372. godine, poznata kao Sveta Ruka. Takođe, monaštvo čuva i ikonu svetog Jovana Krstitelja iz 14. veka. Važno je napomenuti i da je u manastiru Duboki Potok 1891. godine počela da radi i prva škola u Ibarskom Kolašinu.

programme.title: Serbian shrines in Kosovo and Metohija / Srpske svetinje na Kosovu i Metohiji
programme.desc: In front of the viewers, the episode dedicated to the monastery of Budisavci. The Budisavci Monastery is located in the village of the same name in the municipality of Peja, Kosovo and Metohija. The Church of the Monastery is dedicated to the adoration of the Lord. The monastery was built at 14. century but never found who the cititor is. It is transmitted that the endowment of King Milutin, because in his Charter from 1318. It was mentioned that the monastery possession with the environment was donated to Hilandar, and according to the National Monastery, the endowment of Queen Jelena, the King Stefan's sister. The original painting was completely destroyed, and today's frescoes originate from the 16th century when the monastery renovated the Patriarch Makarije Sokolović. / Pred gledaocima je epizoda posvećena manastiru Budisavci. Manastir Budisavci se nalazi u istoimenom selu u opštini Peć, na Kosovu i Metohiji. Crkva manastira posvećena je Probraženju Gospodnjem. Manastir je sagrađen u 14. veku ali nikada nije utvrđeno ko je ktitor. Prenosi se da je zadužbina kralja Milutina, jer se u njegovoj povelji iz 1318. godine pominje da je manastirski posed sa okolinom darivao Hilandaru, a prema narodnom predanju manastir je zadužbina kraljice Jelene, sestre kralja Stefana Dečanskog. Prvobitni živopis je u potpunosti uništen, a današnje freske potiču iz 16. veka kada je manastir obnovio patrijarh Makarije Sokolović.

programme.title: About / Oko
programme.desc: In foreign policy, there are three principles that do not change - these are cynicism, double standards and hypocrisy, once upon a time when the Ambassador Darko Tanasković, its Chinese counterpart. Although a truce was concluded after the twelve-day war, Iran and Israel may change individuals, but the Zionist Politics will not change, Tanasković, Professor of Orientalistic. At the same time, he also noticed that the Iranian revolution and Montenegrin lithium launched the same feeling, a sense of abduction. The guest of the eye is Darko Tanasković tonight, a former ambassador of Serbia in Turkey, Azerbaijan and Vatican, as well as the Ambassador to the UNESCUE. Darko Tanaskovic is a professor, philologist, orientalist, academician, erudite, a man who speaks more than 7 world languages. / U spoljnoj politici postoje tri principa koja se ne menjaju - to su cinizam, dvostruki standardi i licemerje, rekao je jednom prilikom ambasador Darko Tanasković, svom kineskom kolegi. Iako je sklopljeno primirje posle dvanaestodnevnog rata, u Iranu i Izraelu se mogu se promeniti pojedinci, ali se neće promeniti ni cionistička, ni islamistička politika, primetio je Tanasković, profesor orijentalistike. Istovremeno, primetio je i da je Iransku revoluciju i crnogorske litije pokrenuo isti osećaj, osećaj obezduhovljenosti. Gost Oka večeras je Darko Tanasković, nekadašnji ambasador Srbije u Turskoj, Azerbejdžanu i Vatikanu, kao i ambasador pri Unesku. programme.title: A new beginning / Novi početak
programme.desc: We will meet twenty families that have smiled to start a new and better life in the new environment, a new house and on new jobs. Mary Veljkovic will lead us through these stories. Each family will have a budget of 1,200,000 dinars for the purchase of the house, and there is an additional budget (up to 500,000 dinars) with which I can start a job in his own backyard. Participants have only one day to choose a house and a 30-day deadline to move to the selected home. After that, their new job begins with the selfless help of the production team of the series a new beginning, in the form of an assistance of experts from various fields. Through the professional education and with an additional investment in their own business, the intention is for families to become economically independent in the new environment. / Upoznaćemo dvadeset porodica koje su se osmelile da započnu novu i bolju životnu etapu , u novoj sredini, novoj kući i na novim poslovima. Kroz ove priče vodiće nas Marija Veljković. programme.title: Fantastic planeta / Fantastična planeta
programme.desc: Vladimir Banić with a fantastic planet in the ninth episode travel to Italy, Brazil and the Great Britain to learn how to deal with different forms of crime in these cultures. In Italy, Vladimir Banić spoke with Atili Bolzoni journalism that reports 50 years of the mafia. Then the team goes to Calabria and the city of Kantanzaro, from the prosecutor Nikola Graceri, who lives 30 years under protection, hunting the Italian criminals in the entire Italy, but also the world. At the end of the trip by Italy, the Fantastic Planet ends in Tuscany, in the House of Karmel Musomeshi, a former bareforce that led a criminal organization that controlled almost half of Italy. After Italy, a fantastic planet travel even in Brazil, where he visits five Favela Rio de Janeira. / Vladimir Banić sa Fantastičnom planetom u devetoj epizodi putuje u Italiju, Brazil i Veliku Britaniju kako bi saznao kako se u ovim kulturama nose sa različitim oblicima kriminala. U Italiji, Vladimir Banić je razgovarao sa Atiliom Bolzonijem novinarem koji 50 godina izveštava o mafiji. Zatim tim odlazi u Kalabriju i grad Kantanzaro, odakle tužilac Nikola Gratjeri, koji živi 30 godina pod zaštitom, lovi italijanske kriminalce u celoj Italiji, ali i svetu. Na kraju putovanja po Italiji, Fantastična planeta završava u Toskani, u domu Karmela Musomešija, nekadašnjeg bosa koji je vodio kriminalnu organizaciju koja je kontrolisala skoro pola Italije. Posle Italije Fantastična planeta putuje čak u Brazil gde obilazi pet favela Rio de Žaneira.

programme.title: Serbian shrines in Kosovo and Metohija / Srpske svetinje na Kosovu i Metohiji
programme.desc: In front of the viewers, the episode dedicated to the monastery of Budisavci. The Budisavci Monastery is located in the village of the same name in the municipality of Peja, Kosovo and Metohija. The Church of the Monastery is dedicated to the adoration of the Lord. The monastery was built at 14. century but never found who the cititor is. It is transmitted that the endowment of King Milutin, because in his Charter from 1318. It was mentioned that the monastery possession with the environment was donated to Hilandar, and according to the National Monastery, the endowment of Queen Jelena, the King Stefan's sister. The original painting was completely destroyed, and today's frescoes originate from the 16th century when the monastery renovated the Patriarch Makarije Sokolović. / Pred gledaocima je epizoda posvećena manastiru Budisavci. Manastir Budisavci se nalazi u istoimenom selu u opštini Peć, na Kosovu i Metohiji. Crkva manastira posvećena je Probraženju Gospodnjem. Manastir je sagrađen u 14. veku ali nikada nije utvrđeno ko je ktitor. Prenosi se da je zadužbina kralja Milutina, jer se u njegovoj povelji iz 1318. godine pominje da je manastirski posed sa okolinom darivao Hilandaru, a prema narodnom predanju manastir je zadužbina kraljice Jelene, sestre kralja Stefana Dečanskog. Prvobitni živopis je u potpunosti uništen, a današnje freske potiču iz 16. veka kada je manastir obnovio patrijarh Makarije Sokolović.

At the same time, he also noticed that the Iranian revolution and Montenegrin lithium launched the same feeling, a sense of abduction. The guest of the eye is Darko Tanasković tonight, a former ambassador of Serbia in Turkey, Azerbaijan and Vatican, as well as the Ambassador to the UNESCUE. Iako je sklopljeno primirje posle dvanaestodnevnog rata, u Iranu i Izraelu se mogu se promeniti pojedinci, ali se neće promeniti ni cionistička, ni islamistička politika, primetio je Tanasković, profesor orijentalistike. programme.title: Pole / Poaro
programme.desc: Poiro is the English TV series filmed in 1989. by the novel of the famous agate Christ. The main character of the series, the private detective of Hercules Poiro, interpreted by David Caution. Poiro appears already in the first novel agate Kristi mystery in Stails, published in 1920. years. Very unusual, round heads, stretched shoes, a slight shoes, a little eccentric, often comic, solves the most frequent cases across the planet, often in a duet with Arthur Hastings. He was a member of the Belgian police in Mladost, but in 1916 he came to England as a refugee during the First World War and settled in Stail. So he got the opportunity to solve his first case on British soil. Agatha Kristi has been conducting him through 33 novels and several dozen short stories during a number of years. The last novel in which the curtain appeared, written during the Second World War, but published only in 1975. year, immediately before the death of the Queen Criminal novels. / Poaro je engleska TV serija snimljena 1989. godine po romanu čuvene Agate Kristi. Glavnog junaka serije, privatnog detektiva Herkula Poaroa, tumači Dejvid Sačet. Poaro se pojavljuje već u prvom romanu Agate Kristi Misterija u Stajlsu, objavljenom 1920. godine. Veoma neobičan, okrugle glave, uvoštenih brkova, izglancanih cipela, pomalo ekscentričan, često komičan, briljantnog uma rešava najzamršenije slučajeve širom planete, često u duetu sa Arturom Hejstingsom. U mladosti je bio pripadnik belgijske policije, ali je 1916. godine došao u Englesku kao izbeglica tokom Prvog svetskog rata i nastanio se u Stajlzu. Tako je dobio priliku da reši svoj prvi slučaj na britanskom tlu. Agata Kristi ga tokom niza godina provodi kroz 33 romana i nekoliko desetina kratkih priča. Poslednji roman u kome se pojavio je Zavesa, napisan tokom Drugog svetskog rata, ali objavljen tek 1975. godine, neposredno pred smrt kraljice krimi romana.

programme.title: Bells Besen's bells again / Ponovo zvone Bešenova zvona
Clump of land further / Grudva zemlje nadaljske
programme.desc: Professor at the University of Novi Sad, Dr. Lazar Rakić was one of the most prominent historians of his generation, whose rich scientific opus represents a valuable contribution to the study of our newer past. Born at the end of the 1920s, Rakić was educated during great ideological conflicts and fragments, who did not spare him nor his family, but he had completed his studies and became a great researcher of Serbs in Vojvodina, publishing more significant historical monographs. He was engaged in the history of Fruškogorje monasteries, as well as political oversmiths within the Serbian people in the area of today's Vojvodina, and also wrote the monograph of his homeland, onwards, which is still considered the best work of that type in our country. He visited the whole world, exploring fate and following the traces of members of his Night in their villobs on all continents, from California and Ohio in the United States, to Vladivostok in the northeast of Russia. Within the travels, he always carried with him the lump of land from Gender Following, which he sprinkled in the graves of his compatriots in the alien. The emission of the Documentary and Education Program RTV The Group of the Earth of the Siments will present the scientific opus and the life path of this our eminent historian, Dr. Lazar Rakić. / Profesor Univerziteta u Novom Sadu, dr Lazar Rakić bio je jedan od najistaknutijih istoričara svoje generacije, čiji bogati naučni opus predstavlja dragoceni doprinos proučavanju naše novije prošlosti. Rođen krajem dvadesetih godina prošlog veka, Rakić se školovao u vreme velikih ideoloških sukoba i lomova, koji nisu poštedeli ni njega ni njegovu porodicu, ali je on uprkos svim nedaćama završio studije i postao sjajan pedagog i predani istraživač istorijata Srba u Vojvodini, objavivši više značajnih istorijskih monografija. Bavio se istorijom fruškogorskih manastira, kao i političkim previranjima unutar srpskog naroda na području današnje Vojvodine, a napisao je i monografiju svog rodnog sela, Nadalja, koja se i danas smatra za najbolje delo toga tipa kod nas. Obišao je čitav svet, istražujući sudbine i prateći tragove pripadnika svog naciona u njihovim seobama na svim kontinentima, od Kalifornije i Ohaja u SAD, do Vladivostoka na dalekom istoku Rusije. Odlazeći na ta putovanja, uvek je sa sobom nosio grudvu zemlje iz rodnog Nadalja, koju je posipao po grobovima svojih sunarodnika u tuđini. Emisija Dokumentarno-obrazovnog programa RTV Grudva zemlje nadaljske predstaviće gledaocima naučni opus i životni put ovog našeg eminentnog istoričara, dr Lazara Rakića.

programme.title: First service / Prvi servis
programme.desc: The first service is the first Serbian pseudo-documentary series. It was broadcast for the first time in 2016. years and has notes over 200 recorded episodes so far. The action series takes place in a small car mechanic workshop owned by Hranislav Đrić, who is trying to lead a business in the service with the help of his Šegrt Mikica. His desire to do as little as possible is directly proportional to the costs that accumulate each day. With selfless support of the wife, the help of car dealers Safet Hranislav tries to climb a healthy branch and begins to operate legally. The problem is that no branch can bear the weight of its business ventures. Despite the fact that every business plan of these triplets end up in the canal, their neodustuction creates a number of comic situations. From another fit, the ability of actors to meet like cats and like a bird of phoenix again, race make this series irresistibly fun. In addition to the main characters, the series abounds in interesting episodists, of which the characters of Stojan Savić, Bosilj, Baneta and the banet and unsurpassed electrical lies are especially emphasized. This AlanFord's universe that has a car mechanical shop instead of the flowers and who recorded huge popularity on Ju-Tjuba, finally got its television life on the Radio-Television of Vojvodina. / Prvi servis je prva srpska pseudodokumentarna serija. Prvi put je emitovana 2016. godine i do sada beleži preko 200 snimljenih epizoda. Radnja serije se odvija u maloj automehaničarskoj radionici u vlasništvu Hranislava Đrića koji uz pomoć svog šegrta Mikice pokušava da vodi posao u servisu. Njegova želja da što manje radi je direktno proporcijalna troškovima koji se svakodnevno gomilaju. Uz nesebičnu podršku supruge Kaće i pomoć auto dilera Safeta Hranislav pokušava da se popne na zdravu granu i počne da posluje legalno. Problem je u tome što ni jedna grana ne može da podnese težinu njegovih poslovnih poduhvata. Uprkos činjenici da svaki biznis plan ove trojke završi u kanalu, njihovo neodustajanje stvara niz komičnih situacija. Sa druge stane, sposobnost aktera da se kao mačke dočekaju na noge i poput ptice Feniksa ponovo rode čine ovu seriju neodoljivo zabavnom. Pored glavnih likova serija obiluje zanimljivim epizodistima od kojih se posebno ističu likovi Stojana Savića, Bosiljka, Baneta i nenadmašnog Elektro Lazija. Zahvaljujući dopisničkoj mreži, brzom reagovanju i saradnji sa institucijama, ali i građanima - našim gledaocima, plasiramo vesti, izveštaje i reportaže iz različitih oblasti - privrede, poljoprivrede, politike, kulture, sporta, međuetničkih odnosa, ljudskih prava i dr.

programme.title: Zelena Prognoza / Zelena prognoza
programme.desc: This is a show where you can learn how to protect your agricultural cultures and get accurate and timely information. The green forecast is broadcast on the RTV program. / Ovo je emisija u kojoj možete da saznate kako da zaštitite svoje poljoprivredne kulture i da dobijete precizne i pravovremene informacije. Zelena prognoza emituje se na programu RTV.

programme.title: Arthery / Art-erija
programme.desc: In order to affirm and popularize the domestic cultural scene, the media does not pay attention to the Cultural Magazine of the Art and the City and the Province, but IM goes to the announcements, talks with influential guests, the actors of the most important daily events. Also, thematic approaches and processes important phenomena and segments of modern creation in the field of literature, theater, articles, film, music, architecture, museology. Provides the festivals, successes and the guests of artists in our country and the anniversary of the national culture, we add the news of the Day and in the world, and we pay for activities on the preparation of Novi Sad for the European Capital of Culture. In one place, the widest auditorium gets a picture of culture throughout the day. / U cilju afirmacije i popularizacije domaće kulturne scene kojoj se u medijima ne posvećuje dostojna pažnja, kulturni magazin Art-erija svakog radnog dana donosi najaktuelnije događaje iz umetnosti i kulture grada i pokrajine, ali im i ide u susret najavama, razgovorima sa uticajnim gostima, akterima najvažnijih dnevnih zbivanja. Takođe, i tematski pristupa i obrađuje vazne pojave i segmente savremenog stvaralaštva u domenu književnosti, pozorišta, likovnosti, filma, muzike, arhitekture, muzeologije. Progovara se o festivalima, uspesima i gostovanjima umetnika kod nas i u svetu, obeležavamo godišnjice i važne datume nacionalne kulture, sabiramo vesti dana kod nas i u svetu, preporučujemo i ukazujemo na vredne poduhvate, a poseban prostor posvećujemo aktivnostima oko pripreme Novog Sada za evropsku prestonicu kulture. Na jednom mestu najširi auditorijum dobija sliku kulture tokom dana.

programme.title: Most / Most
programme.desc: One evening of light on the bridge suddenly turned off, and when they turned on again, it was found to be exactly in the middle of him, at the border between Sweden and Denmark, is the corpse. The police, however, soon realizes that they are two corpses. At the crime scene, there are Danish detective Martin Roda and Young Saga Noren, which performs the same job in Malmo. The difference between them is huge. Martin is a police veteran, in the third marriage and has just performed vasectomy as he would no longer make children; As it turned out, it's too late. In contrast, Saga has elements of Asperger's behavioral syndrome, badly reads and interprets the emotions of other people, cannot be converted and often everything literally understands. Saga, however, has a valuable virtue: It is incredibly insightful, extremely analytical mind and very persistent. / Jedne večeri svetla na mostu su se iznenada ugasila, a kada su se ponovo upalila, ustanovljeno je da se tačno nasred njega, na granici između Švedske i Danske, nalazi leš. Policija, međutim, uskoro shvata da su u pitanju dva leša. Na mestu zločina nalaze se danski detektiv Martin Rode i mlada Saga Noren, koja isti posao obavlja u Malmeu. Razlika među njima je ogromna. Martin je policijski veteran, u trećem braku i upravo je obavio vazektomiju kako više ne bi pravio decu; kako se ispostavilo, ipak prekasno. Nasuprot njemu, Saga ima elemente Aspergerovog sindroma u ponašanju, loše čita i tumači emocije drugih ljudi, ne ume da se pretvara i često sve bukvalno shvata. Saga, međutim, ima dragocenu vrlinu: neverovatno je pronicljiva, izrazito analitičnog uma i veoma uporna.

programme.title: Plane / Aviondžije
programme.desc: Macan, Ceger, Nina and Medena work as a steward in one domestic airline. During the flights they fall into different adventures and meet colorful travelers who often have unusual requirements. Despite frequent disagreements, the stewards and other crew members solve all the problems with common forces. / Macan, Ceger, Nina i Medena rade kao stjuardi u jednoj domaćoj avio-kompaniji. Tokom letova upadaju u različite avanture i upoznaju živopisne putnike koji često imaju neobične zahteve. Uprkos čestim nesuglasicama, stjuardi i drugi članovi posade sve probleme rešavaju zajedničkim snagama.

programme.title: Closely / Izbliza
programme.desc: Incorrectly wealth near you have people who do selflessly do not save themselves, contributing to the well-being of the entire community to which they belong. / Neprocenjivo je bogatstvo u svojoj blizini imati ljude koji nesebično rade ne štedeći sebe, doprinoseći dobrobiti cele zajednice kojoj pripadaju.

programme.title: TV chiffon / TV šifonjer
programme.desc: This documentary emission represents us in an interesting way of some of the historical stories and events. / Ova emisija dokumentarnog karaktera predstavlja nam na zanimljiv način neke od istorijskih priča i događaja.

programme.title: Globus / Globus
programme.desc: The show where we provide you with a wider picture of the world's events. programme.title: Jungle / Urbán dzsungel
programme.desc: Emissions in Hungarian who brings various topics from urban life with the aim of providing the current viewers to the current and interesting content. / Emisija na mađarskom jeziku koja donosi razne teme iz urbanog života sa ciljem da dragim gledaocima pruži aktuelan i interesantan sadržaj.

programme.title: Cultural Magazine on Hungarian (Jelen -let) / Kulturni magazin na mađarskom (Jelen-let)
programme.desc: The deer-flight is a conceptual informative emission, and deals with cultural events, mainly related to the Hungarian national community, but also in other, important cultural events. / Jelen-let je konceptualno informativna emisija, a bavi se kulturnim zbivanjima, uglavnom vezanim za mađarsku nacionalnu zajednicu, ali i onim ostalim, važnim kulturnim događajima.

programme.title: Pallet in Hungary / Paleta na mađarskom
programme.desc: It is a choice of content prepared by the editorials of television in the languages of national communities. In order to approach each other, the pallet is broadcast in the languages of national communities, with translation into Serbian. Every working day we bring pictures and words from life, stories of ordinary people, events and process reports important for preserving cultural, linguistic and ethnic diversity in Vojvodina. Reports, lifesty stories, information, documentary emissions, events, problems and solutions ... Reality, instead of sensationalism. Affirmation of multiculturalism as a model of living together in Vojvodina. We offer viewers a diversity and credibility. We break through the language barrier, we look at ourselves and listen, to understand each other better. / U pitanju je izbor iz sadržaja koje pripremaju redakcije Televizije na jezicima nacionalnih zajednica. Da bismo se približili jedni drugima, Paleta se emituje na jezicima nacionalnih zajednica, i to s prevodom na srpski jezik. Svakog radnog dana donosimo slike i reči iz života, priče o običnim ljudima, izveštaje o događajima i procesima važnim za očuvanje kulturne, jezičke i etničke raznolikosti u Vojvodini. Reportaže, životne priče, informacije, dokumentarne emisije, dešavanja, problemi i rešenja... Realnost, umesto senzacionalnosti. Afirmacija multikulturalnosti kao modela zajedničkog života u Vojvodini. Gledaocima nudimo raznovrsnost i verodostojnost. Probijamo jezičku barijeru, gledamo se i slušamo, da bismo se bolje razumeli.

programme.title: 31. DFF Golden Gate 1. Part / 31. DFF Zlatá brána 1. časť
programme.desc: Zlatá Brána is a festival of children's games, songs, music and folklore and as such more broadcast more than a thousand participants from all Slovak sites in Serbia, as well as guests from abroad. / Zlatá brána je festival dečijih igara, pesama, muzike i folklora a kao takav svake godine okuplja više od hiljadu učesnika iz svih slovačkih mesta u Srbiji, kao i goste iz inostranstva.

programme.title: Iris / Duhovka

programme.title: furrow / Brazda
programme.desc: The emission of the furrow of viewers brings topics in the field of agriculture with useful advice experts, necessary for each agricultural farm. It is also intended for those whom agriculture is only a hobby. Isto tako namenjena je i onima kojima je poljoprivreda samo hobi. U prilozima se govori o raznim aspektima seoskog života u naseljima sa pretežno mađarskim stanovništvom.

programme.title: Rhomology / Romologija
programme.desc: Emission in Roma and Serbian, dedicated to education, permanent acquisition of knowledge and care for interculturality. programme.title: Macedonian sun / Makedonsko sunce
programme.desc: Macedonian Sonce is a semi-efficient show in Macedonian. It is processed by topics from all segments of the lives of Vojvodina Macedonians, in order to preserve the national and cultural identity of the Macedonian people in our country. Special attention is paid to the daily life of Macedonians, their problems, work and successes achieved in various fields. programme.title: Medicopter 117 - The Legs / Medicopter 117 - A legimentők
programme.desc: The exciting series of actions are a helicopter rescue team for adventurous days. During the deployment, pilots, doctors, paramedics must dwell on life and death, and have to solve unusual intervention situations. The twisted cake, the scenes that are often committed to hair stunts, and the unparalleled landscape of the Medicopter became one of the most popular film series. / Az izgalmas akciosorozat ket helikopteres mentőcsapat kalandos hetkoznapjairol szol. A bevetesek során pilotáknak, orvosoknak, mentősoknek egyaránt eletről es halálrol kell donteniuk, s nem mindennapi beavatkozást igenylő helyzeteket kell megoldaniuk. A fordulatos tortenetnek, a lelegzetelállíto jeleneteknek - melyekben sokszor maguk a színeszek vállalkoznak hajmeresztő mutatványokra - es a páratlan szepsegű tájnak koszonhetően a Medicopter 117 meltán vált az egyik legnepszerűbb filmsorozattá.

programme.title: Porsche SuperCup / Porsche Supercup
programme.desc: Porsche Supercup is an international competition competition founded in 1993. in the sponsorship of FIA. Six teams and 24 drivers move every year in the race for the winner's cup. At the end of the season, the driver with the highest number of points won is the winner of the competition. In addition to an individual award, a cup comes to the best constructor. / Porsche Supercup međunarodno je automobilističko takmičenje osnovano 1993. godine pod pokroviteljstvom FIA-e. Prema ostvarenom plasmanu na kraju svake trke vozačima se dodeljuju bodovi. Na kraju sezone vozač s najvećim brojem osvojenih bodova je pobednik takmičenja. Osim individualne nagrade, deli se pehar i za najboljeg konstruktora.

programme.title: Samra / Samra
programme.desc: Samra is a beautiful dancer, without a personal card and formal education. Live nomadic, in tents, rejected and depressed. When a deadly virus takes several children's lives, including Samrina's sister, the Nomadic settlement in Lebanon from Dubai is arriving a young doctor Thamer. Thamer is a wealthy and married English language professor, but soon is fascinated by samrina indescribable beauty and simplicity. After he saved her brother, Thamer became the only spark that he associates with her arms and hopes - that the day he will lose fear of love and replace his nomadic life with a warm family atmosphere worthy of a good man. Can honest love win all social and class differences? The director signs Rasha Shurbatji, and the main roles are played by: Khaled el-Sayed, Toni Issa, Nadine NasiB Nadi ... / Samra je lepa plesačica, bez lične karte i formalnog obrazovanja. Živi nomadski, u šatorima, odbačeno i potišteno. Kada smrtonosni virus odnese nekoliko dečijih života, među kojima je i Samrina sestra, u nomadsko naselje u Libanu iz Dubaija stiže mladi lekar Thamer. Thamer je imućan i oženjen profesorkom engleskog jezika, ali uskoro biva očaran Samrinom neopisivom lepotom i jednostavnošću. Nakon što je spasio njenog brata, Thamer je postao jedina iskra koja Samru povezuje sa njenim strepnjama i nadama - da će doći dan kada će izgubiti strah od ljubavi i svoj nomadski život zameniti toplom porodičnom atmosferom dostojnom čoveka. Može li iskrena ljubav pobediti sve socijalne i klasne razlike? Režiju potpisuje Rasha Shurbatji, a glavne uloge igraju: Khaled el-Sayed, Toni Issa, Nadine Nassib Njeim...

programme.title: Samra / Samra
programme.desc: Samra is a beautiful dancer, without a personal card and formal education. Live nomadic, in tents, rejected and depressed. When a deadly virus takes several children's lives, including Samrina's sister, the Nomadic settlement in Lebanon from Dubai is arriving a young doctor Thamer. Thamer is a wealthy and married English language professor, but soon is fascinated by samrina indescribable beauty and simplicity. After he saved her brother, Thamer became the only spark that he associates with her arms and hopes - that the day he will lose fear of love and replace his nomadic life with a warm family atmosphere worthy of a good man. Can honest love win all social and class differences? The director signs Rasha Shurbatji, and the main roles are played by: Khaled el-Sayed, Toni Issa, Nadine NasiB Nadi ... / Samra je lepa plesačica, bez lične karte i formalnog obrazovanja. Živi nomadski, u šatorima, odbačeno i potišteno. Kada smrtonosni virus odnese nekoliko dečijih života, među kojima je i Samrina sestra, u nomadsko naselje u Libanu iz Dubaija stiže mladi lekar Thamer. Thamer je imućan i oženjen profesorkom engleskog jezika, ali uskoro biva očaran Samrinom neopisivom lepotom i jednostavnošću. Nakon što je spasio njenog brata, Thamer je postao jedina iskra koja Samru povezuje sa njenim strepnjama i nadama - da će doći dan kada će izgubiti strah od ljubavi i svoj nomadski život zameniti toplom porodičnom atmosferom dostojnom čoveka. programme.title: An angel of revenge / Anđeo osvete
programme.desc: Santa Martinez is a woman of poor origin, married to Willie, with whom he has a son who wears his father's name. In order to further earn, the villa gives music classes to Daniela Kano, grandchildren of one of the most powerful lawyers in the country, Gaspar Kana. But Danielel's mother Barbara, although he married happily, throws around on Willie, trying to seduce him in all ways. The villa remains immune, but it reveals Daniel drugs. The two of them realize it as a threat, so they decide to solve him. When she invent that Villa raped Daniel, he in fear for a woman and child, asked the Santa to leave the country with his son. Although innocent, he gets 30 years in prison. The judge decides to reconsider the case, but Barbarian brother, Umberto, ordered his murder. Santi communicate that the villa was killed in a prison fight, but it doubts the official version of the story. So decide to take revenge into their hands. Will destroy members of a powerful family one by one. She came up with a plan, which is why he becomes the devil of Amanda first. Umberta will seduce, become his fiancée, and accuse him crime, so he will not be able to defend himself. Barbarians will destroy the marriage, and separate her from the child, and her husband George sent behind bars. It will make Daniel to admit to the truth, Gaspar and his wife will lead to poverty. But then the seductive Santiago, Umbert's brother, where he falls in love with her. It has nothing to do with the murder, but he is a member of the hated family, and Aamanda is in the dilemma. Will they allow to overwhelm love or desire for revenge? / Santa Martinez je žena siromašnog porekla, udata za Vilija, sa kojim ima sina koji nosi očevo ime. Kako bi dodatno zaradio, Vili daje časove muzike Danijeli Kano, unuci jednog od najmoćnijih advokata u zemlji, Gaspara Kana. Ali, Danijelina majka Barbara, iako srećno udata, baca oko na Vilija, pokušavajući na sve načine da ga zavede. Vili ostaje imun, ali otkrije da se Danijela drogira. Njih dve to shvate kao pretnju, pa odluče da ga se reše. Kada izmisle da je Vili silovao Danijelu, on u strahu za ženu i dete, zamoli Santu da sa sinom napusti zemlju. Iako nevin, dobije 30 godina zatvora. Sudija odluči da ponovo razmotri slučaj, ali Barbarin brat, Umberto, naručuje njegovo ubistvo. Santi saopštavaju da je Vili poginu u zatvorskoj tuči, ali ona sumnja u zvaničnu verziju priče. Zato odlučuj da osvetu preuzme u svoje ruke. Uništiće članove moćne porodice jednog po jednog. Smislila je plan, zbog čega najpre postaje đavolica Amanda. Umberta će zavesti, postati mu verenica, i optužiti ga zločin, tako da on neće biti u mogućnosti da se brani. Barbari će razoriti brak, i odvojiti je od deteta, a njenog supruga Džordža poslati iza rešetaka. Danijelu će naterati da prizna istinu, Gaspara i suprugu dovešće so siromaštva. Ali onda joj na put staje zavodljivi Santjago, Umbertov brat, u koga se zaljubi. Nema veze sa ubistvom, ali je član omražene porodice, a aAmanda je u dilemi. Da li će dopustiti da nadvalda ljubav ili želja za osvetom?

Excised through the fate of a married couple, this is actually a story about all of us, about modern families, about the divorce epidemic, about the loneliness of the modern man. The alphabet of our lives is a story about love, about missed lives, about disappointment, ostentation and repentance, about trying to catch at least a fraction of the Procedure of happiness. / U središtu intrigantne, zabavne, ali na momente i teške i tragikomične priče je urbana beogradska porodica i bračni par Popović. Azbuka našeg života je priča o ljubavi, o promašenim životima, o razočaranju, o otrežnjenju i pokajanju, o pokušaju da se uhvati makar delić proćerdane sreće.

programme.title: The alphabet of our lives / Azbuka našeg života
programme.desc: In the center of the intriguing, entertainment, but on moments and heavy and tragicomic stories is an urban Belgrade family and a married couple Popović. Behind Vesna and Uroš is twenty-five years of living together, in which, from the juvenile rapture and passion, they entered with student love, eager for a better tomorrow and success in a trivial society in which it is all permitted to reach status, career and money. Nevertheless, a quarter of a century later, after acquired all material goods, while their children are studying abroad, this seemingly ideal family, begins to break up. Vesna and Uroš then realize that they are in the fight for material - lost itself. Such, defeated and embarrassed, running away from reality, wander through love adventures, scams, lies, solitude, biting conscience and the crisis of their own identities. Through a dynamic action, frequent Fleshbekov, which evoke us otherwise, the past dimension of their priority, which enriches the drama of the main characters of the family and the crisis of the family and the crisis of our society, identity crisis. Excised through the fate of a married couple, this is actually a story about all of us, about modern families, about the divorce epidemic, about the loneliness of the modern man. The alphabet of our lives is a story about love, about missed lives, about disappointment, ostentation and repentance, about trying to catch at least a fraction of the Procedure of happiness. / U središtu intrigantne, zabavne, ali na momente i teške i tragikomične priče je urbana beogradska porodica i bračni par Popović. Iza Vesne i Uroša je dvadeset i pet godina zajedničkog života, u koji su, iz mladalačke zanesenosti i strasti, ušli nošeni studentskom ljubavlju, željni boljeg sutra i uspeha u trivijalnom društvu u kojem je sve dozvoljeno da bi se došlo do statusa, karijere i novca. Ipak, četvrt veka kasnije, nakon što su stekli sva materijalna dobra, dok im se deca školuju u inostranstvu, ova naizgled idealna porodica, počinje da se raspada. Vesna i Uroš tada shvataju da su u borbi za materijalno – izgubili sebe. Takvi, poraženi i posramljeni, bežeći od realnosti, tumaraju kroz ljubavne avanture, prevare, laži, samoću, grižu savesti i krizu sopstvenih identiteta. Priča prati paralelno žensku i mušku stranu. Kroz dinamičnu radnju, česte flešbekove, koji nam dočaravaju drugačiju, onu prošlu dimenziju njihove životne priče, zatim kroz voice-over naraciju koja obogaćuje dramu ličnim doživljajima glavnih likova, serija nam donosi iskrenu priču o veoma aktuelnim društvenim pojavama – o krizi porodice i međuljudskih odnosa, krizi srednjih godina, krizi našeg društva, krizi identiteta. Ispričano kroz sudbinu jednog bračnog para, ovo je zapravo priča o svima nama, o modernim porodicama, o epidemiji razvoda, o usamljenosti savremenog čoveka. Azbuka našeg života je priča o ljubavi, o promašenim životima, o razočaranju, o otrežnjenju i pokajanju, o pokušaju da se uhvati makar delić proćerdane sreće.

programme.title: Storm / Oluja
programme.desc: The shop is located in the period - a few days before the Operation Storm until the end of the operation, with an epilog, which is briefly displayed and the refugee life of our heroes and their navigation outside Krajina. The action occurs through two dominant lines. One follows the life of Ilija, deer and their son Petra. Ilija is a diversal that a storm is followed while on the front and Ilija from the War Hell is cramping tricked to return to the family. Ilija does not know that his wife and son is in the column, nor does he assume where and how their persecution will end. In search of them, Ilija loses his friends from the company and barely saves his own life. The second line follows the life of the former legionary of honor - Danet, the perfect soldier and the killer, who returns to the gender village after he learned that Ustashas killed his brother of the twin somewhere in Croatia. Dane Mother gives the promise to bring the body of his brother and will be buried in a family tomb. While Serbian troops are drawn up as the storm destroyed Krajina through persecution, in contrast, it is deeply pierceed towards the interior of Croatia, cleaning every enemy on the road, would not come to his brother's body and returned him home. The family represents the nucleus of these stories and through their suffering, escape, sacrifice and struggle, the whole context and horror through which the inhabitants of the Serbian Krajina are through. This story also abounds in episodes and images that are leaning into true stories, destinies and confessions of Krajina refugees. The vision from which the story is observed comes from the twelve-year-old Petra, / Radnja je smeštena u period - nekoliko dana pre operacije Oluja sve do završetka operacije, s epilogom koji se ukratko prikazuje i izbegličku život naših junaka i njihovo snalaženje izvan Krajine. Radnja se događa kroz dve dominante narativne linije. Jedna prati život Ilije, Jelene i njihovog sina Petra. Ilija je diverzant kojeg Oluja zadesi dok je na frontu i Ilija iz ratnog pakla grčevito pokušava da se vrati porodici. Ilija ne zna da su mu supruga i sin u koloni, niti pretpostavlja gde i kako će se završiti njihov progon. U potrazi za njima, Ilija gubi svoje prijatelje iz čete i jedva spašava sopstveni život. Druga linija prati život bivšeg legionara časti – Daneta, savršenog vojnika i ubicu, koji se vraća u rodno selo nakon što je saznao da su ustaše ubili njegovog brata blizanca negde na teritoriji Hrvatske. Dane majci daje obećanje da će doneti telo svog brata i da će biti sahranjen u porodičnoj grobnici. Dok se srpske trupe povlače i dok Oluja razara Krajinu kroz progon, Dane se, nasuprot tome, duboko probija prema unutrašnjosti Hrvatske, čisti svakog neprijatlja koji mu se nađe na putu, ne bi li došao do bratovog tela i vratio ga kući. Porodica predstavlja nukleus ove priče i kroz njihovo stradanje, bežanje, žrtvovanje i borbu prikazuje se ceo kontekst i užas kroz koji su prošli stanovnici Srpske Krajine. Ova priča obiluje i epizodama i slikama koje se naslanjaju i na istinite priče, sudbine i ispovesti krajinskih izbeglica. Vizura iz koje se priča posmatra dolazi od dvanaestogodišnjaka Petra,

U pokušaju da spase teren od najavljene gradnje a porodicu od selidbe, Ilija poseže za svim legalnim i nelegalnim metodama: odlučuje da sinove preko veze učlani u političke stranke, i u one na vlasti i na one u opoziciji, kao i, za svaki slučaj - u svet kriminala. programme.title: Dust / Prašina

programme.title: Mother / Majke
programme.desc: From fiction to documentary, this film brings us three different stories located in three cities in Macedonia. programme.desc: Upon completion of the Greek civil war, many fighters of defeated forces were sent to political persecution. Džulijus saznaje za svog brata tek kada napuni 35 godina i nalazi ga, a onda zajedno kreću u potragu za svojom majkom.

programme.desc: The day of jevies wedding turns into a great spectacle. The day of Jeviet's wedding is converted to the undecorated spectacle until then. programme.title: Past and present / Passato e presente
programme.desc: In the history of the Rome Rome the figure of Livia Drusilla, wife of Ottaviano Augusto, occupies a special place. Woman of power, he conquered fame and respect and left a decisive imprint on the future of Rome, entrusting his son Tiberius and his descent the control of the empire created by his wife. The Latin historians of orientation senatorial orientation, like Tacitus, have handed down a portrait of Livia full of shadows, accusing her of having plotted against the natural descendants of Augustus to encourage the power of his son Tiberius, had from a previous marriage. Other historians, such as Supponio, are more indulgent on his figure and describe long between Livia and Augustus not as a political deal but as a long duck history. In the studio, with Paolo Mieli, the historic Francesca Cenerini. / Nella storia dellantica Roma la figura di Livia Drusilla, moglie di Ottaviano Augusto, occupa un posto speciale. Donna di potere, si è conquistata fama e rispetto e ha lasciato unimpronta decisiva sul futuro di Roma, affidando al figlio Tiberio e alla sua discendenza il controllo dellImpero creato dal consorte. Gli storici latini di orientamento filo senatoriale, come Tacito, ci hanno tramandato un ritratto di Livia pieno di ombre, accusandola di aver tramato contro i naturali discendenti di Augusto per favorire lascesa al potere di suo figlio Tiberio, avuto da un precedente matrimonio. Altri storici, come Svetonio, sono più indulgenti sulla sua figura e descrivono lunione tra Livia e Augusto non come un affare politico ma come una lunga storia damore. In studio, con Paolo Mieli, la storica Francesca Cenerini.

Among these, Professor Jacopo Buongiorno, engaged in the development of advanced nuclear energy systems, Professor Paola Cappellaro, quantum computer scholar, Claudia Cea, inventor of a new type of neural system. Finally, Luciano Floridi, philosopher director of the Department of Digital Ethics of the University of Yale, tries to shed light on the complexity of the technological revolution that is changing our era. / Fjona Cakalli è volata a Boston, nel leggendario Massachusets Institute of Technology, una delle più prestigiose università al mondo, per svelare i segreti dellIntelligenza Artificiale grazie allaiuto di alcuni tra i massimi esperti del settore. programme.title: The mystery of the universe / Misterija svemira
programme.desc: Come with us to explore and execute what everything lies outside the bounds of our planet. This is a series of spaceships and stories, with information about the universe, about everything that surrounds us and everything we can see around ourselves, about how we can live in space, about what science says about the past and the future of the universe. Topics that series includes are: solar system, telescopes, stars, solar eruptions, asteroids, nebula, universe, black holes, jupiter, latest year, food in space, apollo 11, kuiper belt, Uranus, Seti, NASA, Laws in space, Solar winds, Neptune, Orbite, Orbite, Tide and Tide, Walking in the Universe, Space Way, Zvezdane Maps, Pluto. / Pođite sa nama da istražimo i razotkrijemo šta sve leži izvan granica naše planete. Ovo je serija o svemirskim temama i pričama, sa informacijama o univerzumu, o svemu što nas okružuje i svemu što vidimo oko sebe, o tome kako bismo mogli da živimo u svemiru, o tome šta nauka kaže o prošlosti i budućnosti univerzuma. Teme koje serija obuhvata su: Solarni sistem, teleskopi, zvezde, Zemlja, životinje u svemiru, Mesec, solarne erupcije, Habl teleskop, Nil Armstrong, asteroidi, komete, Venera, meteroiti, nebule, svemirski programi, crne rupe, Jupiter, Međunarodna svemirska stanica, svetlosna godina, hrana u svemiru, Apolon 11, Kuiper pojas, Uran, SETI, NASA, zakoni u svemiru, paradoks Fermi, solarni vetrovi, Neptun, velika crvena mrlja (na Jupiteru), orbite, Mlečni put, Saturn, plima i oseka, pomračenja Sunca i Meseca, pogled u prošlost, šetnja po svemiru, svemirsko odelo, zvezdane mape, Pluton.

programme.desc: The Mexican series based on true events, brings exceptional stories about special women. programme.desc: Emission The fruits of the plain is dedicated to farmers and agriculture. From the very beginning of the work of our media home, it is included in the program. Kikinda is an agricultural area and more and more, every household has a piece of arable land. Our goal is to introduce local manufacturers to introduce them to the general public, as well as with the products they offer. programme.title: New weekend morning / Novo vikend jutro
programme.desc: The new weekend morning in Pinko in the new television season leads Jovana Jeremić. Every Saturday and week from 05:45 to 10:45, Jovana will process all current topics from the country and the world with professional interlocutors and make the retrospective of all the most important events marked by the previous week. Within the weekend of the morning, the viewers will be introduced to new rubrics: Press a trial that implies the transmission of the daily press with a review of those topics that the most talked about; The right target through which Jovana will cultivate the topic of the morning; Believed or not, and this is a section reserved for those topics and events that have been surprising and surprised by the public; Within the TV Duel Jovan section, the two opposing parties will host the opportunity to express their opinion on the given topic; and a weekend mirror that represents a recapitulation of everything that marked the previous week. / Novo vikend jutro na Pinku u novoj televizijskoj sezoni vodi Jovana Jeremić. Svake subote i nedelje od 05:45 do 10:45 časova, Jovana će obrađivati sve aktuelne teme iz zemlje i sveta sa stručnim sagovornicima i napraviće retrospektivu svih najvažnijih događaja koji su obeležili prethodnu nedelju. U okviru Vikend jutra, gledaoci će se upoznati sa novim rubrikama: Press pretres koji podrazumeva prelistavanje dnevne štampe uz osvrt na one teme o kojima se najviše pričalo; Pravo metu kroz koju će Jovana obrađivati temu jutra; Verovali ili ne, i ovo postoji je rubrika rezervisana za one teme i događaje koji su začudili i iznenadili javnost; u okviru rubrike TV duel Jovana će ugostiti dve suprotstavljene strane koje će imati priliku da iskažu svoje mišljenje o datoj temi; i Vikend retrovizor koji predstavlja rekapitulaciju svega što je obeležilo prethodnu nedelju.

programme.title: A trap of love / Klopka ljubavi
programme.desc: The dark curse hangs over the rich family Develoglula. Her successor must be a boy, but for jihan, the successor of the family empire, children are just an unfulfilled desire. He doesn't believe in love. He married a marriage by arrangement and believes that it is simply impossible to be successful in business and in love. Love is a weakness for him. His mother Mukader, a ruthless guardian of the family tradition and the future, is ready to ensure his son of the heir. programme.title: Wine and viticulture / Vino i vinogradarstvo
programme.desc: The wine and viticulture was created in 2009. year and deals with the monitoring of winemaking, viticulture and wine tourism in Serbia and the countries of the former Yugoslavia. The show is intended for a very wide audience - winemakers and wine lovers as well as everyone who wants to see and learn something new and interesting from the world of winemaking and wine tourism. He is most committed to domestic wineries but also contains very interesting contributions on wineries from the space of the former Yugoslavia. Many wine experts and enologists were guest in it. It has greatly influenced the expansion of wine culture and drew attention to the importance and quality of domestic wine as well as the possibilities provided in the area. / Vino i vinogradarstvo nastala je 2009. godine i bavi se praćenjem vinarstva, vinogradarstva i vinskog turizma u Srbiji i zemljama bivše Jugoslavije. Emisija je namenjena jako širokom auditorijumu - vinarima i ljubiteljima vina kao i svima koji žele da vide i saznaju nešto novo i zanimljivo iz sveta vinarstva i vinskog turizma. Najviše je posvećena domaćim vinarijama ali sadrži i vrlo interesantne priloge o vinarijama sa prostora bivše Jugoslavije. U njoj su gostovali mnogi vinski stručnjaci i enolozi. U velikoj meri uticala je na proširenje vinske kulture i skrenula pažnju na značaj i kvalitet domaćeg vina kao i mogućnosti koje se pružaju u toj oblasti.

programme.title: Unpublished lectures Academician Mufti Muamera ef. Zukorlića / Neobjavljena predavanja akademika muftije Muamera ef. Zukorlića
programme.desc: Academician Mufti Muamer ef. Zukorlić was born on February 15, 1970. In the village of Orlje near Tutin. He finished elementary school in his hometown, and Madras Gazi Husrev-beg in Sarajevo. Studies of the Sheriatic Rights Philosophy) ended in the Islamic University of El-Emir Abdel-Kadir in Constantine (Algeria), Evogreza Kuran (Tefsir) at the University of El-Giant in Tripolija (Lebanon), and received his doctorate at the International University of Novi Pazar on the topic of the Academy - Evaluation, development and significance with special reference to the Bosniak academy of Sciences and Arts. He spoke fluently, wrote and read in Arabic, spoke Turkish, and served in English. He held more than 1000 lectures from the Islamic and the topic of collective and individual human rights, gave more than 800 interviews, had countless different media performances, participated in several hundred international scientific, cultural and political symposia and conferences. He moved to Ahiret on November 6, 2014. in Novi Pazar and buried in Harem Altun Alem Mosque. / Akademik muftija Muamer ef. Zukorlić rođen je 15.02.1970. u selu Orlje kod Tutina. Osnovnu školu završio u svom rodnom mjestu, a Medresu Gazi Husrev-beg u Sarajevu. Studije filozofije šeriatskog prava (Usuli fikh) okončao na Islamskom univerzitetu El-Emir Abdel-Kadir u Konstantini (Alžir), zvanje magistra stekao iz oblasti egzegeze Kurana (Tefsir) na Univerzitetu El-Džinan u Tripoliju (Libanon), a doktorirao na Internacionalnom univerzitetu u Novom Pazaru na temu Akademija - nastanak, razvoj i značaj sa posebnim osvrtom na Bošnjačku akademiju nauka i umjetnosti. Tečno je govorio, pisao i čitao na arapskom jeziku, govorio turski jezik, a služio se engleskim jezikom. Održao više od 1000 predavanja iz islamske i tematike kolektivnih i individualnih ljudskih prava, dao više od 800 intervjua, imao bezbroj raznih medijskih nastupa, učestvovao na više stotina međunarodnih naučnih, kulturnih i političkih simpozija i konferencija. programme.title: Linea verde: Estate / Linea verde: Estate
programme.desc: Prosegue il viaggio di Linea Verde Estate nel territorio compreso tra Udine e Pordenone, in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Un paradiso terrestre dove le acque del torrente hanno scavato piccole spiagge cangianti: durante un trekking lungo il torrente Meduna, si può ammirare lo straordinario spettacolo di una natura rigogliosa e incontaminata. Tra le eccellenze locali, a Tramonti di Sopra, si trova la tradizione della pitina, un prelibato salume. Il custode per eccellenza dei sapori e dei profumi: nello scenario del Collio, a Capriva del Friuli, passeggiando tra i filari, un racconto fatto di vino e di solidarietà. Il Castello dellXI secolo, considerato uno dei più belli dItalia, il Duomo e i caratteristici vicoli del centro storico di Spilimbergo offrono una visione di storia, curiosità e personaggi della città. I bagliori dellacciaio più famosi al mondo sono legati alla tradizione antichissima di produzione di coltelli a Maniago, unusanza che continua a tramandarsi di generazione in generazione. Il fascino di una tecnica millenaria è rappresentato dalla scuola dei mosaicisti del Friuli a Spilimbergo, dove si possono scoprire i segreti di questa antica arte. A San Daniele, in una delle aziende più antiche del paese per la lavorazione del prosciutto, si può scoprire una gloriosa filiera che ha conservato la sua artigianalità nel tempo e godere di un delizioso convivio con tutti i prodotti tipici del territorio. I sapori di una volta: nel borgo di Fagagna, nella latteria del paese, si assiste alla lavorazione / Prosegue il viaggio di Linea Verde Estate nel territorio compreso tra Udine e Pordenone, in Friuli-Venezia Giulia. programme.title: Fish on the cake / Hal a tortán
programme.desc: Stars again stick to the wooden spoon in the legendary Gastro Reality. The fish on the cake shows the color of the star world, who try to convince their dinner fellow that they are the best amateur chefs in the week. The housewife of the show, Bea Gáspár, provides the actors at the convenience store, where the cooking materials are obtained, but it does not make the stars harder with a screw. In the first week, his younger daughter, Flower, will also be the youngest host of the weekly field. Vendegei Anna Kelemen, András Szabo Csuti, Viki Szorcsik and Attila Kokeny will be. But in the next few weeks, the stars give each other the wooden spoon, Milan Valkusz, Lara Schobert, Smaltig Dalma, Judy, Csebnár, Fanni Halastyák, Cooky and Krisztián Zámbo can also be seen. / Újra sztárok ragadnak fakanalat a legendás gasztro reality-ben. A Hal a tortán felvonultatja a sztárvilág színe-javát, akik igyekeznek meggyőzni vacsoratársaikat arrol, hogy ők a legjobb amatőr szakácsok a heten. A műsor háziasszonya, Gáspár Bea jotanácsokkal látja el a szereplőket a kisboltban, ahol a főzeshez szukseges alapanyagokat beszerzik, ám neha egy-egy csavarral megnehezíti a sztárok dolgát. Az első heten ráadásul kisebbik lánya, Virág is megmereti magát, ő lesz a heti mezőny legfiatalabb házigazdája. Vendegei Kelemen Anna, Szabo András Csuti, Szorcsik Viki es Kokeny Attila lesznek. De a kovetkező hetekben a sztárok egymásnak adják a fakanalat, a teljesseg igenye nelkul Valkusz Milán, Schobert Lara, Smaltig Dalma, Judy, Gyebnár Csekka, Halastyák Fanni, Cooky es Zámbo Krisztián főzeset is láthatják a nezők.

The hosts of the tasty life, Adrienn Marton and Pataky Peter, also traveled the famous kitchens of the Great Britain, and also lead the life and the food. And he likes to share the minds with others, so the tasty life can be sure that they will not only be richer with new recipes, but also feel like rethinking a classic food. We'll show you how to make traditional dishes in a novel way, and what makes it more healthy to make it more. In addition to the simplest, cheapest, and most healthy defamation modes, he tells the ethnic torture, the effects of the Etel, and it also enriches smart kitchen tips. / Az Ízes elet nem egy klasszikus főzőműsor, sokkal inkább egy eletforma a konyhában.
