programme.title: With Tamara through Belgrade / Sa Tamarom kroz Beograd
programme.desc: The show with Tamarom through Belgrade provides viewers the opportunity to explore the sights, culture and hidden places of Belgrade through the eyes and stories of Tamara. In each episode, Tamara leads us together with their friends through the capital of the capital, revealing interesting locations, traditional and modern customs, historical monuments, as well as inspiring stories of local people. The TV project combines tourist recommendations, curiosities and anecdotes, providing a unique combination of education and entertainment for all those who want to get to know Belgrade better or remind the charms of this city. / Emisija Sa Tamarom Kroz Beograd pruža gledaocima priliku da istraže znamenitosti, kulture i skrivena mesta Beograda kroz oči i priče Tamare. U svakoj epizodi, Tamara nas zajedno sa svojim prijateljima vodi kroz ulice glavnog grada, otkrivajući zanimljive lokacije, tradicionalne i moderne običaje, istorijske spomenike, kao i inspirativne priče lokalnih ljudi. TV projekat kombinuje turističke preporuke, zanimljivosti i anegdote, pružajući jedinstven spoj edukacije i zabave za sve one koji žele da bolje upoznaju Beograd ili se podsete na čari ovog grada.

programme.title: When the leaves fall / Kad lišće pada
programme.desc: This strong family saga, based on the Romanes' Roman Pisac's novel, is brought by Nuri Guntekin, brings a deep and shake story of traditional values, generational conflicts and emotional struggles to keep you nailed to the screen. At the heart of the store is the Tekin family, led by a strict, but fair father, but Rız, whose values and moral principles collide with changes made by modern society. When the family moves to Istanbul in search of a better life, they face temptations that will change them forever. Daughters looking for their own path, the son who is torn between responsibilities and personal desires, is trying to preserve harmony - each character of their own decisions, and the family, sometimes strong and stable, just like the leaves falling. / Ova snažna porodična saga, bazirana na istoimenom romanu čuvenog turskog pisca Rešata Nurija Guntekina, donosi duboku i potresnu priču o urušavanju tradicionalnih vrednosti, generacijskim sukobima i emotivnim borbama koje će vas držati prikovanim uz ekran. U središtu radnje nalazi se porodica Tekin, predvođena strogim, ali pravednim ocem Ali Rızom, čije se vrednosti i moralni principi sudaraju sa promenama koje donosi moderno društvo. Kada se porodica preseli u Istanbul u potrazi za boljim životom, suočavaju se sa iskušenjima koja će ih promeniti zauvek. Kćerke koje traže sopstveni put, sin koji je rastrzan između odgovornosti i ličnih želja, majka koja pokušava da sačuva sklad - svaki lik nosi težinu vlastitih odluka, a porodica, nekada snažna i stabilna, počinje polako da se raspada, baš poput lišća koje pada.

All drivers drive identical Porsche 911 GT3 cars. According to the realized placement at the end of each race drivers are awarded points. At the end of the season, the driver with the highest number of points won is the winner of the competition. In addition to an individual award, a cup comes to the best constructor. / Porsche Supercup međunarodno je automobilističko takmičenje osnovano 1993. godine pod pokroviteljstvom FIA-e. Šest timova i 24 vozača svake godine kreće u trku za peharom pobednika. Svi vozači voze identične Porsche 911 GT3 automobile. Prema ostvarenom plasmanu na kraju svake trke vozačima se dodeljuju bodovi. Na kraju sezone vozač s najvećim brojem osvojenih bodova je pobednik takmičenja. Osim individualne nagrade, deli se pehar i za najboljeg konstruktora.

programme.title: Snuker - Shanghai Masters: Finals / Snuker - Šangaj Masters: Finale
programme.desc: International Masters Shanghai is a professional tournament in Snuker. The best professionals in this tournament compete for the title of the best, but also for a certain prize fund. Until 2018. This was a ranking tournament, and then it became inviting. / Internacionalni Masters Šangaj je profesionalni turnir u snukeru. Najbolji profesionalci se na ovom turniru nadmeću za titulu najboljeg, ali i za određeni nagradni fond. Do 2018. godine ovo je bio rangirni turnir, a od tad je postao pozivni.

programme.title: Endurance Moto Race: Holy Championship - 8 hours Suzuke: Race / Endurance moto trka: Svetsko prvenstvo - 8 sati Suzuke: Trka
programme.desc: Motorcyclists, teams and manufacturers unites the desire for success, and the World District Championship is a perfect place to show the performance of vehicles and driving skills. Find out who the race track in Suzuki best suits. / Motocikliste, timove i proizvođače ujedinjuje želja za uspehom, a Svetsko prvenstvo u izdržljivosti je savršeno mesto za pokazivanje performansi vozila i vozačkih veština. Saznajte kome će trkačka staza u Suzuki najbolje odgovarati.

programme.title: Bicycle - Turkish Turk: Stage 1 (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Poljske: Etapa 1 (M)
programme.desc: The race was first organized in 1928. year, and from then until 1952. it was held sporadically, after which it begins with regular annual implementation. Tur of Poland is considered a large European competition, as well as serious preparation before Vuelt. / Trka je prvi put organizovana 1928. godine, i od tada se sve do 1952. godine održavala sporadično, nakon čega počinje sa redovnim godišnjim realizovanjem. Tur Poljske smatra se velikim evropskim takmičenjem, kao i ozbiljnom pripremom pred Vueltu.

programme.title: Race Bikes / Race Bikes
programme.desc: Welcome to the show that leads you into the world of competitive mountain biking, exploring some of the fastest machines! Learn more about bikes and cyclists that move the borders and thanks to which mountain biking has experienced the right revolution. / Dobrodošli u emisiju koja vas vodi u svet takmičarskog planinskog biciklizma, istražujući neke od najbržih mašina! Saznajte nešto više o biciklima i biciklistima koji pomeraju granice i zahvaljujući kojima je planinski biciklizam doživeo pravu revoluciju.
